# AI driven content creation - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/ai-driven-content-creation#content-area)

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/ai-driven-content-creation#what-you%E2%80%99ll-learn)

**What you’ll learn**

*   Create compelling, high-performing content using AI
*   Develop your unique voice and perspective
*   Engineer and utilize AI prompts effectively

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/ai-driven-content-creation#stay-ahead-of-the-curve-and-boost-your-productivity-with-the-help-of-artificial-intelligence)

**Stay ahead of the curve and boost your productivity with the help of Artificial Intelligence.**

This training is your gateway to becoming a prompt engineer, armed with a formula for crafting thoughtful prompts so you can turn up AI’s full potential. You’re going to learn how to boost your productivity as a course creator or coach by using AI to help you create the content that normally takes you days… in seconds. [**Learn to use CoFounder to answer your questions, quickly create high-quality content for your business, and more.**](https://help.kajabi.com/hc/en-us/articles/16776393972379-How-to-Use-Kajabi-s-Conversational-AI-Assistant-Ama)
 ‍

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/ai-driven-content-creation#prompt-structure-the-who-the-what-and-the-how)

**Prompt Structure: The Who, The What, and The How**

**The Who:** Tells CoFounder the role they are to play or the job description it has. My favorite job descriptions are copywriter and digital marketer, but you could also use: Journalist, Project Manager, Speech writer… the list goes on. When you start off your prompt like this, it will respond as if it has these credentials & skills. **The What:** is exactly what task you want accomplished. You need to be specific about exactly what you want, unlike an ill-defined Google search. My strategy is to tell CoFounder exactly what I want but in the same breath… also exactly what I’m USING it for and WHO it’s for. **The How:** Is your opportunity to dictate the exact format, tone, and style you’d prefer the response to be in. This is what most people unfortunately forget, but it’s crucial if you want the chatbot to create content that sounds like it came from you. First, tap into your inner thesaurus to control the tone of voice, and style that you write in. Should it be written in a witty way? Passionate? Business-casual? Whimsical? Emotional? Assertive? Assigning these colorful adjectives to your prompt will not only significantly improve the responses, but also make them unique to your brand voice. Last, be sure to tell the chatbot how you want your answer formatted: A list? Spreadsheet? Summary? Detailed paragraphs? Step by step directions? **Example:** You are a copywriter. Create a short social media post perfect for Instagram that will captivate the attention of \[Insert your target audience\]. Write the caption with an \[insert tone\] tone of voice. ‍

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/ai-driven-content-creation#sales-email-prompt)

**Sales Email Prompt**

You are a copywriter specialized in writing high converting emails, with a decade of experience and millions of dollars in revenue as a direct result of your email copy. I want you to write a compelling sales email about \[topic\] that enhances the chances of driving conversions and generating revenue for my course called \[course name\]. My course helps people \[end result of your course\]. This email will be sent to my target audience consisting of \[target audience\]. For the tone, focus on urgency to purchase soon, however you need to be witty and provide value to the reader. In the first paragraph discuss one pain point my customers are facing. In the second paragraph add a call to action to purchase my course and how their life will be better when they do. In the 3rd paragraph include 3 bullets covering the benefits my course offers. Your sales email will demonstrate mastery over the most difficult aspects of email marketing: grabbing attention, maintaining relevance & personalization, striking the right tone, and overcoming spam filters. Your response should be a well crafted and convincing email that provides value to my potential customers who read it. Please also provide three subject lines for me to choose from. ‍

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/ai-driven-content-creation#sales-video-prompt)

**Sales Video Prompt**

You are a sales video script copywriter with a decade of experience and millions of dollars in revenue as a direct result of your sales videos.  Write a video sales letter explaining why \[Insert Your Target Audience\] should buy my course called \[Name of Your Course\]. My course teaches people how to \[Insert Detailed Description about the End Result of Your Course\]. The viewers should know this about me: \[Insert your qualifications\]. My course costs: \[Insert price\]. Your response should be an emotionally impactful winning Video Sales Letter script limited to 3 minutes long, inspired by techniques taught by the legendary Copywriter Stefan Georgi.  Your response will be structured as follows:

1.  INTRO
2.  RELATABLE STORY
3.  TOUCHING ON PAIN POINTS
4.  SOLUTION REVEAL
5.  SOCIAL PROOF
6.  CALL TO ACTION
7.  RECAP AND CLOSING

‍

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/ai-driven-content-creation#sales-page-copy-prompt)

**Sales Page Copy Prompt**

You are a sales page copywriter with 10 years of experience and your copy has led to millions of dollars in sales.  Your task is to write the content for my sales page explaining why \[Insert Your Target Audience\] should buy my course called \[Name of Your Course\]. My course teaches people how to \[Insert Detailed Description about the End Result of Your Course\]. The sales page visitors should know this about me: \[Insert your qualifications\]. My course costs: \[Insert price\].Your response needs to be SEO optimized with popular keywords in the \[Insert your niche\] niche. The long-form sales page content you create should be conversational, persuasive, and written in a storytelling format, inspired by the sales page techniques taught by the original conversion copywriter, Joanna Wiebe. ‍

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/ai-driven-content-creation#social-media-video-prompt)

**Social Media Video Prompt**

\*\*Prompt #1 \*\* You know everything about \[Insert your Niche\]. Create a list of 5 video ideas that \[Insert your target audience\] would be highly interested in watching. Each Idea should have a title, a caption, and an explanation of what happens in the video. Label each idea 1-5.  \*\*Prompt #2 \*\* You are a social media expert with 10 years of experience and your videos have been viewed and loved by billions of people. Your task is to fully write the content for \[Copy/paste the video title, caption, and explanation\]. Your response needs to be entertaining and worth watching. The first few seconds of the video needs to have a hook that captures attention. You have read and mastered the social media techniques and teachings of people like and related to Gary Vaynerchuk, Brendan Kane, Seth Godin, and Donald Miller. This video should be less than a minute long and formatted for \[Insert Desired Social Media Platform\] and at the end the call to action should be to click the link in bio. ‍ **Additional Resources**

*   **[‍Future Tools](https://www.futuretools.io/)
    :** To quote their website directly, FutureTools Collects & Organizes All The Best AI Tools So YOU Too Can Become Superhuman! This is how you discover new tools powered by artificial intelligence to make your life easier.[**‍**](https://www.leonardo.ai/)
    
*   **[Leonardo.ai](http://leonardo.ai/)
    [:](https://www.leonardo.ai/)
    ** [Copy.AI](http://copy.ai/)
     allows you to leverage AI to write your content and copy in minutes.[**‍**](https://kajabi.com/artificial-intelligence)

Your path to building a successful online business starts here. This guide walks you through the essential steps to get your Kajabi site up and running — from validating your idea to testing the purchase experience. Follow these steps, in order, to plan, launch, and scale your business:

1.  **[Validate your idea](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-1-validate-your-idea)
    ** — Poll your family, friends, and existing network to validate product market fit
2.  **[Customize brand settings](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-2-customize-your-global-branding-settings)
    ** — Update site settings with your brand colors to establish and align your brand’s visual identity across the platform
3.  **[Add instructor details](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-3-add-your-instructor-details)
    ** — Add an instructor name, a brief biography, and upload a photo to personalize your site
4.  **[Build a waitlist](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-4-build-a-waitlist)
    ** — Import contacts or build a waitlist funnel to begin promoting your product
5.  **[Connect payment integrations](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-5-connect-payment-integrations)
    ** — Connect payments to enable transactions from the start
6.  **[Create a product](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-6-create-a-product)
    ** — Create your first product to sell to your audience
7.  **[Price a product](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-7-price-your-product)
    ** — Create an Offer to monetize your product
8.  **[Design a website](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-8-design-your-website)
    ** — Customize your website and refine the customer experience
9.  **[Test the journey](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-9-test-the-journey)
    ** — Experience firsthand what your customers will see by testing the purchase flow

# Step 3: Add instructor details - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-3-add-your-instructor-details#content-area)

**Instructor details** — your name, photo, and professional background — appear on Course and Lesson pages and help build credibility with your customers. Add this information once in **Site Details** settings, and it links automatically to the Instructor Block on Course and Lesson page templates.

To add instructor information to a Course template or site page without a built-in Instructor Block, use sections and blocks in the Page Builder.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-3-add-your-instructor-details#update-instructor-info-in-site-details-settings)

Update instructor info in Site Details settings
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

When you create a Course using the Premier, Creative, or Prosper template and add an Instructor Block to your Product Sidebar, your information is pulled in automatically: ![Imported Instructor Info](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/6C2WUJiFcENaSgpZ/articles/images/02ef712c_28015229529627.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=6C2WUJiFcENaSgpZ&q=85&s=09f1b4bf82853d716b12b712151c9127)

**Note:** An Instructor image and name are required when linking the Instructor Block to your site settings. If those values are not completed, the Instructor Block will not display in your preview or for your course members.

1.  Open the **Settings** tab from your Dashboard.
2.  Click **Site Details**.
3.  Navigate to the **Instructor** section.
4.  Upload an **image** of the instructor.
5.  Enter the **instructor’s name**.
6.  Include the **instructor’s title**.
7.  Add the **instructor’s bio**.
8.  Click **Save** to keep and apply your changes.

**Note:** Adding instructor info in **Site Details** will not retroactively update your info in any pre-existing Courses. If you have already created a Course using a template with a built-in Instructor Block, update your information directly on the Course and Lesson templates.

# Step 1: Validate an idea - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-1-validate-your-idea#content-area)

**Validating your idea** before you start building saves time and ensures you create something your audience actually wants. A quick survey on social media can reveal exactly what your network is willing to pay for. Sometimes what you _assume_ your audience might be interested in purchasing might not be what they _actually_ will purchase. Let’s use Shelly as an example. Shelly is a personal trainer looking to start a few online courses for her clients. She regularly teaches her clients about nutrition and weight-bearing exercises. Shelly thinks her clients would like a mini-course about at-home weight-bearing exercises. However, when she talks to her clients, most express interest in meal prepping and fast, healthy recipes. This should be the topic for Shelly’s first course. Shelly’s glad she asked her clients so she could create a course that would be the most helpful and relevant for them.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-1-validate-your-idea#validate-an-idea-with-a-social-media-survey)

Validate an idea with a social media survey
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Validating your idea is easier than you think. Post a survey on one social media platform and get feedback in real-time.

1.  **Select a social media platform** — Choose the social media platform you use the most often and feel most comfortable with. Don’t worry about using a business social media account yet. It will take some time to build up a following of people you don’t know. The best way to validate your idea and get started is to leverage the existing network on your personal platforms.
2.  **Choose one social platform where you have the biggest personal audience**, such as:
    *   Facebook
    *   Instagram
    *   LinkedIn
    *   X (formerly Twitter)
3.  **Post a survey** — Many social platforms allow you to include a survey (sometimes called a poll) directly on your post. Using your personal account, post a survey to ask your current audience what mini-course topic they’d be most likely to purchase from you.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-1-validate-your-idea#survey-post-template)

Survey post template
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Hi everyone! As some of you know I’m starting my business on \[business topic or theme\]. I’m currently working on creating my first mini-course and need your help! Which one of the following mini-course topics would you be most likely to purchase?

*   Topic 1
*   Topic 2
*   Topic 3
*   Topic 4

Leave a comment if you have another topic you’d be interested in.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-1-validate-your-idea#faqs)

FAQs
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-1-validate-your-idea#what-if-i-don%E2%80%99t-use-any-social-media)

What if I don’t use any social media?

That’s okay. Create a one-question survey using a free service like Google Forms and email it to your contacts with a note like the one above.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-1-validate-your-idea#how-do-i-choose-the-right-topics-for-a-mini-course-survey)

How do I choose the right topics for a mini-course survey?

A mini-course is a shallow dive into a specific topic. Typically, a mini-course is one module containing no more than 5 lessons. A lesson usually consists of a video anywhere from 5 to 15 minutes long. For a mini-course, don’t include PDF attachments or quizzes unless you feel they’re absolutely necessary. Consider the customer problem you will solve with your mini-course. If the solution is five steps or less, that’s a great topic for a mini-course.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-1-validate-your-idea#what-are-some-examples-of-topics-that-are-specific-enough-for-a-mini-course)

What are some examples of topics that are specific enough for a mini-course?

**Good example:** Shelly and her meal-prepping or at-home weight-bearing exercise mini-course topics. **Bad example:** Using Shelly again, a bad topic (because they’re too broad) would be “improving your food habits” or “how to get fit”.

# Step 7: Price a product - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-7-price-your-product#content-area)

Your Product is ready to go and it’s time to get paid. Create an **Offer** to set pricing and start monetizing your knowledge.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-7-price-your-product#tips-for-pricing-an-offer)

Tips for pricing an Offer
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Pricing your services and Products is crucial to the success of your business because it impacts profitability, defines perceived value, and influences marketing positioning. Get it right — or at least get as close as possible and iterate as needed.

*   **Understand your value proposition** — Before setting a price, clearly define the unique value your Product or service offers. Consider what problems it solves or what benefits it provides to your target audience. The more unique and valuable your offering, the higher you can price it. Make sure to communicate this value in your marketing.
*   **Research the market** — Conduct thorough market research to understand how similar Products are priced. This includes analyzing competitors’ pricing strategies and understanding the expectations of your target customers. Pricing too high may deter potential buyers, while pricing too low might make your Product seem less valuable.
*   **Consider a tiered pricing model** — Implementing a [tiered pricing model](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/create-multiple-pricing-options-for-legacy-checkout)
     can cater to different customer segments. Offer basic, standard, and premium versions of your Product with varying features or levels of access. This strategy maximizes revenue and provides options for customers with different budgets and needs.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-7-price-your-product#create-an-offer)

Create an Offer
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  From your Kajabi dashboard, select **Sales**.
2.  Navigate to **Pricing**.
3.  Click **\+ New Offer** to enter the Offer Creation Flow.
4.  Enter an **Offer Title** and choose the **Product(s)** to sell with this Offer.
5.  Set a price for your Offer.
6.  Select **Save and Finish** to complete creating your Offer.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-7-price-your-product#customize-the-offer-checkout-page)

Customize the Offer Checkout Page
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Design the customer experience by customizing the Offer Checkout Page after configuring the details of your Offer:

1.  Open the **Sales** tab from your Dashboard.
2.  Click **Pricing**.
3.  Select the **Offer** you wish to edit.
4.  In the top menu, click **Edit Checkout**.

![Edit Checkout](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/Fky1o1xAW1UyWbKo/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-16-customize-offer-checkout-page-1785428683054.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=Fky1o1xAW1UyWbKo&q=85&s=7e0a4b3f81ff3a3082cd64c2a9c99314) [Learn more about editing the Offer Checkout Page](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/checkout/customize-your-checkout-page)
.

# Step 2: Customize global Branding Settings - Kajabi

> Documentation Index

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-2-customize-your-global-branding-settings#content-area)

**Branding Settings** let you control fonts, colors, logos, and social links from one place so every page on your Kajabi site reflects a consistent identity. Changes apply globally — across Website pages, Landing pages, Courses, Newsletters, Coaching programs, and Email templates — so you only need to set them once.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-2-customize-your-global-branding-settings#customize-branding-settings)

Customize Branding Settings
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Sign in to your Kajabi account and make sure you’re on the main dashboard.
2.  From the dashboard menu, select **Settings**.
3.  Click **Branding** to access all available customization options. ![Branding Settings](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/-IEuur07Sv6pI5G7/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-10-select-on-branding-1785429812505.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=-IEuur07Sv6pI5G7&q=85&s=34c030ec2b6b598c3a592b1a5724ad56)
4.  Within the **Branding** section, you can update:
    *   **Favicon** — Upload a file or select a recent file
    *   **Logo** — Upload a file or select a recent file
    *   **Typography** — Choose a heading font and a paragraph font
    *   **Colors** — Brand, Accent, Global Color Palette
    *   **Social Media Links** — Twitter, Instagram, LinkedIn, etc.
5.  Use the real-time preview to see how your updates will look before saving.
6.  Click **Save** to apply your selections across your platform.

**Note:** Brand changes will update items where the default global brand settings are used. Any themes or blocks that you have already customized will not change. Instead, go into those areas and sync the branding with these global settings.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-2-customize-your-global-branding-settings#preview-changes-in-real-time)

Preview changes in real time
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Kajabi’s real-time preview allows you to see how font and color updates will appear before you save them. This makes it easy to experiment and fine-tune your branding without committing to changes right away: ![Real-time preview](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/-IEuur07Sv6pI5G7/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-11-branding-preview-1785429812972.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=-IEuur07Sv6pI5G7&q=85&s=88861a863db3669e043d4ce91bc5ed18)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-2-customize-your-global-branding-settings#sync-style-elements-with-branding-settings)

Sync style elements with Branding Settings
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

While working within your individual pages, you may notice an unlink icon on certain style elements. If you decide to change an individual element linked to your **Branding Settings**, clicking this icon resets the Style Guide element to the default Branding Settings: ![Unlink icon](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/3Y-k0yYjJG6ZJVOo/articles/images/f00e6539_e9e7426c-be47-404d-b8f0-2561d1c67e71.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=3Y-k0yYjJG6ZJVOo&q=85&s=cf71fc6cae481d8159697a062fa7ff14)

Customize your website and refine the experience your customers go through before and after they purchase. Your website can be designed with Kajabi’s highly customizable page templates and streamlined templates built to help you get started fast. The **Website Builder** gives you full control over layout, branding, and content across every page.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-8-design-your-website#get-started-with-the-website-builder)

Get started with the Website Builder
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Select a template that best fits your design vision. Kajabi provides you with an ever-growing list of basic streamlined pages and premium-designed pages to help you get started: ![Website template selection](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/z1XYJHwJ4PoPwV6O/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-16-website-design-template-store-1785429596962.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=z1XYJHwJ4PoPwV6O&q=85&s=684c67f856ef23828992162214e94134) After selecting the template for your website, customize your Global Page Settings before diving into the individual design of your standard website pages. .

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-8-design-your-website#build-website-pages)

Build website pages
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Before you begin building your website pages with the Website Builder, understand the structure of your page. Pages built with the Website Builder and Kajabi Pages are made up of:

*   **Blocks**
*   **Sections**

Each Section of your page is made up of specific Blocks. For example, the Offer Section includes an Offer Block and a Text Block: ![Blocks and Sections example](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/6TANF4m79lK7BDqA/articles/images/9b80d5a9_29527905164955.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=6TANF4m79lK7BDqA&q=85&s=477de032bfea40a68cbf32600833fffe) Kajabi provides you with preset Sections containing specific Blocks to streamline the process of designing your page. Each section is customizable. Regardless of the Section you choose, you can always remove, add, and edit the Blocks within your chosen Section to create a page that best fits your brand and business.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-8-design-your-website#customize-a-homepage-with-the-website-builder)

Customize a homepage with the Website Builder
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Design a homepage custom-tailored to represent your brand and online presence. When visitors enter your URL, this is the page that will appear unless you have changed your settings in **Site Details**. With the Website Builder, create a homepage that is uniquely yours.

###

Access the home editor

2.  Click the **Pages** tab.
3.  Locate the **Home** page in your list of Website pages.
4.  Select the **Home** page to begin customizing.

Course
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Step 9: Test the journey - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-9-test-the-journey#content-area)

With a strong foundation in place, it’s time to experience firsthand what your customers will see. Test the **customer journey** by purchasing your Offer yourself.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-9-test-the-journey#create-a-test-purchase)

Create a test purchase
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Warning:** Test purchase and accidental customer purchase transaction fees are non-refundable. First, clear your cache and cookies from your browser and log out of your Kajabi account, or open a private/incognito window or use a different browser.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-9-test-the-journey#test-a-purchase-in-incognito-mode)

Test a purchase in incognito mode

1.  Open the **Sales** tab from your Dashboard.
2.  Click **Pricing** and select the Offer you want to test.
3.  In the Offer Status card, click **Get Link**.
4.  Open an incognito window and paste your link.
5.  On the checkout page, follow the flow of your customers by going through the process of purchasing your Offer.

After you submit your payment (or sign up for free, if testing a free Offer), you receive an email at the email address you entered on the checkout page. The email contains a login link to access the Product(s).

**Tip:** If you don’t want to charge your card you can:

*   Edit the Offer price to be free before testing the purchase
*   Create a coupon for the Offer that you can use to bring the price of the Offer down to $0.00 (an error will occur if the end price is between $0.01 - $0.49)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-9-test-the-journey#best-practices-when-testing-a-purchase)

Best practices when testing a purchase
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Only use the Offer Link (not the Preview link) when testing: ![Offer Link vs Preview Link](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/a1ySzUIhDWEC90Mt/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-18-offer-get-link-1785428496820.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=a1ySzUIhDWEC90Mt&q=85&s=489a2872a8315a66d3e09195738c5ded)

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-9-test-the-journey#always-use-a-different-browser-or-incognito/private-window)

Always use a different browser or incognito/private window

To successfully test a purchase, do not test on the same browser when logged in as an Admin of your Kajabi account.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-9-test-the-journey#why-can%E2%80%99t-i-click-the-purchase-button)

Why can’t I click the purchase button?

Make sure to exit out of preview mode when testing your Checkout Page. Testing a purchase in Preview mode will not allow you to make a purchase. Open a separate window and enter the checkout page URL excluding the `preview=true` piece of the URL.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-9-test-the-journey#use-a-different-email-address)

Use a different email address

Create a separate email address specifically for testing purposes. This allows you to use different variations of the same email address for tests you wish to perform on your site. If you are using G-Suite or any Gmail address, insert a ”+” character before the ”@” symbol and insert any verbiage you wish. This will send any applicable emails connected with your test to your Gmail inbox with a unique identifier. Example: `kajabihelpcenter+purchasetest1-date@gmail.com`

# Step 5: Connect Kajabi Payments - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-5-connect-payment-integrations#content-area)

Connecting Kajabi Payments and/or PayPal ensures you can collect payment for the value you offer your audience, from the start.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-5-connect-payment-integrations#kajabi-payments)

Kajabi Payments
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Kajabi Payments is an all-in-one solution that gives you everything you need to accept customer payments, oversee purchases, manage refunds, initiate payouts, and more — all from your Kajabi dashboard. Kajabi Payments is purpose-built to support an all-in-one experience. It includes exclusive features like additional payment methods such as Apple Pay, Google Pay, Afterpay, and more: ![Payment options available with Kajabi Payments](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/uG5M_9Irmb-dLu49/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-11-offers-payment-providers-1780204596551-1780240427908.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=uG5M_9Irmb-dLu49&q=85&s=f8e9baca5cf6b588b8fa0303cf21f8d8) With Kajabi Payments, your Checkout page enables customers to purchase your Offers effortlessly. They can either enter their credit card information directly on the page or choose from the additional payment methods you’ve selected. The payments are then processed and collected into your connected bank account, incurring a small fee that’s equivalent to major payment providers. [Learn more about processing fees](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/kajabi-payments-processing-fees)
. Kajabi Payments is currently available to businesses registered in the United States, Canada, Australia, the United Arab Emirates, the United Kingdom, and select European countries. [Learn more about Kajabi Payments](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/kajabi-payments-overview)
.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-5-connect-payment-integrations#paypal)

PayPal
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

PayPal is a worldwide online payment system that allows you to pay, send money, and accept payments with a [small fee](https://www.paypal.com/us/webapps/mpp/paypal-fees)
. PayPal uses data encryption and anti-fraud technology to help keep your information secure, reducing the risk of online fraud. PayPal is a well-trusted platform that services 200+ countries. Find out if [PayPal is available in your country](https://www.paypal.com/us/webapps/mpp/country-worldwide)
. With PayPal, your customers can purchase your Offers with their personal PayPal accounts or by creating a guest PayPal account. If you choose to connect PayPal to your Kajabi account, your customers can purchase your Offers using PayPal: ![PayPal checkout option](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/Y0-wARx9yh8Sk6QV/articles/images/ae3e4f4e_35934242761627.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=Y0-wARx9yh8Sk6QV&q=85&s=d3538f92b8f4746b1676ca42d5f91447) [Learn how to connect PayPal to your Kajabi account](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/api-integrations/payment-integrations/connect-paypal-to-kajabi)
 and begin pricing your Offers with PayPal.

**Tip:** Connect Kajabi Payments in addition to PayPal to give your customers the option to select their preferred payment method. [Learn more about enabling payment providers for Offers](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-turn-on-a-payment-provider-for-your-offers)
.

If Kajabi Payments or PayPal do not work for you, [learn how to connect a third-party payment gateway](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/api-integrations/payment-integrations/connect-a-third-party-payment-gateway-to-kajabi)
.

# Understand Downloads security - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/downloads/how-kajabi-protects-your-downloads#content-area)

Protecting your content is essential. The **Downloads Product** safeguards your downloadable materials with multiple security measures, ensuring only your customers can access them.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/downloads/how-kajabi-protects-your-downloads#how-downloads-security-works)

How Downloads security works
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Kajabi generates a temporary URL when a customer clicks on your download link. This temporary URL is created specifically for that customer and auto-initiates the download. A customer must be logged in to perform the download. The link cannot be copied, and if shared publicly, it cannot be used to download your content.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/downloads/how-kajabi-protects-your-downloads#what-makes-the-temporary-url-secure)

What makes the temporary URL secure

*   **Not guessable** - The temporary URL uses a secure, randomized format
*   **Hidden from the customer** - The URL is not visible or accessible to copy
*   **Regenerated each time** - A new URL is created with each download click, so shared links won’t work
*   **Expires after 1 minute** - After expiration, your customer must be logged in and click download again to generate a new temporary URL

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/downloads/how-kajabi-protects-your-downloads#faqs)

FAQs
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/downloads/how-kajabi-protects-your-downloads#can-customers-share-the-download-link-with-others)

Can customers share the download link with others?

No. The temporary URL is hidden from customers and cannot be copied. Even if a URL were shared, it expires after 1 minute and cannot be reused.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/downloads/how-kajabi-protects-your-downloads#do-customers-need-to-be-logged-in-to-download-files)

Do customers need to be logged in to download files?

Yes. A customer must be logged in to their account to generate a temporary download URL and access your files.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/downloads/how-kajabi-protects-your-downloads#what-happens-if-a-download-link-expires)

What happens if a download link expires?

If the link expires, the customer can simply click the download button again while logged in. A new secure temporary URL is generated with each click.

# Backstage Offer pricing - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/backstage/backstage-offer-pricing#content-area)

**Beta:** This feature is currently in Beta. Future entitlements and pricing are subject to change.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/backstage/backstage-offer-pricing#what-backstage-is)

What Backstage is
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

You promised transformation. Most of your clients got a course they never finished. Backstage is how you actually deliver on the promise. It’s the premium tier of the Kajabi suite. Sold like any other Offer, bundled with your existing courses, communities, or coaching programs. If you’ve been running Coaching, Backstage replaces it. It’s a superset that pulls the entire client relationship into one place… no more bouncing between Zoom, Voxer, Notion, Google Drive, and Calendly. [Learn how to set up a private client Backstage.](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/backstage/set-up-a-private-client-backstage)

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/backstage/backstage-offer-pricing#the-5%C3%97-rule)

The 5× rule

Backstage is included in our standard Kajabi plans. Each customer you sell a Backstage offer to uses one seat. Additional seats are $49/month each. The dream version: a $2,000/month client from content you already built. Here’s the math that gets you there. Price your Backstage offer at **roughly 5× your current top monthly offer**.

*   $200/month course or coaching program → Backstage at $1,000/month
*   $500/month program → Backstage at $2,500/month
*   $2,000/month mastermind → Backstage at $10,000/month

That math isn’t arbitrary. At $1,000/month per customer, a $49 seat is about 5% of the revenue each customer brings in. At $2,500/month, it’s 2%. The higher you price the offer, the more negligible the seat cost becomes.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/backstage/backstage-offer-pricing#why-premium-pricing-is-the-point)

Why premium pricing is the point

Backstage is priced for outcomes, not content. The people paying for it aren’t buying lessons. They’re buying the right lesson at the right moment, your direct attention applied to their situation, and the operational depth that turns a course they’d never finish into a program they actually complete. Your time, attention, and energy are finite. Years (often decades) of pattern-matching, focused on their problem, so they can skip the dead ends you’ve already navigated. That’s what they’re paying for. AI, courses, and group programs can’t replicate it. When you price Backstage low, three things break:

*   You attract the wrong customer (someone shopping for a deal, not transformation)
*   You burn yourself out delivering high-touch service at low-touch margins
*   You devalue what direct access to an expert is worth, for yourself and for every other Hero on the platform

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/backstage/backstage-offer-pricing#small-audiences-are-the-sweet-spot)

Small audiences are the sweet spot

Backstage doesn’t need volume to be profitable. A handful of high-intent customers paying premium can outperform hundreds of low-ticket buyers. Three customers at $1,000/month is $3,000/month in revenue. Five customers at $2,500/month is $12,500/month in revenue. The model is designed to make small, premium audiences profitable. If you only need 2 or 3 seats, that’s not a problem with Backstage. That’s exactly what it’s for.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/backstage/backstage-offer-pricing#when-backstage-is-the-right-fit)

When Backstage is the right fit

Backstage works best when:

*   You have an audience that already trusts your expertise
*   Your audience would pay a premium specifically to be closer to _you_
*   You’re ready to deliver personal value to a smaller group of high-intent buyers

**Backstage might not be the right product if:**

*   You’re early in building your audience and trust hasn’t formed yet
*   Your offer is primarily content or curriculum (Courses, Coaching, or Communities are better matches)
*   You want to scale to thousands of buyers at a low price point (Products and Communities are built for that)

If you’re not there yet, that’s not a problem. Other Kajabi products will serve you better until you’re ready to charge a premium for direct access.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/backstage/backstage-offer-pricing#a-note-on-seat-costs)

A note on seat costs

The $49/seat/mo price reflects what Backstage delivers. If it feels steep, the offer is the problem. Your expertise is worth more than you’re charging for it.

# Compare Downloads Product and Course downloads - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/downloads/difference-between-the-downloads-product-and-downloads-in-a-course-product#content-area)

Kajabi offers two ways to deliver downloadable content — the standalone **Downloads Product** and file attachments within a Course. Each option serves a different purpose, so choosing the right one depends on how you want to package and deliver your content.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/downloads/difference-between-the-downloads-product-and-downloads-in-a-course-product#what-is-the-downloads-product)

What is the Downloads Product?
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The Downloads Product is a [Kajabi Product Type](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/products-overview/kajabi-products-overview)
 like Course Products, Coaching, Communities, Podcasts, and Newsletters. ![Downloads Product](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/T7HThu_bu5xEvH2P/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-14-downloads-product-overview-1785428381731.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=T7HThu_bu5xEvH2P&q=85&s=c88385d4d40ba153d9819b07d3a0b67f) By creating a Downloads Product, you can package your downloadable content and connect it to an Offer to monetize it. Connecting your Downloads Product to an Offer allows you to create any type of packaging that best fits your business model. With Offers, you can deliver your downloadable content as an add-on or offer it as a higher-tiered package with additional product types included. [Learn more about the Downloads Product](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/downloads/create-sell-downloadable-files-as-a-product)
.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/downloads/difference-between-the-downloads-product-and-downloads-in-a-course-product#what-are-downloads-in-a-course)

What are downloads in a Course?
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Downloads in a Course are exclusively connected to the Course through individual lessons. With downloads in a Course, you can provide additional resources to supplement your lesson. ![Downloads in Course](https://mintlify.s3.us-west-1.amazonaws.com/kajabi-support/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-7-what-is-the-difference-between-the-downloads-product-and-downloads-in-a-course-product-kajabi-help-center17278020521121727806409067-1744235839248-1756080392090-1765851433103-1768530398353-1769338597532-1775382380735-1781160453870.png) [Learn to add downloadable files to your Course](https://help.kajabi.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037641793)
.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/downloads/difference-between-the-downloads-product-and-downloads-in-a-course-product#faqs)

FAQs
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/downloads/difference-between-the-downloads-product-and-downloads-in-a-course-product#when-should-i-use-the-downloads-product-instead-of-course-downloads)

When should I use the Downloads Product instead of Course downloads?

Use the Downloads Product when you want to sell standalone downloadable content connected to its own Offer. Use Course downloads when you want to supplement existing Course lessons with additional resources.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/downloads/difference-between-the-downloads-product-and-downloads-in-a-course-product#can-i-use-both-the-downloads-product-and-course-downloads-together)

Can I use both the Downloads Product and Course downloads together?

Yes. You can create a Downloads Product for standalone downloadable content and also attach files to individual Course lessons. Both can be packaged into Offers to fit your business model.

# Remove a Podcast from third-party platforms - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/podcasts/how-to-remove-your-podcast-from-third-party-platforms#content-area)

Deleting a **Podcast** from your Kajabi account may not automatically remove it from third-party platforms where you’ve distributed it. If you’ve connected your Podcast RSS feed to a third-party distributor such as Apple Podcasts, Google Podcasts, or Spotify, further action may be needed to remove it from each platform.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/podcasts/how-to-remove-your-podcast-from-third-party-platforms#apple-podcasts)

Apple Podcasts
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Archive your Podcast content on [Apple Podcasts Connect](https://podcastsconnect.apple.com/login)
 by following the procedure in the [Apple Podcasts for Creators Support Center](https://podcasters.apple.com/support/901-archive-or-restore-a-channel-podcast-or-episode)
.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/podcasts/how-to-remove-your-podcast-from-third-party-platforms#google-podcasts)

Google Podcasts
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Per the [Podcasts Manager Help Center](https://support.google.com/podcast-publishers/answer/9482981#remove_podcast&zippy=%2Cremove-a-podcast-from-google)
, Google will remove your Podcast from [Google Podcast Manager](https://podcastsmanager.google.com/about?hl=en)
 3-4 weeks after you delete your RSS feed in Kajabi.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/podcasts/how-to-remove-your-podcast-from-third-party-platforms#spotify)

Spotify
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

If your Podcast still appears on [Spotify for Podcasters](https://podcasters.spotify.com/)
, submit both your RSS feed link and the link to your Spotify Podcast to [Spotify Support](https://help.spotifyforpodcasters.com/hc/en-us/articles/12611097424923-Removing-your-podcast-from-Spotify)
 and they’ll remove it for you.

# Redirect a Podcast - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/podcasts/redirecting-your-podcast#content-area)

Kajabi uses a [301 redirect](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/crawling-indexing/301-redirects?visit_id=638025361412132985-2305525764&rd=1)
 to tell your subscribers and Podcast listings that your Podcast has moved to a new RSS feed. Your feed address is referenced by websites, newsfeed readers, podcatchers (such as iTunes podcast directory), and apps. Redirecting your Podcast off of Kajabi means that Kajabi will no longer host your Podcast, and any future updates must be made through your new Podcast provider. This also means that any updates you make to your Podcast on Kajabi after implementing the redirect will not take effect, and must be executed through your new Podcast provider. If applicable, we recommend changing any links in your Kajabi hosted websites, landing pages, and emails to reflect the new Podcast destination.

**Warning:** Proceed with caution, as this action cannot be undone except through our support team. Ensure you are redirecting to the correct URL. Undoing this action via our support team may result in your customers being unable to find and access your Podcast.

We recommend that you leave a redirect in place for 2-3 weeks to ensure your listings and subscribers have moved to your new provider. Do not place a 301 redirect with your new Podcast hosting provider.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/podcasts/redirecting-your-podcast#redirect-a-podcast)

Redirect a Podcast
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

To redirect a Podcast off of Kajabi:

1.  Open the **Products** tab from your dashboard
2.  Click **Podcasts**
3.  Select the Podcast you wish to redirect
4.  Click the **Settings** tab
5.  Scroll down to the **Migrate your podcast** section
6.  Click the **Configure Migration Settings** toggle **On**
7.  Insert your new URL into the **URL Redirect** field. Be sure to double check that you’ve entered the correct URL
8.  Click **Save** to keep your changes

# Listen to a private Podcast on the Apple Podcast app - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
>

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/podcasts/how-to-listen-to-a-private-podcast-on-the-apple-podcast-app#content-area)

Your customers can listen to your **private Podcast** on their favorite listening apps, including Apple Podcasts. Customers access a unique private Podcast URL from their subscription confirmation email and add it to the Apple Podcast app.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/podcasts/how-to-listen-to-a-private-podcast-on-the-apple-podcast-app#access-the-private-podcast-url)

Access the private Podcast URL
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

When a customer purchases your private podcast, they will receive an email that provides a link that will send them to a login page. Once they have logged in, they can access the podcast from the library. Below the login link, there will be a **private podcast URL** that contains an access token specific to that customer: ![Private Podcast URL in email](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/PSl7XzyvfgSe-sdv/articles/images/3c035428_4403299575707.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=PSl7XzyvfgSe-sdv&q=85&s=0a1842a670edfca571aaccaec9f6e845)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/podcasts/how-to-listen-to-a-private-podcast-on-the-apple-podcast-app#access-private-podcasts-in-the-apple-podcast-app)

Access private Podcasts in the Apple Podcast app
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

To listen to your podcast on the Apple Podcast app, paste the private podcast URL into the app. This can be done via desktop or mobile.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/podcasts/how-to-listen-to-a-private-podcast-on-the-apple-podcast-app#listen-to-a-private-podcast-in-the-mobile-apple-podcast-app)

Listen to a private Podcast in the mobile Apple Podcast app

1.  Copy the **Private Podcast URL** from inside the subscription confirmation email
2.  Open the Apple Podcast app and click the **Library** tab
3.  Click **Edit** in the top right corner and select **Add Show by URL**
4.  Paste the Private Podcast URL into the text box and then click **Follow**
5.  The show will then appear in your library

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/podcasts/how-to-listen-to-a-private-podcast-on-the-apple-podcast-app#listen-to-a-private-podcast-in-the-apple-podcast-app-via-desktop)

Listen to a private Podcast in the Apple Podcast app via desktop

1.  Copy the **Private Podcast URL** from inside the subscription confirmation email
2.  Open the Apple Podcast app
3.  Open the File from the main menu and select **Add Show by URL**
4.  Paste the Private Podcast URL into the text box and select **Follow**
5.  The show will then appear in your Library

# Grow Newsletter subscribers - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/newsletters/how-to-grow-your-newsletter-subscribers#content-area)

Building a strong **subscriber base** is essential for expanding your reach and nurturing meaningful connections with your audience. Whether you are starting out or looking to boost your subscriber count, these strategies can help.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/newsletters/how-to-grow-your-newsletter-subscribers#define-a-value-proposition)

Define a value proposition
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Before promoting your Newsletter, clearly define what value you offer to subscribers. Ask yourself: What unique insights, knowledge, or benefits do you provide? Understanding your value proposition helps you attract the right audience.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/newsletters/how-to-grow-your-newsletter-subscribers#create-compelling-opt-in-incentives)

Create compelling opt-in incentives
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Entice visitors to subscribe by offering valuable incentives such as exclusive content. Make sure your opt-in incentives align with your audience’s interests and address their needs or pain points.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/newsletters/how-to-grow-your-newsletter-subscribers#leverage-social-media)

Leverage social media
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Harness the power of social media to reach a wider audience and drive traffic to your Newsletter signup page. Share snippets of your Newsletter content, engage with your followers, and utilize targeted advertising to promote your Newsletter effectively.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/newsletters/how-to-grow-your-newsletter-subscribers#collaborate-with-influencers-or-partners)

Collaborate with influencers or partners
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Partner with influencers, bloggers, or complementary businesses in your niche to reach audiences beyond your own. Guest blog posts, joint webinars, or co-hosted events can expose your Newsletter to a broader network of potential subscribers.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/newsletters/how-to-grow-your-newsletter-subscribers#optimize-for-seo)

Optimize for SEO
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Optimize your content for search engines to increase visibility and attract organic traffic. Create valuable, keyword-rich content that addresses your audience’s interests and includes clear calls-to-action prompting visitors to subscribe.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/newsletters/how-to-grow-your-newsletter-subscribers#encourage-referrals)

Encourage referrals
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Encourage your existing subscribers to refer friends, colleagues, or family members to your Newsletter.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/newsletters/how-to-grow-your-newsletter-subscribers#analyze-and-iterate)

Analyze and iterate
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Regularly monitor your subscriber growth and engagement metrics to evaluate the effectiveness of your strategies. Experiment with different tactics, track results, and refine your approach based on what works best for your audience.

# Add a video to a lesson with the Creator app - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/mobile-apps/kajabi-creator-app/how-to-add-a-video-to-a-lesson-with-the-kajabi-creator-app#content-area)

With the **Kajabi Creator app**, you can record or upload a video and add it to a lesson.

If you don’t see the **Create** tab, visit the [App Store (iOS)](https://www.apple.com/app-store/)
 or the [Play Store (Android)](https://play.google.com/store/apps)
 and select **Update** to get the latest features.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/mobile-apps/kajabi-creator-app/how-to-add-a-video-to-a-lesson-with-the-kajabi-creator-app#add-a-video-to-an-existing-lesson)

Add a video to an existing lesson
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

To add your video to an existing lesson using the mobile Creator app:

1.  Log into the Kajabi [Creator mobile app](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/mobile-apps/kajabi-creator-app/kajabi-creator-mobile-app)
    
2.  From the Dashboard, tap **Create**
3.  Choose to either **Record a video** or **Upload a video**
4.  Record or select your video and use the **Play** icon to preview. (Optional) Tap **Edit** at the top right to trim your video
5.  Tap **Save and continue** to save your video
6.  Tap **Search lessons** to find an existing lesson
7.  Tap the **Draft** button to toggle to viewing lessons in **Published** status
8.  Tap the button displaying a Course title to select a different Course
9.  Select the lesson where you wish to add your video
10.  Tap **Publish** to add your video to the lesson

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/mobile-apps/kajabi-creator-app/how-to-add-a-video-to-a-lesson-with-the-kajabi-creator-app#add-a-video-to-a-lesson)

Add a video to a lesson
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

To add your video to a lesson using the mobile Creator app:

1.  Log into the Kajabi [Creator mobile app](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/mobile-apps/kajabi-creator-app/kajabi-creator-mobile-app)
    
2.  From the Dashboard, tap **Create**
3.  Choose to either **Record a video** or **Upload a video**
4.  Record or select your video and use the **Play** icon to preview. (Optional) Tap **Edit** at the top right to trim your video
5.  Tap **Save and continue** to save your video
6.  Tap **Create a lesson**
7.  Tap the **Select course** dropdown menu to select your Course
8.  Use the **Select module** dropdown to select your Module
9.  Enter a title in the **Enter lesson title** field and tap **Create**
10.  Tap **Publish** to add your video to the lesson

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/mobile-apps/kajabi-creator-app/how-to-add-a-video-to-a-lesson-with-the-kajabi-creator-app#troubleshooting)

Troubleshooting
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/mobile-apps/kajabi-creator-app/how-to-add-a-video-to-a-lesson-with-the-kajabi-creator-app#seeing-your-video-in-low-resolution)

Seeing your video in low resolution?

When you record or upload your file, Kajabi’s video partner Wistia encodes the video in various formats to be delivered to all types of devices with varying internet speeds. It can take up to several minutes for Wistia to finish encoding your video files at high quality. If your video doesn’t immediately appear in high resolution, wait about 15 minutes and check again.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/mobile-apps/kajabi-creator-app/how-to-add-a-video-to-a-lesson-with-the-kajabi-creator-app#having-trouble-uploading-a-video)

Having trouble uploading a video?

[Check if your video format is supported](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/courses/video-formats-supported-by-kajabi)
 by Kajabi. The maximum file size for video uploads is 4GB. If your video file size is larger than 4GB, use a video file compression tool such as [Handbrake](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-compress-a-video-file-using-handbrake)
.

# Understand RSS feeds - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/podcasts/how-do-rss-feeds-work#content-area)

An **RSS feed** (Really Simple Syndication) is the backbone of Podcast distribution. Understanding how RSS feeds work helps you manage your Podcast hosting and distribution on Kajabi.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/podcasts/how-do-rss-feeds-work#what-is-rss)

What is RSS?
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

RSS stands for Really Simple Syndication and refers to files that are easily read by a computer application in order to automatically get the latest content from sources that are updated frequently, like websites, blogs, podcasts, and newsletters.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/podcasts/how-do-rss-feeds-work#how-rss-feeds-work)

How RSS feeds work
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Podcast directories like Spotify, Apple, and Google don’t actually store your podcast files. Instead, they use the RSS feed from your hosting site (Kajabi) to allow users to subscribe to your podcasts. This means that once you create your Podcast on Kajabi, any time you update your podcast or publish a new episode, your podcast directories can use your RSS feed to automatically update and notify your subscribers. [Learn more about using Podcasts on Kajabi](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/podcasts/how-to-create-and-publish-podcast-products-with-kajabi)
.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/podcasts/how-do-rss-feeds-work#what-is-an-rss-feed-reader)

What is an RSS feed reader?
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

An RSS feed reader is a third-party application that allows you to have multiple RSS feeds in one place. An RSS feed reader will automatically check your websites for new content so that you don’t have to check multiple places for the latest content. Below is a list of popular RSS feed readers:

*   [Feedly](https://feedly.com/)
    
*   [Inoreader](https://www.inoreader.com/)
    
*   [Feeder](https://feeder.co/)

> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/mobile-apps/kajabi-app/getting-started-with-kajabi-mobile-app#content-area)

The **Kajabi Mobile App** provides your customers with a superior experience compared to accessing content through a mobile browser. The app enhances the way your customers experience your content in an easy-to-use, engaging, and on-the-go design.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/mobile-apps/kajabi-app/getting-started-with-kajabi-mobile-app#access-content-with-one-touch)

Access content with one touch
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

When trying to access your content with a mobile browser, your customers need to remember the URL of your Course and the login they created when they purchased. Your customers might have those bookmarks saved on their computer at home, but that doesn’t help when they want to pull up your Course to listen to while riding the train or driving long commutes. The Kajabi Mobile App puts your content one tap away, with no logins to remember. When your customers download the app, they sign in once using a “magic link” and then they never have to worry about typing in a URL or password ever again. Just one tap to open the app — that’s it.

**Tip:** You can include a link pointing to **kajabimobileapp://** on your website. This will open the Kajabi Mobile App on a person’s device if they have it installed.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/mobile-apps/kajabi-app/getting-started-with-kajabi-mobile-app#enable-push-notifications-for-instant-engagement)

Enable push notifications for instant engagement
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Push notifications are perhaps the biggest engagement win inside the app vs. using the mobile browser experience. They put your important updates front and center on the screen your customers look at the most so that they’re received as quickly as a text message. With push notifications, you are never more than an arm’s length away from engaging with your customers on the go. ![Push notifications](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/KcN1Ave2wqokJV1G/articles/images/640323cc_sbTNo51RsGoXOnEqZhWZ_Screen_Shot_2019-11-07_at_9_51_06_AM.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=KcN1Ave2wqokJV1G&q=85&s=b29406cdf5a022d3f453d682c9ae0cf6)

iOS devices allow you to download PDFs, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, .zip, .txt, .mp3, .M4a, .wav, .mov, and more. Follow these steps to download a file from the **Kajabi App** to your iOS device.

**Note:** The current Kajabi App does not preview downloadable files, but downloading files to your iOS device is still possible by following the steps below.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/mobile-apps/kajabi-app/how-to-download-files-on-kajabi-mobile-app-ios#download-content-from-inside-the-kajabi-app)

Download content from inside the Kajabi App
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Click the content you would like to download from inside the **Downloads** section of a lesson. In this example, we are downloading a PNG file:

![Downloads section](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/M-wREd-SKWO7LgG-/articles/images/1223c88d_1260802436730.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=M-wREd-SKWO7LgG-&q=85&s=a135bf2e8d19add89dc7156094a27865)

![Save options](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/So_4WToHMfn76-m1/articles/images/6a31eae4_42468968657435.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=So_4WToHMfn76-m1&q=85&s=f04c6872fee515d4cfe9474732577502)

3.  At this point, you may rename the file and select a specific location before saving it. Once you’re done, click **Save**:

![Save to Files](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/yV8YCdKpqAWaoiWT/articles/images/7f47aaab_1260802416349.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=yV8YCdKpqAWaoiWT&q=85&s=3f55ab2e854ba7df70a1e76d6531e07a)

4.  Your saved downloaded file can then be found in the folder or application you chose. In this example, because we saved our downloaded content to Files, it will be found in the **Files** app:

![Files app](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/ozJszuNKO84dmc_i/articles/images/438a8100_1260802436770.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=ozJszuNKO84dmc_i&q=85&s=2a3006f003c9ab32b9db2dda0f87dbdb)

# Update the Kajabi Mobile App - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/mobile-apps/kajabi-app/how-to-update-the-kajabi-mobile-app#content-area)

Keeping the **Kajabi Mobile App** updated ensures you have access to the latest features and bug fixes. Use this guide to update the app on both iOS and Android devices.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/mobile-apps/kajabi-app/how-to-update-the-kajabi-mobile-app#manually-update-the-app-on-an-apple-device)

Manually update the app on an Apple device
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

To update the Kajabi Mobile App manually on an iOS device:

1.  Open the **App Store.**
2.  Tap your **profile icon** at the top of the screen.
3.  Pull down to refresh this page.
4.  Scroll to see the pending Kajabi app update. Tap **Update** next to the Kajabi app to update the app.

![iOS update screen](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/KcN1Ave2wqokJV1G/articles/images/6252b429_ios14-iphone-12-pro-app-store-account-available-updates.jpg?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=KcN1Ave2wqokJV1G&q=85&s=a3a1c37ee2daf67a7678ba8d63901f9f)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/mobile-apps/kajabi-app/how-to-update-the-kajabi-mobile-app#manually-update-the-app-on-an-android-device)

Manually update the app on an Android device
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Depending on mobile device settings, apps may update automatically or can be updated manually. To update the Kajabi Mobile App manually on an Android device:

1.  Open the **Google Play Store** app.
2.  Tap the **Menu** icon.
3.  Tap **My apps & games.**
4.  Locate the Kajabi app under the **Updates pending** section.
5.  Tap **Update**.

**Note:** If you do not see the Kajabi Mobile App in the list of updates pending, you may have the latest version installed and may not require an update.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/mobile-apps/kajabi-app/how-to-update-the-kajabi-mobile-app#enable-automatic-updates)

Enable automatic updates
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

To avoid manually updating the app each time a new version is released, you can enable automatic updates on your device. **On iOS:**

1.  Open your device **Settings.**
2.  Tap **Apps**, then tap **App Store.**
3.  Under **Automatic Downloads**, toggle on **App Updates.**

**On Android:**

1.  Open the **Google Play Store** app.
2.  Tap your **profile icon.**
3.  Tap **Settings**, then tap **Network preferences.**
4.  Tap **Auto-update apps** and select your preferred option.

# Use Favorites in the mobile apps - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/mobile-apps/kajabi-app/use-favorites-in-the-mobile-apps#content-area)

**Favorites** let members bookmark the lessons they want to return to. Tapping the heart icon on a lesson adds it to a Favorites list for that Course, so members can jump straight back to key material instead of scrolling through modules. Favorites works the same way in both the Kajabi Mobile App and the Branded App, and a member’s favorites stay in sync across their devices and both apps.

**Note:** Favorites is available for lessons in evergreen Courses only. It is not available in Cohort Courses, Coaching, or Podcasts.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/mobile-apps/kajabi-app/use-favorites-in-the-mobile-apps#favorite-a-lesson)

Favorite a lesson
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A member can favorite any lesson in an evergreen Course, regardless of whether the lesson is audio, video, or text. To favorite a lesson:

1.  Open a **Course** in the Kajabi Mobile App or the Branded App.
2.  Go to the lesson you want to save.
3.  Tap the **heart icon** to add the lesson to Favorites.

Tap the **heart icon** again at any time to remove the lesson from Favorites.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/mobile-apps/kajabi-app/use-favorites-in-the-mobile-apps#view-favorite-lessons)

View favorite lessons
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Favorites are organized by Course, so each Course keeps its own list. To view favorite lessons, open the Course and select **Favorites** from the top bar. The list shows every lesson favorited in that Course.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/mobile-apps/kajabi-app/use-favorites-in-the-mobile-apps#faqs)

FAQs
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/mobile-apps/kajabi-app/use-favorites-in-the-mobile-apps#do-favorites-sync-across-devices-and-apps)

Do favorites sync across devices and apps?

Yes. Favorites sync across all of a member’s devices and between the Kajabi Mobile App and the Branded App. A lesson favorited on one device appears everywhere the member is signed in.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/mobile-apps/kajabi-app/use-favorites-in-the-mobile-apps#can-members-favorite-a-whole-course-podcast-or-coaching-session)

Can members favorite a whole Course, Podcast, or Coaching session?

No. Favorites applies to individual lessons within an evergreen Course. It isn’t available for Cohort Courses, Coaching, or Podcasts.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/mobile-apps/kajabi-app/use-favorites-in-the-mobile-apps#where-do-members-find-their-favorite-lessons)

Where do members find their favorite lessons?

Members open the Course and select **Favorites** from the top bar. Each Course keeps a separate Favorites list.
