# View Newsletter analytics - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/newsletters/newsletter-analytics#content-area)

**Newsletter analytics** help you understand how your Newsletter is performing. Your Newsletter dashboard displays real-time data on subscriber growth, email opens, clicks, bounces, and complaints. Use these metrics to identify what resonates with your audience and refine your content strategy.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/newsletters/newsletter-analytics#access-newsletter-analytics)

Access Newsletter analytics
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Open the **Products** tab from your Dashboard
2.  Click **Newsletters**
3.  Navigate to the top of your Newsletter Dashboard to view your Newsletter analytics

![Newsletter analytics dashboard](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/T7HThu_bu5xEvH2P/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-17-newsletter-analytics-1785428289173.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=T7HThu_bu5xEvH2P&q=85&s=54a7f844b6739c5619dcf71afea8f0c3) Your analytics display for the Newsletter Posts published during your selected time frame: ![Analytics time frame](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/T7HThu_bu5xEvH2P/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-17-newsletter-posts-timeframe-1785428289718.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=T7HThu_bu5xEvH2P&q=85&s=3af50bd137f202fb0c4fd849f85d054b)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/newsletters/newsletter-analytics#overview-metrics)

Overview metrics
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

View the overview metrics for the Newsletter Posts published within your selected time frame.

*   **Subscribers** — The number of subscribers from posts published during your selected time frame
*   **Open rate** — The percentage of Newsletter Posts opened during your selected time frame
*   **Click rate** — The percentage of Newsletter Posts with a link that was clicked during your selected time frame

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/newsletters/newsletter-analytics#audience-metrics)

Audience metrics
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

View your audience metrics for the Newsletter Posts published within your selected time frame.

*   **New subscribers** — The total number of subscribers that subscribed through your published Newsletter Posts during your selected time frame
*   **Unsubscribes** — The percentage of unsubscribes that occurred during your selected time frame
*   **Net subscribers** — The percentage of net subscribers (subscribers minus unsubscribes) that occurred during your selected time frame

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/newsletters/newsletter-analytics#engagement-metrics)

Engagement metrics
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

View your engagement metrics for the Newsletter Posts published within your selected time frame.

*   **Open rate** — The number of Newsletter emails opened during your selected time frame
*   **Click rate** — The percentage of Newsletter Posts with a link that was clicked during your selected time frame
*   **Impressions** — The number of views on the Newsletter Post from your email subscribers

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/newsletters/newsletter-analytics#health-metrics)

Health metrics
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

View your health metrics for the Newsletter Posts published within your selected time frame.

*   **Bounce rate** — The number of Newsletter Posts published that did not make it to the subscribers’ email inbox as a result of a [hard bounce](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/marketing/email-campaigns/email-metrics-overview)
    
*   **Complaints** — The number of [complaints](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/marketing/email-campaigns/email-metrics-overview)
     that occurred from Newsletter Posts published during your selected time frame
*   **Unsubscribes** — The number of unsubscribes that occurred during your selected time frame

# Preview the Kajabi Mobile App - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
>

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/mobile-apps/kajabi-app/how-to-preview-the-kajabi-mobile-app#content-area)

As a Kajabi Admin, you can preview how your Products appear to customers in the **Kajabi Mobile App**. This requires creating a test Contact with an alternate email address.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/mobile-apps/kajabi-app/how-to-preview-the-kajabi-mobile-app#create-a-test-contact)

Create a test Contact
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

To view your Product in the mobile app from the perspective of your customers, create a Contact with an alternate email address to your admin login and grant yourself an Offer.

1.  Select the **Contacts** tab from your Dashboard
2.  Click **Add Contacts**
3.  Add yourself using an alternate email address to your admin login. If you don’t have one, it only takes a few minutes to create and verify an email address
4.  Once you have added yourself as a Contact, grant that Contact an Offer. [Learn more about granting an Offer](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-grant-an-offer)
    
5.  You will then receive a [Grant Confirmation email](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/account-settings/notifications/edit-automated-email-notifications)
    . Follow the instructions in the email to verify your account:

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/mobile-apps/kajabi-app/how-to-preview-the-kajabi-mobile-app#log-into-the-kajabi-mobile-app)

Log into the Kajabi Mobile App
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Using that alternate email account, log in to the Kajabi Mobile App:

1.  Open the Kajabi Mobile App. Use your test Contact email in the **Email Address** field after pressing **Get Started**
2.  This will send you through the email verification process. You can now see your Products from the perspective of your customers
3.  You and your members are able to access Courses, Coaching, private Podcast, and Backstage products from the Kajabi Mobile App

# Customize a Newsletter: Premier vs. Encore - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/newsletters/customizing-your-newsletter-premier-vs-encore#content-area)

**Premier** and **Encore** website themes offer different levels of Newsletter customization.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/newsletters/customizing-your-newsletter-premier-vs-encore#newsletters-and-themes)

Newsletters and themes
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Creating a Newsletter creates three pages on your website:

*   Newsletter
*   Newsletter Post
*   Newsletter Subscribe

If you have the latest version of Encore or a theme created by third-party developers that includes the three Newsletter Website pages installed, you can customize these pages in your site builder. If you use earlier versions of Encore, Legacy Premier themes, or themes created by third-party developers that do not include the Newsletter Website pages, these pages are styled according to your site’s theme [settings](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/customize-your-page-font-and-style-with-the-style-guide)
 and cannot be customized with additional content blocks. If you do not have a theme installed, the Newsletter pages are rendered according to the Kajabi defaults to match other fallback pages.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/newsletters/customizing-your-newsletter-premier-vs-encore#encore)

Encore
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

If you are using the latest version of Encore, you can design and customize your Newsletter pages with Encore’s robust suite of editing features. ![Encore newsletter customization](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/Fky1o1xAW1UyWbKo/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-13-encore-newsletter-1785428462170.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=Fky1o1xAW1UyWbKo&q=85&s=a4c924f0af7992bd7d38be84a98007bc)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/newsletters/customizing-your-newsletter-premier-vs-encore#premier)

Premier
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

If you have not updated your site theme to the latest version of Encore, your Newsletter pages display your site’s theme settings and cannot be customized with additional content blocks or page layouts. ![Premier newsletter display](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/8OxtRX4ccA7GVWxq/articles/images/7746e191_28214633537051.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=8OxtRX4ccA7GVWxq&q=85&s=fb00a80dabfad1ae43f2a7ee8f196d63)

**Tip:** If you are using Premier but want to customize the Newsletter sign-up experience, you can [create a separate landing page](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-add-pages-to-your-website)
 with a Form block linked to your Newsletter Form. [Learn to create a Form block](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-add-a-form-to-your-page)
.

# Add client notes (customer view) - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/coaching/how-clients-can-add-notes#content-area)

Your coaching clients can add **shared and private notes** within their coaching sessions to track their progress and key takeaways.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/coaching/how-clients-can-add-notes#add-notes-client-view)

Add notes (client view)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Your coaching clients can add shared and private notes in their note tab.

1.  Open the **Coaching Product** from their Library
2.  Click the **Session** they wish to add their notes to
3.  Open the **Notes** tab
4.  Add **Shared Notes** or **personal Client Notes**
5.  Click **Save** to keep their changes

**Note:** Personal client notes are not visible to the admin and are only accessible to the client that added the note.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/coaching/how-clients-can-add-notes#view-client-shared-notes)

View client shared notes
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Open the **Products** tab from your Dashboard
2.  Click **Coaching**
3.  Select the **Coaching Product** you wish to view
4.  Click the **name** of the customer you wish to view
5.  Select the **Session** you wish to view
6.  Open the **Notes** tab

**Note:** If you have connected Calendly to your Coaching Program, your Coaching Dashboard will include an additional page before displaying your Programs.

# Add Coaching client notes - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/coaching/how-to-add-notes-for-clients#content-area)

Keep your coaching sessions organized with **shared and private notes**. Shared notes are visible to both you and your coaching client, while private notes are for your eyes only.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/coaching/how-to-add-notes-for-clients#shared-notes)

Shared notes
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

With shared notes you can create notes that both you and your coaching client can view at any time. This is a great place to make note of progress, provide session recaps, and list assignments.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/coaching/how-to-add-notes-for-clients#private-notes)

Private notes
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Keep personal notes that only you can see and cannot be accessed by your coaching client. Use private notes to track observations during each coaching session. **To add client notes:**

1.  Open the **Products** tab from your Dashboard.
2.  Click **Coaching.**
3.  Select the **Session** you wish to view.
4.  Open the **Notes** tab.
5.  Add private notes under **Your notes**. Add notes clients can see under **Shared notes**.
6.  Click **Save** to apply your changes.

# Compare 1:1 Coaching and Group Coaching - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/coaching/differences-between-a-11-coaching-program-and-group-coaching#content-area)

Kajabi offers two Coaching Program types: **1:1 Coaching** for individual client sessions and **Group Coaching** for multiple participants. Choose the format that best fits your business model and audience.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/coaching/differences-between-a-11-coaching-program-and-group-coaching#11-coaching-program)

1:1 Coaching Program
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Use a 1:1 Coaching Program to deliver an exclusive coaching program for your clients. A 1:1 Coaching Program can also provide your customers a single consultation for a needs assessment, a preliminary meeting with a nutritional coach, or a “get to know you” meeting with a business coach or a marketing expert. [Get started creating a Coaching program](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/coaching/how-to-create-a-coaching-product)
. ![1:1 Coaching Program](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/3dT4k6GfaoRj67A8/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-12-1-on-1-coaching-program-1756080392510-1759912602611-1768530398903-1769338596776-1775382381212-1778363811326-1778810176355-1780226197629-1780240553552.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=3dT4k6GfaoRj67A8&q=85&s=23f961d3df79d84aed07f77548eba481)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/coaching/differences-between-a-11-coaching-program-and-group-coaching#group-coaching)

Group Coaching
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Use Group Coaching to build a Coaching Program that includes multiple coaching clients. Group Coaching is a great way to offer coaching opportunities for your customers and create tiers of access to your time and expertise. [Get started creating a Coaching program](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/coaching/how-to-create-a-coaching-product)
. ![Group Coaching](https://mintlify.s3.us-west-1.amazonaws.com/kajabi-support/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-10-what-is-the-difference-between-a-11-coaching-program-and-group-coaching-kajabi-help-center1727801620636-1756080392330-1759912603538-1768530398654-1769338596710-1775382381211-1778363811296-1778810176120-1780226197693-1781159717711.png)

# Customize a Coaching Product - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/coaching/how-to-customize-your-coaching-product#content-area)

Design your **Coaching Product** by adding your brand colors as primary and accent colors to create a cohesive look that reflects your brand.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/coaching/how-to-customize-your-coaching-product#select-primary-and-accent-colors)

Select primary and accent colors
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

![Coaching Product Customization](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/nkRqu5SkPIvOaY51/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-7-coaching-page-customization-1769338599267-1775382382366-1780240046799.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=nkRqu5SkPIvOaY51&q=85&s=afb136aa162f3cab8a50423d66c5311e) The primary color applies to all buttons and icons on your page. The accent color applies to the background of the top section of your Product.

1.  Open the **Products** tab from your Dashboard
2.  Click **Coaching**
3.  Select the Coaching Product you wish to edit
4.  Click **Settings**
5.  Scroll to the **Page customization** card

# Upload recorded Coaching sessions - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/coaching/how-to-upload-recorded-coaching-sessions#content-area)

Give your coaching clients access to **recorded sessions** so they can reference your coaching content later.

**Note:** If you have not connected Calendly to your Coaching Program, your Coaching Dashboard may differ in appearance. If Calendly is not connected, your Coaching Dashboard will display your Programs first and will not present the Upcoming sessions page.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/coaching/how-to-upload-recorded-coaching-sessions#recorded-coaching-sessions)

Recorded Coaching sessions
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Looking to record your coaching session? During your live video session, use the [Live Video Settings](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/coaching/how-to-create-a-live-video-session)
 to record your session.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/coaching/how-to-upload-recorded-coaching-sessions#upload-a-recorded-coaching-session)

Upload a recorded Coaching session
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Open the **Products** tab from your Dashboard
2.  Click **Coaching**
3.  Select the **Session** to upload your recorded session to
4.  Click the **name** of the client you wish to upload your recorded session to
5.  Navigate to **Session recording**
6.  Click **Select Video**
7.  Click **Upload a New File** or **Select a Recent File**
8.  Add your recorded session
9.  Click **Upload**
10.  Click **Save** to upload your recording

**Note:** If you have not connected Calendly to your Coaching Program, your Coaching Dashboard may differ in appearance. If Calendly is not connected, your Coaching Dashboard will display your Programs first and will not present the Upcoming sessions page.

# Manage Coaching session recordings - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/coaching/manage-your-coaching-session-recordings#content-area)

**Kajabi Live recordings** can be automatically saved and uploaded to your coaching sessions, giving you and your clients easy access to past session content.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/coaching/manage-your-coaching-session-recordings#record-coaching-sessions)

Record Coaching sessions
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Kajabi gives you the power to meet virtually with your coaching clients with [Kajabi Live](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/coaching/how-to-create-a-live-video-session)
. With Kajabi Live, your recordings are automatically saved and can be accessed in Past Recordings in each session. Click the link next to **Access session recordings** in the **Session recording** section:

Recording your sessions allows you to share, repurpose, or review your coaching session.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/coaching/manage-your-coaching-session-recordings#enable-automatic-uploads)

Enable automatic uploads
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Give your coaching clients access to the recordings by automatically uploading the Kajabi Live recordings to each session. This uploads a recording to the Session Recording section after each session is completed.

1.  Open your **Products** tab from your Dashboard
2.  Click **Coaching**
3.  Select the **Program** you wish to customize
4.  Open **Settings**
5.  Toggle on **Automatically upload Kajabi Live recordings to sessions**
6.  Click **Save** to keep and apply your changes

**Note:** Previous recordings can be accessed and uploaded to a coaching session by opening **Access recording sessions** in the Session Recording section. Keep in mind that if you recorded around a [breakout session](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/coaching/how-to-create-breakout-sessions-with-kajabi-live)
, there may be multiple recording files available within a single live video session.  
Members cannot download coaching session recordings.

# Offer a single Coaching session - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/coaching/how-to-offer-a-single-coaching-session#content-area)

**Single Coaching Sessions** allow you to offer additional coaching sessions on top of an existing coaching package. If your member needs another session or additional coaching to meet their goal, you can add one directly from the admin dashboard.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/coaching/how-to-offer-a-single-coaching-session#add-a-single-coaching-session)

Add a single Coaching session
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Open the **Products** tab from your Dashboard
2.  Click **Coaching**
3.  Select **Clients**
4.  Select the client and **Coaching Program** you wish to add a session to
5.  Click **\+ Add Session**
6.  Give the Session a **Title** and **Description**, then click **Add Session**
7.  Select **Schedule Session** to schedule a time for the session

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/coaching/how-to-offer-a-single-coaching-session#charge-for-a-single-coaching-session)

Charge for a single Coaching session
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

If you wish to charge a fee for the single Coaching session, set up a Ghost Offer for your member to purchase. [Learn more about Ghost Offers and how to use them](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-create-a-ghost-offer)
.

# Kajabi Vibe Check policy - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/community/how-does-the-kajabi-vibe-check-work#content-area)

Kajabi enforces a strict set of community standards — the **Vibe Check** — to maintain a safe, respectful, and welcoming environment for everyone in your Community.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/community/how-does-the-kajabi-vibe-check-work#kajabi-vibe-check)

Kajabi Vibe Check
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

At Kajabi, we stand behind respect, inclusivity, acceptance, and positivity for all individuals.

*   **Good vibes only.** No trolls, spam, or violence.
*   **Predicated on respect.** No name-calling or harassment.
*   **Everyone is included, and everyone belongs.** No bullying or shaming.
*   **Zero tolerance** for hate, solicitation, nudity, or discrimination.
*   **Positivity enforcement.** Offenders are subject to immediate removal from the platform.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/community/how-does-the-kajabi-vibe-check-work#tools-that-enforce-the-vibe-check)

Tools that enforce the Vibe Check
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   Automated flagging of content.
*   Filters that remove nudity and other inappropriate content.
*   Community reporting tools.
*   Blacklist tools.
*   Leader and ambassador tools to remove community members, messages, and content as needed.
*   Shadow bans.
*   A policy based on 100% respect for each other - the same as we’d expect out of people we meet in everyday life.

Was this page helpful?

YesNo

⌘I

# Connect a custom domain - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/connect-a-custom-domain#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/connect-a-custom-domain#overview)

Overview
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Connecting a custom domain to your Kajabi site allows you to use your own branded URL instead of the default Kajabi subdomain. This guide walks you through connecting your domain via nameservers, managing DNS settings, and setting up a custom email domain.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/connect-a-custom-domain#connect-a-custom-domain-to-kajabi)

Connect a custom domain to Kajabi
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

To connect a custom domain to your Kajabi site, you must first purchase a domain. If you haven’t done so already, follow our guide to help you get started in purchasing a domain, [How to purchase a domain name](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-purchase-a-domain-name)
. To connect your custom domain via nameservers, you will need to replace the existing nameservers in your domain registrar with the unique nameservers that Kajabi has created for you.

**Note:** Some domain name registrars ([such as Wix](https://support.wix.com/en/article/request-changing-name-server-ns-records-for-a-wix-domain)
) may not have the capability to replace your existing name servers. We recommend contacting your domain name registrar to ensure that you will be able to replace your existing name servers with the unique name servers that Kajabi has created for you.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/connect-a-custom-domain#connect-the-custom-domain)

Connect the custom domain

**Important:** Do you have a webmail service (Google Workspace, Office 365, etc.) connected to your custom website domain? If yes, make sure you know who your webmail provider is and take a screenshot of all your original DNS records, including any MX (mail server) records, prior to updating your Nameservers.

1.  Navigate to your Kajabi dashboard and open **Settings**
2.  Click **Domain**
3.  Click **Set up custom domain**
4.  Select **Connect domain to Kajabi**
5.  Enter your domain into the **domain name text box**
6.  Click **Next**
7.  The next page shows you two unique Nameservers that Kajabi has created for you.
8.  On a separate page, log into your domain registrar account and navigate to the DNS Settings. These may include pairs like `jermaine.ns.cloudflare.com` and `joyce.ns.cloudflare.com`
    
    _**Important:**_ Always refer to the Kajabi-provided nameservers displayed in your Domain settings or setup instructions for accuracy.
    
9.  Navigate to your Nameservers in your Domain Registrar DNS settings.
10.  Remove the existing Nameservers in your domain registrar.
11.  Add the two Nameservers Kajabi has provided for you to your domain registrar.
12.  Then, in the Kajabi Domain Settings page, then click **Done, verify domain**.

**Note:** DNS changes can take time to propagate across the internet.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/connect-a-custom-domain#dns-settings)

DNS settings
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

If you have successfully connected your custom domain, you will then have access to DNS settings in your Domain Settings in Kajabi. To access your DNS settings in Kajabi:

1.  Open the Settings tab from the dashboard and click Domain.
2.  Click into your connected domain.

From here you can view your DNS records and add the following custom records:

*   A
*   CNAME
*   MX
*   SRV
*   TXT

If you’ve previously connected a webmail service (i.e. Google Workspace, Office 365) to your custom domain, check for the MX records in your Kajabi DNS Settings after connecting your domain to make sure they imported correctly. [Learn more about how to prevent an email disruption](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-test-your-domain-connection-to-prevent-a-webmail-disruption)
.

**Note:** If you’re using a webmail service and are experiencing issues sending and receiving emails after connecting your custom domain to Kajabi, you may need to manually add your MX records from your webmail service to your DNS Settings on Kajabi. [Learn more](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/marketing/email-campaigns/why-are-my-emails-not-sending-or-receiving-after-i-connect-my-custom-domain)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/connect-a-custom-domain#connect-a-custom-email-domain)

Connect a custom email domain
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Once your domain is connected, you will have the option to send your Marketing emails from your custom domain.

**Note:** You must have a paid Kajabi account in order to set up a custom email domain. If you are on a free trial, you will not have access to this feature.

**To set up the custom email domain:**

1.  Click **Setup Custom Email Domain**.
2.  Enter a From name, create a From email, and, optionally, add a Reply to email address.
3.  Click **Save**. Your marketing emails will now be sent from your custom email domain.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/connect-a-custom-domain#limitations)

Limitations
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   Custom domains cannot contain “kajabi” in the URL (e.g., `mybrand.kajabi.com` is not allowed). Domains that include Kajabi trademarks will be rejected.
*   Each Kajabi site can have only one custom domain connected at a time.
*   If the domain is not yet registered with a domain registrar, you will see the error “is not a registered domain.”

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/connect-a-custom-domain#custom-domain-best-practices)

Custom domain best practices
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **Allow sufficient time to connect your custom domain.** We recommend that you complete this process well in advance of any product launch. This ensures you have enough time to test, troubleshoot, and resolve any potential issues before going live.
*   If you are encountering a “Cloudflare error 1014 CNAME Cross-User Banned” error, please reach out to our support team for further assistance.

**Note:** We are aware that some Kajabi users in Spain are currently experiencing issues where their sites become temporarily accessible. To explain what’s happening: Kajabi uses Cloudflare to help keep websites fast and secure. However, in Spain, major internet providers (like Movistar, Vodafone, and Orange) have recently been required by court orders to block certain Cloudflare IP addresses as part of anti-piracy efforts, especially during major events. It’s important to note that Kajabi has no control over how Spanish ISPs enforce these national restrictions or Cloudflare’s response. We’re actively monitoring the situation and exploring options to reduce the impact for creators and their audiences in Spain. In the meantime, we recommend Spanish Heroes use their .mykajabi.com domain, which can help customers access your site more reliably.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/connect-a-custom-domain#best-practices)

Best practices
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   Allow up to 48–72 hours for DNS propagation before assuming the change failed
*   If verification fails after 72 hours, contact your registrar to ensure the name servers were applied correctly
*   Take screenshots of the original DNS records before changing name servers so you can recreate important records with the new DNS host
*   Do not remove Kajabi’s name servers prematurely once verification starts

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/connect-a-custom-domain#faqs)

FAQs
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/connect-a-custom-domain#how-long-does-it-take-for-my-domain-to-connect)

How long does it take for my domain to connect?

DNS propagation can take up to 48–72 hours. Kajabi verification may complete sooner once the name servers are updated globally.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/connect-a-custom-domain#can-i-connect-a-subdomain)

Can I connect a subdomain?

Kajabi’s name server method is for root domain connections. For subdomains, check Kajabi’s domain documentation.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/connect-a-custom-domain#what-if-my-registrar-won%E2%80%99t-let-me-change-name-servers)

What if my registrar won’t let me change name servers?

Contact your registrar’s support. If they can’t change name servers, you can move DNS hosting to a provider that allows name server updates or ask Kajabi support for alternatives.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/connect-a-custom-domain#how-do-i-confirm-my-domain-is-verified)

How do I confirm my domain is verified?

After clicking **Done, verify domain**, check the domain settings page in Kajabi for a connected/verified status or use a DNS lookup to confirm the two Kajabi name servers are listed.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/connect-a-custom-domain#dns-provider-resources-godaddy)

DNS provider resources: GoDaddy
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   [Replacing nameservers on GoDaddy](https://www.godaddy.com/help/change-nameservers-for-my-domains-664)
    
*   [How to create a CNAME record with GoDaddy](https://www.godaddy.com/help/change-a-cname-record-19237)
    

**Note:** When replacing your nameservers on GoDaddy be sure to select the “Enter my own nameservers (advanced)” option.

# Create a subdomain for a Kajabi site - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-create-a-subdomain-for-a-kajabi-site#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-create-a-subdomain-for-a-kajabi-site#overview)

Overview
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A subdomain is a part of your main website address that sits in front of your domain name, like **blog**.yoursite.com, and it points visitors to a specific section of your site. It helps you organize your website by separating different types of content while still keeping everything connected to your main site. Creating a subdomain for your Kajabi site (without repointing your top-level website domain to Kajabi) requires the creation of a CNAME record in your domain registrar that points to ssl.kajabi.com.

**Note:** The creation of a DNS record will differ slightly with each domain registrar. See GoDaddy resources below.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-create-a-subdomain-for-a-kajabi-site#create-the-subdomain)

Create the subdomain

1.  Navigate to **Settings** from the dashboard
2.  Click **Domain**
3.  Click **Set up custom domain**
4.  Select **Create subdomain for Kajabi site**
5.  Enter your root domain into the **Domain name** text box
6.  Input your chosen subdomain into the **Subdomain name** text box
7.  Review the preview shown below the preview domain text box, then click **Next**
8.  The Subdomain Setup wizard will provide you with the information you need to add your CNAME record:

*   On a separate page, log into your domain registrar account.
*   Navigate to your DNS Records in your Domain Registrar DNS settings.
*   Add your CNAME record per the data provided by the Kajabi Subdomain Setup wizard:
    *   Type: CNAME
    *   Name/Host: (see Subdomain Setup wizard)
    *   Data/Domain/Target/Value: ssl.kajabi.com
    *   TTL: (see Subdomain Setup wizard)
*   Click **Save**.
*   Then, on the Kajabi Subdomain Setup page, click **Done, verify subdomain**.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-create-a-subdomain-for-a-kajabi-site#best-practices)

Best practices
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   Use a simple, descriptive subdomain such as _learn_, _courses_, or _app_ to make it easy for customers to remember.
*   If verification fails, check your domain registrar for any required DNS records (for example, a CNAME). DNS changes can take up to 48 hours to propagate.
*   Verify the full subdomain URL in the preview before clicking **Done verify subdomain** to avoid typos.
*   If you need help with DNS settings, contact your domain provider or Kajabi support for guidance.

###

Verification usually completes quickly but DNS changes can take up to 48 hours to propagate.

# Coupons for subscriptions and payment plans - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/advanced-coupon-usage-scenarios#content-area)

**Coupons** on Kajabi allow you to design special promotions and deals for your Offers. Refer to this guide for examples of various advanced coupon scenarios.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/advanced-coupon-usage-scenarios#how-duration-works)

How duration works
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Three rules cover nearly every scenario:

*   **Duration counts payments, not calendar time.** A coupon set to repeat for 2 months discounts the first two payments. Once applies to the first payment only. Forever applies to every payment.
*   **Annual subscriptions bill once per year.** A duration shorter than 12 months only reaches the first payment. To discount multiple years, use increments of 12 months: 24 months covers two annual payments.
*   **Discounts cap at 100% of each payment.** If the amount off exceeds the payment amount, the customer pays $0 for that payment. The difference doesn’t carry over.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/advanced-coupon-usage-scenarios#examples)

Examples

**100% off, once, on a $100/month payment plan (6 months).** The first payment is free. The customer pays $100 per month for the remaining five payments. **100% off, repeating for 2 months, on a $100/month payment plan (6 months).** The first two payments are free. The customer pays $100 per month for the remaining four payments. **100% off, repeating for 2 months, on a $1,200 annual subscription.** The first annual payment is free. The 2-month duration doesn’t reach the second year, so year two bills at full price. **$500 off, repeating for 3 months, on a $1,200 annual subscription.** The customer pays $700 at purchase. The duration doesn’t reach the second year. **$500 off, repeating for 3 months, on a $100/month payment plan (6 months).** The first three payments are free. The discount caps at 100% of each payment, so the extra $400 per month doesn’t apply. The remaining three payments bill at $100.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/advanced-coupon-usage-scenarios#editing-a-coupon-on-active-subscriptions)

Editing a coupon on active subscriptions

Coupon edits apply to new redemptions only. Customers who already redeemed a coupon keep the discount amount and duration that were in place at purchase. For example, if a coupon set to repeat for 4 months is edited to Forever, existing subscribers keep the 4-month duration and new redemptions apply forever. [Learn more about editing coupons](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/how-to-remove-an-offer-from-your-coupon)

# Gmail & Yahoo email requirement updates - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/gmail-yahoo-email-requirement-updates#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/gmail-yahoo-email-requirement-updates#overview)

Overview
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Have questions about the Gmail and Yahoo email requirement updates? This guide covers what’s happening, who needs to take action, and how to add a DMARC record to DNS.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/gmail-yahoo-email-requirement-updates#what%E2%80%99s-happening)

What’s happening?
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

You may have heard about the email requirements for bulk senders starting February 4, 2024. Yahoo and Gmail have separately announced updated requirements to deliver email to their platforms. Their goal is to better secure customers’ inboxes and provide an improved consumer email experience. The updated recommendations cover the following:

*   **Ensure proper setup and authentication** - For senders to Yahoo or Gmail, both mail providers require that all emails be fully authenticated with Sender Policy Framework (SPF), Domain Keys Identified Mail (DKIM), and Domain-based Message Authentication, Reporting and Conformance (DMARC).
*   **Make it easy to unsubscribe** - To provide a hassle-free experience for users, senders must support one-click unsubscribe in the List-Unsubscribe header in the email. This does not affect the visible Unsubscribe link in the body of the email. Both mailbox providers require senders to honor the unsubscribe request within two days.
*   **Send emails that your subscribers want to receive** - To help reduce spam in their users’ inboxes, both Yahoo and Gmail will enforce a spam complaint threshold of 0.3%. However, Kajabi enforces a complaint threshold of 0.2% to ensure email success for our Heroes. Exceeding this threshold will likely increase the number of blocked emails or emails being directed to the bulk folder.

Although this change will improve your email deliverability, there are actions you may need to take if you have a custom email domain connected to Kajabi.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/gmail-yahoo-email-requirement-updates#which-email-providers-are-implementing-changes)

Which email providers are implementing changes?
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[Google](https://blog.google/products/gmail/gmail-security-authentication-spam-protection/)
 and [Yahoo](https://blog.postmaster.yahooinc.com/post/730172167494483968/more-secure-less-spam)
 are adding email requirements for bulk senders starting February 2024.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/gmail-yahoo-email-requirement-updates#what-do-you-need-to-do)

What do you need to do?
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

For our Kajabi Heroes, we are dedicated to empowering you with the tools necessary to succeed. Because of this, Kajabi has been hard at work building updates for our email tool to match the updated requirements. Therefore, the majority of our Heroes will not need to take any action, and the updates to accommodate these requirements will not impact your email deliverability through Kajabi. Additionally, your email metrics will not be impacted.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/gmail-yahoo-email-requirement-updates#if-you-send-email-from-a-kajabi-email-domain)

If you send email from a Kajabi email domain:

You are already set up to match the updated requirements and there is nothing for you to do! All required DNS records are already in place for shared sending pools.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/gmail-yahoo-email-requirement-updates#if-you-send-email-from-a-custom-sending-domain-and-kajabi-controls-your-dns)

If you send email from a custom sending domain and Kajabi controls your DNS:

There is nothing for you to do! SPF, DKIM, and PTR records are already in place, and DMARC records will be in place by February 4, 2024.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/gmail-yahoo-email-requirement-updates#who-needs-to-take-action)

Who needs to take action?
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

For Heroes with custom email domains who control their own DNS, there is one small action item: You will need to implement a DMARC. If this applies to you, we will reach out with a reminder. If you don’t add the DMARC record to your DNS by February 4, 2024, you will still be able to send email through Kajabi, but your custom email domain will be disabled, and your email will be sent from a shared sending pool. **Not sure if you control your DNS? See below.**

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/gmail-yahoo-email-requirement-updates#if-you-send-email-from-a-custom-sending-domain-and-you-control-your-dns)

If you send email from a custom sending domain and you control your DNS:

You will need to add a DMARC record specific to your sending domain to your DNS by February 4, 2024. Your SPF, DKIM, and PTR records are already in place. Unless you have an existing DMARC record, the following will need to be added to your DNS: **Type**: `TXT` **Name**: `_dmarc` **Content (or Value)**: `"v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc_kjb@kajabi.com; pct=100; rf=afrf"` (Be sure to include all special characters, e.g., "") ![Example of DMARC record added to GoDaddy](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/N_ou1KPM051i95tz/articles/images/b948ae8e_22010428102683.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=N_ou1KPM051i95tz&q=85&s=7ed44676739f8e3fabe1b827a3bd2854) **If you already have a DMARC record and your parameter is set to `adkim=s`:** If you have a DMARC record, without an ADKIM tag or an ADKIM tag is set to `adkim=r` (relaxed) and not `adkim=s` (strict), there is nothing more for you to do! However, if your ADKIM tag is set to `adkim=s`, please reach out to our support team for assistance.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/gmail-yahoo-email-requirement-updates#add-a-dmarc-record-to-dns)

Add a DMARC record to DNS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Adding a DMARC record to DNS will vary depending on the DNS Provider. Follow the instructions for the specific DNS Provider:

*   GoDaddy
*   CloudFlare
*   Bluehost
*   Namecheap
*   SiteGround

**Important:** The verification process can take up to 48 hours due to the timeframe for the Domain Name System (DNS) changes to propagate. To create a successful connection: (1) A custom subdomain has been added to ensure that your records don’t interfere with existing domains. (2) Your DNS changes must propagate, meaning that Internet Service Provider (ISP) nodes across the world must update their caches with your new DNS information.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/gmail-yahoo-email-requirement-updates#godaddy)

GoDaddy

**To add a DMARC record to GoDaddy, add it as a TXT record:**

1.  In your GoDaddy DNS Records, click **Add** and select **TXT** from the Type dropdown.
2.  Enter the Name `_dmarc` into the **Name** field in GoDaddy.
3.  Enter `"v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc_kjb@kajabi.com; pct=100; rf=afrf"` into the **Value** field in GoDaddy.

**Note:** Be sure to include all special characters, including quotations, apostrophes, and spaces. We recommend copying and pasting the exact value into the Value field.

4.  Keep the default value in the TTL field.
5.  Click **Add record**.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/gmail-yahoo-email-requirement-updates#cloudflare)

CloudFlare

**To add a DMARC record to CloudFlare, add it as a TXT record:**

1.  Log into the CloudFlare dashboard and click into the **Active domain**.
2.  Select the **DNS** tab.
3.  Click +**Add Record** and select **TXT** from the Type dropdown.
4.  Enter the Name `_dmarc` into the **Name** field in CloudFlare.
5.  Keep the default value in the TTL field.
6.  Enter `"v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc_kjb@kajabi.com; pct=100; rf=afrf"` into the **Content** field in CloudFlare.

**Note:** Be sure to include all special characters, including quotations, apostrophes, and spaces. We recommend copying and pasting the exact value into the Content field.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/gmail-yahoo-email-requirement-updates#determine-if-you-control-dns)

Determine if you control DNS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

If you connected your domain to Kajabi using the “Connect domain to Kajabi” option (nameserver method), Kajabi controls your DNS. If you connected your domain using the “Create subdomain for Kajabi site” option (CNAME method), you likely still control your DNS through your domain registrar.

# Connect a custom domain using nameservers - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-can-i-connect-my-custom-domain-to-kajabi-using-nameservers#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-can-i-connect-my-custom-domain-to-kajabi-using-nameservers#overview)

Overview
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

To connect your custom domain to Kajabi, you need to update your domain’s nameservers to those provided by Kajabi. This ensures that your domain properly points to your Kajabi site. This guide outlines the steps you need to take and key considerations during the process.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-can-i-connect-my-custom-domain-to-kajabi-using-nameservers#understand-nameservers)

Understand nameservers
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Nameservers are part of a domain’s DNS settings. By updating nameservers to those specified by Kajabi, you delegate DNS management for your domain to Kajabi’s Cloudflare integration. It’s important to use only the nameservers provided in your Kajabi account during setup as these are specific to your domain.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-can-i-connect-my-custom-domain-to-kajabi-using-nameservers#update-nameservers)

Update nameservers
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Follow these steps to update your Nameservers:

1.  **Log in to your domain registrar**: Access the account where you manage your domain’s DNS settings, such as GoDaddy, Namecheap, or InMotion Hosting.
2.  **Locate nameserver settings**: Find the section where your domain’s nameservers are configured. This is usually under DNS management or domain settings.
3.  **Replace existing nameservers**: Use the nameservers provided by Kajabi. These may include pairs like `jermaine.ns.cloudflare.com` and `joyce.ns.cloudflare.com`
    
    **Important:** Always refer to the Kajabi-provided nameservers displayed in your Domain settings or setup instructions for accuracy.
    
4.  **Save changes**: Confirm the update and save your settings.
5.  **Wait for DNS propagation**: Allow up to 24 hours for the changes to propagate globally. During this time, your domain may not resolve to Kajabi immediately.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-can-i-connect-my-custom-domain-to-kajabi-using-nameservers#registrar-specific-instructions)

Registrar-specific instructions
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Some registrars may have unique processes for updating nameservers:

*   **InMotion Hosting**: Log in to your account, navigate to DNS settings, and replace your current nameservers (e.g., `ns.inmotionhosting.com`) with the Kajabi-provided nameservers. Save changes, and allow propagation time.
*   **Namecheap**: Enter the Kajabi-provided nameservers directly into the “Custom DNS” field and save your settings.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-can-i-connect-my-custom-domain-to-kajabi-using-nameservers#troubleshooting)

Troubleshooting
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **Troubleshooting downtime**: If your Kajabi site is inaccessible after updating nameservers, confirm that only the specified nameservers are in use and no others are configured. Ensure you are using the exact pair provided in your Kajabi account.
*   **Custom nameservers**: Avoid using general Cloudflare nameservers (e.g., alexis.ns.cloudflare.com) that are not specifically provided by Kajabi.
*   **Propagation time**: Allow 24-48 hours for DNS propagation. Kajabi will notify you when your domain successfully connects.

# Troubleshoot redirect issues on Kajabi landing pages - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-troubleshoot-and-resolve-redirect-issues-on-kajabi-landing-pages#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-troubleshoot-and-resolve-redirect-issues-on-kajabi-landing-pages#overview)

Overview
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Redirect issues on Kajabi landing pages commonly arise due to countdown blocks, button misconfigurations, or custom code. This guide outlines the key steps to identify and resolve such problems, ensuring a smooth user experience.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-troubleshoot-and-resolve-redirect-issues-on-kajabi-landing-pages#common-causes-of-redirect-issues)

Common causes of redirect issues
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-troubleshoot-and-resolve-redirect-issues-on-kajabi-landing-pages#countdown-blocks-with-redirect-actions)

Countdown blocks with redirect actions

Countdown blocks are a frequent cause of automatic redirections. If a countdown timer is set to redirect after reaching zero, it may send users to an unintended page. Here’s how to check and fix it:

1.  Navigate to your Kajabi landing page editor.
2.  Locate any countdown blocks within your page sections.
3.  Open the settings for the countdown timer.
4.  Toggle off the “Enable countdown action” or remove the countdown block entirely.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-troubleshoot-and-resolve-redirect-issues-on-kajabi-landing-pages#homepage-countdown-section-redirects)

Homepage countdown section redirects

If your homepage is redirecting unexpectedly, verify whether the countdown section is triggering the issue:

1.  Open your homepage in the Website Pages editor.
2.  Locate the countdown section.
3.  Untick the option “Enable Countdown Action” or delete the countdown section.
4.  Save your changes and test your homepage as a logged-out visitor.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-troubleshoot-and-resolve-redirect-issues-on-kajabi-landing-pages#fixing-call-to-action-button-misconfigurations)

Fixing call-to-action button misconfigurations
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

If a landing page button refreshes the page instead of redirecting to the intended URL, ensure it’s a properly configured Call-to-Action (CTA) button:

1.  Open the landing page editor in Kajabi.
2.  Scroll to the Call-to-Action section or button.
3.  Use the “Button action” setting to select the correct destination.
4.  Verify the URL or action is set correctly.
5.  Save and test the button behavior.

> Documentation Index

> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)

> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-verify-your-custom-domain-on-kajabi-for-google-workspace#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-verify-your-custom-domain-on-kajabi-for-google-workspace#overview)

Overview
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Looking to connect, create, and collaborate with your entire team on Google Workspace? This guide walks you through verifying your custom domain on Kajabi to complete your Google Workspace setup.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-verify-your-custom-domain-on-kajabi-for-google-workspace#google-workspace)

Google Workspace
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

With Google Workspace you can build custom business emails for your Kajabi email campaigns, organize your events with Google Calendar, collaborate with your team on upcoming projects, and more! [Learn more about Google Workspace](https://workspace.google.com/)
. With the combined power of Google Workspace and Kajabi, you can streamline and connect your workflows. If you wish to use Google Workspace with your site on Kajabi you will first need to connect a custom domain to Kajabi and verify your domain to complete your Google Workspace setup. [Learn to connect your custom domain to Kajabi](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/connect-a-custom-domain)
.

**Note:** If your custom domain is purchased through Google, Google will automatically verify your domain for you and you will not be required to complete the steps provided in this article.

If you have purchased your custom domain from a registrar that does not partner with Google, you will be required to verify your domain to ensure the protection and privacy of your Google Workspace and Domain.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-verify-your-custom-domain-on-kajabi-for-google-workspace#domain-verification)

Domain verification
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Before verifying your domain to set up your Google Workspace, you will first need to connect your custom domain to Kajabi. The verification process cannot be completed with a Kajabi Subdomain, as you will need access to your domain DNS settings. [Learn to connect your custom domain to Kajabi](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/connect-a-custom-domain)
 After successfully connecting your custom domain to Kajabi, verify your domain in Google Workspace.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-verify-your-custom-domain-on-kajabi-for-google-workspace#step-1-get-your-verification-code)

Step 1. Get your verification code

1.  Open the [Google Workspace setup tool](https://admin.google.com/u/0/ac/signup/setup/v2/verify/txt)
    .
2.  Then, sign in to your Google Admin console.

**Note:** You will need to sign in with your Google Administrator account.

1.  Click **Continue** next to the “Verify your domain” card.
2.  Locate your verification code and click **Copy**:

![Verify your domain](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/xXNsh6vIFsWHcSnx/articles/images/bc63b70b_42472773565339.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=xXNsh6vIFsWHcSnx&q=85&s=da22d9ce0defea0d1e4a7316edb15610)

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-verify-your-custom-domain-on-kajabi-for-google-workspace#step-2-add-your-verification-code-to-your-dns-settings-on-kajabi)

Step 2. Add your verification code to your DNS settings on Kajabi

1.  In a separate browser window or tab, log into your Kajabi account.
2.  Click **Settings** in the bottom left corner of your Dashboard.
3.  Open **Domain** to access your Domain Settings.
4.  Click the **right-arrow next to your domain URL** to open your DNS Settings for your connected custom domain.
5.  Click **\+ Custom Record** in the top-right corner.
6.  Select **TXT Record**.
7.  In the name field, enter the **@** symbol.
8.  Then, in the **TXT Record** field, enter your Google Workspace verification code from Step 1.
9.  Click **Add** to apply:

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-verify-your-custom-domain-on-kajabi-for-google-workspace#step-3-verify-your-domain)

Step 3. Verify your domain

1.  Navigate back to your Google Admin Console.
2.  Then, click **Verify my domain**:

**Note:** Additional time may be required to publish the verification code. If you receive an error message from the Google Workspace setup tool, wait an hour before attempting to verify again. It is important to note that in some cases, it can take up to 48 hours to publish your verification code.

# Manage DNS records on Kajabi - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-manage-your-dns-records-on-kajabi#content-area)

If you have successfully connected your custom domain to Kajabi, you will have access to DNS settings for the connected custom domain on Kajabi. [Learn how to connect a custom domain](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/connect-a-custom-domain)
.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-manage-your-dns-records-on-kajabi#what-are-dns-records)

What are DNS records?
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

What is **DNS**? DNS stands for the Domain Name System. Which is a fancy way of saying that the DNS is the handbook for the Internet. So, if the DNS is the handbook for the Internet, the DNS records are the listings for the businesses in that handbook. For example, a business listing within a handbook will provide information about the address, office hours, and services provided to help a person access that business. Similarly, DNS records communicate the essential information for a user to access your website. DNS records are crucial to ensuring that your website can be connected and accessible to the outside world. With Kajabi, connecting your custom domain allows you to manage and view your DNS records directly from your Kajabi account.

**Note:** Removing, editing, or adding custom records requires working with domain settings. If you are unfamiliar with domain settings, we recommend consulting with a web professional before making changes to DNS records. If you require additional assistance, reach out to our [support team](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/support/how-to-contact-kajabi-support)
.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-manage-your-dns-records-on-kajabi#view-dns-records)

View DNS records
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-manage-your-dns-records-on-kajabi#access-dns-settings-in-kajabi)

Access DNS settings in Kajabi

**Note:** DNS Settings are only available if you have successfully connected a custom domain to Kajabi using the nameserver method. If you connected your domain using the CNAME/subdomain method, your DNS is still managed by your domain registrar and will not appear in Kajabi.  
[Learn how to connect a custom domain](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/connect-a-custom-domain)
.

1.  Open the **Settings** tab from the Dashboard:

![Dashboard - Kajabi](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/yejBQObxZkrUDGeF/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-20-settings-tab-1782636379163-1784126776815-1784151495858.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=yejBQObxZkrUDGeF&q=85&s=a61677196e3ff9673f0cb880b34ad291)

2.  Click **Domain**:

![Kajabi settings](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/Fky1o1xAW1UyWbKo/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-17-domain-settings-1785428437544.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=Fky1o1xAW1UyWbKo&q=85&s=ae37a050e624677aab6223a8209d75fd)

3.  Click **DNS Settings**:

![Kajabi custom domain](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/So_4WToHMfn76-m1/articles/images/6a996be5_26296350049179.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=So_4WToHMfn76-m1&q=85&s=13d579075ee1c0876cea50bd9f40ba61)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-manage-your-dns-records-on-kajabi#add-custom-records-to-dns-settings)

Add custom records to DNS settings
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  From the Dashboard, open the **Settings** tab.
2.  Under **Site settings**, click **Domain,** then **DNS Settings**.
3.  Click **\+ Custom Record** in the top right corner of the DNS Settings page and select a record type:

![DNS Settings](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/EFdfkzsgcSmbPght/articles/images/c4df2456_26296694269979.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=EFdfkzsgcSmbPght&q=85&s=4fe015eba773b870b5a04a4c469fe197)

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-manage-your-dns-records-on-kajabi#available-custom-record-types)

Available custom record types

*   **A record** - Assigns an address for your domain to a specific IP
*   **CNAME record** - Used to connect platforms through subdomains
*   **MX record** - Holds your email sending and receiving information
*   **SRV record** - Specifies a port for specific services. Commonly used for services like Skype or Discord.
*   **TXT record** - These records are used to hold your email security information (e.g., DKIM) as well as for third-party plug-ins.

Changes to your DNS records can take up to 24-48 hours to go into full effect. If you encounter issues after 24-48 hours, please reach out to our [support team](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/support/how-to-contact-kajabi-support)
 for additional assistance.

# Test a domain connection to prevent webmail disruption - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-test-your-domain-connection-to-prevent-a-webmail-disruption#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-test-your-domain-connection-to-prevent-a-webmail-disruption#overview)

Overview
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

After connecting your custom website domain to Kajabi by choosing the “Connect domain to Kajabi” option and updating your domain nameservers, check to make sure that the DNS records for your webmail service have been imported to Kajabi.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-test-your-domain-connection-to-prevent-a-webmail-disruption#what-happens-after-connecting-a-custom-domain-to-kajabi)

What happens after connecting a custom domain to Kajabi
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Every website has a domain host that manages the [DNS (Domain Name System) records](https://www.cloudflare.com/learning/dns/dns-records/)
 on the backend of the site. Examples of domain hosting providers include GoDaddy, Bluehost, and Cloudflare. When you change your nameservers to point your website domain to Kajabi, Kajabi becomes the new DNS authority for your site. This means that any time you need to update your DNS records, you’ll do so directly in your Kajabi DNS Settings. If you have a webmail service connected to your custom website domain, Kajabi will need to know the DNS records associated with your webmail in order to keep it up and running. Common examples of webmail providers include Google Workspace and Office 365. Learn how to manage your DNS settings in Kajabi [here](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-manage-your-dns-records-on-kajabi)
.

**Tip:** If you don’t yet have a webmail service connected to your domain, you’ll need to set one up in order to both send and receive emails via a full-service email account tied to your domain name. Kajabi’s Custom Email Domain feature is used exclusively to customize the sender address on your site’s automated outgoing marketing emails. It is not a replacement for a webmail service.

After you follow the steps to [connect your custom domain to Kajabi](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/connect-a-custom-domain)
, your DNS records (including any webmail records) should automatically import as part of the connection process. However, in some cases this import can fail. **We strongly recommend that you screenshot all of your original DNS records prior to changing nameservers in case you need to manually add them later.**

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-test-your-domain-connection-to-prevent-a-webmail-disruption#test-the-domain-connection)

Test the domain connection
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Follow these steps to check if the DNS records for your webmail are imported correctly.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-test-your-domain-connection-to-prevent-a-webmail-disruption#step-1-wait-for-a-connection-confirmation)

Step 1. Wait for a connection confirmation

After connecting your website domain to Kajabi, you’ll receive an email confirmation that the connection process has completed. If you don’t see this email within about 24 hours, check your Kajabi Domain Settings to see if your domain is connected: ![Custom Domain is Connected](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/ulOk3PjSKir43Xg0/articles/images/0abcb0f7_upload_10745792245508523069.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=ulOk3PjSKir43Xg0&q=85&s=3c5dae6fa3f8b3417353f2ba8caf5ee1)

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-test-your-domain-connection-to-prevent-a-webmail-disruption#step-2-check-your-kajabi-dns-settings)

Step 2. Check your Kajabi DNS settings

Once you’ve received confirmation that your domain is connected to Kajabi, check your Kajabi DNS Settings for webmail MX records:

1.  Open the **Settings** tab at the lower left of your Kajabi Dashboard.
2.  In your Site Settings, select **Domain**.
3.  Click the **DNS Settings** link at the top left of your Domain Settings page.
4.  Navigate to the **MX Record** section of your Advanced Settings:

If you see MX records listed, the automatic import process worked — but send yourself a test email to confirm your email account is still working properly.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-test-your-domain-connection-to-prevent-a-webmail-disruption#restore-missing-webmail-records)

Restore missing webmail records
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

If there are no MX records listed in your Kajabi DNS Settings, you’ll need to add your webmail records manually. You might need to add just MX records or a combination of MX and TXT records, depending on your webmail provider (Google Workspace, Office 365, etc.). If you took a screenshot or otherwise noted your original DNS records, use that documentation for reference. If you don’t have a copy of your records, contact your ESP (email service provider) and ask them to provide you with the DNS records needed to reconnect your webmail. Alternately, you might still be able to retrieve the records from your prior domain host’s DNS settings. Google’s MX records are also available in our troubleshooting guide [here](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/marketing/email-campaigns/why-are-my-emails-not-sending-or-receiving-after-i-connect-my-custom-domain#h_01FRVAHREHYDH7S5BHP5X8RN9P)
. Microsoft Office 365 requires several DNS records to connect, including Autodiscover, MX, and SPF records. The MX record value is unique to your personal account. Learn more about using Office 365 DNS records [here](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/enterprise/external-domain-name-system-records?view=o365-worldwide#external-dns-records-required-for-email-in-office-365-exchange-online)
. Once you have a copy of your webmail records in hand, follow the steps in our guide on [how to manually add missing DNS records](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/marketing/email-campaigns/why-are-my-emails-not-sending-or-receiving-after-i-connect-my-custom-domain)
.
