# Kajabi default subdomain vs custom domain - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/kajabi-default-subdomain-vs-custom-domain#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/kajabi-default-subdomain-vs-custom-domain#overview)

Overview
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Kajabi ensures that your site can be accessed through both your Kajabi subdomain and a connected custom domain. This guide explains the difference between these options and how to configure them. ![Domain Setup Options](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/T7HThu_bu5xEvH2P/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-9-domain-setup-1785428314947.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=T7HThu_bu5xEvH2P&q=85&s=bf0a7e1fc2c509fd2cb13e4dabf41cc9)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/kajabi-default-subdomain-vs-custom-domain#kajabi-default-subdomain)

Kajabi default subdomain
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

When you create your account, Kajabi generates a default subdomain for you. You should **use (or change) the default subdomain for your Kajabi site** if your site is hosted elsewhere, like Wordpress, Wix, or Squarespace. An example of this subdomain would be the “cooking with Carl” piece of \*\*\*cookingwithcarl.\*\*\*mykajabi.com. This subdomain must be unique. Meaning, just like with an email address, there cannot be two of the same subdomain under Kajabi. Subdomains must be at least 3 characters long, contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens, and cannot use reserved words such as: `admin`, `blog`, `login`, `mail`, `www`, `staging`, `smtp`, or `ftp`.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/kajabi-default-subdomain-vs-custom-domain#change-the-default-kajabi-subdomain)

Change the default Kajabi subdomain

1.  Open the **Settings** tab from your **Dashboard**.
2.  Click **Domain**.
3.  Then, in the Kajabi default Subdomain section, edit your **Kajabi subdomain**.
4.  Click **Save** to apply your changes.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/kajabi-default-subdomain-vs-custom-domain#custom-domain)

Custom domain
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Connect a custom domain if your business’s main website is hosted by Kajabi and you would like to give your site a full custom URL. Connecting a custom domain is a great way to reinforce brand identity and build trust between prospects/customers and your business while giving your website an added professional look and feel. Example: _**cookingwithcarl.com**_ If desired, you may also add a subdomain to your custom domain. Example: \*\*\*courses.\*\*\*cookingwithcarl.com Doing this (even after your site has been live for some time) will allow your visitors to access your site with both your original Kajabi subdomain and your connected custom domain. **For example:** You launch your site with the Kajabi subdomain, _cookingwithcarl.mykajabi.com_, then decide to connect your custom domain to Kajabi (i.e., _cookingwithcarl.com_). Your site visitors can access your site using both the Kajabi subdomain cookingwithcarl.mykajabi.com and your connected custom domain cookingwithcarl.com. To learn how to connect your custom domain to your Kajabi site, see our article [Connect a custom domain](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/connect-a-custom-domain)
.

# Lightning Loader - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/lightning-loader#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/lightning-loader#overview)

Overview
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Load time is the amount of time it takes for a website to render on a device screen and become functional. A fast load time is essential to give your site users a great experience. Learn more about how Kajabi’s Lightning Loader accomplishes this.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/lightning-loader#what-is-lightning-loader)

What is Lightning Loader?
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Lightning Loader is caching technology that improves your website load time and overall site performance to create the best possible experience for your visitors. And the best part is, Kajabi automatically includes this technology with your site! You don’t have to lift a finger to enable Lightning Loader.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/lightning-loader#how-does-it-work)

How does it work?
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Lightning Loader is different than browser caching. Browser caching is local to each site visitor and can vary depending on the visitor’s unique browser settings. Lightning Loader caches your page output independent of browser caching, which greatly speeds up page load time. The more complex your site is, the more impact Lightning Loader may have on your load time.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/lightning-loader#what-is-load-time-and-why-is-it-important)

What is load time and why is it important?
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Load time is the amount of time it takes for a website to render on a device screen and become functional. A fast load time is essential to give your site users a great experience. Let’s be real, the only time you’ve probably noticed load time is when a site is taking way too long to load (and you’ve got better things to do than wait around). Slow load times can lose customers fast.

# Troubleshoot a site not secure message - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-troubleshoot-site-not-secure-message#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-troubleshoot-site-not-secure-message#overview)

Overview
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

If you receive a “Site Not Secure” error message when accessing a Product or Page, refer to this guide to ensure that your site is secure.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-troubleshoot-site-not-secure-message#understand-secure-vs-not-secure)

Understand secure vs. not secure
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Site Not Secure Message:** ![Site Not Secure Message](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/fIOZvo-6lVf3a0o9/articles/images/fd789707_360065851553.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=fIOZvo-6lVf3a0o9&q=85&s=53c06333e1241f98489aa7c77300891d)

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-troubleshoot-site-not-secure-message#what-can-cause-this-message)

What can cause this message?

This message can be caused by conflicting temporary internet files (from web browser caching) or your domain may be directing your visitors to your site using HTTP instead of HTTPS.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-troubleshoot-site-not-secure-message#what-is-the-difference-between-http-and-https)

What is the difference between HTTP and HTTPS?

In short, HTTPS is HTTP encrypted. The S in HTTPS stands for “secure.” HTTPS uses an encryption protocol known as a Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) to encrypt HTTP requests and responses. As a result, HTTPS is more secure than HTTP. To determine if your site is using HTTP or HTTPS:

*   `http://` is using HTTP
*   `https://` is using HTTPS

When your website displays `http://` in the URL instead of `https://` you may encounter a “Site Not Secure” message:

Read [CloudFlare’s Guide to HTTPS](https://www.cloudflare.com/learning/ssl/what-is-https/)
 to learn more.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-troubleshoot-site-not-secure-message#troubleshoot-your-site)

Troubleshoot your site
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-troubleshoot-site-not-secure-message#step-1-clear-your-web-browser%E2%80%99s-cache-and-cookies)

Step 1. Clear your web browser’s cache and cookies

Clearing your web browser’s cache and cookies provides a “clean slate” for you. Your browser will be reset and you can try again with a fresh browsing setup. Read popular web browser guides on clearing your browser’s cache:

*   Learn to [clear cache and cookies in Chrome](https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/32050?co=GENIE.Platform%3DDesktop&hl=enIn)
    .
*   Learn to [clear history, cache, and cookies in Safari](https://support.apple.com/guide/safari/clear-your-browsing-history-sfri47acf5d6/mac)
    .

If you are using another web browser, check its support site for instructions on clearing cache and cookies.

**Note:** When managing your browser settings to clear cache and cookies from your web browser, be sure to continue allowing third-party cookies to avoid experiencing the [Login Page error](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/why-does-the-login-page-or-404-error-keep-appearing-when-editing-my-site)
.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-troubleshoot-site-not-secure-message#step-2-check-if-your-domain-redirects-to-http-or-https)

Step 2. Check if your domain redirects to http or https

If your cache and cookies have been cleared but the “Not Secure” message persists, check to see if your website is using `http://`or `https://`:

1.  Enter your **domain** into the address bar of your web browser.
2.  Click into the **URL** to expand and view the entire URL:

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-troubleshoot-site-not-secure-message#step-3-set-up-a-forwarding-rule-with-your-domain-host)

Step 3. Set up a forwarding rule with your domain host

In order to secure your custom domain, ensure that you’ve set up a forwarding rule for your domain to always go to `https://`. Each domain provider has their own flow for setting up a forwarding rule, so depending on your domain host (e.g., GoDaddy, Bluehost, etc.) your setup may differ slightly. If your custom domain still requires a forwarding rule to always go to `https://`, refer to the guide corresponding with your domain provider. If you’re using another domain provider, please refer to their support site for instructions on creating a forwarding rule. Learn how to add/edit a Forwarder for a few popular hosting services:

*   [GoDaddy](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-set-up-a-forwarding-rule-for-your-custom-domain-on-godaddy)
    
*   [Bluehost](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-set-up-a-forwarding-rule-for-your-custom-domain-on-bluehost)
    

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-troubleshoot-site-not-secure-message#step-4-ensure-that-all-5-records-have-been-added-to-your-custom-domain-properly)

Step 4. Ensure that all 5 records have been added to your custom domain properly

[Learn more about configuring DNS settings in Kajabi](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/connect-a-custom-domain)
.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-troubleshoot-site-not-secure-message#still-experiencing-issues-contact-support)

Still experiencing issues? Contact support

Lastly, if you’ve cleared your browser’s cache and cookies and your custom domain is set to always go to `https://` instead of `http://`, please reach out to our support team.

# Troubleshoot custom domain issues - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/troubleshooting-custom-domain-issues#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/troubleshooting-custom-domain-issues#overview)

Overview
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Kajabi provides tools to manage every aspect of your custom domain, including disconnecting or reconnecting the domain, reverting to your default Kajabi subdomain (.mykajabi.com), and resolving DNS issues.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/troubleshooting-custom-domain-issues#disconnect-a-custom-domain)

Disconnect a custom domain
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

To disconnect your custom domain from Kajabi, follow these steps:

1.  Open your Kajabi dashboard and navigate to **Settings > Domain**.
2.  Locate the custom domain you want to disconnect.
3.  Click the three-dot menu (located next to your custom domain).
4.  Select **Remove** or **Disconnect** to complete the process.

**Important:**

*   If there is no three-dot menu or no option to disconnect, your domain may not currently be connected to your Kajabi account.
*   In some cases, you may also need to update your DNS settings at your domain registrar (e.g., GoDaddy, Squarespace) to stop pointing the domain to Kajabi.
*   Enter the required information, such as the subdomain name (e.g., courses). Do not enter the full domain (e.g., courses.example.com).

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/troubleshooting-custom-domain-issues#reconnect-or-add-a-custom-domain)

Reconnect or add a custom domain
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

To reconnect or add a custom domain to your Kajabi account, follow these steps:

1.  Go to **Settings > Domain** in your Kajabi dashboard.
2.  Click **Setup Custom Domain**.
3.  Choose and follow one of the available methods:
    *   **Connect Domain to Kajabi (Nameserver Method)**: Update the nameservers at your domain registrar as provided by Kajabi.
    *   **Subdomain Method**: Update specific DNS records (e.g., CNAME) at your registrar per Kajabi’s instructions.
4.  Allow up to 24-48 hours for DNS propagation.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/troubleshooting-custom-domain-issues#switch-back-to-the-kajabi-subdomain)

Switch back to the Kajabi subdomain
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

If you want to use the default Kajabi subdomain instead of your custom domain:

1.  Go to **Settings > Domain**.
2.  Click the three-dot menu next to your custom domain.
3.  Select **Remove**. This will automatically revert your Kajabi site to the default subdomain.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/troubleshooting-custom-domain-issues#troubleshoot-common-domain-issues)

Troubleshoot common domain issues
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/troubleshooting-custom-domain-issues#resolve-dns-connection-issues)

Resolve DNS connection issues

If your domain is not connecting properly, you may need to:

1.  Remove the custom domain in Kajabi and then go through the setup process again.
2.  Verify that the DNS records at your registrar match the values provided by Kajabi.
3.  Allow time for DNS propagation, which can take up to 24-48 hours after making changes.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/troubleshooting-custom-domain-issues#update-dns-settings-for-specific-registrars)

Update DNS settings for specific registrars

For users dealing with specific platforms like GoDaddy or Squarespace:

1.  Disconnect the domain from the current platform (e.g., Squarespace).
2.  Remove the old nameservers (e.g., Kajabi’s Cloudflare nameservers).
3.  Add the new DNS records or nameservers applicable to your setup.

This process ensures that domains pointing to one service can be updated to point to another (e.g., for GHL record setup).

# Code-based customizations - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/code-based-customizations#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/code-based-customizations#overview)

Overview
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Kajabi provides you with the flexibility to make your site your own through the use of custom code. However, adding custom code to your site is an advanced modification that may affect the functionality and the security of your site, which may result in unintended consequences. Kajabi cannot guarantee the functionality or compatibility of any custom code with your site, and **all code-based customizations fall outside the scope of Kajabi Support**. We advise Heroes to use vulnerability tools like [VirusTotal](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/home/url)
 or [Snyk](https://snyk.io/)
 to scan any custom code they intend to use and apply certain best practices to help reduce potential impact.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/code-based-customizations#code-based-customizations)

Code-based customizations
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

You can use custom code-based modifications when a feature, functionality, or embedded content isn’t available in Kajabi. All code-based customizations fall outside of the scope of Kajabi support. Adding a custom modification usually involves pasting code provided by a third-party service into an acceptable location of your site. We recommend using an external tool like VirusTotal, Snyk, or any other tool you prefer to scan for vulnerabilities and malware for any custom code you intend to use from a third party. Since these are code-based solutions, we cannot guarantee their functionality or compatibility with Kajabi. This includes, but is not limited to, their ability to function with our design, particularly their appearance on mobile devices or if it functions on all templates. Things to think about when integrating third-party code:

*   What is your objective for adding code to your site?
*   Who wrote the code that you are adding to your site?
*   Did you test your code before adding it to your site?

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/code-based-customizations#custom-code-recommendations)

Custom code recommendations
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Code customizations can cause issues on your site with future updates to our platform. While we can’t help further, many resources can point you in the right direction, including the following:

*   Kajabi experts
*   W3 Schools
*   Stack Overflow
*   Kajabi custom code articles (see links below)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/code-based-customizations#common-code-types-available-to-add-to-your-site)

Common code types available to add to your site
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/code-based-customizations#html)

HTML

The code used to add content to a web page. When you add a block, you’re adding HTML to your site.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/code-based-customizations#javascript)

JavaScript

The code used to add interactivity to a web page. JavaScript works behind the scenes to make things like slideshows, sliders, and lightboxes work.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/code-based-customizations#css)

CSS

CSS is the coding language used to apply style and design to a web page written in HTML. You can use the CSS editor to customize:

*   Fonts
*   Colors
*   Backgrounds

You shouldn’t use CSS to customize:

*   Padding
*   Margins
*   Floats
*   Sizes (Blocks, Images, or Banners)
*   Positioning

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/code-based-customizations#custom-code-integration-articles)

Custom code integration articles
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

| Custom code integration article | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [How to add a custom section](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-add-a-custom-section) | Use custom sections to add custom code to your pages. |
| [How to add custom fonts](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/add-custom-fonts) | Add custom fonts to your pages with custom fonts. |
| [How to add custom code to your page](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/add-custom-code-to-pages) | Modify your site with custom code. |
| [How to embed custom code to your page with Premier](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-embed-custom-code-to-your-page-with-premier) | Add custom code with pages built with Premier. |
| [Connect a third-party payment gateway](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/api-integrations/payment-integrations/connect-a-third-party-payment-gateway) | Connects your third-party payment gateway to Kajabi. |

# Verify a domain with Facebook - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/verifying-your-domain-with-facebook#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/verifying-your-domain-with-facebook#overview)

Overview
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Verifying your domain with Facebook is a required step to ensure that only verified owners can edit the way their content appears on Facebook. This guide walks you through how to verify your domain with Facebook’s Business Manager.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/verifying-your-domain-with-facebook#domain-verification)

Domain verification
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

If you wish to implement Facebook tools like [connecting Facebook Pixel](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/api-integrations/analytics-integrations/meta-pixel-with-kajabi)
 to your site on Kajabi, Facebook requires you to [verify your domain](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/sharing/domain-verification)
 to protect and claim ownership of your website domain name. Facebook provides three different methods to verify your domain, two of which can be used for your site on Kajabi: ![Facebook domain verification methods](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/p8xUcPoEbYtv-GgI/articles/images/b51ad753_73574EC6-9DB3-4FA6-9727-853A81E9D6E4.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=p8xUcPoEbYtv-GgI&q=85&s=15d359ae92860d381a9881ca016fa2be) Method 1 and 3 will allow you to verify your domain for your site on Kajabi. [Learn to implement Facebook’s domain verification](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/sharing/domain-verification/verifying-your-domain)
. If you choose to follow Method 3, the meta tag can be easily copied and pasted onto your header page scripts. [Learn to add to your header page scripts](https://help.kajabi.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037850453#page-scripts)
.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/verifying-your-domain-with-facebook#my-domain-is-not-verifying-with-facebook)

My domain is not verifying with Facebook
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Facebook cannot verify your domain if you have not connected a custom domain to your site.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/verifying-your-domain-with-facebook#why-do-you-need-a-custom-domain-to-verify)

Why do you need a custom domain to verify?

Facebook verifies the root domain for a site (e.g., kajabi.com). Without a custom domain, method 1 is unavailable because your DNS records will be inaccessible and method 3 will not allow Facebook to find and verify the root domain if you add a meta tag to your header page scripts for your Kajabi subdomain (e.g., yoursubdomain.mykajabi.com). In order to verify your domain with Facebook you will need to connect a custom domain to your site. [Learn to connect a custom domain](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/connect-a-custom-domain)

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/verifying-your-domain-with-facebook#will-your-site-be-accessible-with-your-kajabi-subdomain-if-you-connect-a-custom-domain)

Will your site be accessible with your Kajabi subdomain if you connect a custom domain?

Connecting a custom domain to your site on Kajabi allows your site visitors to access your site with both your Kajabi subdomain and your connected custom domain. [Learn more](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/what-happens-if-i-change-my-domain-after-my-website-has-been-live)

# Change a domain after a site is live - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/what-happens-if-i-change-my-domain-after-my-website-has-been-live#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/what-happens-if-i-change-my-domain-after-my-website-has-been-live#overview)

Overview
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Wondering what happens to your existing traffic and links if you change your domain? This guide explains the differences between changing to a custom domain versus changing your Kajabi subdomain.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/what-happens-if-i-change-my-domain-after-my-website-has-been-live#changing-subdomain-to-a-custom-domain)

Changing subdomain to a custom domain
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Kajabi ensures that your site can be accessed through your Kajabi Subdomain and your connected Custom Domain! [Connecting a custom Domain](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/connect-a-custom-domain)
 to your Kajabi site (even after your site has been live for some time) will allow your visitors to access your site with both your original Kajabi Subdomain and your connected Custom Domain. For example: You launch your site with the Kajabi subdomain, myawesomesite.mykajabi.com, then decide to connect your custom domain to Kajabi (e.g., myawesomesite.com). Your site visitors can access your site with both the Kajabi subdomain **myawesomesite.mykajabi.com** and your connected custom domain **myawesomesite.com**!

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/what-happens-if-i-change-my-domain-after-my-website-has-been-live#change-your-kajabi-subdomain-to-a-different-kajabi-subdomain)

Change your Kajabi subdomain to a different Kajabi subdomain
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

At this time, it isn’t possible to set up a 301 redirect to the new subdomain natively within Kajabi. If you start with a Kajabi subdomain (e.g., helpcenter.mykajabi.com), gain traffic, and then change it at a later date (e.g., articles.mykajabi.com) the old subdomain will show up as a non-existing page.

**Tip:** If you wish to create a new domain for branding purposes, we recommend creating a custom domain and [connecting it to Kajabi](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/connect-a-custom-domain)
. Then, both the old subdomain and new custom domain will direct to your website appropriately.

# Manage affiliates - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-your-affiliates#content-area)

Create and manage your affiliates in the **My affiliates** section of your **Affiliates Dashboard**. Before getting started, ensure your Kajabi site is set up for affiliate use, including enabling affiliate features and setting default and Offer-level commissions. [Access your Affiliate report](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-report)
 for an overview of affiliate data. Click on an affiliate’s **Name** to:

*   Review their individual affiliate statistics.
*   Override their affiliate [Percentage](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/set-up-your-affiliate-program#set-default-affiliate-commission)
    .
*   View which **Share Links** are available to each affiliate.
*   Create a **Manual Transaction** to credit your affiliate.

![Upload 5942558563625786733](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/3dT4k6GfaoRj67A8/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-7-affiliate-user-dashboard-1744235844850-1756080394552-1759912604446-1768530397312-1769338596991-1775382381998-1780241397065.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=3dT4k6GfaoRj67A8&q=85&s=3ff6e3841ef8cb5187a5bf69a8da10fd)

**Note:** Affiliates do not automatically get added to your **Contacts** tab. Because affiliates do not need to be customers of your site, they may only exist on your **Affiliates Dashboard**.However, if your affiliates complete a **Form** created on your Kajabi site, purchase an **Offer**, or are manually imported into your Contacts tab, then you will be able to see your affiliates in both your Affiliates Dashboard and your Contacts tab.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-your-affiliates#invite-affiliates)

Invite Affiliates
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Manually import affiliates by sending an invite to join your site.

1.  From the Dashboard, click **Sales.**
2.  Click **Affiliates**.
3.  Open **My affiliates** from the top navigation menu.
4.  There, click **\+ Invite affiliates** in the top right corner of the page.
5.  Enter the **Name** and **Email Address** of your new affiliate(s).
6.  Click **Invite**.

You will receive an email from our support team to the email associated with your account when the affiliate import process has finished.

**Note:** You may add up to 500 affiliates with each import.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-your-affiliates#use-a-csv-to-import-affiliates)

Use a CSV to import affiliates

You can copy affiliate information from a specifically formatted CSV file and paste it into the **Invite new affiliates** field. ![37939832860955](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/sWVSYxLy3BSQwV9A/images/37939832860955.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=sWVSYxLy3BSQwV9A&q=85&s=fa1bb6b6264e7ea1165f7e1bef084d59)

*   Format each line as **First Name Last Name**,**Email Address**
*   Do not include extra commas or special characters
    *   **Examples:**
        *   John Doe,[jdoe@example.com](mailto:jdoe@example.com)
            
        *   Jane Smith,[jsmith@example.com](mailto:jsmith@example.com)
            

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-your-affiliates#activate-affiliate-commissions)

Activate Affiliate commissions

After inviting your affiliates, activate **Affiliate commissions** to credit your affiliates for transactions made with their Share Links. [Learn more](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/activate-affiliate-commission)
. Additionally, you can activate affiliate commissions specifically for certain offers:

1.  From the Dashboard, click **Sales**, then click **Pricing.**
2.  Select the desired **Offer**.
3.  Select the **Settings** tab.
4.  Toggle on **Activate affiliate commissions for this offer** to configure the specific payout percentage or fixed amount for that offer.

For custom affiliate links, head to the **Affiliates Dashboard** and use the **Share Links** tab to generate referral links that redirect to specific Landing Pages, Sales Pages, or Checkout Pages. Provide affiliates with these unique links for targeted promotions. To manage payouts, monitor transactions in the **Transactions** tab of the Affiliates Dashboard. From here, you can export reports for performance reviews and configure automatic or manual payouts.

**Note:** When opening an exported report CSV file, use TextEdit (for Mac) or Notepad (for PCs).

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-your-affiliates#after-inviting-an-affiliate)

After inviting an Affiliate
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

An invited affiliate is marked with an **Invite pending** banner until they have confirmed their desire to join as an affiliate of your site: ![My Affiliates](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/sWVSYxLy3BSQwV9A/images/MyAffiliates.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=sWVSYxLy3BSQwV9A&q=85&s=dcede4de65c64053061c85ba8a192571)

**Note:** Your invited affiliate has up to 72 hours to confirm and verify their email before they are successfully added to your site.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-your-affiliates#send-the-affiliate-signup-link)

Send the Affiliate Signup link
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Enable self-registration to allow Affiliate Users to register for your site.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-your-affiliates#enable-affiliate-registrations)

Enable Affiliate registrations

1.  Open the **Sales** tab from your Dashboard.
2.  Click **Affiliates**.
3.  Open **Settings** from the top navigation menu.
4.  Toggle on **Enable Self-Registrations**.

![Affiliate Sign Up](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/sWVSYxLy3BSQwV9A/images/AffiliateSignUp.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=sWVSYxLy3BSQwV9A&q=85&s=c06e2d1d7ac07022ab0ef916e5272bd1)

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-your-affiliates#copy-and-share-the-affiliate-sign-up-link)

Copy and share the Affiliate sign-up link

1.  Open the **Sales** tab from your Dashboard.
2.  Click **Affiliates**.
3.  Open **Settings** from the top navigation menu.
4.  Select **Copy** next to the **Share sign-up link** field.

**Tip:** Learn how to [create a custom Affiliate Signup Page](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/contacts/manage-your-contacts/create-a-custom-affiliate-signup-page)
 to customize your affiliate onboarding experience.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-your-affiliates#affiliate-user-welcome-email)

Affiliate user welcome email
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

An **affiliate user welcome email** is sent to your affiliates after they’ve successfully signed up as an affiliate of your site.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-your-affiliates#default-welcome-email)

Default welcome email

![Affiliate Welcome Email 1](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/sWVSYxLy3BSQwV9A/images/AffiliateWelcomeEmail-1.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=sWVSYxLy3BSQwV9A&q=85&s=90103af61f3158b40946232c6d108684)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-your-affiliates#edit-the-affiliate-user-welcome-email)

Edit the affiliate user welcome email
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Open the **Sales** tab from your Dashboard.
2.  Click **Affiliates**.
3.  Select the **Settings** tab from the top menu.
4.  Scroll down the page to the **Welcome email**.
5.  Edit your **Subject line** and **Email body**.
6.  Click **Save** to apply your changes.
7.  Click **Preview welcome email** to view how your email will appear to your Affiliates.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-your-affiliates#send-an-affiliate-portal-login-link)

Send an Affiliate Portal login link
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

New affiliates will receive an email containing their login credentials and the link to log in to their [Affiliate Portal](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliates-overview#affiliate-portal)
. If you wish to send your affiliates the link to log in directly:

1.  Open the **Sales** tab from your Dashboard.
2.  Click the **Affiliates** tab.
3.  Select the **Settings** tab from the top menu.
4.  In the **Affiliate sign-up and registration** section, click **Copy** next to the **Login page link** and send to your new affiliate.

![Affiliates Login Link](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/sWVSYxLy3BSQwV9A/images/AffiliatesLoginLink.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=sWVSYxLy3BSQwV9A&q=85&s=8982042e4de76ec59c3bdcc8e952e4d1)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-your-affiliates#delete-an-affiliate-user)

Delete an Affiliate User
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Deleting an affiliate will permanently remove them from your site, including all related affiliate data such as clicks and conversions.

1.  Open the **Sales** tab from your Dashboard.
2.  Click **Affiliates**.
3.  Select **My affiliates** from the top navigation menu.
4.  Select the name of the Affiliate you wish to remove.
5.  Scroll to the bottom of the page and click **Delete**.
6.  Complete the prompt.
7.  Click **Delete affiliate**.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-your-affiliates#additional-resources)

Additional resources
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Get started with SEO - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/get-started-with-seo#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/get-started-with-seo#overview)

Overview
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

SEO (Search Engine Optimization) helps put your business at the forefront of search engines like Google. Optimizing your website can help you rank higher in search results for keywords related to your business, increasing traffic and visibility.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/get-started-with-seo#what-is-seo)

What is SEO?
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

SEO stands for Search Engine Optimization—the practice of optimizing your website to rank higher in search engine results. When users search for a keyword, search engines display a series of results. Each result typically contains:

*   URL
*   Page title
*   Description

![search-engine-results-page.png](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/c9qoPwTHAQHxkdRa/articles/images/52875ab6_4417408132763.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=c9qoPwTHAQHxkdRa&q=85&s=b2289e9b1b9fc1c1b626ad78f49c2429)

**Note:** Search engine results pages may also include paid ads at the top or bottom of the results.

The higher you rank in search results, the more likely someone will click through to your website. SEO helps you optimize your content to achieve better rankings for keywords relevant to your business. Every page and blog post on your Kajabi site has an SEO and Sharing section where you can set a page title, description, and image.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/get-started-with-seo#page-title)

Page title
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

You can set a page title in the SEO and Sharing section of any page or blog post. Depending on the search engine, your page title may display below the URL breadcrumb on results pages and on browser tabs.

**Note:** Search engines may display relevant text from your page instead of your custom title.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/get-started-with-seo#improve-page-titles-for-seo)

Improve page titles for SEO

*   Describe your page content in less than 70 characters
*   Include a relevant keyword when it makes sense
*   Use unique titles for each page

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/get-started-with-seo#pages)

Pages

![page-title-pages.png](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/0SrqXIvQyuWTYRde/articles/images/d5aeced7_4417481686043.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=0SrqXIvQyuWTYRde&q=85&s=bd14e9a35be76c3dcc96339fad90b0cd)

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/get-started-with-seo#blog)

Blog

![page-title-blog.png](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/uG5M_9Irmb-dLu49/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-11-seo-blog-page-title-1780204596510-1780240229832.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=uG5M_9Irmb-dLu49&q=85&s=806d0ec495b0c61b535c1b7cd4c42d25)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/get-started-with-seo#page-description)

Page description
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Set a page description in the SEO and Sharing section of a page or blog post.

**Note:** Search engines may display relevant text from your page instead of your custom description.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/get-started-with-seo#improve-page-descriptions-for-seo)

Improve page descriptions for SEO

*   Summarize your page content in 1-2 sentences
*   Include a relevant keyword
*   Use unique descriptions for each page

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/get-started-with-seo#pages-2)

Pages

![page-description-pages.png](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/bsblzYTSOWswzHGj/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-8-seo-page-description-1782636379834-1784152795503.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=bsblzYTSOWswzHGj&q=85&s=3caf90bcb686b7b91737760c1c87ef81)

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/get-started-with-seo#blog-2)

Blog

![page-description-blog.png](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/ahwoU0_p6kjEKLjN/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-11-seo-blog-page-description-1780204596465-1781159460137.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=ahwoU0_p6kjEKLjN&q=85&s=e8da679aa565d4a1b7474718499bc7aa)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/get-started-with-seo#page-url)

Page URL
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Set a page URL in the General section of a page or the SEO and Sharing section of a blog post. This URL displays in search results and is the link users click to access your page.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/get-started-with-seo#improve-page-urls-for-seo)

Improve page URLs for SEO

*   Keep it short
*   Avoid vague URLs (e.g., page-123)—briefly describe the page instead
*   Use hyphens to separate words, not underscores
*   Use lowercase letters
*   Include a relevant keyword when appropriate

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/get-started-with-seo#pages-3)

Pages

![page-url-pages.png](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/kyPjiIL9ED6HYU81/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-9-pages-subdomain-1780204596336-1781159461124.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=kyPjiIL9ED6HYU81&q=85&s=9c9591ea0ec20e23c30f7f0f688e0f90)

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/get-started-with-seo#blog-3)

Blog

![page-url-blog.png](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/XVFEW84mgDPH75bG/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-10-seo-blog-page-url-1780204596476-1781159461850.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=XVFEW84mgDPH75bG&q=85&s=aeaaf3c52ad03d0890ea3151cd115c4e)

The title in the General section is an internal title, while the Page Title in the SEO and Sharing section is visible to users. The same applies to blog posts. [Learn more about the SEO and Sharing section](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/seo-and-sharing)
.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/get-started-with-seo#header-tags)

Header tags
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Header tags structure your page content for both users and search engines. Use Kajabi’s text editors to select heading tags that organize your content.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/get-started-with-seo#to-view-header-tag-options)

To view header tag options

1.  Open the **text editor** for your desired text section
2.  Click **Formats**
3.  Select **Heading**

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/get-started-with-seo#heading-hierarchy)

Heading hierarchy

*   **Heading 1:** The title of your page
*   **Heading 2:** Subheadings
*   **Heading 3-6:** Further subheadings for your content

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/get-started-with-seo#improve-headings-for-seo)

Improve headings for SEO

*   Use only one H1 tag per page
*   Include a relevant keyword in your H1 tag
*   Add keywords to other header tags when appropriate

![header-tags.png](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/Fky1o1xAW1UyWbKo/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-13-text-editor-headings-1785055573277-1785428635681.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=Fky1o1xAW1UyWbKo&q=85&s=83eaff4a6312887f326c381513f4c151)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/get-started-with-seo#images)

Images
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Good filenames and alt text for images improve your SEO. Alt text describes an image for screen readers and search engines. You can find this field in the Image Block in the website or page builder.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/get-started-with-seo#improve-images-for-seo)

Improve images for SEO

*   Avoid vague filenames (e.g., image123.png)—briefly describe the image instead
*   Use hyphens to separate words in filenames, not underscores
*   Reduce image file size using tools like [Squoosh](https://squoosh.app/)
    
*   Add alt text that briefly describes each image
*   Include relevant keywords in filenames and alt text when appropriate

![image-alt-attribute.png](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/kyPjiIL9ED6HYU81/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-9-image-alt-attribute-1781159463060.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=kyPjiIL9ED6HYU81&q=85&s=8032e81f32044477efa5a869a6a914dd)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/get-started-with-seo#text)

Text
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Quality written content on your pages and blog posts supports better SEO performance.

**Note:** AI-powered search tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews rely on readable text content to surface your pages. Text written directly on your pages is more accessible to both search engines and AI tools than text embedded in images. For best results, avoid placing important content inside images.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/get-started-with-seo#improve-text-for-seo)

Improve text for SEO

*   Write longer content (over 2,000 words) when appropriate
*   Include relevant keywords throughout your content, but don’t overdo it
*   Use descriptive link text instead of phrases like “click here”

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/get-started-with-seo#sitemap)

Sitemap
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A sitemap helps search engines index the pages on your website. While not required to get listed on search engines, submitting your sitemap to Google and Bing can be helpful.

Submitting your sitemap to Bing also submits it to Yahoo. DuckDuckGo references Bing’s search results. Depending on your location, you may also want to submit to Yandex or Baidu.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/get-started-with-seo#google)

Google

#### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/get-started-with-seo#submit-a-sitemap-to-google)

Submit a sitemap to Google

1.  Log in to [Google Search Console](https://search.google.com/search-console/welcome)
     (requires a Google account)
2.  In the **URL Prefix** field, enter your full domain name (e.g., [https://www.example.com](https://www.example.com/)
    )
3.  Click **Continue**

There are several ways to verify your domain. This example uses the HTML tag method.

#### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/get-started-with-seo#to-use-the-html-tag-method)

To use the HTML tag method

1.  Click **HTML tag**
2.  Copy the Meta tag provided

![HTML tag verification](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/CM-okGX-0K4XYDbT/articles/images/59acb8ab_4418251493403.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=CM-okGX-0K4XYDbT&q=85&s=bf5e3593668a2a98c1fb0b5a4d195b5d) Open a separate browser tab and navigate to your Kajabi account.

#### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/get-started-with-seo#to-add-the-meta-tag-in-kajabi)

To add the Meta tag in Kajabi

1.  Open the **Settings** tab from your Dashboard
2.  Click **Site Details**
3.  Scroll to **Page scripts**
4.  Paste in your copied Meta tag
5.  Click **Save**

#### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/get-started-with-seo#to-complete-verification-in-google-search-console)

To complete verification in Google Search Console

1.  Click **Verify**
2.  Click **Go to Property**
3.  Select **Sitemaps**
4.  Enter **sitemap.xml** in the text field
5.  Click **Submit**

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/get-started-with-seo#bing)

Bing

#### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/get-started-with-seo#submit-a-sitemap-to-bing)

Submit a sitemap to Bing

1.  Open [Bing Webmasters Tools](https://www.bing.com/webmasters)
    
2.  Click **Get started** or **Login** (requires a Microsoft, Google, or Facebook account)
3.  In the “Add your site manually” field, enter your full domain name (e.g., [https://www.example.com](https://www.example.com/)
    )
4.  Click **Add**

![Bing add site](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/m6ttm4IwHXcY_OW_/articles/images/714021ca_4418365127579.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=m6ttm4IwHXcY_OW_&q=85&s=e72629dcf63f51ab5340e8a7ab298104) You can import your site from Google Search Console, but this example covers manual setup using the HTML Meta Tag method.

#### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/get-started-with-seo#to-use-the-html-meta-tag-method)

To use the HTML Meta Tag method

1.  Click **HTML Meta Tag**
2.  Copy the Meta tag provided

![Bing HTML meta tag](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/0-YPsbfqtWW6JQNQ/articles/images/f68d504e_4418365160859.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=0-YPsbfqtWW6JQNQ&q=85&s=ba53aad807d8946a29b9b2b2b8995445) Open a separate browser tab and navigate to your Kajabi account.

#### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/get-started-with-seo#to-add-the-meta-tag-in-kajabi-2)

To add the Meta tag in Kajabi

1.  From the Dashboard, open the **Settings** tab
2.  Click **Site Details**
3.  Scroll to **Page scripts**
4.  Paste the Meta tag into the Header Page Scripts field
5.  Click **Save**

#### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/get-started-with-seo#to-complete-verification-in-bing-webmaster-tools)

To complete verification in Bing Webmaster Tools

1.  Click **Verify**
2.  When “Site addition successful” appears, click **Done**
3.  Click **Sitemaps** in the left sidebar
4.  Click **Submit sitemap**
5.  Enter your full domain name with **/sitemap.xml** at the end (e.g., [https://www.example.com/sitemap.xml](https://www.example.com/sitemap.xml)
    )
6.  Click **Submit**

# Create Coupons - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/how-to-create-a-coupon#content-area)

Create **Coupons** to give a dollar amount or percentage off your Offers, or a percentage off cart purchases. Choose from three Coupon types: **Offer** for specific Offers, **Cart** for a customer’s cart total, and **Bulk** for a batch of unique one-time-use codes. If you’re not sure which type fits your promotion, see [Coupons Overview.](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/coupons-overview)

Coupons can be edited after creation, including the code, discount, and expiration date. Changes apply to new redemptions only.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/how-to-create-a-coupon#create-an-offer-coupon)

Create an Offer coupon
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Open the **Sales** tab from your Dashboard.
2.  Choose **Coupons**.
3.  Click **\+ New coupon**.
4.  Select **Offer coupon**.
5.  Under **Coupon details**, enter a custom **Coupon code** (i.e., HALFOFF)
6.  Select a **Discount type** of **Percentage off** or **Fixed amount off**.
    
    Select the corresponding **currency** if you apply an **Amount off**. Your Coupon must be in the same currency as the Offer it is attached to.
    
7.  Enter the value of the discount (i.e., enter 10 for 10% off).
    
    To create a free Coupon, set the Discount type to Percentage off and the value to 100. It must be applied as a percentage rather than an Amount off. Keep in mind that a customer still needs to provide their credit card information when using a free Coupon on recurring subscription Offers.
    
8.  For payment plan or subscription Offers, choose how the discount applies over time under **Subscription and payment plan behavior**:
    *   **Once** applies to the first payment of a subscription or payment plan
    *   **Repeating** applies for a set number of payments, and you can choose how many billing cycles it repeats
    *   **Forever** applies to every payment for the life of the subscription or payment plan
9.  Under **Applies to**, choose the Offers this Coupon covers, or select **All published offers**.
10.  Set **Redemption limits** (optional). See [Set redemption limits](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/how-to-create-a-coupon#set-redemption-limits)
     below.
11.  Click **Save**.
    
    New Coupons save as a **Draft**. When you’re ready to launch the promotion, set the status to **Active** from the Coupon’s detail page.
    

![Status And HALFOFF](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/5tGzrR4cG8p-9S62/images/Status_and_HALFOFF.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=5tGzrR4cG8p-9S62&q=85&s=defdb36ef50c2665beb3dd07aee4b623)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/how-to-create-a-coupon#create-a-cart-coupon)

Create a Cart Coupon
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Cart Coupons discount the customer’s cart total, so they’re a natural fit for storewide sales.

1.  Open the **Sales** tab from your Dashboard.
2.  Choose **Coupons**.
3.  Click **\+ New coupon**, then select **Cart order**.
4.  Enter a **Coupon code** and the discount value.
    
    Cart order discounts can only be percentage-based coupons.
    
5.  To require a minimum cart value, turn on **Minimum purchase amount**, then enter the **Amount** and select the **Currency**. The Coupon will only apply once the cart reaches that amount.
6.  Set **Redemption limits** (optional).
7.  Click **Save**

![Status And New Cart Order Coupon](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/5tGzrR4cG8p-9S62/images/Status_and_New_cart_order_coupon.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=5tGzrR4cG8p-9S62&q=85&s=43212c2229757b67b4bea9d450066d32)

**Tip:** Pair a Cart Coupon with a minimum purchase amount to encourage customers to add one more product before checkout.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/how-to-create-a-coupon#create-bulk-coupon-codes)

Create Bulk Coupon codes
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Bulk Coupons generate a batch of unique codes for the Offers you attach, and each code can only be used once. Use them to sell licenses to organizations or give every customer their own code.

1.  Open the **Sales** tab from your Dashboard.
2.  Choose **Coupons**.
3.  Click **\+ New coupon**, then select **Bulk coupon codes**.
4.  Name the Coupon.
5.  Enter the **Amount of coupons** to generate.
6.  Select **Percent** or **Amount**, and enter the value of the discount.
7.  Under **Offers**, select the Offers the codes apply to.
8.  Click **Save**.

Kajabi generates the codes as random 6-character codes, listed under **Available codes**. When a code has been used, it moves to **Redeemed codes**.

*   Click any individual **Available code** to copy it and share in individual emails or messages.
*   Click **Export all codes** to receive a .CSV file of all Bulk codes.

![Status And SUMMERTRAINING](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/5tGzrR4cG8p-9S62/images/Status_and_SUMMERTRAINING.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=5tGzrR4cG8p-9S62&q=85&s=089859d08aa96f7e3def40e2e685d437)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/how-to-create-a-coupon#set-redemption-limits)

Set redemption limits
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Redemption limits control how often a Coupon can be used. Set them when you create a Coupon, or add them later by editing it.

*   **Limit number of times this coupon can be used in total**: Cap total redemptions across all customers. Once the cap is reached, the Coupon stops working at checkout.
*   **Limit to one use per customer**: Each customer can only redeem the Coupon once.
*   **Limit redemption to a date range**: Customers can only redeem the Coupon within the set dates. Existing subscriptions keep their discount.

![Status And HALFOFF](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/5tGzrR4cG8p-9S62/images/Status_and_HALFOFF-1.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=5tGzrR4cG8p-9S62&q=85&s=4b4c8e04bfb630dfde30eeba63204458)

The maximum expiration date must be less than 5 years from the current day. If you apply a multi-month Coupon to a weekly subscription Offer, the Coupon will discount all payments within the specified period. For example, a Coupon with a four-month duration applied to a weekly subscription discounts 16 weekly payments within the 4 month period.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/how-to-create-a-coupon#copy-offer-coupon-urls)

Copy Offer coupon URLs
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Each Offer attached to a Coupon has a checkout URL with the Coupon already applied.

1.  Open the **Sales** tab from the Dashboard.
2.  Select **Coupons**, then click a Coupon.
3.  In the **Coupon details** panel, choose an Offer from the dropdown under **Offer checkout URL**.
4.  Click the **copy icon**. Share this direct link on social media or in email campaigns to encourage customers to purchase the discounted Offer.

Once a Coupon is attached to an Offer, customers can also apply the code themselves at checkout.

![Screenshot 2026 07 07 At 12 13 08 AM](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/5tGzrR4cG8p-9S62/images/Screenshot-2026-07-07-at-12.13.08-AM.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=5tGzrR4cG8p-9S62&q=85&s=a121e570c4a62f1b6cb582c56a2c22fb "Screenshot 2026 07 07 At 12 13 08 AM")

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/how-to-create-a-coupon#share-a-coupon-for-popup-checkout)

Share a Coupon for popup checkout
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Use the Coupon URL to apply a discount automatically at popup checkout on any Landing Page. This is a favorite for promotions where the customer never needs to type a code.

1.  Open the Coupon from **Sales > Coupons**.
2.  Click the ”…” **overflow menu** in the upper right, then select **Share Coupon**.
3.  Copy the **Coupon URL** from the modal.
4.  Add the slug to the end of any **Landing Page URL**, and the Coupon applies automatically when customers reach popup checkout.

![Screenshot 7 7 26 12 24 AM](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/5tGzrR4cG8p-9S62/images/Screenshot_7_7_26__12_24-AM.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=5tGzrR4cG8p-9S62&q=85&s=1bf8b3caae451da590ddd53bb5449e5e "Screenshot 7 7 26 12 24 AM")

**Coupon URL path example:**

*   Landing page: `https://hello.mykajabi.com/landingpage`
*   Coupon URL path: `/?coupon_code=HALFOFF`
*   Combined: `https://hello.mykajabi.com/landingpage/?coupon_code=HALFOFF`

Offer coupons only apply to the Offers attached. If the Offer includes an Upsell, the Coupon will not apply to the Upsell.

# Coupons Overview - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/coupons-overview#content-area)

Use **Coupons** to boost a launch, reward your most loyal customers, or win back someone who almost bought. Every Coupon has a type that determines what it discounts, a status that controls when it can be redeemed, and built-in analytics to show you how it performs.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/coupons-overview#coupon-types)

Coupon types
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Kajabi has three Coupon types:

| Type | What it discounts | Best for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Offer** | Specific Offers you attach to the coupon | Promotions on a course, community, coaching program, or any individual Offer |
| **Cart** | The customer’s cart total, with an optional minimum purchase amount | Storewide sales and encouraging multi-product purchases |
| **Bulk** | Specific Offers, using a batch of unique one-time-use codes | Selling licenses to organizations, or giving each customer their own code |

See [Create Coupons](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/how-to-create-a-coupon)
 for step-by-step instructions for each type.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/coupons-overview#coupon-statuses)

Coupon statuses
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Every Coupon has a status, so you can tell what’s live at a glance:

*   **Draft**: Saved but not redeemable yet. Use Draft to set up a promotion before it goes live.
*   **Active**: Live. Customers can redeem the Coupon at checkout.
*   **Expired**: The Coupon has passed its expiration date or reached its maximum number of redemptions, and can no longer be redeemed.

You can change a Coupon’s status at any time. See **[Manage and Edit Coupons](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/how-to-remove-an-offer-from-your-coupon)
.**

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/coupons-overview#the-coupons-page)

The Coupons page
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Open the **Sales** tab and select **Coupons** to see all coupons on your site. Search by coupon code or filter by status, type, or offer.

![Status And Coupons](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/z1XYJHwJ4PoPwV6O/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-2-coupon-page-1785429685154.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=z1XYJHwJ4PoPwV6O&q=85&s=8d206d36961803bbe597aeace2023b35)

You can also see a Coupon from the other direction: every Offer’s detail page lists its Active Coupons.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/coupons-overview#the-coupon-detail-page)

The Coupon detail page
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Select any Coupon to open its detail page. Here you’ll find its settings, a **Coupon details** panel with its status and Offer checkout URLs, and an [**Analytics**](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/coupon-analytics)
 panel showing redemptions, unique customers, and active recurring redemptions, so you can see how each promotion is performing.

![Status And 10OFF](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/z1XYJHwJ4PoPwV6O/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-2-the-coupon-detail-page-1785429685713.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=z1XYJHwJ4PoPwV6O&q=85&s=420580d27f6ae31839d5956d20f71122)

Coupons can be edited after creation, and changes apply to new redemptions only. Anyone who already redeemed keeps the terms they signed up with, including subscriptions and payment plans.To change the price of an existing subscription processed through Stripe, adjust the subscription directly in your Stripe dashboard.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/coupons-overview#redemption-limits)

Redemption limits
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Redemption limits control how often a Coupon can be used. Cap the total number of redemptions, limit the Coupon to one use per customer, or limit redemption to a date range. Once a Coupon reaches its limit, it can no longer be redeemed at checkout. Add limits when you create a Coupon, or anytime after by editing it. See [Create Coupons](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/how-to-create-a-coupon)
.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/coupons-overview#subscriptions-and-payment-plans)

Subscriptions and payment plans
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

When a Coupon is applied to a subscription or payment plan Offer, its **Subscription and payment plan behavior** setting determines how many payments the discount covers. **Once** applies to the first payment only, **Repeating** applies for a set number of billing cycles, and **Forever** applies to every payment for the life of the subscription or payment plan.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/coupons-overview#troubleshooting)

Troubleshooting
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

If a Coupon won’t apply at checkout, the cause is usually one of these settings.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/coupons-overview#wrong-currency)

Wrong currency

An Amount off Coupon must match the currency of the Offer it’s attached to. If the two are set to different currencies, the Coupon won’t apply. **Fix:** Check the Offer’s currency under **Sales > Pricing** and the Coupon’s currency on its detail page, then align the two.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/coupons-overview#100%-off-set-as-an-amount)

100% off set as an amount

Only **Percentage off** Coupons can make an Offer completely free. An **Amount off** Coupon can’t bring the price all the way to zero. **Fix:** Edit the Coupon’s discount type to **Percent** and set the value to 100.

Customers still need to provide their credit card information when using a free Coupon on recurring subscription Offers.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/coupons-overview#expired-coupon)

Expired Coupon

The Coupon reached its expiration date or its maximum number of redemptions, so it’s marked Expired and can’t be redeemed. **Fix:** Edit the Coupon’s Redemption limits. Extend the date range, or raise or remove the total use limit, depending on which one the Coupon hit. No need to rebuild the Coupon from scratch.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/coupons-overview#wrong-offer-attached)

Wrong Offer attached

Coupons only apply to the Offers attached to them. If a customer enters the code on a different Offer’s checkout, it won’t apply. **Fix:** Open the Coupon and add the Offer, or share the correct Offer checkout URL with your customer.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/coupons-overview#deleted-coupon)

Deleted Coupon

A deleted Coupon code is gone for good and can’t be restored. **Fix:** Create a new Coupon.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/coupons-overview#coupon-is-still-in-draft)

Coupon is still in Draft

New Coupons start in Draft and can’t be redeemed until activated. **Fix:** Open the Coupon and change its status from Draft to Active using the status dropdown in the Coupon details panel.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/coupons-overview#customer-already-used-the-coupon)

Customer already used the Coupon

The Coupon is limited to one use per customer, and this customer has already redeemed it. **Fix:** This limit can’t be bypassed for a customer who has already redeemed. Share a different Coupon, or remove the one-per-customer limit for future [customers.No](http://customers.no/)
 coupon field at checkout The coupon field only appears when at least one Active Coupon is attached to the Offer. If the field is missing, the Offer has no Active Coupons. **Fix:** Check that the Coupon is attached to the Offer and its status is Active.

Was this page helpful?

YesNo

# Create a Coupon in Stripe - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/how-to-create-a-coupon-in-stripe#content-area)

Creating a coupon in Stripe is a straightforward solution to giving your customers a discount after their initial purchase in Kajabi.

**Note:** In order to create a coupon in Stripe, you must first connect your Kajabi account to your Stripe account or Create a New Account. [Learn how to connect Stripe to Kajabi](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/api-integrations/payment-integrations/connect-stripe-to-kajabi)
. Interested in using an all-in-one payment solution with exclusive features designed specifically for the Kajabi platform instead? Check out [Kajabi Payments](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/kajabi-payments-overview)
.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/how-to-create-a-coupon-in-stripe#create-a-coupon-in-stripe)

Create a coupon in Stripe
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Click the **Products** tab from the Stripe dashboard.
2.  Select **Coupons**.
3.  Click **\+ New** in the top right corner of the Coupons page.
4.  On this page, give your new coupon a **Title**, select the coupon type between a **Percentage discount** or a **Fixed Amount discount,** choose the **amount of the discount**, and the time **Duration**. You can also choose to create customer-facing promo codes for your coupon.
5.  Click **Create Coupon**.
6.  This coupon can now be used for your products inside of Stripe.

[Learn more about creating coupons and promotion codes in Stripe.](https://stripe.com/docs/payments/checkout/discounts)
