# Manage and Edit Coupons - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/manage-and-edit-coupons#content-area)

Every **Coupon** stays flexible after you create it. Edit its details, move it between statuses, add or remove Offers, and delete it when the promotion has run its course.

Coupon edits apply to new redemptions only. Anyone who already redeemed keeps the terms they signed up with, including subscriptions, payment plans, and one-time purchases. If a customer redeemed a 20% off Coupon on a subscription and you later change the discount to 10%, that customer keeps their 20% discount.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/manage-and-edit-coupons#edit-a-coupon)

Edit a Coupon
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Open the **Sales** tab from your Dashboard.
2.  Choose **Coupons**, then click the Coupon you want to update.
3.  Update any of the Coupon’s settings, including the **Coupon code**, **Discount**, **Applies to** Offers, **Redemption limits**, and **Subscription and payment plan behavior**.
4.  Click **Save**, then confirm your changes.

For Bulk Coupons, the number of codes can be increased but not decreased, and discount changes apply immediately to all unredeemed codes.

![Status](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/5tGzrR4cG8p-9S62/images/Status.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=5tGzrR4cG8p-9S62&q=85&s=9effb46c750b833f7c029c39fe836b33)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/manage-and-edit-coupons#change-a-coupon%E2%80%99s-status)

Change a Coupon’s status
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

New Coupons start as a Draft, and only Active Coupons can be redeemed at checkout.

1.  Open the Coupon from **Sales > Coupons**.
2.  In the **Coupon details** panel, click the **Status** dropdown.
3.  Select the new status.

Moving a Coupon from **Active** to **Draft** asks you to confirm, since it takes a live Coupon out of circulation. Customers who already redeemed the coupon are unaffected, and new customers can’t redeem it until it’s Active again. An **Expired** Coupon can’t be changed from the status dropdown. To bring it back, edit the Coupon’s **Redemption limits**. Extend the date range if it expired by date, or raise or remove the total redemption limit if it expired by reaching its maximum uses. You’ll be asked to confirm, and the Coupon becomes Active again.

![Screenshot 7 7 26 12 43 AM](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/5tGzrR4cG8p-9S62/images/Screenshot_7_7_26__12_43-AM.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=5tGzrR4cG8p-9S62&q=85&s=f8bf818c2299cbeeec0011cc6637511c "Screenshot 7 7 26 12 43 AM")

**Tip:** To pause a promotion without ending it permanently, set the Coupon to **Draft** instead of deleting it.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/manage-and-edit-coupons#add-or-remove-offers-on-a-coupon)

Add or remove Offers on a Coupon
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The Coupon only applies to the Offers attached to it.

1.  Open the Coupon from **Sales > Coupons**.
2.  Under **Applies to**, add or remove Offers, or select **All published offers**.
3.  Click **Save**.

Once an Offer is removed, customers can no longer apply the Coupon to that Offer. Redemptions that have already taken place are unaffected.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/manage-and-edit-coupons#delete-a-coupon)

Delete a Coupon
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Deleting a Coupon permanently retires it. The code can never be used or restored.

1.  Open the Coupon from **Sales > Coupons**.
2.  Click the **”…” overflow menu** in the upper right, then select **Delete**.
3.  Review the confirmation message and confirm.

The confirmation you see depends on the Coupon’s redemption history, so you know exactly what you’re removing. Customers who already redeemed the Coupon keep their discount terms.

![Screenshot 7 7 26 12 47 AM](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/z1XYJHwJ4PoPwV6O/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-4-delete-coupon-1785429633211.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=z1XYJHwJ4PoPwV6O&q=85&s=209165c4ad24afceb37108271e8b1b89 "Screenshot 7 7 26 12 47 AM")

**Warning:** Deleting a Coupon can’t be undone.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/manage-and-edit-coupons#share-a-coupon)

Share a Coupon
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Each Offer attached to a Coupon has an **Offer checkout URL** in the **Coupon details** panel, and the **Share Coupon** option in the overflow menu provides the Coupon URL for popup checkout. See [Create Coupons](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/how-to-create-a-coupon)
 for steps and examples.

![Screenshot 7 7 26 12 46 AM](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/z1XYJHwJ4PoPwV6O/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-1-share-coupon-1785429633580.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=z1XYJHwJ4PoPwV6O&q=85&s=83dcc7579873ccb42de0ec399fa472a0 "Screenshot 7 7 26 12 46 AM")

# Use Single-Use Coupon Automations - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/how-to-use-single-use-coupon-automations#content-area)

The Single-Use Coupon Automation is an automation action that sends an email containing a single-use coupon code after your specified trigger occurs (e.g., An Offer is purchased, a Tag is added, a Form is added, a Course Lesson is completed, and more).

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/how-to-use-single-use-coupon-automations#single-use-coupon-codes)

Single-Use Coupon Codes
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Just as the name suggests, the single-use coupon code is only available for a single use. After your customer applies their single-use coupon code to their Offer purchase, the code can no longer be applied to future purchases. The single-use coupon code is generated from an existing Offer coupon and applies that coupon’s settings. Bulk and Cart coupons can’t be used with this automation. This is a great way to automatically send unique, single-use coupon codes after a specified trigger occurs.

**Tip:** Use a single-use coupon code to create a Gift Offer. [Learn more](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-create-and-manage-gift-offers)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/how-to-use-single-use-coupon-automations#configure-a-single-use-coupon-automation)

Configure a Single-Use Coupon Automation
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Create your single-use coupon code in the Automations tab (available with Growth and Pro plans) or the various editors in Kajabi (e.g., Offers, Funnels, Forms, etc.). [Learn more](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/marketing/automations/automations-overview#h_c82be0ac-2ffd-4437-a622-3c82323abefc)

As an Automation, a new single-use coupon code will be created for each contact who triggers the Automation. For example, if you want all customers of a specific Offer to receive a discount for another Offer, you can create this Automation to send a single-use coupon code after they purchase your specified Offer.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/how-to-use-single-use-coupon-automations#create-a-single-use-coupon-automation-in-an-offer)

Create a single-use coupon automation in an Offer

1.  Open the **Sales** tab from the Dashboard and then click **Pricing**.
2.  Select your desired **Offer** to customize.
3.  In the Offer Editor, navigate to **Automations**.
4.  Click **\+ Add Automation**.
5.  From the “When” dropdown menu, select **Offer is purchased**.
6.  From the “Then” dropdown menu, select **Send a single-use** **coupon.**
7.  Select the **Coupon** o generate single-use codes from.
8.  Customize the automation email according to your brand and language.
9.  Click **Save** to keep and apply your changes.

Automations can generate single-use codes from a Draft coupon, but customers can’t redeem them until the coupon is Active. Check that the connected coupon is Active before your automation starts sending codes.

# Coupon analytics - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/coupon-analytics#content-area)

Every coupon has an Analytics panel that shows how it’s performing, so you can track a promotion’s results without exporting transactions or checking a third-party tool.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/coupon-analytics#view-a-coupon%E2%80%99s-analytics)

View a coupon’s analytics
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Open the **Sales** tab from the Dashboard.
2.  Select **Coupons**.
3.  Click the coupon you want to review.

The **Analytics** panel appears in the right sidebar of the coupon detail page.

![Status And HOLIDAY](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/K4ph-vFvbGqfRhNn/images/Status_and_HOLIDAY.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=K4ph-vFvbGqfRhNn&q=85&s=03379a59dbf8f851bfdde64dfe4d70e4)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/coupon-analytics#understand-the-metrics)

Understand the metrics
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **Total redemptions:** The number of times the coupon has been redeemed at checkout.
*   **Total unique customers:** The number of individual customers who have redeemed the coupon. If the coupon allows multiple uses per customer, this number can be lower than total redemptions.
*   **Active recurring redemptions:** The number of active subscriptions and payment plans the coupon is currently attached to. When a subscription is canceled or a payment plan completes, it no longer counts here.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/coupon-analytics#filter-by-date)

Filter by date
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Use the date filter at the top of the Analytics panel to change the reporting period. Analytics default to the last 30 days.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/coupon-analytics#coupons-without-activity)

Coupons without activity
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The Analytics panel stays in a placeholder state until the coupon has at least one redemption. Draft coupons can’t be redeemed, so their analytics remain empty until the coupon is Active and a customer uses it.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/coupon-analytics#find-customers-who-used-a-coupon)

Find customers who used a coupon
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

To see which customers redeemed a specific coupon:

1.  Open the **Contacts** tab from the Dashboard.
2.  Click **Filters**.
3.  Select **Coupon** from the Category dropdown.
4.  Select **Coupon used** as the conditional.
5.  Choose your coupon code as the value.

Your Contacts list now shows every customer who purchased with that coupon.

# Troubleshoot coupon errors - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/why-is-my-coupon-not-working#content-area)

If a customer received an error message when attempting to use a coupon on your checkout page, refer to this guide for more information and troubleshooting solutions.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/why-is-my-coupon-not-working#coupon-error-messages)

Coupon error messages
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A message box will appear if an error occurs when a customer attempts to complete a purchase while using a coupon on your checkout page. Your customer will not be able to use the coupon and complete the purchase until the error is resolved. **Example:** ![Coupon error example](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/8OxtRX4ccA7GVWxq/articles/images/7770d19a_5758381725339.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=8OxtRX4ccA7GVWxq&q=85&s=f6e7059694da511239faafd97bb1055c)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/why-is-my-coupon-not-working#common-coupon-errors)

Common coupon errors
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The following is a list of common coupon errors that may be causing the issue.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/why-is-my-coupon-not-working#wrong-currency)

Wrong currency

This error message will appear if the coupon and offer have been set up for different currencies. For example, if you have an offer set up for CAD currency and the coupon is $100 off USD currency, it will not work.

#### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/why-is-my-coupon-not-working#edit-offer-pricing)

Edit Offer pricing

1.  Open the **Sales** tab from your Dashboard.
2.  Select **Pricing**.
3.  Select the Offer you would like to edit or [create a new one](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/create-an-offer)
    .
4.  In the Offer Editor, click the **Pricing** tab.
5.  Scroll down to the **Price Details** section and use the **Currency** dropdown menu to choose your Currency.
6.  Click **Save** to apply your changes.

**Coupon Currency:** A Coupon’s currency can only be edited when first creating the coupon. After the coupon has been created, the currency cannot be changed.

#### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/why-is-my-coupon-not-working#create-a-new-coupon)

Create a new coupon

1.  Open the **Sales** tab from your Dashboard.
2.  Choose **Coupons**.
3.  Click **\+ New Coupon**.
4.  Select **Single Coupon Code** or **Bulk Codes**.
5.  Enter your **Coupon Code**.
6.  Choose **Amount Off** under **Discount Type**.
7.  In the **Amount Off** menu, use the **Currency Type** dropdown menu to select your currency.
8.  Press **Continue** to save your Coupon.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/why-is-my-coupon-not-working#100%-off-an-amount)

100% off an amount

A 100% off coupon will not work if the “Amount Off” option was selected during the Coupon Creation process instead of “Percentage Off”. Amount off coupons require a monetary payment, they cannot be completely free. Only “Percentage Off” coupons can make an offer completely free. A new coupon will need to be created using “Percentage Off” if a 100% discount is the intended outcome.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/why-is-my-coupon-not-working#previously-deleted-coupon)

Previously deleted coupon

If a coupon was previously deleted from your Kajabi site it will no longer be valid for use. This will cause the coupon error message to show upon checkout. A new coupon will need to be created.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/why-is-my-coupon-not-working#expired-coupon)

Expired coupon

If the coupon’s expiration date has passed, the coupon can no longer be used. A coupon’s expiration date can be set during coupon creation in the **Duration** section of the coupon creator: ![Coupon duration settings](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/uG5M_9Irmb-dLu49/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-14-coupon-duration-1756080391351-1768530398557-1769338597490-1771756597588-1775382383070-1778363811875-1780226198004-1780240278731.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=uG5M_9Irmb-dLu49&q=85&s=0fc29af0b409fde0adb768e130298967)

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/why-is-my-coupon-not-working#wrong-offer-attached-to-coupon)

Wrong Offer attached to coupon

A coupon will only work with the Offer that has been attached to it. If the coupon code is entered on the wrong offer checkout page, the coupon will not work and the error message will show.

#### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/why-is-my-coupon-not-working#add-an-offer-to-a-coupon)

Add an Offer to a coupon

1.  Open the **Sales** tab from the Dashboard.
2.  Select **Coupons**.
3.  Select the coupon you wish to edit or [create a new one](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/how-to-create-a-coupon)
    .
4.  Navigate to the Included Offers section and click **\+ Add Offer**.
5.  Choose the Offer you want to include, then click **Done** to save your changes.

**Tip:** Once your coupon is working, you can share a checkout link with the discount already applied. Go to **Sales** > **Coupons**, click your coupon, and copy the **Offer checkout URL**. [Learn how to copy Offer coupon URLs](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/how-to-create-a-coupon#copy-offer-coupon-urls)
.

Still have questions? Reach out to [our support team](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/support/how-to-contact-kajabi-support)
 if you need additional assistance.

# Compare single and bulk coupon codes - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/what-is-the-difference-between-single-coupon-codes-and-bulk-coupon-codes#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/what-is-the-difference-between-single-coupon-codes-and-bulk-coupon-codes#overview)

Overview
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

With Kajabi, you can create coupons for your [Offers](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/offers-overview)
 to:

*   Encourage new and repeat customers.
*   Acquire customer data to build your list.
*   Reintroduce older Offers to your audience.

Create coupons on Kajabi with a single coupon code, bulk coupon code, or single-use coupon codes.

**Tip:** Create segments on Kajabi to group customers interested in coupons, deals, and discounts and create targeted marketing campaigns. [Learn more](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/contacts/manage-your-contacts/segment-your-contacts)

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/what-is-the-difference-between-single-coupon-codes-and-bulk-coupon-codes#types-of-coupon-codes)

Types of coupon codes

*   **Single coupon codes** allow you to create a coupon code with your branded language that anyone can use for your applied Offer(s). For example, create a summer promotion with the coupon code SUMMER25 to give 25% off to anyone that applies the coupon code SUMMER25 during checkout. [Learn more](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/what-is-the-difference-between-single-coupon-codes-and-bulk-coupon-codes#single-coupon-code)
    
*   **Bulk codes** auto-generate your specified number of unique, one-of-a-kind codes to share with your audience. Each code created from the bulk code generator is a single-use code that can only be used for a single purchase. With Bulk codes you can randomly generate multiple, single-use coupon codes. Single-use coupon codes are different from single coupon codes because after the coupon is applied once, the coupon becomes invalid. [Learn more](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/what-is-the-difference-between-single-coupon-codes-and-bulk-coupon-codes#bulk-codes)
    

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/what-is-the-difference-between-single-coupon-codes-and-bulk-coupon-codes#single-coupon-code)

Single coupon code
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Create a single custom coupon code to provide your customers with a discount for your Offer(s).

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/what-is-the-difference-between-single-coupon-codes-and-bulk-coupon-codes#single-coupon-settings)

Single coupon settings

*   **Coupon code** - create a custom code to fit your business and promotion.
*   **Discount type** - the percentage or amount off for the coupon’s discount.
*   **Duration** - the number of times the coupon code can be used for a customer subscription and/or payment plans.
*   **Expiration date** - set an expiration date for your coupon discount.

For example, if you want to give a 50% off discount for a summer promotion, you can create a Single Coupon Code called **Summer50** for specific Offer(s) that can be applied by anyone with the Summer50 coupon code. Then, you can choose to set a duration to discount future payments. This allows the discount amount to be applied to your customers’ future payments if the Offer is a [subscription](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-create-a-subscription-offer)
 or [payment plan](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/create-a-payment-plan-offer)
 Offer. **Example:** If a customer applies your Summer50 discount code to a payment plan Offer set to pay a total of 100overaperiodof5payments(i.e.,100 over a period of 5 payments (i.e., 100overaperiodof5payments(i.e.,20 for each payment), your customer with their discount code will pay $10 for each payment. And if you want the coupon to expire after the conclusion of your summer promotion, set the expiration date for the end of your summer promotion period. This will ensure that the discount code cannot be applied to a new Offer purchase after your specified expiration date.

**Note:** If you choose to apply a Multi-month coupon to a weekly subscription Offer, your coupon will discount all payments within your specified duration. For example, if you set up a Multi-month coupon to last for the duration of 4 months and you apply it to a weekly subscription your customer applying the coupon will have 16 weekly payments discounted within the 4 months.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/what-is-the-difference-between-single-coupon-codes-and-bulk-coupon-codes#create-a-single-coupon-code)

Create a single coupon code

1.  Open the **Sales** tab from the Dashboard.
2.  Select **Coupons.**
3.  Click **\+ New Coupon** to create a new coupon.
4.  Select **Single Coupon** as the Coupon Type.
5.  Enter your Coupon Code (example: Summer25), choose the Discount type, the Duration, and the Expiration Date.
6.  Click **Continue**.
7.  Be sure to select the Offer the coupon can be applied to by clicking **\+ Add Offer**.

After you have included an Offer with the coupon you will see a **Discount link** button. Copy and share your Discount link with your customers.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/what-is-the-difference-between-single-coupon-codes-and-bulk-coupon-codes#bulk-codes)

Bulk codes
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Bulk codes are great for special promotions or deals on your offers. Just as with Single Coupon Codes, Bulk Codes can be set up for either an amount or a percentage off. However, instead of going through the process of creating 100 individual, single coupon codes, Kajabi will auto-generate your specified number of unique, one-of-a-kind codes. The coupon bundle will also track and monitor code usage which makes it a great solution for selling individual “licenses” to organizations. For example, if you wanted to create a pack of 100 unique, individual coupon codes, you can use Bulk codes to generate 100 unique codes to share.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/what-is-the-difference-between-single-coupon-codes-and-bulk-coupon-codes#create-bulk-coupon-codes)

Create bulk coupon codes

1.  Open the **Sales** tab from the Dashboard.
2.  Select **Coupons.**
3.  Click **\+ New Coupon** to create a new coupon.
4.  Select **Bulk Codes**.
5.  Choose the coupon name, the discount type, and the amount of unique codes you’d like to generate.
6.  Click **Continue**.
7.  Be sure to select the Offer the coupon can be applied to by clicking **\+ Add Offer**.

**Note:** There a maximum limit of 1,000 coupon codes generated for a bulk codes coupon.

After creating your Bulk Coupon Codes you can copy or export the individual coupon codes to share with your customers.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/what-is-the-difference-between-single-coupon-codes-and-bulk-coupon-codes#single-use-coupon-code-automation)

Single-use coupon code automation
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The Single-Use Coupon Code Automation is an Automation action that sends an Email containing a single-use coupon code after your specified trigger occurs (e.g., An Offer is purchased, a Tag is added, a Form is submitted, a Course Lesson is completed, and more). [Learn more about the Single-use Coupon Code Automation on Kajabi.](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/how-to-use-single-use-coupon-automations)

# Activate Affiliate commission - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/activate-affiliate-commission#content-area)

Activating **Affiliate Commission** within your Offers credits the transaction to your Affiliate Users for the Offers you specify. Once enabled, you can track commission data in your [Affiliate Dashboard](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliates-overview#dashboard)
.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/activate-affiliate-commission#activate-affiliate-commission-in-an-offer)

Activate Affiliate commission in an Offer
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Open the **Sales** tab from your Dashboard.
2.  Click **Pricing**.
3.  Select the **Offer** you wish to edit.
4.  Open **Settings**.
5.  Toggle on **Activate Affiliate commissions for this Offer**.
6.  Enter the **Percentage** or **Fixed Amount** you are willing to offer your affiliates when an affiliate transaction occurs.
7.  Use the check box if you would like to **Collect commission only on the first payment** if your offer is a Subscription or Payment Plan.
8.  Click **Save** to apply your changes.

**Note:** Selecting **Give an affiliate commission** in an Offer tracks affiliate transactions for the specific Offer. You will need to manually pay your affiliates as it is not an automatic process.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/activate-affiliate-commission#activate-affiliate-commission-from-the-commission-setup-page)

Activate Affiliate commission from the Commission setup page
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Open the **Sales** tab from your Dashboard.
2.  Click **Affiliates**.
3.  Open the **Commission setup** page.
4.  Select the **Offer(s)** you wish to activate.
5.  Enter the **Percentage** or **Fixed amount** you are willing to offer your affiliates when an affiliate transaction occurs. **Fixed amount** commission cannot be applied in bulk at this time.
6.  Use the check box if you would like to **Collect commission only on the first payment** if your offer is a Subscription or Payment Plan.
7.  Click **Save** to apply your changes.

**Note:** Activating Affiliate Commission tracks Affiliate transactions for your specific Offer(s). You will need to manually pay your Affiliates as it is not an automatic process.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/activate-affiliate-commission#referral-conversion-window)

Referral Conversion Window
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The **Referral Conversion Window** is the specified length of time a customer can make a purchase after clicking an [Affiliate Share link](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/create-an-affiliate-share-link)
 for the affiliate to receive credit for the referral. Select a specified time for the Referral Conversion Window:

*   30 days (default)
*   60 days
*   90 days

If a customer clicks an Affiliate Share link, they must purchase an Offer within your specified time frame (30 days, 60 days, or 90 days) for the affiliate to receive credit for the referral.

**Note:** The Referral Conversion Window applies to the [Affiliate Share Link](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/create-an-affiliate-share-link)
. If the customer purchases with an [Affiliate Coupon code](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/create-affiliate-coupons)
, the affiliate associated with the code will receive credit for the referral regardless of the presence of a browser cookie.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/activate-affiliate-commission#select-a-referral-conversion-window)

Select a Referral Conversion Window
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Open the **Sales** tab from your Dashboard.
2.  Click **Affiliates.**
3.  Click **Settings** from your Affiliate Dashboard.
4.  Locate the **Conversion Window** section and choose your window period.
5.  Click **Save** to apply your changes.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/activate-affiliate-commission#add-a-cookie-disclaimer)

Add a cookie disclaimer
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The Referral Conversion Window feature uses cookies to keep track of the purchase after an affiliate link is clicked. Various laws require website owners, such as yourself, to inform their visitors of cookies placed on their site and require visitors’ consent to use them. We encourage you to speak to legal counsel to learn how to ensure that any applicable banners or disclaimers are implemented on your site to comply with the cookie regulations that may pertain to your business. [Learn how to add a cookie disclaimer to your site](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/cookies-and-cookie-disclaimers)
. [Learn more about the cookies Kajabi uses](https://help.kajabi.com/hc/en-us/articles/1260804142350)
.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/activate-affiliate-commission#override-offer-percentage-for-individual-affiliate-users)

Override Offer percentage for individual Affiliate Users
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

To give a different commission percentage to specific Affiliate Users, be sure to [activate Affiliate Commission](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/activate-affiliate-commission#activate-affiliate-commission-in-an-offer)
 in your Offers to track purchases made with your affiliates Share Links and Coupon Codes.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/activate-affiliate-commission#override-percentage-in-the-affiliate-dashboard)

Override percentage in the Affiliate Dashboard

1.  Open the **Sales** tab from your Dashboard.
2.  Select **Affiliates**.
3.  Click **Users**.
4.  Select or search for the **Affiliate User** you wish to edit.
5.  Locate **Affiliate Percentages**.
6.  Enter your desired percentage override and click **Allow affiliate’s percentage to be overridden**.

![Affiliate percentage override](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/zWdoUKm3XPeQD8ud/articles/images/19176a93_upload_6501850275814768844.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=zWdoUKm3XPeQD8ud&q=85&s=440d81b67c4c33a1279ca6c700184f03)

**Note:** Checking **Allow affiliate’s percentage to be overridden** will override the commission percentage specified in _all_ Offers with Affiliate commission activated.The Affiliate Percentage will not specify the commission percentage for specific individual Offers. If left unchecked, the [commission percentage specified in the Offer](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/activate-affiliate-commission#activate-affiliate-commission-in-an-offer)
 will determine the affiliate’s commission tracked within Affiliates.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/activate-affiliate-commission#subscription-commission-tracking)

Subscription commission tracking
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

When a customer makes a purchase within the conversion window after clicking an [affiliate Share Link](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/create-an-affiliate-share-link)
 or using an [Affiliate Coupon](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/create-affiliate-coupons)
, their purchase and all subsequent subscription or payment plan payments will be attributed to the referring affiliate. By default, affiliate commissions for subscription and payment plan Offers apply for the lifetime of the customer’s subscription, and affiliates will earn a commission for every recurring payment the customer makes. Optionally, you can choose to apply commissions only to the first subscription payment. In this case, affiliates will earn a one-time commission with no future payouts. ![Subscription commission settings](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/tnn8jq8THgIpHwTP/articles/images/6183a26b_36422697341979.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=tnn8jq8THgIpHwTP&q=85&s=bb954adb03970218f8f0d0c8b976949b) [Learn more about the **Affiliate Report**](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/analytics/report-affiliates)
.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/activate-affiliate-commission#faqs)

FAQs
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/activate-affiliate-commission#when-applying-fixed-amount-commission-for-an-individual-subscription-i-am-able-to-exceed-my-offer%E2%80%99s-price-%E2%80%93-is-this-expected)

When applying Fixed amount commission for an individual subscription, I am able to exceed my offer’s price – is this expected?

Yes, this is expected, but keep in mind that it’s only possible to make this exception while editing the commission in your individual Offer’s Settings, and it cannot be done in bulk. This may be useful if you’d like to offer extra incentives and can be paired nicely when collecting commission on the first payment only.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/activate-affiliate-commission#is-it-possible-to-apply-fixed-amount-commission-in-bulk-on-the-commission-setup-page)

Is it possible to apply fixed amount commission in bulk on the Commission Setup page?

Not at this time.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/activate-affiliate-commission#when-i-have-a-mix-of-one-time-payment-plan-and-subscription-offers-selected-how-does-applying-commission-in-bulk-work)

When I have a mix of One-time, Payment Plan, and Subscription offers selected, how does applying commission in bulk work?

This depends on whether or not **Collect commission only on the first payment** is selected when you apply commission in bulk. If this setting is _not_ selected, the commission update will apply to all Offers. If this setting _is_ selected, the bulk update will automatically exclude any one-time Offers in your selection.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/activate-affiliate-commission#my-customers-are-paying-for-a-subscription-that-was-collecting-commission-only-on-the-first-payment-what-happens-if-i-deselect-that-setting-at-a-later-date)

My customers are paying for a subscription that was collecting commission only on the first payment. What happens if I deselect that setting at a later date?

If this setting becomes unchecked, subsequent payments will be attributed to the referring affiliate, even if a customer purchased the offer while this setting was enabled.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/activate-affiliate-commission#what-happens-when-i-select-to-collect-commission-only-on-the-first-payment)

What happens when I select to collect commission only on the first payment?

Affiliates will earn commission only on the first payment of a subscription or payment plan. All future payments for that subscription will not generate commission.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/activate-affiliate-commission#what-happens-if-i-turn-the-%E2%80%9Ccollect-commission-only-on-the-first-payment%E2%80%9D-setting-on-or-off-after-a-subscription-has-already-started)

What happens if I turn the “Collect commission only on the first payment” setting on or off after a subscription has already started?

If the setting was _on_ (first payment only) and you later turn it _off_, affiliates will start earning on future payments of the subscription. If the setting was _off_ and you later turn it _on_, affiliates will stop earning on all future payments, assuming an earlier payment of this subscription was already attributed to an affiliate.

# Kajabi Payments overview - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/kajabi-payments-overview#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/kajabi-payments-overview#overview)

Overview
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Kajabi Payments offers everything you need to accept and manage payments, all in one place.

*   Accept payments
*   Manage transactions
*   [Generate receipts](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-send-receipts-with-kajabi)
    
*   Issue refunds
*   [Receive payouts](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/kajabi-payments-payouts)
    
*   [Request Instant Payouts](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/instant-payouts-with-kajabi-payments)
    
*   Pause/cancel subscriptions
*   [Offer additional payment methods](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/buy-now-pay-later-methods-with-kajabi-payments)
    
*   [Charge sales tax](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/kajabi-payments-sales-tax-overview)
    

**Note:** Kajabi Payments is currently available to Kajabi Heroes whose businesses are registered in the United States, Canada, Australia, the United Arab Emirates, the United Kingdom, and select European countries.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/kajabi-payments-overview#supported-countries)

Supported countries
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Onboard and set up Kajabi Payments on your sites in these supported regions:

*   [United States](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/getting-started-with-kajabi-payments-united-states)
    
*   [Canada](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/getting-started-with-kajabi-payments-canada)
    
*   [Australia](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/getting-started-with-kajabi-payments-australia)
    
*   [United Arab Emirates](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/getting-started-with-kajabi-payments-united-arab-emirates)
    
*   [United Kingdom](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/getting-started-with-kajabi-payments-united-kingdom)
    
*   [Select European countries](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/getting-started-with-kajabi-payments-europe)
    

Kajabi Payments supports additional payment methods at checkout, including digital wallets like [Apple Pay and Google Pay](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/how-to-enable-apple-pay-and-google-pay-on-kajabi-payments-offers)
 and [Buy Now Pay Later](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/buy-now-pay-later-methods-with-kajabi-payments)
 options like [Afterpay](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/how-to-enable-afterpay-on-kajabi-payments-offers)
. [Learn more about Kajabi Payments processing fees](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/kajabi-payments-processing-fees)
.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/kajabi-payments-overview#faqs)

FAQs
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/kajabi-payments-overview#what-happens-if-i-detach-my-stripe-account)

What happens if I detach my Stripe account?

*   **Payment stoppages**: Detaching your Stripe account from Kajabi will stop Stripe from processing new payments through Kajabi
*   **Subscription continuity**: Existing subscriptions and multi-payment purchases will remain active but will not renew unless manually managed through another system
*   **Data accessibility**: Records of past Stripe transactions will be visible in Kajabi, but new data will not sync to Stripe

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/kajabi-payments-overview#can-i-delete-my-stripe-account-while-using-kajabi-payments)

Can I delete my Stripe account while using Kajabi Payments?

Yes, deleting your personal Stripe account has no impact on your ability to collect payments via Kajabi Payments, as it operates independently.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/kajabi-payments-overview#what-happens-to-my-subscriptions-if-i-cancel-kajabi)

What happens to my subscriptions if I cancel Kajabi?

After canceling Kajabi, you can manage subscriptions directly in Stripe for active ones, as Kajabi’s tools will no longer be accessible.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/kajabi-payments-overview#is-kajabi-payments-available-to-all-heroes)

Is Kajabi Payments available to all Heroes?

Kajabi Payments is currently available to Heroes whose businesses are based in the United States, Australia, Canada, the United Arab Emirates, the United Kingdom, and select European countries. We are currently in development to expand Kajabi Payments to additional regions, so keep an eye on your email.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/kajabi-payments-overview#how-does-kajabi-payments-differ-from-stripe-or-paypal)

How does Kajabi Payments differ from Stripe or PayPal?

Kajabi Payments is directly integrated into the Kajabi dashboard, allowing you to manage transactions without a separate login. It also supports exclusive payment methods including [Apple Pay, Google Pay](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/how-to-enable-apple-pay-and-google-pay-on-kajabi-payments-offers)
, [Afterpay](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/how-to-enable-afterpay-on-kajabi-payments-offers)
, [Klarna](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/how-klarna-works-with-kajabi-payments)
, [Xero](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/how-to-integrate-xero-with-kajabi-payments)
, and QuickBooks integrations, and the option to calculate [sales tax](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/kajabi-payments-sales-tax-overview)
 on your offers. Stripe and PayPal integrations are also supported and can be used alongside Kajabi Payments.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/kajabi-payments-overview#what-can-my-customers-expect-to-change-if-i-use-kajabi-payments)

What can my customers expect to change if I use Kajabi Payments?

Most of your customers won’t notice a difference. Some returning customers may need to re-enter their payment information when they make their first purchase with Kajabi Payments. Cards that have been stored via Stripe will not be carried over to Kajabi Payments.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/kajabi-payments-overview#how-does-kajabi-payments-handle-payment-security)

How does Kajabi Payments handle payment security?

Kajabi Payments is built in partnership with Stripe, which means both payment solutions use the same processing engine. Kajabi Payments operates as a standalone feature within the Kajabi platform but is powered by Stripe on the backend, handling core aspects of payment processing. You can expect the same reliability with Kajabi Payments as you would with Stripe.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/kajabi-payments-overview#does-kajabi-still-support-other-existing-payment-integrations)

Does Kajabi still support other existing payment integrations?

We maintain and support Stripe and PayPal integrations.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/kajabi-payments-overview#is-kajabi-payments-an-additional-option-or-a-replacement-for-stripe)

Is Kajabi Payments an additional option or a replacement for Stripe?

You can connect Kajabi Payments as a payment option on your account in addition to third party payment processors such as Stripe and PayPal. Kajabi Payments and Stripe both serve the same function of allowing your customers to pay with their credit card/debit cards. PayPal is different because it allows your customers to pay with their PayPal account. For example, if you have connected all three payment options to your Kajabi account, you may choose to use either Kajabi Payments _OR_ Stripe to accept card payments on your Offers. You can also choose to add PayPal as a payment option _IN ADDITION_ to your card payment option.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/kajabi-payments-overview#does-kajabi-payments-cost-more-than-stripe)

Does Kajabi Payments cost more than Stripe?

Kajabi Payments has industry-standard processing fees in line with Stripe. [See the full fee breakdown](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/kajabi-payments-processing-fees)
.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/kajabi-payments-overview#what-will-my-checkout-look-like-if-i-use-kajabi-payments)

What will my checkout look like if I use Kajabi Payments?

Kajabi Payments unlocks additional payment methods for you to accept at checkout, such as [Apple Pay, Google Pay](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/how-to-enable-apple-pay-and-google-pay-on-kajabi-payments-offers)
, [Klarna](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/how-klarna-works-with-kajabi-payments)
, and [Afterpay](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/how-to-enable-afterpay-on-kajabi-payments-offers)
. When additional payment methods are configured to your Kajabi Payments offer, the look and feel of your checkout form will be refreshed to a more intuitive user experience for selecting payment methods. [Learn more about additional payment methods](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/how-to-enable-apple-pay-and-google-pay-on-kajabi-payments-offers)
. For additional FAQs, see [Kajabi Payments FAQs](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/kajabi-payments/why-kajabi-payments-everything-you-need-to-know)
.

# Build membership levels - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-build-membership-levels#content-area)

A **membership** is a recurring subscription that gives customers ongoing access to your content, delivered all at once or released over time. Membership levels let you offer tiers, so customers unlock more content each time they upgrade to a higher tier. On Kajabi, a membership isn’t a single product type. You build one by connecting your content Products to a recurring Offer, and each level is its own Offer, so you decide exactly what every tier includes and what it costs.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-build-membership-levels#how-memberships-work-on-kajabi)

How memberships work on Kajabi
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A membership brings together two things: the content **Products** your customers receive, and an **Offer** that charges them on a recurring schedule of weekly, monthly, or annually. A single Offer can bundle several Products, so one subscription might include a **Course**, a **Community**, and a set of **Downloads** together. It helps to know how a membership differs from a Community. A Community is the social space where members connect with you and each other, while a membership is the recurring paid access to content that can sit around it. Most memberships use both: content to deliver the value, and a Community to keep members coming back.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-build-membership-levels#plan-membership-levels)

Plan membership levels
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Each membership level is a separate Offer connected to one or more Products. There’s no limit to how many Products a level can hold. A starter tier might connect to a single Course, while a top tier connects to several Courses, a Community, and your Downloads. A reliable pattern is to make each higher tier include everything in the tier below it, plus something more. For example:

| Level | What’s included |
| --- | --- |
| Bronze | Bronze Product |
| Silver | Bronze and Silver Products |
| Gold | Bronze, Silver, and Gold Products |
| Platinum | Bronze, Silver, Gold, and Platinum Products |

You don’t have to build every tier at once. Many creators launch with one level and add higher tiers as their content library grows.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-build-membership-levels#create-products-for-each-level)

Create Products for each level
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Before you build your Offers, create the content Products that each level will include. A Product can be a Course, Community, Download, Podcast, Coaching Program, or Newsletter. Choose the types that fit what you’re delivering. [Learn how to create a Product](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/step-6-create-a-product)
. Group your Products by the level they belong to, so you can connect them to the right Offer in the next step.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-build-membership-levels#create-an-offer-for-each-level)

Create an Offer for each level
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

An Offer sets the price, billing schedule, and content for a level. Create one Offer per level, then connect the Products that belong to it.

1.  [Create an Offer](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/create-an-offer)
     for each membership level.
2.  Set the Offer to a recurring price, billed weekly, monthly, or annually, so customers are charged on an ongoing schedule.
3.  Connect the Products for that level. For a stacked tier, add every Product from the lower tiers plus the new one, so a Gold Offer includes the Bronze, Silver, and Gold Products.
4.  Repeat for each level you plan to offer.

**Tip:** If you enter pricing information while creating a Product, Kajabi automatically uses it to create a matching Offer.

You can also offer a free trial or a discounted entry period in the Offer settings, so customers can experience a level before the full subscription begins.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-build-membership-levels#control-how-members-access-content)

Control how members access content
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Offer settings decide when customers see your content and for how long, so you can match the pacing and access rules to your program.

*   Release everything at once when a customer joins, or drip content on a schedule so it unlocks over time
*   Limit access to a set number of days from the purchase date for fixed length programs or trials
*   Revoke access automatically when a subscription is canceled or a payment fails, so only active paying members keep access

If you want new members to see only the content released after they join, rather than everything from earlier months, set up a Monthly Enrolling Membership. This model ties each month to its own Offer and Product, so someone who joins in February gets February onward but not January. [Learn how to set up a Monthly Enrolling Membership](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-set-up-monthly-enrolling-memberships)
.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-build-membership-levels#showcase-membership-levels)

Showcase membership levels
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Once your Offers are ready, put them where customers can compare tiers and subscribe. Two options work well together.

*   Add the Offers to a landing page so visitors see every tier side by side, each with its price and what’s included, and can pick the level that fits them
*   Add the Offers to your store page so all your levels live in one browsable place alongside your other products

A clear membership page usually lists the tiers in order, from the entry level to the top tier, and shows what each one unlocks so the upgrade path is obvious. [Add an Offer to a page](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/add-an-offer-to-a-page)
 or [add Offers to your store](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-add-offers-to-your-store)
.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-build-membership-levels#keep-members-engaged)

Keep members engaged
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Recurring revenue depends on members staying subscribed, so give them reasons to return. Kajabi includes tools to help you do that:

*   Email marketing to onboard new members and win back quiet ones
*   A Community for discussion, questions, and connection
*   Live events and challenges to build momentum
*   Analytics to see which content resonates, so you can keep the experience fresh

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-build-membership-levels#faqs)

FAQs
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-build-membership-levels#can-i-build-a-recurring-membership-on-kajabi)

**Can I build a recurring membership on Kajabi?**

Yes. Kajabi lets you create subscription-based memberships where members pay a recurring fee (weekly, monthly, or annually) to access your content. You can combine Courses, Communities, Downloads, and other content types into a full membership experience.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-build-membership-levels#can-i-create-multiple-membership-tiers)

**Can I create multiple membership tiers?**

Yes. You can build tiered memberships by creating separate content products for each level and connecting them to corresponding Offers. This lets you structure a basic tier, premium tier, or any combination that fits your business model.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-build-membership-levels#what-happens-if-a-member-cancels-their-subscription)

**What happens if a member cancels their subscription?**

You control this. You can configure Kajabi to revoke product access when a subscription is canceled or payment fails, ensuring only active paying members can view your content.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-build-membership-levels#can-i-limit-how-long-a-member-has-access-to-content)

**Can I limit how long a member has access to content?**

Yes. Kajabi’s Offer settings allow you to restrict access to a specific number of days from the date of purchase. Useful for fixed-length programs or trial access.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-build-membership-levels#can-new-members-access-all-content-immediately-or-is-it-released-over-time)

**Can new members access all content immediately, or is it released over time?**

Your choice. You can release all content at once when a member joins, or drip content over time on a set schedule — giving you full control over the pacing of your member experience.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-build-membership-levels#can-i-prevent-new-members-from-accessing-older-content-from-before-they-joined)

**Can I prevent new members from accessing older content from before they joined?**

Yes. Kajabi supports Monthly Enrolling Memberships where new members only access content from the point they joined forward, not past content. This is useful for date-based programs and rolling enrollments.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-build-membership-levels#how-do-i-attract-and-keep-members-engaged)

**How do I attract and keep members engaged?**

Kajabi gives you tools for engagement including built-in email marketing, a community product, live events, challenges, and analytics to track what content is resonating. So you can keep your membership fresh and your churn rate low.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-build-membership-levels#can-i-offer-a-free-trial-before-charging-for-membership)

**Can I offer a free trial before charging for membership?**

Yes. You can create trial access by using Kajabi’s offer settings to provide free or discounted entry before a full subscription kicks in.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-build-membership-levels#what%E2%80%99s-the-difference-between-a-kajabi-membership-and-a-community)

**What’s the difference between a Kajabi membership and a community?**

A membership is typically built around recurring access to content (courses, downloads, resources), while a Community is the social/discussion layer where members connect with each other and with you. Most successful memberships on Kajabi combine both.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-build-membership-levels#can-i-bundle-multiple-products-into-one-membership-offer)

**Can I bundle multiple products into one membership offer?**

Yes. A single Kajabi Offer can bundle multiple Products together. For example, a course, a community, and downloadable resources are all accessible with one subscription.

# Affiliate Challenges - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-challenges#content-area)

**Affiliate Challenges** are performance-based incentives you can create within your Affiliates program to motivate affiliates with milestone-based rewards. Instead of relying only on standard commissions, you can create time-bound Challenges that reward affiliates when they hit specific performance goals, such as a set number of sales. Challenges help you drive higher engagement, increase sales velocity, and reward your top-performing affiliates in a more intentional way. Each Challenge defines:

*   **A goal** (For example, a sales count threshold)
*   **A reward** (Monetary or custom)
*   **A timeframe** (Start and end dates)
*   **A budget cap** (Optional)

When affiliates meet the Challenge requirements within the set timeframe, they earn the reward you defined.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-challenges#access-affiliate-challenges)

Access Affiliate Challenges
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  From your Dashboard, click **Sales.**
2.  Select **Affiliates.**
3.  Open **Commission setup.**
4.  Click the **Challenges** tab.

On the **Challenges** tab, you can:

*   Create a Challenge
*   View existing Challenges
*   Edit or delete Challenges

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-challenges#create-an-affiliate-challenge)

Create an Affiliate Challenge
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

To create a new Challenge:

1.  From your Dashboard, go to **Sales > Affiliates > Commission setup > Challenges.**
2.  Click **Create challenge.**

![Create challenge](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/YUgT0sTx06doKTBl/articles/images/690221cd_a2490660-fae7-4e42-84f2-29e0feafe044.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=YUgT0sTx06doKTBl&q=85&s=9e2ac44d575046cb150fb1c0894fffdd)

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-challenges#add-challenge-details)

Add Challenge details

*   **Name your challenge** - This is visible to affiliates on their dashboard.
*   **Description** - Use this to explain the goal, rules, or reward details (500 or less characters).
*   **Thumbnail** - Upload an image to visually highlight the challenge for your affiliates.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-challenges#set-up-the-reward)

Set up the reward

When configuring rewards, you’ll define what affiliates need to achieve and what they earn.

*   Choose **Offers** - Select one or more Offers that count toward the Challenge.
*   Set a **Sales count** threshold - Define how many sales an affiliate must generate to complete the Challenge.
*   Choose a **Reward type**. Choices include:
    *   **Monetary**
        *   Enter a dollar amount.
        *   Select a payout method (manual or automatic, based on your affiliate payout settings).
    *   **Custom**
        *   Use this for non-cash rewards (for example, gift cards, swag, or private perks).
        *   Custom rewards are tracked but fulfilled manually.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-challenges#set-a-budget-optional)

Set a budget (optional)

Setting a budget helps you cap spending and run controlled promotions.

*   Define a maximum total budget for the Challenge
*   Once the budget is reached, the Challenge automatically ends.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-challenges#schedule-the-challenge)

Schedule the challenge

Set a **Start date** and **End date.** Only sales made within this window count toward the Challenge. ![Schedule challenge](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/X2fl5c4w8CoiMUSm/articles/images/99a1503b_f41182e6-3b68-42ce-89be-962c9f3ac4bf.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=X2fl5c4w8CoiMUSm&q=85&s=0a85bb7409ebafc423b7b290636a2c2f)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-challenges#publish-and-manage-challenges)

Publish and manage Challenges
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

After creating a Challenge, you can:

*   **Publish** the Challenge when you’re ready.
*   **Edit** Challenge details before or during its run (depending on status).
*   **Delete** a Challenge if it’s no longer needed

![Manage challenges](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/0X831VxXANnxgpSu/articles/images/dcaab97e_a373e2f7-c2ab-4db4-9c6e-432df2ef2ade.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=0X831VxXANnxgpSu&q=85&s=c81ad3b99ec55044fcf69a611cc4e758)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-challenges#view-challenge-progress)

View Challenge progress
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opening a Challenge shows an overview of its performance, including:

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-challenges#key-metrics)

Key metrics

*   **Total sales**
*   **Sales count**
*   **Affiliates enrolled**
*   **Paid rewards**

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-challenges#leaderboard)

Leaderboard

The **Leaderboard** makes it easy to identify top performers and track competition at a glance. It ranks affiliates based on:

*   **Total sales**
*   **Challenge completion progress**

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-challenges#budget-breakdown)

Budget breakdown

The **Budget breakdown** helps you understand how much of your allocated budget has been used and what’s still available. This includes:

*   **Total budget**
*   **Paid rewards**
*   **Remaining rewards**

![Challenge progress](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/oDd10s3Gsc03FIcd/articles/images/823ac1de_03ea3cad-34f1-4b16-b04a-a143d3991bd7.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=oDd10s3Gsc03FIcd&q=85&s=bc14a31a92067d6f0ad25841069c6335)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-challenges#affiliate-view-of-challenges)

Affiliate view of Challenges
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

When an affiliate opens a Challenge, they’re shown a dedicated challenge card with clear, actionable information about their progress and rewards. Affiliates can view:

*   **Challenge name** and **Thumbnail**: Makes it easy to recognize active promotions.
*   **Active Challenge dates**: Includes **Start** and **End time**.
*   **Sales goal** and **progress:** Displays as a progress bar (for example, _0 / 10 sales_).
*   **Reward amount:** The total reward they can earn for completing the challenge.
*   **Real-time metrics**: Including **Sales count** and **Total sales** amount.

By expanding **Challenge details**, affiliates can also read the full description you set when configuring the Challenge. All progress updates automatically as sales are tracked, so affiliates always know where they stand and how close they are to earning the reward. ![Affiliate challenge view](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/tnn8jq8THgIpHwTP/articles/images/5d53d273_2c551887-2730-4866-b4b5-ac9f9abec9c6.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=tnn8jq8THgIpHwTP&q=85&s=ed4bec887618761366f1b5d4e4372747)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-challenges#export-challenge-results)

Export Challenge results
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Exports make it easy to analyze performance or reconcile rewards outside the platform. You can export challenge data at any time for reporting or payouts. Exported fields include:

*   **Affiliate ID**
*   **State**
*   **Sales Count**
*   **Sales Amount (in cents)**
*   **Completed At**
*   **Affiliate Name**
*   **Affiliate Email**

# Affiliate Coupons vs. Affiliate Share Links - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-coupons-vs-affiliate-share-links#content-area)

**Affiliate Coupons** and **Share Links** are two ways to track purchase conversions through your affiliates. Each method lets Kajabi credit the correct affiliate so you can deliver their commission or reward based on your agreement with them.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-coupons-vs-affiliate-share-links#affiliate-coupons)

Affiliate Coupons
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Affiliate Coupons** give your affiliates a custom **coupon code** that they can share. Any customer that uses an affiliate’s personalized coupon code will be credited to that affiliate, regardless of the presence of a browser cookie. As an admin, you can create **Discounts** that will generate personalized coupon codes for each affiliate. ![Affiliate Coupon Codes](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/3dT4k6GfaoRj67A8/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-7-affiliate-coupon-codes-1768530397921-1769338598249-1775382383372-1780241390969.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=3dT4k6GfaoRj67A8&q=85&s=a013759907663881e78af3eb2314338f) [Learn how to create Affiliate Coupons](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/create-affiliate-coupons)
.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-coupons-vs-affiliate-share-links#affiliate-share-links)

Affiliate Share Links
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A **Share link** is a URL that can lead to any site or page (even a site outside Kajabi). When a user clicks on a Share link a cookie is placed in their browser for 30 days. This cookie will track the user’s habits on your site and attribute any profit generated from that user to the appropriate affiliate. ![Affiliate Share Links](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/O5ZsKXCFiDIup7FH/articles/images/be8216da_upload_4558279711823473339.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=O5ZsKXCFiDIup7FH&q=85&s=715a2de4c0c6d0bb3bb61d2083b5b4e5) [Learn how to create Affiliate Share Links](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/create-an-affiliate-share-link)
.

# Affiliate FAQs - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-faqs#content-area)

The **Affiliate** feature lets you leverage partnerships to grow revenue by rewarding others for selling your courses on your behalf. Below are answers to common questions about how Affiliate commission, tracking, and cookies work.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-faqs#faqs)

FAQs
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-faqs#how-does-a-refund-impact-affiliate-commission)

How does a refund impact Affiliate commission?

If a purchase with an Affiliate link results in a refund, the commission credited to the Affiliate will account for the refund by displaying a $0.00 commission credit in both the [Affiliate Transactions in the Affiliate Dashboard](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliates-overview#transactions)
 and the [Affiliate Report](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/analytics/report-affiliates)
. ![Refund commission display](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/OtYg3iR4Ks8hETRd/articles/images/26eafc22_37945983854107.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=OtYg3iR4Ks8hETRd&q=85&s=12a89e22533142ad140af9904b37e7cf)

**Note:** Partial refunds are not reported as a partial amount in an Affiliate commission. A commission for a partial refund will reflect the same commission amount as a full refund.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-faqs#does-my-affiliate%E2%80%99s-commission-reflect-the-discounted-price-or-the-original-price-when-a-coupon-code-is-applied)

Does my Affiliate’s commission reflect the discounted price or the original price when a coupon code is applied?

If an Affiliate’s link is used to purchase an Offer with a coupon code, your Affiliate will be credited based on the discounted price after the coupon code is applied. [Learn more about Coupons in Kajabi](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/how-to-create-a-coupon)
.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-faqs#can-i-create-a-specific-commission-percentage-for-a-single-affiliate-user-when-a-specific-offer-is-purchased)

Can I create a specific commission percentage for a single Affiliate user when a specific Offer is purchased?

No, Affiliate commission is determined by:

*   The [commission percentage specified in each Offer](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/activate-affiliate-commission#h_2a445f05-d465-414f-8f6b-11902452331f)
     (which will apply to all Affiliate users)
*   or by an [Affiliate user](https://help.kajabi.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037760773#h_11217203-f034-45b1-b624-1bdec0c95294)
     with the [Percentage override](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/activate-affiliate-commission#h_01ECTE4VJYQV7VHEN07SV9PPFT)
     (which will apply to all Offers purchased with the Affiliate’s link).

Unsure of how your Affiliates receive commission? [Learn more about the Affiliate commission workflow](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/understanding-the-affiliates-commission-workflow)
.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-faqs#how-long-do-cookies-last-for-an-affiliate-link)

How long do cookies last for an Affiliate link?

The duration that an Affiliate Cookie will remain in a customer’s browser depends on the [Referral Conversion Window](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/activate-affiliate-commission)
 you have specified. If a customer clicks an Affiliate Share link, they must purchase an Offer within your specified time frame (30 days, 60 days, or 90 days) for the Affiliate to receive credit for the referral. If your customer clicks another Affiliate’s link before making their purchase, the Affiliate with the most recent link clicked will be credited for the referral. Each time an affiliate URL is visited, the Affiliate Cookie’s duration will be refreshed. [Learn more about the Affiliate Program](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliates-overview)
.

# Manually add an Affiliate Transaction - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manually-add-an-affiliate-transaction#content-area)

If an Affiliate purchase occurred but was not tracked, you can manually create a transaction to appear in the commission records. Manual transactions are useful for compensating affiliates for untracked sales, addressing special cases, or providing bonuses.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manually-add-an-affiliate-transaction#add-an-affiliate-transaction-manually)

Add an Affiliate Transaction manually
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Manually add an **Affiliate Transaction** to record anything from missed reports to awarding affiliate bonuses. Keep in mind that manually added transactions cannot be deleted once created. Additionally, manually added transactions will not display as conversions on the affiliate’s dashboard; they are visible only to site owners in Kajabi’s affiliate reports.

1.  Open the **Sales** tab from your Dashboard.
2.  Click **Affiliates**.
3.  Click **My Affiliates** in the top menu.
4.  Select your Affiliate’s **Name**.
5.  Click **New Transaction** in the top right corner.
6.  Complete the **New Affiliate Transaction** form.
7.  Attach the transaction to an existing **Offer**, enter a specified **Commission** amount, and include a reason for the manual add.
8.  Click **Save** to keep your changes.

When completing the **New Affiliate Transaction** form, ensure the following fields are filled accurately:

1.  Select the **Offer** purchased by the referral.
2.  Choose the **Currency** for the transaction.
3.  Enter the **Commission amount** or **Percentage** for the affiliate.
4.  Mark the **Transaction Status** as “Due” (for future payment within Kajabi) or “Paid” (if processed outside Kajabi).

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manually-add-an-affiliate-transaction#view-a-manually-added-transaction)

View a manually added transaction
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Manually added Affiliate Transactions will appear in your [Affiliates report](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/analytics/report-affiliates#understandingyouraffiliatesreport)
 when viewing by affiliate. The reports include transaction details such as the reason for the transaction (e.g., manual), commission information, and associated customer details.

**Note:** These transactions are only visible to site owners and do not impact affiliates’ performance metrics.
