# Affiliate Portal overview - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-portal-overview#content-area)

The **Affiliate Portal** is your affiliate’s dashboard where they can access their resources, reports, and performance data. Similar to your [Affiliate Dashboard](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliates-overview)
, it gives affiliates a real-time view of their sales activity and program materials. After an affiliate is added to your site by registering or by being manually added, they receive an **Affiliate User** welcome email containing their login credentials and a link to access their Affiliate Portal.

**Note:** The Affiliate feature is only available with Growth and Pro Plans. See [kajabi.com/pricing](https://kajabi.com/pricing)
 for more details.

[Learn how to send your affiliate the link to log in](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-your-affiliates)
.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-portal-overview#affiliate-portal-features)

Affiliate Portal features

*   View their **Stats** within a specified time range.
*   View the latest updates of your affiliate program in the **Memo.**
*   Download or access **Resources** you’ve uploaded in your **Affiliate Settings**.
*   Access their **Share Links** or their personalized **Coupon Code**.
*   Export their **Purchase Summary Report**.
*   Change their **Settings** to update their profile, email preferences, and change their password.

![Affiliate Portal overview](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/NHosPLWrdBkWec8r/articles/images/1ce6d0af_41109660526363.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=NHosPLWrdBkWec8r&q=85&s=d97bb466b6d5dd8c38bb2e294a20cbd6)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-portal-overview#access-the-affiliate-portal)

Access the Affiliate Portal
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Affiliates are provided the login URL when they register to be an affiliate or are added by you.
2.  You can access the login or registration URL by going to **Affiliates > Settings.**

![Affiliate Portal access](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/Y0-wARx9yh8Sk6QV/articles/images/af69315e_41109646307739.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=Y0-wARx9yh8Sk6QV&q=85&s=77f0902cc78a0c788480ea52c0593290)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-portal-overview#affiliate-dashboard)

Affiliate Dashboard
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The **Affiliate Dashboard** provides a real-time snapshot of performance and quick access to announcements, resources, coupon codes (if enabled), and share links. ![Affiliate Dashboard](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/c9qoPwTHAQHxkdRa/articles/images/5237b890_41109646317723.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=c9qoPwTHAQHxkdRa&q=85&s=08b735451944882e930d68f48edc5c22)

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-portal-overview#date-filter)

Date filter

Affiliates can use the date filter to view metrics for a specific time period (e.g., this week, this month, a custom range). All metrics update to reflect the selected range.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-portal-overview#performance-metrics)

Performance metrics

The Dashboard displays four key metrics, each scoped to the selected date range:

*   **Total Sales**: The **count** of sales attributed to the affiliate over the selected period.
*   **Commissions Earned**: The **total value of commissions** earned over the selected period, **excluding any refunds**.
*   **Clicks**: The **total number of times** an individual clicked any of the affiliate’s share links.
*   **Form Submissions**: The **count of form submissions** attributed to the affiliate over the selected period.

**Tip:** Affiliates can use the date filter to compare launches or campaigns.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-portal-overview#memo)

Memo

The **Memo** is a static message from the program owner that appears for all affiliates. Affiliates may see launch dates, campaign rules, payout information, or other timely updates here. This is a great place to provide information on upcoming events or helpful information for affiliates to get started.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-portal-overview#resources)

Resources

The **Resources** section is where your affiliates can access helpful links and downloadable assets such as brand guidelines, images, copy templates, or swipe files provided by you. You can update this in your **Affiliates Settings**.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-portal-overview#coupon-code)

Coupon Code

If you have enabled them, the affiliate will see their specific **Affiliate Coupon Code** here. Affiliates can use this code in their promotions as instructed by the owner.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-portal-overview#share-links)

Share Links

These are affiliate-specific **Share Links** that your affiliates can copy and share in content, emails, and social posts, so clicks and sales can be attributed correctly.

**Note:** Share Links are unique to the logged‑in affiliate and links marked as private will not be displayed.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-portal-overview#reports)

Reports
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-portal-overview#purchase-summary)

Purchase Summary

The **Purchase Summary** is the report available to affiliates. It provides a downloadable export of purchases attributed to the affiliate with the following fields:

*   **Customer Name**
*   **Offer Name**
*   **Date of Purchase**

Affiliates can use this export for tracking, reconciliation, or to analyze which offers and timeframes perform best. ![Purchase Summary report](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/CM-okGX-0K4XYDbT/articles/images/5d388ac9_41109660534299.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=CM-okGX-0K4XYDbT&q=85&s=63ed7cd68d0d425dcfeeca723d7be9aa) ![Purchase Summary details](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/iolg5aP2bSMt_GJt/articles/images/4859693a_41109646324635.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=iolg5aP2bSMt_GJt&q=85&s=80c1884178d83707075fb320ceb3582b)

**Note:** Sensitive information (e.g., full name, email address, payment information) is not available to the affiliate.

[Learn how your affiliates get paid](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-affiliate-payouts-and-commissions)
.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-portal-overview#settings)

Settings
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Affiliates can manage profile information, payout email, notifications, and password from **Settings**. ![Affiliate Settings](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/fIOZvo-6lVf3a0o9/articles/images/ff0511b6_41109646328091.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=fIOZvo-6lVf3a0o9&q=85&s=fd6a2a10c701f045bcc1cf5c2ff541e7)

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-portal-overview#profile-information)

Profile information

Affiliates can update the following details:

*   **Name**
*   **Email**
*   **PayPal email** (used if you pay affiliates via PayPal)

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-portal-overview#email-notifications)

Email notifications

Affiliates can control which emails they receive:

*   **Please email me affiliate program news and updates:** Opt in or out of affiliate announcements from your site.
*   **Please email me when I make an affiliate sale:** Kajabi sends an automatic email whenever a new sale is made with the affiliate as the referring affiliate.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-portal-overview#change-password)

Change password

Affiliates can update their password at any time. For security, they should use a unique passphrase with a mix of letters, numbers, and symbols.

# Create Affiliate Coupons - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/create-affiliate-coupons#content-area)

**Affiliate Coupons** let you give your affiliates a custom **Coupon Code** that they can share. Any customer that uses an affiliate’s personalized Coupon Code is credited to that affiliate, regardless of the presence of a browser cookie. As an administrator, you can create **Discounts** that generate personalized Coupon Codes for each affiliate.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/create-affiliate-coupons#what-is-a-discount)

What is a Discount?

Discounts allow you to generate and enable personalized Coupon Codes for every Affiliate User.

**Note:** You can only have one active Discount at a time.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/create-affiliate-coupons#affiliate-use-of-coupon-codes)

Affiliate use of Coupon Codes

After creating an affiliate Discount, your affiliates can access and share their personalized Coupon Codes to encourage people to purchase from your site using one. When the affiliate’s personalized Coupon Code is used, they are credited for the transaction.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/create-affiliate-coupons#create-an-affiliate-coupon)

Create an Affiliate Coupon
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Open the **Sales** tab from your Dashboard.
2.  Click **Affiliates**.
3.  Select **Settings**.
4.  Navigate to the **Affiliate Coupon Codes** section.
5.  Click **Create new discount**.
6.  Complete the discount details:
    1.  Enter your **Discount title** (An internal title that is not visible to your affiliates).
    2.  Under **Coupon Discount**, you can choose one of the following options:
        *   **Discount Percentage**: Enter the percentage discount that affiliates will receive on Offers purchased using the coupon.
        *   **Amount Off**: Set a fixed currency amount that the affiliate will earn for each Offer purchased with the coupon.
    3.  Select the **Duration** for how long the coupon will last once applied to a customer.
    4.  Be sure that **Enable affiliate coupon codes** is selected/enabled.
7.  Click **Create discount** to keep and apply your changes.

Edit the personalized Coupon Code for individual affiliates:

1.  Open the **Sales** tab from your Dashboard.
2.  Click **Affiliates**.
3.  Open **My Affiliates**.
4.  Select the **Name** of the affiliate you wish to edit.
5.  Navigate to **Coupon Code** and edit as needed.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/create-affiliate-coupons#faqs)

FAQs
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/create-affiliate-coupons#how-many-coupon-codes-can-i-have-active-at-once)

How many Coupon Codes can I have active at once?

Only one Discount at a time is allowed (that is available for all Affiliate Users).

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/create-affiliate-coupons#how-do-i-change-the-discount-once-i%E2%80%99ve-already-created-an-affiliate-coupon)

How do I change the Discount once I’ve already created an Affiliate Coupon?

Discounts can not be edited, but you can create a new Discount whenever you’d like. Creating a new Discount will not change the personalized codes, it will simply apply the new discount. Discounts can also be “rerun” or repeated later on. We save all previously created Discounts.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/create-affiliate-coupons#can-an-affiliate-coupon-be-deleted)

Can an Affiliate Coupon be deleted?

At this time, Affiliate Coupons cannot be deleted. If you no longer want to offer coupons, you would need to toggle Affiliate Coupons “off” from your Coupon Settings page.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/create-affiliate-coupons#can-i-change-an-affiliate-user%E2%80%99s-discount-without-changing-any-others)

Can I change an Affiliate User’s Discount without changing any others?

Affiliate Coupons will follow the Discount determined by the currently active one. These Discounts apply to all Affiliate Users. Discounts can’t be changed on an individual basis.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/create-affiliate-coupons#can-i-change-an-affiliate%E2%80%99s-personalized-coupon-code)

Can I change an affiliate’s personalized Coupon Code?

You can change an Affiliate User’s personalized Coupon Code whenever you’d like, as long as the new code is not already taken.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/create-affiliate-coupons#can-i-filter-the-contacts-tab-by-who-has-used-the-coupons)

Can I filter the Contacts tab by who has used the coupons?

You can filter your Contacts tab to view the people that have used an Affiliate Coupon generated by your Discount. The filter will show the Discount instead of the individual coupon. A separate Contacts tab filter in the future will likely be used to determine which customers came from which Affiliate Users.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/create-affiliate-coupons#can-an-affiliate-user-change-their-personalized-coupon-code)

Can an Affiliate User change their personalized Coupon Code?

Only a Kajabi admin can change personalized Coupon Codes.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/create-affiliate-coupons#how-are-conversions-tracked)

How are conversions tracked?

Conversions are tracked and logged in reports. The Commission calculation will occur after the Discount is applied, as is the case with Coupons.

# Understand the Affiliates commission workflow - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/understanding-the-affiliates-commission-workflow#content-area)

Kajabi’s **Affiliates commission workflow** gives you transparency and control over affiliate earnings. This page covers what each commission status means, how statuses flow and can be updated, how refunds are handled, and how to execute manual payouts.

**Note:** The Affiliates feature is only available with Growth and Pro Plans. See [kajabi.com/pricing](https://kajabi.com/pricing)
 for more details.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/understanding-the-affiliates-commission-workflow#commission-statuses)

Commission statuses
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Every affiliate commission displays a clear **Status** indicator so you can instantly see where it stands in the payout process:

*   **Pending** - The commission is recorded but not yet eligible for payout according to your delay schedule.
*   **Due** - The commission has met the payout delay requirements and is now payable.
*   **Paid** - The commission has been paid out to your affiliate.
*   **Canceled** - The commission was canceled and will not be paid out.

![Commission status indicators](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/YUgT0sTx06doKTBl/articles/images/664d6ce3_41110416689563.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=YUgT0sTx06doKTBl&q=85&s=56791240e2e8856c22adf099ca1816e6) Before you can begin this process and onboard to the flow, you’ll need to configure your payout settings.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/understanding-the-affiliates-commission-workflow#finalized-statuses)

Finalized statuses

Once a commission is **Paid** or **Canceled**, it’s finalized and cannot be changed anymore.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/understanding-the-affiliates-commission-workflow#payouts)

Payouts
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

When commissions become **Due**, they are eligible to be paid either manually or automatically.

1.  Navigate to the **Payouts Due** cards on your Affiliate Transaction page.
2.  Determine your preferred **Payout Method**, **Manual** or **Automatic**.
3.  Set up a **Payout Schedule** to keep transactions organized and set reminders to pay commissions.
4.  Once your Affiliates generate sales and their associated transactions are **Due** according to your **Payout Schedule**, they’re ready to be paid out. Learn more about [Managing Affiliate Payouts and Commissions](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-affiliate-payouts-and-commissions)
    .

**Tip:** You can also manually mark individual **Pending** or **Due** commissions as **Paid** by clicking their status badge and selecting **Paid**. That action creates a corresponding Payout record. Check out [PayPal’s Guide](https://www.paypal.com/us/smarthelp/article/what-is-mass-payment-and-how-do-i-send-it-faq3094)
 to learn more about Mass Payment.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/understanding-the-affiliates-commission-workflow#faqs)

FAQs
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/understanding-the-affiliates-commission-workflow#can-i-change-a-paid-commission-back-to-due)

Can I change a Paid commission back to Due?

No. Once a commission is marked Paid, it’s finalized and cannot be changed.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/understanding-the-affiliates-commission-workflow#what-happens-if-i-refund-after-payout)

What happens if I refund after payout?

The commission stays **Paid** and is tagged as **Refunded**, so you can see it was returned after payment.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/understanding-the-affiliates-commission-workflow#how-do-i-see-which-commissions-are-flagged-as-refunded)

How do I see which commissions are flagged as Refunded?

Look for the **Refunded** badge next to the status indicator in your Affiliate Commission list, or apply the **Refunded** filter to locate them more easily.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/understanding-the-affiliates-commission-workflow#if-i-reassign-the-commission-of-a-subscription-to-a-different-affiliate-will-it-reassign-all-subsequent-payments)

If I reassign the commission of a subscription to a different affiliate, will it reassign all subsequent payments?

Yes. The transaction you reassigned _and_ the subsequent subscription payments will all be credited towards the newly selected affiliate user.

# Troubleshoot Affiliate commission - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/troubleshooting-affiliate-commission#content-area)

If an Affiliate isn’t receiving credit for sales, several factors may be responsible. This page helps you identify and resolve common commission tracking issues.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/troubleshooting-affiliate-commission#common-reasons-for-missing-affiliate-credit)

Common reasons for missing Affiliate credit
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **The purchaser did not buy within the specified [Referral Conversion Window](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/activate-affiliate-commission)
    ** after clicking the [Share Link](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/create-an-affiliate-share-link)
    .
*   **The purchaser used a different browser or device** from the browser or device used when the Share Link was clicked.
*   **The purchase was made outside of your Kajabi site’s checkout or cart.**
*   **The customer clicked a different Affiliate’s [Share Link](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/create-an-affiliate-share-link)
    ** (this overrides the initial link) before purchase.
*   **The Offer purchased is not set to give an affiliate commission.** Learn how to [activate Affiliate Commission](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/activate-affiliate-commission)
     in your Offers.
*   **The Affiliate Cookie (kjba) is blocked** by a visitor’s privacy settings or by your site’s cookie script.
*   **If you have a custom domain connected** and a customer purchases under your .mykajabi.com domain.

If you are certain you set everything up correctly, please contact [our support team](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/support/how-to-contact-kajabi-support#submit_a_request)
 for further help.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/troubleshooting-affiliate-commission#discrepancy-between-conversions-and-purchases)

Discrepancy between conversions and purchases
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Notice a discrepancy between the number of conversions and the number of customers that purchased with an Affiliate? If a purchase is in the midst of a trial or a Free Offer was purchased, they are not recorded as purchases. Read the [Affiliate Report](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/analytics/report-affiliates)
 to gain more insight into your Affiliate’s performance.

# Create an Affiliate Share link - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/create-an-affiliate-share-link#content-area)

A **Share Link** is a URL that can lead to any site or page, even outside Kajabi. When a visitor clicks a Share Link, a cookie is placed in their browser for 30 days. This cookie tracks the visitor’s activity on your site and attributes any resulting sales to the appropriate affiliate. ![Affiliates Share Links](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/3dT4k6GfaoRj67A8/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-5-unmanaged-129-1778363810427-1780204596724-1780241218490.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=3dT4k6GfaoRj67A8&q=85&s=bea5e924805279c0601862994af0d2fe) Create Share Links that lead to any URL, Landing Page, or Checkout Page. As long as the visitor completes a purchase of an Offer on Kajabi using the same browser where they originally clicked the Share Link, the sale is credited to the Affiliate User. Keep in mind that although you can track clicks for specific Share Links, there is no way to determine which Affiliate Link was used by a specific customer or the affiliate credited. Truncating an Affiliate Share Link using tools like the [Bitly URL shortener](https://bitly.com/)
 still credits the affiliate for the conversion.

**Note:** Affiliates will only be credited if you set an **Affiliate percentage** in the Offer. Learn how to set up your Affiliate Commission in the [Additional Settings of an Offer](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-include-additional-settings-for-your-offer)
.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/create-an-affiliate-share-link#generate-a-share-link)

Generate a Share Link
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Open the **Sales** tab from your Dashboard.
2.  Click **Affiliates**.
3.  Select **Share links** from the top menu of the **Affiliates Dashboard**.
4.  Click **New affiliate link**. Or, if you’ve previously created an affiliate link, click **\+ New Link** at the top right.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/create-an-affiliate-share-link#share-link-editor)

Share Link editor
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/create-an-affiliate-share-link#create-a-link)

Create a link

Enter the **Name** and **Target URL** where you’d like the Affiliate Share link to redirect. The Name and URL will be visible to the affiliate. Redirect to a:

*   Custom URL
*   Landing Page
*   Checkout Page

This link will be accessible to every Affiliate User on your site, and will contain their unique tracking info. ![Share link editor](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/2Utp8VZlU4lQCvIj/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-8-share-link-editor-1744235844948-1756080383926-1768530397895-1769338598901-1775382380810-1778363811309-1780204597167-1781159378326.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=2Utp8VZlU4lQCvIj&q=85&s=a449228ec058469fa0ef2d2d68603c20)

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/create-an-affiliate-share-link#private)

Private

Toggle on or off the **Private** setting in the Share link editor to hide the link from your affiliates or make it accessible to every affiliate on your site. Creating a Private Share Link will not display the Share link in your [Affiliate’s Portal](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliates-overview#h_52456a83-02fd-4d90-81a2-62a8f7e565e1)
. This allows you to keep the Share link unpublished or send it directly to a specific affiliate only. ![Private share link setting](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/2Utp8VZlU4lQCvIj/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-5-private-share-link-1781159379008.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=2Utp8VZlU4lQCvIj&q=85&s=9732189a422a6a169b4e48420de2d96f)

**Note:** Although you can track clicks for specific Share links, there is no way to determine which Affiliate Share link was used and who used it.

# Manage Affiliate payouts and commissions - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-affiliate-payouts-and-commissions#content-area)

Commissions move through different statuses as they progress toward payout. Understanding these statuses, payout methods, and settings like the Commission Due Day and Payout Date helps you run your affiliate program effectively.

**Note:** The Affiliate feature is only available with Growth and Pro Plans. See [kajabi.com/pricing](https://kajabi.com/pricing)
 for more details.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-affiliate-payouts-and-commissions#commission-status-and-timing)

Commission status and timing
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Every affiliate commission displays a **Status** so you can quickly see where it stands in the payout process:

*   **Pending:** The commission is recorded but not yet eligible for payout according to your delay schedule.
*   **Due:** The commission has met the payout delay requirements and is now payable.
*   **Paid:** The commission has been paid out to your affiliate.
*   **Canceled:** The commission was canceled and will not be paid out.

**Tip:** Refunded commissions retain their Paid status but display a Refunded badge for transparency.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-affiliate-payouts-and-commissions#commission-lifecycle)

Commission lifecycle

1.  **Transaction** occurs. An affiliate earns a **Commission** on a qualifying sale.
2.  **Due Day** countdown. You set a **Commission Due Day** (2–365 days; 30 days recommended).
3.  **Commission becomes Due**. After the countdown, it becomes payable.
4.  **Payout method applies**. You pay commissions manually or let Kajabi process them automatically.

![Commission lifecycle](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/2rWeSU56xHYQYbo0/articles/images/bf867117_41019744905499.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=2rWeSU56xHYQYbo0&q=85&s=bd20a304dad0fa3e6f0579dcaf3202b6) From the **Transactions tab**, you can manually adjust statuses when needed:

*   Change **Pending** → **Due** to accelerate payout eligibility.
*   Change **Pending** or **Due** → **Paid** to record a manual payout.
*   Change **Pending** or **Due** → **Canceled** to prevent payout.

Once a Commission is Paid or Canceled, it becomes finalized and cannot be changed.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-affiliate-payouts-and-commissions#manual-payouts)

Manual payouts
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Manual payouts give you full control over when and how affiliates are paid. Kajabi helps you track and batch **Due commissions**, but you send the money outside Kajabi (for example, PayPal, Wise, or cash). ![Manual payouts](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/gPLd9epPHl3pyPMl/articles/images/da3cd976_41019703554075.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=gPLd9epPHl3pyPMl&q=85&s=0bee2cd1ef8d5f9c747bd8c28daee170)

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-affiliate-payouts-and-commissions#key-settings)

Key settings

*   **Commission Due Day:** Choose **2–365 days** (Kajabi recommends at least 30 days). This buffer helps you verify transactions and account for any refunds or disputes before payment.

![Commission due day settings](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/ohdabStj0dwgP9R9/articles/images/a692af9d_41019744906267.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=ohdabStj0dwgP9R9&q=85&s=2f17808c668cd27a1c6069dd18793372)

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-affiliate-payouts-and-commissions#complete-manual-payouts)

Complete manual payouts

1.  When commissions become **Due**, visit **Affiliates > Transactions**.
2.  Select **Pay Now** to mark commissions as Paid in Kajabi.
3.  View **Itemized Transactions** and **Download the PayPal mass payout** report for easier bulk payments. ![Itemized transactions](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/CM-okGX-0K4XYDbT/articles/images/5b34f6d6_41019744907419.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=CM-okGX-0K4XYDbT&q=85&s=8a566f0daf6897768fbd8a7f67d061d3)
4.  Complete the payment in PayPal (or your preferred method). ![PayPal payment](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/ig0P6X_YYqhSgRa-/articles/images/1f76cc4d_41019744907803.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=ig0P6X_YYqhSgRa-&q=85&s=fc078dd3568145fcc83e8b4224c1f96c)
5.  Select **Confirm payment** in Kajabi. We will automatically record a single **Payout** entry in your **Payouts** tab containing those commissions.

**Note:** A sale happens on Day 0. With a **30-day Commission Due Day**, the commission becomes due on Day 30. You see the commission with a Due Status on the affiliates’ Transaction page, then you complete the **Pay Now** workflow. Review the itemized transactions, download the PayPal mass payout report, pay your affiliates, and confirm this action within Kajabi. All transactions will be marked as Paid.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-affiliate-payouts-and-commissions#automatic-payouts)

Automatic payouts
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Automatic payouts reduce manual work by scheduling payments directly through PayPal.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-affiliate-payouts-and-commissions#key-settings-2)

Key settings

![Automatic payout settings](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/ADlD5UQgkduQhvui/articles/images/a9cc6599_41019703555739.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=ADlD5UQgkduQhvui&q=85&s=5b9effe814fba85bd2f9e7cb8cc114ea)

*   **Commission Due Day:** Determines when each commission becomes due (choose **2–365 days**; Kajabi recommends at least 30 days).
*   **Payout Frequency & Date (schedule):** Choose **Weekly** (a day of the week) or **Monthly** (a specific calendar day). Kajabi enforces this schedule and triggers payouts on that day.
*   **Currency:** Choose the currency with which PayPal will attempt to pay out to all of your affiliates. Generally, if the affiliate has a wallet with a different currency, currency conversion will automatically occur.

**Note:** To use automatic payouts, ensure that you have a **PayPal Business account**, as Personal accounts do not support the critical Mass Payouts feature.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-affiliate-payouts-and-commissions#complete-automatic-payouts)

Complete automatic payouts

1.  Commissions reach their **Due Day**.
2.  On your chosen **Payout Date**, Kajabi triggers PayPal to send payments.
3.  You receive an email notification two days before the payout with a summary of included transactions.
4.  Review the snapshot, verify transactions, and ensure your PayPal wallet has sufficient funds.

**Note:** For example, with a 30-day commission **Due Day** and a monthly payout schedule set to the first of the month: a sale on January 1st becomes due on January 31st, and a sale on January 15th becomes due on February 14th. On February 1st, Kajabi would only pay out the first transaction because it became due before that date. The second transaction would not get paid out until March 1st.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-affiliate-payouts-and-commissions#authenticate-paypal)

Authenticate PayPal

1.  In the **Transactions** tab, select the option to set up automatic payouts.
2.  **Re-authenticate PayPal** if you already have it integrated for payment processing, otherwise [Connect PayPal](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/api-integrations/payment-integrations/connect-paypal-to-kajabi)
    .
3.  Grant Kajabi LLC permission to connect to your PayPal account. This allows Kajabi to access transaction data to manage payouts automatically.
4.  Once confirmed, you will also need to verify that the Mass Payout feature is enabled on your PayPal Account via the following PayPal resource: [https://www.paypal.com/payoutsweb/landing](https://www.paypal.com/payoutsweb/landing)
    . This will be required for automatic payouts to function.

**Note:** If you encounter errors setting up PayPal, ensure that PayPal is fully connected to Kajabi, including verifying the enabled Mass Payouts feature. If errors persist, check connectivity, permissions granted, and the account type in PayPal to resolve issues.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-affiliate-payouts-and-commissions#edit-affiliate-commission)

Edit affiliate commission
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

There may be times when you need to adjust an affiliate’s commission, for example correcting the amount, reassigning the sale to a different affiliate, or updating the payout status. Kajabi provides two entry points for editing an affiliate commission:

1.  Navigate to **Affiliates > Transactions**.
2.  Locate the commission you want to edit.
3.  Click the **3-dot menu (···)** beside the transaction.
4.  Select **Edit affiliate commission**.

![Edit commission menu](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/8OxtRX4ccA7GVWxq/articles/images/78c6e61a_41019744909083.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=8OxtRX4ccA7GVWxq&q=85&s=d994d68feb621823e2b91c2b5285f4d9)

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-affiliate-payouts-and-commissions#edit-affiliate-commission-window)

Edit Affiliate commission window

Once you open the edit window, you can update the following fields:

*   **Reassign affiliate**: Transfer the commission to another affiliate if needed.
*   **Set a new commission amount**: Adjust the commission tied to the transaction.
*   **Change payment status**: Choose whether the commission remains **Pending**, is marked as **Paid**, or updated to another available status.

![Edit commission window](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/Y1eeDSTkyoCb85Eu/articles/images/a3d1362b_41019744910107.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=Y1eeDSTkyoCb85Eu&q=85&s=12d12d3922d1ac239fb903f62937cf1a)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-affiliate-payouts-and-commissions#failed-payouts)

Failed payouts
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-affiliate-payouts-and-commissions#if-an-automatic-payout-fails)

If an automatic payout fails

*   Kajabi marks the payout attempt as failed if the entire payout failed or partially failed if only part of the payout failed (example 1 out of 5 transactions in the payout failed to send). In addition, the commission transactions within the payout that failed will be marked as failed.
*   When failed commission transactions are present, Kajabi will show the failed amount and surface a retry button. Once you’ve resolved the failure issue (for example, insufficient PayPal balance) you will be able to retry paying out these failed commission transactions.
*   Verify that PayPal Mass Payouts is enabled, ensure sufficient balance in your PayPal wallet, and check for any account limitations or connectivity issues before retrying the payout.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-affiliate-payouts-and-commissions#customize-the-transactions-table)

Customize the Transactions table
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

You can personalize the **Transactions** table to display the information most relevant to you. By customizing the columns, you can quickly view details such as commission amounts, payout types, or customer names without needing to open each transaction.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-affiliate-payouts-and-commissions#customize-columns)

Customize columns

1.  Navigate to **Affiliates > Transactions**.
2.  Click the **3-dot menu (···)** in the upper right corner of the table.
3.  Select **Customize columns**.
4.  Toggle columns on or off based on the information you want to display.
5.  Drag and drop columns to reorder them.
6.  Click **Apply** to update your view.
7.  If you want to reset your table back to the default view, select **Reset to default**.

![Customize columns](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/Y0-wARx9yh8Sk6QV/articles/images/b3e148f9_41019744910875.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=Y0-wARx9yh8Sk6QV&q=85&s=ca3936af60c86a52be5bd1d8227a6181)

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-affiliate-payouts-and-commissions#available-columns)

Available columns

*   Affiliate
*   Offer
*   Amount
*   Commission
*   Created
*   Estimated Due
*   Status
*   Payout Type
*   Customer
*   Type
*   Due
*   Payout Paid Date
*   Payout ID
*   Refunded

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-affiliate-payouts-and-commissions#export-transactions)

Export Transactions
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

You can export affiliate transaction data from the **Transactions** tab to review payout history, reconcile payments, or process bulk payouts.

1.  Go to the **Transactions** tab.
2.  Click **Export**.
3.  Choose a **report format** and select the date range you want to export.

The available export formats are:

*   **PayPal Mass Pay Report**
    *   Affiliate PayPal email
    *   Commission amount
    *   Currency of commission earned
*   **Summary Report**
    *   Affiliate name
    *   Affiliate email
    *   PayPal email
    *   Commission earned
    *   Currency
*   **Details Report**
    *   Transaction ID
    *   Stripe Charge ID
    *   KP Charge ID
    *   Date
    *   Offer ID
    *   Offer title
    *   Affiliate name
    *   Affiliate PayPal email
    *   Refunded status
    *   Transaction amount (in cents)
    *   Commission type
    *   Commission rate
    *   Commission earned
    *   Currency
    *   Reason (for manually added transactions)
    *   Customer name
    *   Customer email

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-affiliate-payouts-and-commissions#faqs)

FAQs
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-affiliate-payouts-and-commissions#can-i-change-a-paid-commission-back-to-due)

Can I change a Paid commission back to Due?

No. Paid commissions are locked for accuracy.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-affiliate-payouts-and-commissions#what-happens-if-an-affiliate%E2%80%99s-email-isn%E2%80%99t-linked-to-paypal)

What happens if an affiliate’s email isn’t linked to PayPal?

Affiliates have 30 days to link their email to PayPal and claim their funds if an unlinked email was used.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-affiliate-payouts-and-commissions#why-is-a-paypal-business-account-required)

Why is a PayPal Business account required?

PayPal is the only payment processor supported by Kajabi’s automatic payouts feature. A Business account is mandatory to enable the necessary Mass Payouts feature.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-affiliate-payouts-and-commissions#what-happens-if-i-refund-after-payout)

What happens if I refund after payout?

The commission remains Paid but gets a Refunded badge.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-affiliate-payouts-and-commissions#how-do-i-find-refunded-commissions)

How do I find refunded commissions?

Apply the Refunded filter in the Transactions tab.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-affiliate-payouts-and-commissions#if-i-reassign-a-subscription-commission-what-happens)

If I reassign a subscription commission, what happens?

The reassigned transaction and all future subscription payments move to the new affiliate.

# Affiliates overview - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliates-overview#content-area)

**Affiliates** lets you leverage partnerships to grow your revenue by rewarding others for selling your courses on your behalf. You set the commission, your affiliates share the links, and Kajabi tracks every conversion.

**Note:** Affiliates are only available with the Growth and Pro Plans. See [kajabi.com/pricing](https://kajabi.com/pricing)
 for more details.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliates-overview#key-benefits)

Key benefits

*   Manage affiliate registrations and accounts
*   Track conversions and form submissions
*   Automatically calculate earnings
*   Create detailed reports

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliates-overview#determine-payout-method)

Determine payout method

*   **Automatic Payouts** reduce manual work by scheduling payments directly through PayPal.
*   **Manual Payouts** give you full control over when and how affiliates are paid. Kajabi helps you track and batch **Due commissions**, but you send the money outside Kajabi (for example, PayPal, Wise, or cash).

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliates-overview#set-up-a-payout-schedule)

Set up a payout schedule

*   Go to **Transactions** > **Payouts** to determine your preferred method of paying out your affiliates
*   Create a payout schedule to keep transactions organized and set reminders to pay commissions

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliates-overview#enable-commissions)

Enable commissions

*   [Enable Affiliate Commission](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/activate-affiliate-commission)
     for your Offers

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliates-overview#create-share-links-or-affiliate-coupons)

Create Share Links or Affiliate Coupons

*   [Create Share Links](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/create-an-affiliate-share-link)
     to track referrals from affiliate traffic
*   [Create Affiliate Coupons](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/create-affiliate-coupons)
     to credit affiliates when their personalized code is used

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliates-overview#affiliate-dashboard)

Affiliate Dashboard
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The **Affiliate Dashboard** shows an overview of how your affiliates are performing. ![Affiliate Dashboard](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/OtYg3iR4Ks8hETRd/articles/images/270cb318_41109803055643.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=OtYg3iR4Ks8hETRd&q=85&s=4676921ca36a46c4136306b3cca79b75) Set the **Date range** and **Currency** using the selectors above the graph to narrow down the data to review the following metrics:

*   **Total Sales**: The total value of sales attributed to your affiliates, excluding refunds.
*   **Commission Earned**: The total amount of commissions earned by your affiliates, excluding refunds.
*   **Form Submissions**: The count of form submissions attributed to your affiliates.
*   **Sales Count**: The count of both free and paid sales attributed to your affiliate.
*   **Leaderboard**: A ranked list of your top affiliates.
*   **Top offers**: A ranked list of your top-selling affiliate-related Offers

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliates-overview#commission-setup)

Commission setup
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Set up your affiliate’s commission percentage or amount for each **Offer** when it is purchased with their unique **Share Link** or personalized **Coupon Code**. [Learn how to activate Affiliate Commission](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/activate-affiliate-commission)
.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliates-overview#share-links-and-affiliate-coupons)

Share Links and Affiliate Coupons
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliates-overview#share-links)

Share Links

A Share Link is simply a URL that can lead to any site or page (even a site outside Kajabi). When a user clicks on a Share Link a cookie is placed in their browser based upon the referral conversion window you have set in your Affiliate settings. This cookie will attribute the visitor’s form submissions and purchases to the appropriate Affiliate. [Create Share Links](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/create-an-affiliate-share-link)
 that lead to any URL, Landing Page, or Checkout Page. As long as the user completes a purchase of an Offer on Kajabi using the same browser where they originally clicked the Share Link, the sale will be credited to the Affiliate User. ![Share Links](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/Fky1o1xAW1UyWbKo/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-1-affiliate-share-links-tab-1785428509069.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=Fky1o1xAW1UyWbKo&q=85&s=009f3a26a34b2818f0a96fd0ebb8d7d2)

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliates-overview#affiliate-coupons)

Affiliate Coupons

Unlike Share Links, when an [Affiliate Coupon](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/create-affiliate-coupons)
 code is used to purchase an **Offer** from your site, the affiliate is credited with the transaction without needing to click a Share Link first. As an administrator, you can create **Discounts** that generate personalized coupon codes for each affiliate.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliates-overview#affiliate-users)

Affiliate Users
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Create and manage your Affiliate Users in the **Users** section of your **Affiliate Dashboard.** Click on an Affiliate User’s **Name** to:

*   Review their individual affiliate statistics.
*   Override their **Affiliate Percentage**.
*   View which **Share Links** are available to each affiliate.
*   View and update your affiliates’ personalized **Coupon Code**.
*   Manually add an affiliate transaction.
*   Export their form submissions, which contain the following:
    *   Form Title
    *   Form ID
    *   Submission Date
    *   Customer Name
    *   Customer ID
    *   Customer Email
    *   Affiliate ID
    *   Affiliate Name
    *   Affiliate Email

See [Managing your Affiliates](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-your-affiliates)
 for more details.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliates-overview#transactions)

Transactions
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

View all transactions credited to your Affiliate Users in **Transactions**. ![Transactions view](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/8OxtRX4ccA7GVWxq/articles/images/787a19bf_41109816912923.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=8OxtRX4ccA7GVWxq&q=85&s=21242bab8735b3b6514f399920281136) Learn more about the [Affiliate Commission Workflow](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/understanding-the-affiliates-commission-workflow)
 and how to [manage Affiliate payouts and commissions](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/manage-affiliate-payouts-and-commissions)
 to begin allocating commission and paying out your affiliates.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliates-overview#announcements)

Announcements
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

![Announcements](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/Fky1o1xAW1UyWbKo/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-1-affiliates-announcements-tab-1785428509874.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=Fky1o1xAW1UyWbKo&q=85&s=ea9d52cefa8dbaa4888e4b534b5bb6bb) Communicate with every Affiliate User on your site by creating an **Announcement**. An Announcement sends an email to every affiliate, including a **Title** and **Body** text. ![Announcement editor](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/Fky1o1xAW1UyWbKo/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-1-affiliates-new-announcement-1785428510303.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=Fky1o1xAW1UyWbKo&q=85&s=7aaa5e494655f3e172e84d8ebe5dc19b)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliates-overview#settings)

Settings
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Affiliate Settings** in the top menu of your Affiliates page lets you customize the appearance of your Affiliate Dashboards and configure key elements of your affiliate program. Use **Memos** to convey useful information that your affiliates will see when they sign in. Use **Resources** to share files and links (e.g., promo creatives, swipe copy, calendars). A maximum of 10 resources can be added at any given time. **Preview the dashboard** to see the view your affiliates have when they log into their Portal. ![Settings preview](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/Fky1o1xAW1UyWbKo/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-1-affiliates-settings-1785428510889.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=Fky1o1xAW1UyWbKo&q=85&s=b9d79e71edd51760045538e9d1a11fe3)

**Tip:** Click and drag your resources to rearrange the order that your affiliates view them.

The **Affiliate Signup Page** is where individuals can register as your affiliate. Learn how to [create a custom Affiliate Signup Page](https://help.kajabi.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037244074)
.

**Note:** If **Registrations** are disabled, this page will prompt your prospective affiliate to send an email to the Support email listed in your **Site Details**.

The **Affiliate Login page** is where your registered affiliates log in to their own Affiliate Dashboard and view their sales metrics. The **Referral Conversion Window** determines the duration of an affiliate cookie in a visitor’s browser. [Learn more about the Referral Conversion Window](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/activate-affiliate-commission)
.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliates-overview#affiliate-portal)

Affiliate Portal
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

After an affiliate is added to your site manually or through registration, they receive an Affiliate User welcome email containing a link to set up their affiliate account and instructions on how to access their **Affiliate Portal**.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliates-overview#affiliate-portal-features)

Affiliate Portal features

*   View their **Stats** within a specified time range:
    *   Total **Sales**
    *   **Commissions** earned
    *   **Clicks**
    *   **Form submissions**
*   View the latest updates of your affiliate program in the **Memo.**
*   Download or access **Resources** you’ve uploaded in your Affiliate Settings.
*   Access their **Share Links** or their Personalized **Coupon Code**.
*   Export their **Purchase Summary Report**.
*   Change their **Settings** to update their profile, email preferences, and change their password.

![Affiliate Portal](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/nb-ZvvvD8AMIw1RF/articles/images/e42b444e_41109816923803.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=nb-ZvvvD8AMIw1RF&q=85&s=ff8d3633613496bf433e068666069618) See [Affiliate Portal overview](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliate-portal-overview)
 for more details.

# Update existing Affiliate Transactions as paid - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/update-existing-affiliate-transactions-as-paid#content-area)

As you get started with the Kajabi Affiliate experience, there’s a one-time activity to mark existing transactions as paid. Use this to tidy up any outstanding commissions from before the feature was enabled on your account. When you begin using the Affiliates feature, any existing Affiliate Transactions do not have a status. You can set their **Status** as **Paid**, which:

*   **Simplifies future reporting** — all your commission data will accurately reflect which transactions were paid
*   **Helps you stay organized** by better tracking past transactions
*   **Preserves historical integrity** — this action only affects existing transactions, and transactions thereafter follow an updated workflow

**Note:** This Paid status change is done only for tracking purposes, and does not send any money from your account to affiliates. If money is owed for any of these transactions, make sure you pay them out either before or after this action.Once you confirm, these transactions are permanently marked Paid. You cannot revert them to Unpaid status.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/update-existing-affiliate-transactions-as-paid#mark-affiliate-transactions-as-paid)

Mark Affiliate Transactions as paid
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Follow these steps:

1.  From your **Dashboard** sidebar, select **Sales** > **Affiliates**.
2.  Select the **Transactions** tab.
3.  Click **Set up payment schedule**.
4.  Set the **Commission is due after** setting and click **Confirm**.
5.  A banner will appear on the page. Click **Get Started** on the banner.
6.  Select the option to **Mark as Paid**.

**Important:** This is a one-time action. **Only perform this step once** for all legacy transactions. Affiliate sales created after the feature activation will not require this.**This is irreversible.** Double-check your selections—once marked, you cannot undo them.Only transactions created **before** the Affiliates feature activation will be affected. Any transactions thereafter follow the regular affiliate status workflow.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/update-existing-affiliate-transactions-as-paid#resources)

Resources
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

.

# Blog overview - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/blog-overview#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/blog-overview#overview)

Overview
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Your Blog in Kajabi allows you to share content with your audience. Before creating posts, configure your Blog Settings and create your first Blog Post. Your Blog Settings contain the SEO and Sharing information for your Blog homepage and all Blog Posts without individual SEO settings. [Learn to configure SEO and Sharing settings for your Blog](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-configure-seo-and-sharing-settings-for-your-blog)
.

**Note:** When creating Blog Posts, configure individual SEO settings for each Blog Post or it will default to the main SEO and Sharing Information configured in the Blog Settings.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/blog-overview#create-a-blog-post)

Create a Blog post
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Open the **Website** tab from the Dashboard
2.  Click **Blog**
3.  Navigate to the top right corner and click **\+ New Blog Post**

![Create new blog post](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/z1XYJHwJ4PoPwV6O/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-17-blog-new-post-button-1785429608628.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=z1XYJHwJ4PoPwV6O&q=85&s=7a57b1103291852ffff64f7a4a79bd2a)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/blog-overview#customize-a-blog-post)

Customize a Blog post
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Remember, customizing your Blog Settings sets up your SEO and Sharing information for the Blog homepage and all Blog Posts that do not contain individual SEO settings. To set up individual SEO settings for each Blog Post, read [How to Configure SEO and Sharing Settings for your Blog](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-configure-seo-and-sharing-settings-for-your-blog)
. Read [How to Create a Blog Post](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-create-a-blog-post)
 for more details:

*   [Add Media](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-add-media-to-your-blog-posts)
     to your Blog Post
*   [Set a specific publishing date](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-create-a-blog-post#set-a-specific-publish-date)
     for your Blog Post
*   [Create Tags](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-create-a-blog-post#adding-tags-to-your-blog-posts)
     to organize and categorize your Blog Posts

[Learn to add media to your blog posts](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-add-media-to-your-blog-posts)
.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/blog-overview#design-the-blog)

Design the Blog
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/blog-overview#customize-your-blog-post-page)

Customize your Blog post page

1.  Open the **Website** tab from the Dashboard
2.  Click **Pages**
3.  Click **Customize** next to **Blog Post**

![Customize blog post page](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/bsblzYTSOWswzHGj/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-15-blog-overview-1782636379174-1784126776053-1784152806136.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=bsblzYTSOWswzHGj&q=85&s=98952b1214d61577283bd3f9adf9e318) The Blog Post page is similar to the main Blog homepage with the addition of the Blog Post Body. **Blog Post Body** allows you to include additional blocks at the bottom of your Blog Posts:

*   Call to Action (CTA)
*   Image
*   Opt-in

Read [How to Design Your Blog Posts](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-design-your-blog-posts)
 for more details.

**Note:** Designing your Blog Posts will automatically render across all your Blog Posts, both existing and future.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/blog-overview#blog-page)

Blog page

Your blog in Kajabi is integrated onto your site as a standard website page. Customize the overall look and feel of your blog by customizing the [Blog](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-design-your-blog-homepage)
, [Blog Post](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-design-your-blog-posts)
, and [Blog Search](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-design-your-blog-search-page)
 website pages. **Customize your Blog page:**

1.  From inside the editor click the **Page Dropdown** at the bottom of the **Sidebar Editor** and select **Blog**

# Embed custom code to a page with Premier - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-embed-custom-code-to-your-page-with-premier#content-area)

Add custom code to your pages built with the Premier legacy template to include schedulers, videos, or customize the appearance of a section.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-embed-custom-code-to-your-page-with-premier#overview)

Overview
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The Custom Code Block in Premier allows you to embed code without requiring access to the Code Editor. This guide walks you through adding a Custom Code Section and customizing its appearance.

**Important:** Introducing custom code to your site can open you up to vulnerabilities and potential malware attacks. We recommend using vulnerability tools like [VirusTotal](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/home/url)
 or [Snyk](https://snyk.io/)
 to scan any custom code that you intend to use and apply certain [best practices](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/code-based-customizations)
 to help reduce potential impact.

**Note:** This article refers to the Premier Legacy Templates, which may be outdated. If you are using the Kajabi Pages Templates, refer to the updated guide [here](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/add-custom-code-to-pages)
.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-embed-custom-code-to-your-page-with-premier#add-a-custom-code-section)

Add a Custom Code Section
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Embedding custom code can be used to include schedulers or videos, or to customize the appearance of a section of your page.

1.  Open the **Website** tab from the Dashboard.
2.  Click **Pages**.
3.  Select the page you wish to customize or [create a new page](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-create-a-new-page-with-premier)
    .
4.  Click **Customize** to open the [page editor](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-get-to-the-page-editor)
    .
5.  Click **\+ Add Section** from the sidebar.
6.  Click the **Custom Content** section and click **Add**.
7.  Your newly added Custom Content Section will be added to the bottom of the page.
8.  In the Custom Content Section, scroll to the bottom of the editor and click **Add Content**.
9.  Select **Custom Code**.
10.  Paste your copied custom code or enter custom code into the **Code** field.
11.  Click **Save** to keep your changes.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-embed-custom-code-to-your-page-with-premier#customize-your-custom-code-block)

Customize your Custom Code Block
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The Custom Code Block can be used to embed or add custom code for a variety of purposes, including:

*   Adding custom code (like [embedding a calendar](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-install-an-add-to-calendar-button-to-your-page)
     on your page) without requiring access to the Code Editor of your site
*   Creating blank spaces on your page to design beautiful, unique landing page layouts
*   Testing out this Block to see how you can design unique landing pages to fit your business

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-embed-custom-code-to-your-page-with-premier#block-appearance)

Block appearance
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-embed-custom-code-to-your-page-with-premier#alignment)

Alignment

Adjust the alignment of the Block within your Custom Content Section:

*   Left
*   Centered
*   Right

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-embed-custom-code-to-your-page-with-premier#container-width)

Container width

Change the size of your Custom Code Block by selecting your desired container width.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-embed-custom-code-to-your-page-with-premier#place-this-block-on-its-own-row)

Place this block on its own row

Separate your Content Blocks within your Custom Content Section by toggling on this setting.
