# Add custom fonts - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/add-custom-fonts#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/add-custom-fonts#overview)

Overview
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Kajabi offers many native fonts with the page builder. However, Kajabi also gives you the ability to use **custom fonts with Google fonts** or a **licensed font file** to design a uniquely branded page. Regardless of your Kajabi plan, the Page Builder lets you add custom fonts to your page without accessing the code editor.

**Note:** Completion of the steps in this guide requires working with HTML and CSS code. If you aren’t familiar with HTML and CSS, we recommend consulting with a web design professional regarding the addition of embed code to your Kajabi site.Keep in mind that OTF files are not supported by Kajabi and cannot be uploaded.

**Note:** If you are using the Legacy builder, [Premier](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-create-a-new-page-with-premier)
, custom fonts will require access to the code editor.

Adding your custom font will require a basic understanding of **CSS**. This guide will help you understand how to add custom code, which lets you add custom fonts to your page.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/add-custom-fonts#cascading-style-sheets-css)

Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

CSS is a style sheet language that is used to selectively style your HTML elements. For example, you can select a specific paragraph text within your page and change the color to green with CSS. The **CSS Code Editor**, available with the Page Builder, lets you update your HTML style elements to change the fonts on your page.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/add-custom-fonts#headings-and-heading-tags)

Headings and heading tags
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The element tags for font **Heading** sizes are H1, H2, H3, H4, H5, H6. Understanding Heading tags and how to change them on your Kajabi page prepares you with the necessary knowledge for adding custom fonts to your page. ![Heading Tags](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/yejBQObxZkrUDGeF/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-15-custom-fonts-1784151429324.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=yejBQObxZkrUDGeF&q=85&s=c6e6a08221a31879145dff8ffa775acf) Recognizing the differences between each Heading tag will be helpful when adding your custom font. **Font size** and **Style** lets you specify the exact text to apply your custom font to:

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/add-custom-fonts#add-a-custom-font-for-headings)

Add a custom font for headings
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Note:** If you are using the Legacy builder, [Premier](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-create-a-new-page-with-premier)
, adding custom fonts will require access to the code editor.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/add-custom-fonts#how-to-select-your-heading-tag)

How to select your heading tag

Kajabi uses standard Heading tags to define your Heading text. When adding your custom font to your page, you’ll need to define the specific Heading tag that will take on the custom font style. By defining a specific Heading tag, you can simply update that Heading tag throughout your page after adding your custom font to the Page Settings CSS.

#### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/add-custom-fonts#to-view-and-assign-the-heading-tag-you-wish-to-apply-your-custom-font-to)

To view and assign the Heading tag you wish to apply your custom font to:

1.  Open the **Website** tab from your Dashboard.
2.  Click **Pages**.
3.  Click into the page you wish to edit.
4.  Select the **Text block** containing the text you wish to add your custom font to.
5.  Highlight the specific text in the text editor.
6.  Then, click **Formats** from the text editor options.
7.  Select **Headings**.
8.  Select the Heading tag you wish to use for your custom font.
9.  Click **Save** to keep and apply your changes:

**Tip:** Click the **expand icon** in your text editor to view your editor at a larger scale for easier viewing.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/add-custom-fonts#how-to-add-your-custom-font)

How to add your custom font

With Kajabi’s page builder, you can use Google Fonts or a licensed font file to add your custom font to your selected Heading tag. If you wish to add a Google Font to your page, [click here to learn more about using Google Fonts on your page](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-embed-custom-fonts-to-your-page)
.

**Note:** OTF files are not supported by Kajabi and cannot be uploaded onto your site.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/add-custom-fonts#licensed-font-file)

Licensed font file

Follow the steps below to use your licensed font file on your page built with Kajabi. In this example, we will customize our Heading 3 text. If you’ve purchased a font file and you have the license to use it, then you can use a .ttf, .woff, .woff2, or .eot font file type on Kajabi.

**Important:** Introducing custom code to your site can open you up to vulnerabilities and potential malware attacks. We recommend using vulnerability tools like [VirusTotal](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/home/url)
 or [Snyk](https://snyk.io/)
 to scan any custom code that you intend to use and apply certain [best practices](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/code-based-customizations)
 to help reduce potential impact.

#### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/add-custom-fonts#how-to-upload-your-licensed-font-file-to-your-newly-created-page)

How to upload your licensed font file to your newly created page:

1.  First, [create an assets page in your Kajabi landing page folder](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/pages-explained)
     so you can reference it directly from Kajabi.
2.  Open your **Assets** page and add a [Call to Action block](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-add-a-call-to-action-block-to-your-website-page-and-landing-page)
    .
3.  Write the name of your font file in the **Button text** (e.g., Cameliya.ttf).
4.  Then, select **Download a file** for the **Button action**.
5.  Upload your font file.
6.  Then, click **Save**:

**Tip:** Be sure to [keep your Assets page unpublished](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-publish-and-draft-your-page)
 so that it is only visible and accessible internally to you and your team.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/add-custom-fonts#how-to-add-your-licensed-font-file-to-your-page)

How to add your licensed font file to your page

To add your licensed font file to your page, you will need to add **custom code** to your site with Kajabi’s Page Builder. If you are familiar with adding Google Fonts to your page, you will notice that the code used to add your licensed font file is [similar to the code used for your Google Font](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-embed-custom-fonts-to-your-page)
.

**Note:** When you input the sample code below, replace FontName, FONTFILENAME, and XXXXXX with the real name of your font file (examples: Arial, Helvetica, Garamond, etc.).

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/add-custom-fonts#ttf-code)

TTF code

If you are using a TrueType font file, the following code will be added to your page:

    @font-face {
      font-family: 'FontName';
      src: url('FONTFILENAME.ttf') format('truetype');
    }
    h1 {
      font-family: 'FontName', sans-serif;
    }
    

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/add-custom-fonts#eot-code)

EOT code

If you are using an Embedded OpenType font file, replace the source line from the code above to contain the following information:

    src: url('XXXXXX.eot') format('embedded-opentype');
    

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/add-custom-fonts#woff2-code)

WOFF2 code

If you are using a WOFF2 font file, replace the source line from the code above to contain the following information:

    src: url('XXXXXX.woff2') format('woff2');
    

1.  Copy the link address from your **Call to Action** button:
2.  Right-click your **Call to Action** button from your newly created **Assets page**.
3.  Then, copy the link address:

4.  Now that you have copied the font file use the appropriate code based on your font file type (.ttf, .eot, .woff2) and paste it into the code provided above.

**Note:** When you input the sample code below, replace FontName, FONTFILENAME, and the sample URL with the real name of your font file (examples: Arial, Helvetica, Garamond, etc.) and your real source URL.For example, if you have a .ttf file, add your font file link address within the parentheses to define your source address (‘FONTFILENAME.ttf’):

![Font Code Example](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/lKMXoaEC38-vIpmO/articles/images/07b928f8_4410145704475.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=lKMXoaEC38-vIpmO&q=85&s=f342bf51852316921c0121f977560fed)

**Note:** Ensure that your custom font displays on all web browsers with or without a custom domain connected to your site by removing the domain from the source url `src: url` in your code.By default, your link will include your Kajabi subdomain in the source url, but this may not accurately display your custom font if you have connected a custom domain to your site. Refer to the image above to create the correct custom code for your font.

5.  If your font file is an .eot file type, use the **EOT font format code**:

    src: url('FONTFILENAME.eot') format('embedded-opentype');
    

Similarly, if you are using a .woff2 font file, use the WOFF2 font format code:

    src: url('FONTFILENAME.woff2') format('woff2');
    

6.  After adding your font file’s link address to your custom font code, navigate back to the landing page where you want to add your custom font.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/add-custom-fonts#to-add-the-custom-code)

To add the custom code:

1.  In your page editor, open **Settings**.
2.  Click **Custom code**.
3.  Then, add your copied custom code containing your font file code into the CSS code field.
4.  Be sure to click **Save** to apply and view your custom font.
5.  After adding your font file to your Assets page, [preview the page](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/preview-your-page)
    .

![Custom Code Settings](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/YkB8kHzDqR38r-uz/articles/images/6413358a_17056156009627.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=YkB8kHzDqR38r-uz&q=85&s=f1d94edc21be456e6a232bb86a8c511c)

**Tip:** Want to add your custom font to multiple Heading tags? Locate the short form font size tags (e.g., H3) in your CSS code and add your desired Heading tags with commas to separate them.For example, if you want all of your Heading 1, 2, and 3s to display your custom font, your custom CSS would need to include H1, H2, and H3 in your code.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/add-custom-fonts#custom-font-for-the-entire-website)

Custom font for the entire website
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Create a consistent brand with your custom font by adding it to every new page created on your website. Use your **Site Settings** to apply code to your entire website. By using the custom font code created earlier, you can add it to your Settings rather than to an individual page.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/add-custom-fonts#then-add-your-custom-font-to-your-site-settings)

Then, add your custom font to your Site Settings:

1.  Open the **Settings** tab from your Dashboard.
2.  Click **Site Details**.
3.  Then, navigate to **Page Scripts**.
4.  In the Header Page Scripts field, add your custom font code
5.  Add **Style** tags to your code. First, the opening style tag `<style>` above your custom font code, and then the closing style tag `</style>` directly below your custom font code.

**Note:** When you input the sample code below, replace FontName and the sample URL with the real name of your font file (examples: Arial, Helvetica, Garamond, etc.) and your real source URL.For example:

    <style>
    
    @font-face {
      font-family: 'FontName';
      src: url('/resource_redirect/downloads/sites/135263/themes/2148980623/downloads/ea3IaDotWWurDhwu8x3Wd_cameliya.ttf') format('truetype');
    }
    h3 {
      font-family: 'FontName', sans-serif;
    }
    
    </style>
    

6.  Then, click **Save** to apply your custom font to new pages created on your site:

**Note:** If your existing pages do not contain your defined heading (in this case, our Heading 3 text), then the font will not load onto your page.Be sure to include the defined Heading tag for your custom font code in your website and landing pages to add your custom font to your pages:

If your custom font is not reflected in your page CTA buttons (.btn), form buttons (.form-btn), and footer, you will need to include the Body and Button font tags in your code. Your code should look similar to the following code:

    <style>
    
    @font-face {
      font-family: 'FontName';
      src: url('/resource_redirect/downloads/sites/135263/themes/2148980623/downloads/ea3IaDotWWurDhwu8x3Wd_cameliya.ttf') format('truetype');
    }
    body, p, ul, ol, a, .btn, .form-btn {
      font-family: 'FontName', sans-serif;
    }
    
    </style>
    

Be sure to replace FontName in the code sample above with your real font name and the `src: url` in the code with your font file URL. For this example, our source URL is the following:

    /resource_redirect/downloads/sites/135263/themes/2148980623/downloads/ea3IaDotWWurDhwu8x3Wd_cameliya.ttf

# Add a custom section - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-add-a-custom-section#content-area)

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-add-a-custom-section#what-is-a-custom-section)

What is a custom section?
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The Custom Section Category allows you to design a unique, one-of-a-kind Section from scratch. You can add a Custom Section to create a blank slate to pick and choose the Block Types you wish to display and/or add a Custom Code Section to enter custom code to a section of your page. Remember, each Preset Section can be customized to design a unique, one-of-a-kind section, but adding a Custom Section generates a blank Section to build Blocks into according to your vision.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-add-a-custom-section#adding-a-custom-section)

Adding a custom section

Design a Custom Section with various Block types to present and display your content:

*   Open the **Website** tab from your Dashboard
*   Select the **Pages** tab
*   Open the page editor for your Page. [Learn more](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-get-to-the-page-editor)
    
*   Navigate to the sidebar panel
*   Click **Add Section**
*   Select the **Custom Section** from the Custom category to Preview
*   Click **Add** to generate the Preset Section to your Page:

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-add-a-custom-section#customizing-the-preset-custom-sections)

Customizing the preset custom sections
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-add-a-custom-section#custom-section)

Custom section

Adding a Custom Section to your page generates an empty Section to add your desired Block Types:

*   After adding the Custom Section, navigate to the sidebar editor
*   Click **Add Content**
*   Select a [Block type](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/add-blocks-to-your-page#block-types)
     and begin customizing your section
*   Click **Save** to keep your changes:

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-add-a-custom-section#custom-code-section)

Custom code section

Creating a Custom Code Section generates a Custom Code Block to enter custom code or embed code onto your page. The Custom Code Section is a powerful tool for a variety of purposes, including:

*   Adding custom code (like [embedding a calendar](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-install-an-add-to-calendar-button-to-your-page)
     to your page) without requiring access to the Code Editor of your site
*   Creating blank spaces on your page to design beautiful, unique landing page layouts (check out the Iris Template below for an example):

![761B7D1B-8A54-4CFF-953F-4C1E5E18914D.png](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/EFdfkzsgcSmbPght/articles/images/c94d8d8c_17014809113243.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=EFdfkzsgcSmbPght&q=85&s=eb1abf29c69f18db0372dd4a5119bf1d) Test out the Custom Code Section to see how you can best use this Block to build custom code into your page with Kajabi Pages.

**Important:** Introducing custom code to your site can open you up to vulnerabilities and potential malware attacks. We recommend using vulnerability tools like [VirusTotal](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/home/url)
 or [Snyk](https://snyk.io/)
 to scan any custom code that you intend to use and apply certain [best practices](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/code-based-customizations)
 to help reduce potential impact.

Learn to add and customize [Custom Code Blocks](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/add-custom-code-to-pages)
 for more details.

# Why does the login page or 404 error keep appearing when editing my site? - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/why-does-the-login-page-or-404-error-keep-appearing-when-editing-my-site#content-area)

If you are experiencing issues customizing the template for your Website and Product Pages because your site Login Page is displayed, or seeing a 404 page not found error image when customizing draft pages, your browser may be blocking Kajabi’s cookies to allow you to access the editor. Learn to enable Kajabi’s cookies to customize your page.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/why-does-the-login-page-or-404-error-keep-appearing-when-editing-my-site#why-does-this-happen)

Why does this happen?
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The Login Page may appear when attempting to customize your Website Pages or Product Pages if your web browser is set to block third-party cookies. Are you seeing a 404-page not found error when customizing a Website or Product Page? This error appears when a page’s visibility is set to **draft**, and not published, while your web browser is set to block third-party cookies. Learn more about page visibility settings [here](https://kajabi.zendesk.com/Default%20Visibility%20for%20a%20New%20Page)
. If you are experiencing either of these issues, you may have cookie blockers, plugins, or extensions blocking Kajabi’s cookies. Resume customizing your Website Page or Product Page by enabling third-party cookies on your web browser or clearing your web browser’s cache and cookies from the web browser settings. In this guide, you will find instructions for how to enable cookies for a few of the most popular web browsers. If you are using another web browser, check its support site for instructions on enabling cookies or clearing cache and cookies.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/why-does-the-login-page-or-404-error-keep-appearing-when-editing-my-site#login-displayed-when-attempting-to-customize-a-product-page)

Login displayed when attempting to customize a Product Page:

![Login displayed when customizing](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/2rWeSU56xHYQYbo0/articles/images/bfe272d5_41920280147867.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=2rWeSU56xHYQYbo0&q=85&s=8bc5206e5b5014877dbb911226e215e4)

**Note:**Entering valid credentials into the displayed log in will not fix the issue you may be experiencing. Instead, you will see an error message stating “the change you wanted was rejected.” If you are experiencing these issues, enable third-party cookies on your web browser or clear your browser’s cache and cookies to continue customizing your page.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/why-does-the-login-page-or-404-error-keep-appearing-when-editing-my-site#chrome)

Chrome
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/why-does-the-login-page-or-404-error-keep-appearing-when-editing-my-site#enable-third-party-cookies)

Enable third-party cookies

*   On your computer, open **Chrome**.
*   In the top right, click the More icon (the three vertically-aligned dots).
*   Then, click **Settings**.
*   Click **Privacy and Security** from the left sidebar.
*   Scroll down and open **Third-party cookies**.
*   Then, select **Block third-party cookies in Incognito Mode**:

![Chrome cookie settings](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/yV8YCdKpqAWaoiWT/articles/images/7f06c3da_30922818385563.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=yV8YCdKpqAWaoiWT&q=85&s=4c2c5775392801dd78db28cc2f399297) Read [Google’s Support Guide](https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/32050?co=GENIE.Platform%3DDesktop&hl=enIn)
 to clear cache and cookies.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/why-does-the-login-page-or-404-error-keep-appearing-when-editing-my-site#safari)

Safari
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/why-does-the-login-page-or-404-error-keep-appearing-when-editing-my-site#enable-website-tracking-and-cookies)

Enable website tracking and cookies

*   On your computer, open **Safari**.
*   Click the **Safari** drop-down menu then open **Preferences**.
*   Click **Privacy** from the top menu.
*   Uncheck both:
    *   **Website tracking**
    *   **Cookies and website data**

![Safari privacy settings](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/ADlD5UQgkduQhvui/articles/images/ad469da5_360064622814.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=ADlD5UQgkduQhvui&q=85&s=4b4719170a34e82e3f674925410eb6fd) Read [Apple’s Support Guide](https://support.apple.com/guide/safari/clear-your-browsing-history-sfri47acf5d6/mac)
 to clear history, cache, and cookies.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/why-does-the-login-page-or-404-error-keep-appearing-when-editing-my-site#additional-popular-web-browsers)

Additional popular web browsers

Using a browser not listed above?

# Add custom code to pages - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/add-custom-code-to-pages#content-area)

Add **custom code** to a single page or all pages on your website. If you want to edit the underlying code of your pages, see [Access the Code Editor](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-access-the-code-editor)
.

**Important:** Be careful when adding custom code to your site. If you’re adding code from a third-party, make sure you trust them - their custom code might surface negative consequences.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/add-custom-code-to-pages#add-custom-code-to-a-single-page)

Add custom code to a single page
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/add-custom-code-to-pages#page-settings)

Page settings

1.  Under **Website**, navigate to the website or landing page you want to edit.
2.  Next to the page, click the **Customize** button.
3.  In the page builder, click the **Settings** tab. ![Custom Code1](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/-nMQfkmFkYSVaJMU/images/Custom-Code1.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=-nMQfkmFkYSVaJMU&q=85&s=0ebe9bc04847c43e2032c915831b2b11)
4.  Click the **Custom Code** section.
5.  Add your **Custom CSS** or **Custom JavaScript** in the panel. ![Custom Code2](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/-nMQfkmFkYSVaJMU/images/Custom-Code2.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=-nMQfkmFkYSVaJMU&q=85&s=470a17e02b3d8fc8019dda2fc695056b)
6.  Click **Save**.

**Note:** Do not include **`<style>`** or **`<script>`** tags in the **Custom CSS** or **Custom JavaScript** sections within page **Settings**.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/add-custom-code-to-pages#custom-code-block)

Custom code block

Adding custom code in a block can be helpful for embedding content on your page, such as a calendar booking widget.

1.  From the Dashboard, open **Website**.
2.  Locate the **Website Page** or **Landing Page** you want to edit and click the **Page Title**.
3.  In the page builder, open a **Section**.
4.  Click **Add block**. ![Add Block](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/-nMQfkmFkYSVaJMU/images/add-block.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=-nMQfkmFkYSVaJMU&q=85&s=b694a5eec4327db57acf37693760e920)
5.  Click **Custom Code**. ![Add Block2](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/-nMQfkmFkYSVaJMU/images/add-block2.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=-nMQfkmFkYSVaJMU&q=85&s=affedbcf9db31e3f91337fb0b65453c7)
6.  Add your custom CSS or Javascript in the **Code** field.
7.  Add additional settings for the block’s **Background** and **Layout**, as well as any **Animations** and **Time reveal** settings.
8.  Click **Save**.

**Note:** In a **Custom Code Block,** you’ll need to use `<style>` (for CSS) and `<script>` (for JavaScript) tags in order for your custom code to work.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/add-custom-code-to-pages#add-custom-code-to-all-pages)

Add custom code to all pages
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Adding custom code to all pages can be helpful, such as [adding a cookie disclaimer](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/cookies-and-cookie-disclaimers)
, custom fonts, analytics, or more to your website.

1.  From the Dashboard, open **Settings.**
2.  Under **Site settings**, click [**Site details**](https://app.kajabi.com/admin/last_site/edit/site-details)
    .
3.  Under **Page scripts**, enter your custom code in the **Header Page Scripts** field.
4.  Click **Save**.

**Note:** Custom code added to the Header Page Scripts field will be included in the `<head>` tag of every page on your website, except Offer checkout pages and upsell pages. To add tracking code to checkout pages, see [Add a JavaScript tracking code to checkout pages](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/checkout/how-to-add-a-javascript-tracking-code-to-your-checkout-pages)
.

# Increase engagement and sales with email strategies - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/3-effective-email-strategies-to-increase-engagement-and-boost-sales-in-kajabi#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/3-effective-email-strategies-to-increase-engagement-and-boost-sales-in-kajabi#overview)

Overview
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Building an effective email campaign is essential for thriving in online business. Email campaigns nurture, inspire, and ultimately convert leads into customers. These three strategies help you create campaigns that drive engagement and sales.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/3-effective-email-strategies-to-increase-engagement-and-boost-sales-in-kajabi#method-1-create-a-guided-journey)

Method 1: Create a guided journey
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A guided journey takes leads from initial interaction—like a landing page opt-in or social media post—through a structured path that builds anticipation for future emails and next steps. With this method, leads sign up for free training or a free challenge, and your email sequence delivers content that follows a specific path. This creates structure for engaging your entire campaign.

**Tip:** While delivering your guided journey campaign, add small teasers to your offers and previews of your programs. This approach converts leads into sales naturally.

A great example is the [Product Launch Funnel](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/marketing/funnels/funnel-templates)
, which takes potential customers from opt-in through a value-add journey leading to your offering. ![Product Launch Funnel](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/CM-okGX-0K4XYDbT/articles/images/5bbab409_31493669960091.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=CM-okGX-0K4XYDbT&q=85&s=40f48a26a7352ea147f3a116946f960f)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/3-effective-email-strategies-to-increase-engagement-and-boost-sales-in-kajabi#method-2-welcome-sequence)

Method 2: Welcome sequence
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The welcome sequence works when someone opts in as a subscriber, purchases an introductory offer, or joins your list in any way. Its purpose is to build a relationship with prospects and establish trust while gently exposing them to your offerings. ![Welcome sequence example](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/iolg5aP2bSMt_GJt/articles/images/4a82e66a_31981196201371.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=iolg5aP2bSMt_GJt&q=85&s=d4c3bb4f7d9d293894ff55a11fae4f45)

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/3-effective-email-strategies-to-increase-engagement-and-boost-sales-in-kajabi#trigger-and-craft-a-welcome-sequence)

Trigger and craft a welcome sequence

Trigger your welcome sequence by setting up an automation in [Forms](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/marketing/forms/create-and-build-your-form)
 or [Offers](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/offers-overview)
. A well-crafted welcome sequence nurtures relationships, builds trust, and drives action. Here’s a strategic breakdown:

1.  **Email 1: Welcome + Reintroduce the Offer** — Welcome your subscriber or customer. Reintroduce the offer they opted into and highlight your value proposition—what makes your solution unique and why it matters.
2.  **Email 2: Share Your Brand Mission and Story** (Sent 24 hours later) — Build a personal connection by sharing your mission and story. Show your “why” and let your audience know what drives you.
3.  **Email 3: Showcase Social Proof** — Reinforce trust by sharing customer success stories, testimonials, or other proof. Demonstrate real-world results and the impact of your product.
4.  **Email 4: Address Their Pain Points** — Focus on challenges your audience faces. Provide a clear product breakdown and explain how your offer solves their specific problems.
5.  **Email 5: Add Value with Data and Insights** — Build credibility by sharing data, research, or educational content. Link to a relevant blog post or resource that supports your solution.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/3-effective-email-strategies-to-increase-engagement-and-boost-sales-in-kajabi#method-3-newsletter)

Method 3: Newsletter
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Make your newsletter memorable by giving it a unique title. Instead of “XYZ Newsletter,” try something engaging like **“Weekly Wisdom”** or **“Tips and Tricks for \[Your Niche\].”** A well-named newsletter sets the tone and communicates value from the inbox.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/3-effective-email-strategies-to-increase-engagement-and-boost-sales-in-kajabi#launch-a-successful-newsletter-subscription)

Launch a successful newsletter subscription

Ready to add a newsletter to your business? Learn the key steps to launching a successful newsletter subscription. [Read more](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/newsletters/how-to-launch-a-successful-newsletter-subscription)
 ![Newsletter products](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/jr10YKvFYk7-UzP1/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-9-new-product-newsletter-1782636379772-1784151873015.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=jr10YKvFYk7-UzP1&q=85&s=3062a6710c4f07771fa3e59c902bef6b)

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/3-effective-email-strategies-to-increase-engagement-and-boost-sales-in-kajabi#best-practices-for-an-effective-newsletter)

Best practices for an effective newsletter

*   **Re-use emails and make seasonal content** — Recycle content from past campaigns or blog posts, especially evergreen pieces. Tailor content to fit current seasons or trends. A fitness brand could repurpose workout tips into a “New Year, New You” theme for January.
*   **Use AI to produce email content** — Leverage AI tools to brainstorm ideas, craft subject lines, or write first drafts. AI helps maintain consistency and saves time. Always add your personal touch to keep content authentic.
*   **Keep it useful, educational, entertaining, and relevant** — Your audience opens your newsletter because they expect value. Include how-to guides, industry news, or stories related to your niche. Make every piece actionable, informative, or enjoyable.
*   **Use simple formatting with a consistent look and feel** — Visual consistency reinforces brand recognition. Choose a clean layout with white space for easy reading. Stick to consistent colors, fonts, and logo placement.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/3-effective-email-strategies-to-increase-engagement-and-boost-sales-in-kajabi#build-meaningful-connections)

Build meaningful connections
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Effective email campaigns create meaningful connections, deliver value, and guide your audience toward action. Whether you’re nurturing leads through a value-packed journey, building trust with a warm welcome, or maintaining relationships through newsletters, your efforts translate into lasting customer relationships and increased conversions. Stay relevant, authentic, and customer-focused. Take these strategies, adapt them to your unique brand and audience, and start building email campaigns that truly resonate.

Was this page helpful?

YesNo

# Brainstorm a product - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/brainstorm-your-product#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/brainstorm-your-product#overview)

Overview
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This is where you start serving your niche and deciding what to offer. A “product” in this context means the item you’re offering customers in exchange for money. These steps help you position your expertise into a product your audience will find valuable.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/brainstorm-your-product#step-1-define-the-product-benefit)

Step 1: Define the product benefit
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The goal of a product is simple—answer one question: “What is the fastest and most likely way to provide the desired outcome for your customer, getting them from their current state to their desired state?” Here’s an example: **How to run a marathon** — What’s the fastest and most effective method to improve someone’s ability to prepare for, compete in, and finish a marathon?

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/brainstorm-your-product#step-2-determine-product-scope)

Step 2: Determine product scope
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

That marathon idea can be built into multiple, more specific products: **How to run your first marathon**

*   Helps someone who’s never run a marathon
*   Likely a larger course with multiple parts

**How to improve your marathon time by 30 minutes, guaranteed**

*   Targets current runners or marathon runners wanting to improve
*   Likely a larger course with multiple parts

**Ten stretching exercises every marathon runner needs to prevent injury**

*   Helps new or existing runners
*   Could be a free lead magnet or low-price download

**30 must-eat meals for marathon runners to have boundless energy**

*   Helps new or existing runners
*   Could be a small-price PDF cookbook, medium-price product with cooking technique videos, or premium-price product with videos plus a custom nutrition strategy session

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/brainstorm-your-product#step-3-structure-the-product)

Step 3: Structure the product
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Your product structure is only limited by creativity, but here are four common approaches:

1.  **Digital Download** — A single tactic or outcome
2.  **Online Course** — Bigger outcome with multiple parts to achieve it
3.  **Coaching/Consulting** — Combination of course content with personal interaction and customization
4.  **Subscription/Membership** — Courses or downloads offered on a regular basis (e.g., monthly)

When starting out, choose one structure you like most and begin building where you feel most comfortable. Some people prefer higher price points and coaching/consulting products because they enjoy the interaction and it serves their niche best. How do you know if it’s best for your niche? Ask yourself: Is it the fastest and most likely path to deliver them from their current state to their desired state? In Kajabi, you can create many product types for different niches. But the key to getting going is getting started—and that takes focus.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/brainstorm-your-product#brainstorming-questions)

Brainstorming questions
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Use these questions to spark ideas about what you can offer your market:

*   What have you bought in your niche where you thought, “I can do this better”?
*   When have you felt frustrated or lost because you couldn’t find the answers you needed to achieve an outcome?
*   What are the common questions you get about your area of knowledge, experience, or passion? (e.g., what exercises should I do to lose weight)
*   What questions do you wish people were asking so they’d get better results? (e.g., how can I change my diet to lose weight whether I exercise or not?)
*   What transformation are most people in your niche seeking? For example:
    *   Weight loss
    *   More energy
    *   Faster Pinewood Derby car times
    *   Better tennis forehand
    *   Living without lower back pain
    *   Bigger arms or six-pack abs
    *   Eating vegan and knowing how to cook vegan
    *   Feeling confident giving a toast in front of strangers

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/brainstorm-your-product#final-checklist-and-next-steps)

Final checklist and next steps
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Now that you’ve identified:

*   The current state of your market
*   The desired state you’re going to get them to
*   The breadth of product needed to help them achieve it
*   The format you feel best delivering it in

You’re ready to start building.

# Choose a niche - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/choosing-your-niche#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/choosing-your-niche#overview)

Overview
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Your niche is the specific group of people you’re going to serve. It’s the foundation for everything else in your business. Identifying and selecting this group is your first step. Don’t overthink this as a permanent decision. You may serve many kinds of markets over the life of your business—today’s goal is to choose your first niche.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/choosing-your-niche#start-with-an-exercise)

Start with an exercise
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

For each question below, make a list of potential niches. Write down as many as you can—the descriptions and ideas are meant to spark your creativity.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/choosing-your-niche#identify-knowledge-and-life-experience)

Identify knowledge and life experience
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/choosing-your-niche#career)

Career

Your career likely represents a significant portion of your life, and you’re probably an expert at what you do. You’ve found ways to achieve results faster and help others do things better with less stress. There’s opportunity to re-engineer your work experience into knowledge people would gladly purchase.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/choosing-your-niche#education)

Education

Look back at your time in school. Were there subjects that excited you but fell to the wayside as you jumped into your career? Were there areas of education that shaped your career path and could be reawakened to serve a niche?

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/choosing-your-niche#experience)

Experience

Which experiences stand out as potential niches you could be passionate about? Do friends and family ask you for insights and wisdom in certain areas? Did experiences like traveling, brewing craft beers, fishing, or hiking awaken intense interest? An often overlooked area is when things went wrong. Did you face tremendous challenges or hardships that gave you insights you wish you’d had earlier? Can you turn those low points into resources for others experiencing the same challenges?

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/choosing-your-niche#identify-passions-and-interests)

Identify passions and interests
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/choosing-your-niche#hobbies)

Hobbies

Hobbies are a treasure trove of niche ideas—and you’ve already got the passion built in. Whether it’s pinewood derby racing techniques, cookie recipes, fitness, or sports, countless areas can build a great niche. You likely already know where fellow hobbyists hang out and what they’re willing to buy.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/choosing-your-niche#side-jobs-or-projects)

Side-jobs or projects

Think about projects you pursue with a profit motive—developing software in the evening, woodworking and selling creations on Etsy, or similar endeavors. These could become the foundation for your niche.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/choosing-your-niche#choose-passion-over-perceived-profit)

Choose passion over perceived profit
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Whether you choose your niche based on life experience or an area of interest, successful people share one thing in common: they’re excited about what they’re building. It may seem smart to choose a niche you see as lucrative, even without genuine interest—like weight loss or making money online because others have found success there. But your excitement over your niche is the ultimate advantage. It’s what keeps you going through the tough days of building an online business.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/choosing-your-niche#get-help-choosing-a-niche)

Get help choosing a niche
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

If you’re struggling to find a niche or have too many ideas to choose from, join the [Kajabi Mastermind group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/newkajabi)
 on Facebook. Over 6,000 active Kajabi users are there to support each other in selecting niches and building businesses. Once you pick your niche, the fun is just beginning.

# Copy snippets to captivate an audience - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/copy-snippets-to-captivate-your-audience-in-seconds#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/copy-snippets-to-captivate-your-audience-in-seconds#overview)

Overview
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Effective copy connects with your audience by showing them you understand their needs. These snippets provide a starting point for key sections of your website and sales pages. Copy and customize them to fit your style and voice. Good copy isn’t just about selling—it’s about making your audience feel understood and showing them what’s possible.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/copy-snippets-to-captivate-your-audience-in-seconds#hero-section-homepage)

Hero section: Homepage
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Your homepage hero section creates the first impression. Visitors should understand what you do and why it matters within 5 seconds.

*   **Headline:** I help \[Your Avatar\] achieve \[Outcome/Benefit\] with \[Your Service\].
*   **Subheadline:** Whether you’re \[Situation/Challenge\], I provide \[Service/Solution\] to help you \[Result\]

![Hero section homepage](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/bZNMdsaL_lttmKcY/articles/images/7faf2b5e_missing_image_8-20-18.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=bZNMdsaL_lttmKcY&q=85&s=18d520d45c94d9e955755abbbd26ccee)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/copy-snippets-to-captivate-your-audience-in-seconds#about-me-section)

About me section
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The About Me section shows you’re human and builds trust. Use this template whether it’s a standalone page or part of your sales page: Hi, meet me \[Your Name\], and \[your area of expertise\] really makes me love my work. That is why I started \[company name\]. Seeing \[Your Avatar\] \[achieve a benefit\] through \[your approach\] makes me do a happy dance. But I’ll be honest—it did not happen overnight. A few years back, I was… \[tell your story\] But then, I stumbled upon \[specific method/or mentor etc\], and let me tell you—it was like flipping a switch. Suddenly, things started to click, and I couldn’t believe how much easier life became once I had this \[method/trick/approach\] in my corner. That was the moment I poured my heart into refining this process and helping others find their groove and help them from \[where they are now\] to \[where they want to be\] Here’s a little something extra about me: I’m a sucker for \[hobby\]. My happy place? Definitely \[favorite travel destination\]. When I’m not working, you’ll likely find me \[activity you enjoy\]. ![About section](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/bZNMdsaL_lttmKcY/articles/images/7faf2b5e_missing_image_8-20-18.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=bZNMdsaL_lttmKcY&q=85&s=18d520d45c94d9e955755abbbd26ccee)

**Tip:** Adding personal, fun touches to your communication builds rapport with your audience. Mentioning hobbies or interests often becomes a conversation starter during calls.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/copy-snippets-to-captivate-your-audience-in-seconds#hero-section-sales-page)

Hero section: Sales page
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Your sales page hero section hooks your audience. You have just 5 seconds to capture attention and make an impact.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/copy-snippets-to-captivate-your-audience-in-seconds#headline-options)

Headline options

*   Tired of \[Common Problem\]? Let’s turn that frown upside down with \[Solution/Benefit\].
*   Want to \[Reach a Specific Goal\] without feeling like you’re pulling teeth?
*   Ready to \[Achieve an Outcome\] but feeling like you’re spinning your wheels?

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/copy-snippets-to-captivate-your-audience-in-seconds#short-trigger-description)

Short trigger description

Discover how \[Your Avatar\] can \[Benefit or Learn Something Valuable\] with \[Brief Description of Solution\]. Whether you’re \[Starting Out/Experienced\], you’ll find the roadmap to \[Achieve a Specific Outcome\] right here. This approach focuses on the reader’s emotions and benefits, laying the groundwork for trust and connection. ![Sales page hero](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/bZNMdsaL_lttmKcY/articles/images/7faf2b5e_missing_image_8-20-18.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=bZNMdsaL_lttmKcY&q=85&s=18d520d45c94d9e955755abbbd26ccee)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/copy-snippets-to-captivate-your-audience-in-seconds#benefit-section)

Benefit section
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Before introducing your product, paint a picture of the life your audience dreams about. An “Imagine If” section works well right before your pitch.

**Note:** Focus on emotions here—no course selling yet.

Imagine if you could finally \[e.g., “kick your financial stress to the curb”\]. Picture yourself mastering \[skill\] that lets you \[positive outcome\] with ease, giving you more \[benefit\]. Think about the confidence you’d gain to \[specific action\], allowing you to focus on what truly lights your fire. Imagine the relief of starting each day with a clear \[your solution\], knowing you’re the captain of your own ship when it comes to \[area of life\]. Picture the success rolling in as you hit your goals with \[less effort/more satisfaction\]. Envision a future where you feel \[emotion\], empowered to \[specific outcome\] without breaking a sweat.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/copy-snippets-to-captivate-your-audience-in-seconds#introduce-your-course)

Introduce your course
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

When introducing your course, keep copy short and direct: **Introducing: NAME COURSE** The X step course where you will learn X and achieve Y. With this course, you will not only learn how to \[the solution you offer\] but you will have lifetime access and finally feel \[Desired outcome\] By the end of \[COURSE NAME\], you’ll know how to \[use a bullet point list of things they normally struggle with and now finally know how to change\]

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/copy-snippets-to-captivate-your-audience-in-seconds#before-writing)

Before writing
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

These snippets are starting points for your homepage or sales page. Your page will need additional copy, but these templates help you write content that converts. Make it fun. Let your personality shine through, keep it real, and show your audience why you’re the breath of fresh air they’ve been searching for. Now go grab another coffee and start drafting your copy.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/copy-snippets-to-captivate-your-audience-in-seconds#about-the-author)

About the author
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Stephanie is a course marketing expert with a strong focus on creating effective marketing copy. With a background in the arts and a marketing degree from the University of Applied Sciences in Amsterdam, she combines creativity with strategy to craft content that connects with audiences. # Build an automated sales funnel for course sales - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/how-to-build-an-automated-sales-funnel-to-increase-your-course-sales-on-kajabi#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/how-to-build-an-automated-sales-funnel-to-increase-your-course-sales-on-kajabi#overview)

Overview
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

By Brandon Trentalange, [Millennial Marketer](https://www.millennialmktr.com/)
 Creating an online course is no small feat. If you’ve successfully built and uploaded your course to Kajabi, you’ve already tackled one of the most challenging parts of the process. But building a course is just the beginning. To achieve consistent sales, you need an effective, automated system that works tirelessly in the background—even when you’re not. That’s where a sales funnel comes in. The following steps cover building an automated sales funnel tailored for Kajabi course creators. Whether you’re just starting or optimizing an existing funnel, these practical strategies help increase sales and streamline your business.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/how-to-build-an-automated-sales-funnel-to-increase-your-course-sales-on-kajabi#what-is-a-sales-funnel-and-why-do-you-need-one)

What is a sales funnel, and why do you need one?
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A sales funnel is a structured journey that guides potential customers from discovery to purchase. Imagine having a system that nurtures leads, builds trust, and converts browsers into buyers—without needing you to be involved at every step. That’s the power of an automated sales funnel. Not only does it free up your time, but it also ensures your sales process is consistent and scalable.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/how-to-build-an-automated-sales-funnel-to-increase-your-course-sales-on-kajabi#step-1-choose-the-right-value-vehicle)

Step 1: Choose the right value vehicle
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Every successful sales funnel starts with an irresistible _value vehicle_. This is the free content or resource you offer in exchange for a prospect’s email address, serving as the entry point to your funnel. Think of it as your opening handshake—a way to show your audience you understand their challenges and can provide solutions.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/how-to-build-an-automated-sales-funnel-to-increase-your-course-sales-on-kajabi#popular-options-for-kajabi-course-creators)

Popular options for Kajabi course creators

1.  [**Ebook**](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-sell-an-ebook)
    : Use Kajabi’s intuitive landing pages to offer a downloadable PDF packed with actionable insights or a preview of your course material.
2.  [**Webinar**](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/marketing/funnels/how-to-set-up-a-zoom-webinar-funnel)
    : Host a pre-recorded training session on Kajabi. A well-crafted webinar builds trust and positions you as an authority.
3.  [**Free mini-course**](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/courses/courses-overview)
    : A bite-sized version of your course is a great way to showcase the transformation you can deliver.

**Tip:** Your value vehicle should solve a specific problem that’s relevant to your audience while hinting at the more comprehensive solutions found in your paid course.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/how-to-build-an-automated-sales-funnel-to-increase-your-course-sales-on-kajabi#step-2-build-funnel-pages-in-kajabi)

Step 2: Build funnel pages in Kajabi
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Kajabi provides everything you need to build and connect each page of your funnel. Let’s break down the key pages:

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/how-to-build-an-automated-sales-funnel-to-increase-your-course-sales-on-kajabi#1-opt-in-page)

1\. Opt-in page

**Purpose:** Capture your audience’s email addresses in exchange for your value vehicle. **Best practices:**

*   Use a Kajabi Landing Page and a Form to capture your lead
*   Set up the form to go to their next step—either a webinar watch room or thank you page that tells them how they will receive their freebie
*   Use a compelling headline that highlights the benefits (e.g., _“Get My Free Guide to Building a Profitable Online Course”_)
*   Include a simple, eye-catching form
*   Add a clear and enticing call-to-action (CTA)

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/how-to-build-an-automated-sales-funnel-to-increase-your-course-sales-on-kajabi#2-freebie-delivery)

2\. Freebie delivery

**Purpose:** Fulfill the promise made on the opt-in page and encourage further engagement. **Best practices for webinars:**

*   Add your webinar to a Kajabi landing page so your audience can watch your pre-recorded training
*   Include a CTA button below the video for those who would like to take the next step in enrolling in your course

**Best practice for other freebies:**

*   Use a Kajabi Landing Page to create a custom thank you page that tells your lead to check their email to receive their freebie
*   Include contact information or a way for them to engage further with you on the page

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/how-to-build-an-automated-sales-funnel-to-increase-your-course-sales-on-kajabi#3-sales-page)

3\. Sales page

**Purpose:** Convert leads into paying customers by showcasing your course. **Best practices:**

*   Use a Kajabi landing page and focus on only selling 1 offer on the page
*   Focus on the transformation your course provides
*   Use testimonials and case studies to build credibility
*   Address objections with FAQs, guarantees, or bonuses
*   Add CTA buttons throughout the page so your leads can purchase as soon as they make a decision

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/how-to-build-an-automated-sales-funnel-to-increase-your-course-sales-on-kajabi#4-checkout-page)

4\. Checkout page

**Purpose:** Simplify the purchasing process. **Best practices:**

*   Display a clear summary of the offer
*   Include multiple payment options
*   Offer a satisfaction guarantee to reduce risk for buyers

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/how-to-build-an-automated-sales-funnel-to-increase-your-course-sales-on-kajabi#step-3-automate-nurturing-with-email-campaigns)

Step 3: Automate nurturing with email campaigns
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Not everyone will buy immediately, which is why follow-up is critical. Kajabi’s built-in email marketing tools allow you to automate nurturing sequences that keep your leads engaged and interested. Make sure to create this using an email sequence. Your subscribe trigger is the completion of the form on your opt-in page and the unsubscribe trigger is the purchase of your offer.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/how-to-build-an-automated-sales-funnel-to-increase-your-course-sales-on-kajabi#example-14-day-email-sequence)

Example 14-day email sequence

*   **Day 1:** Deliver the promised freebie with a warm introduction.
*   **Day 3:** Share a helpful tip or story related to their pain point.
*   **Day 5:** Highlight testimonials from successful students.
*   **Day 7:** Offer a bonus, like an additional resource or checklist.
*   **Day 10:** Create urgency with a limited-time offer or discount.
*   **Day 14:** Make a final, compelling pitch, emphasizing the transformation they’ll experience.

**Tip:** Use Kajabi’s analytics to monitor open rates and tweak your sequence as needed.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/how-to-build-an-automated-sales-funnel-to-increase-your-course-sales-on-kajabi#step-4-drive-traffic-to-the-funnel)

Step 4: Drive traffic to the funnel
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Without traffic, even the most well-designed funnel will fail. The goal is to attract your ideal audience and direct them to the top of your funnel. This means reaching the people who are most likely to benefit from your course.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/how-to-build-an-automated-sales-funnel-to-increase-your-course-sales-on-kajabi#effective-traffic-sources-for-course-creators)

Effective traffic sources for course creators

*   **Social media:** Platforms like Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube are excellent for sharing educational and engaging content that links to your Kajabi opt-in page.
*   **Partnerships & affiliates:** Collaborate with influencers or other course creators in your niche. Kajabi’s affiliate tracking makes this seamless.
*   **Paid advertising:** Running targeted ads on Facebook, Google, or YouTube can help you generate traffic quickly. Start small, test your messaging, and scale your budget once you identify what works.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/how-to-build-an-automated-sales-funnel-to-increase-your-course-sales-on-kajabi#step-5-optimize-the-funnel-with-analytics)

Step 5: Optimize the funnel with analytics
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Your first funnel likely won’t be perfect, and that’s okay. [Kajabi’s analytics tools](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/analytics/analytics-overview)
 provide valuable insights into what’s working and where you can improve.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/how-to-build-an-automated-sales-funnel-to-increase-your-course-sales-on-kajabi#key-metrics-to-track)

Key metrics to track

*   **Opt-in rate:** If this is low, test new headlines, images, or CTAs on your opt-in page.
*   **Engagement:** Monitor how much of your webinar or video content people are watching.
*   **Conversion rate:** Analyze your sales page and offer to see what might be causing hesitation.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/how-to-build-an-automated-sales-funnel-to-increase-your-course-sales-on-kajabi#the-benefits-of-an-automated-funnel)

The benefits of an automated funnel
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

An automated sales funnel doesn’t just save time—it transforms your business. With a system running 24/7, you can focus on creating new courses, serving your students, or even taking a well-earned break.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/how-to-build-an-automated-sales-funnel-to-increase-your-course-sales-on-kajabi#what-becomes-possible)

What becomes possible

*   Waking up to new sales notifications
*   Spending more time on creative projects
*   Watching your business grow without constant hustle

Building an automated sales funnel in Kajabi is one of the smartest moves you can make as a course creator. By focusing on value, nurturing leads, and leveraging Kajabi’s powerful tools, you can create a sales system that works for you. Start small, stay consistent, and refine as you go—you’ll soon have a funnel that generates consistent, scalable income while you focus on what you love most: teaching and transforming lives.

Was this page helpful?

YesNo

⌘I

# Create a profitable Kajabi sales page - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/how-to-create-a-profitable-kajabi-sales-page#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/how-to-create-a-profitable-kajabi-sales-page#overview)

Overview
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Crafting a high-converting sales page starts with one crucial step: nailing the persuasive sales copy. The essentials of creating an outline for your sales page that not only engages your audience but also compels them to take the next step are covered below.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/how-to-create-a-profitable-kajabi-sales-page#step-1-create-an-outline-with-persuasive-sales-copy)

Step 1: Create an outline with persuasive sales copy
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

One of the most important components of your sales page is your sales page copy. If you’re unfamiliar with the term “copy”, it refers to the text on your sales page including your headlines and body text. Your sales page copy should include the following:

*   **Compelling headings** that are scannable and will stop people in their tracks
*   **The “why”** — the reason they need what you’re selling based on their pain points or desires
*   **The “what”** — this includes the duration of the offer, downloads, etc
*   **Social proof** like testimonials, case studies, or success stories
*   **A little about you** including your story, experience, or qualifications
*   **Enticing offer(s)** with a clear outline of what’s included and what they’ll receive
*   **Incentives or scarcity** including upgrade bonuses, “fast-action bonuses”, or limited-time discounts with a countdown timer (optional)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/how-to-create-a-profitable-kajabi-sales-page#step-2-present-clear-valuable-offers)

Step 2: Present clear, valuable offers
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/how-to-create-a-profitable-kajabi-sales-page#minimize-the-number-of-offers)

Minimize the number of offers

Have you ever heard the saying, “if you give them too many choices, they’ll often choose nothing”? Having too many choices can often lead to customer confusion or they may fear making the wrong choice. In either case, they may abandon your sales page or your checkout altogether. Here’s how to reduce option overwhelm:

*   **Consider how you can eliminate unnecessary choices or options.** This can be by combining offers or offering some things as bonuses with a purchase. Not everything has to be its own offer.
*   **Provide a default or suggested option that makes it easy for them to choose.** For example, use a “most popular” badge on pricing tiers to encourage easy decision-making. Use the Kajabi Pop-Up Checkout with easy payment options. Adding unnecessary pages or making checkout difficult can slow their checkout and reduce conversions.
*   **Offer value-added bonuses.** Along with your irresistible product or service offer, consider offering added value with bonuses, potentially for a limited time or a limited quantity. A value-add encourages visitors to purchase or upgrade to a higher tier.

**Examples of value-added bonuses include:** _A free or discounted download or digital product_ _A live private or group coaching call_ _A physical gift sent in the mail_ _Access to a private community_ [Learn how to set a limit on your available bonus offers](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-set-an-offer-quantity-limit)
.

**Tip:** Consider duplicating your sales page and adapting the content based on the traffic source. For example, a sales page for social media promotions versus a sales page used for your appearances, like speaking at conferences or as a guest on podcasts, may have different messaging or promotional offers.

![Sales page example](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/uLQkDauIHZty6r-X/articles/images/e7c0d0d2_42471087288475.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=uLQkDauIHZty6r-X&q=85&s=ced3dbfaf50197b581b76a624cc1bbeb)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/how-to-create-a-profitable-kajabi-sales-page#step-3-choose-a-sales-page-template-or-start-designing-from-scratch)

Step 3: Choose a sales page template or start designing from scratch
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

You can find free Kajabi Sales Page templates to get you started by:

*   Navigate to your Kajabi Dashboard
*   Select **Website** from the left-hand menu
*   Select **Landing Pages**
*   Click the **New Landing Page** button

Alternatively, you have the option of purchasing an Expert-designed Kajabi Sales Page Template from the [Templates Store](https://templates.kajabi.com/)
.

**Tip:** If you get stuck on the design, consider hiring a Kajabi Expert from the [Experts Marketplace](http://experts.kajabi.com/)
. Experts can help you create professionally designed sales pages as well as provide best practices to potentially increase sales conversions.

**Things you may want to avoid on your sales page:**

*   Difficult to read fonts or small font sizes
*   Unnatural stock photography
*   Colors that are too bright or too muted, making it difficult to read or view
*   Too many offers or unclear offers
*   The ability for visitors to click a link or button that navigates them away from your page

**Tip:** Simplify your website and sales page to reduce friction. If your end goal is to get them to purchase your product or service, don’t send them to a free download, subscribe to your newsletter, follow you on social media, or read a blog post. Make their path clear and straightforward.

![Sales page design](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/YkB8kHzDqR38r-uz/articles/images/66315983_28933022794907.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=YkB8kHzDqR38r-uz&q=85&s=9b14a72b9a8edd905b513e0428cb38aa)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/how-to-create-a-profitable-kajabi-sales-page#step-4-test-test-and-test-again)

Step 4: Test, test, and test again
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Before you promote your sales page, here is a checklist to ensure everything is working correctly:

*   Review your page on both desktop and mobile to ensure legibility and navigability
*   Click all buttons and links on both desktop and mobile to ensure they are working correctly
*   Check all copy spelling and grammar using a tool like [Grammarly](https://www.grammarly.com/)
    
*   Create a coupon giving you 100% off the purchase price to test your checkout, ensuring you receive your purchase confirmations
*   Review your page URL and SEO settings under **Page Details** so that your page displays correctly when shared

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/how-to-create-a-profitable-kajabi-sales-page#get-started)

Get started
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

If you’re just getting started, don’t get caught in the weeds with your design. Remember, done is better than perfect. Put something out into the world, gain data and feedback, and iterate as needed.
