# Understand the psychology of selling - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/understanding-the-psychology-of-selling#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/understanding-the-psychology-of-selling#overview)

Overview
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The truth is, there is no single answer or strategy for effective sales, but when you understand the psychology of selling, you will be better equipped to develop more effective sales pages. Designing a sales page is more than the colors, fonts, and images that you use; it’s about deeply resonating with your potential customers and allowing your sales page to speak to them when you can’t be there in person.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/understanding-the-psychology-of-selling#the-value-is-in-the-why)

The value is in the why
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Although it may seem that the more you offer, the more valuable your product or service may be, overwhelming your customers with inclusions could deter them from purchasing. Rather than focusing on the “what” (e.g. the number of lessons, downloads, or hours of work ahead), instead focus on the “why”. Remember: _they buy because of their why._ Here are some psychological reasons why people buy:

*   **Pain:** This could include physical discomfort or mental discomfort. Consider how you can address and resolve a pain point that they’re experiencing.
*   **Profit:** This could be a monetary profit or even a non-monetary result or a revelation that can help them in their life or business.
*   **Popularity:** As we know from influencers, many people will purchase based on social influence. This could also be with the help of influencers, affiliates, media exposure, or by use of social proof.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/understanding-the-psychology-of-selling#consider-attention-spans)

Consider attention spans
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

You’re not only competing with your competitors for the attention of your customers, but you’re also competing with every other source of distraction online including social media, streaming services, and apps that your customers are using. It’s crucial to take advantage of every second you have their attention. In her book, “Attention Span”, psychologist [Gloria Mark](https://gloriamark.com/attention-span/)
 wrote that the first attention span study in 2004 showed an average attention span for screens was two and a half minutes. Another study from 2012 found it was as low as 75 seconds. The most recent study shows it’s only 47 seconds. _**If you only had 47 seconds to tell someone about what you’re selling, what would you say?**_ What would be the most important points you’d want them to understand? And how would you guide them to purchase? The next time you speak with an existing or potential customer, pay attention to what piques their interest. What questions are they asking? What easy-to-understand terms can you use to illustrate your value?

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/understanding-the-psychology-of-selling#create-a-digestible-sales-page)

Create a digestible sales page
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

If you’ve ever used a visitor recording tool like [Hotjar](https://www.hotjar.com/)
 or reviewed Google Analytics to understand the average time a visitor spends on your page, you may have noticed that people scan a page very quickly and leave. People are skiing quickly through your website, often noticing only the large things like headlines, images, bullet points, and pricing. When [designing your sales page](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/how-to-create-a-profitable-kajabi-sales-page)
, it’s important to draw focus and attention to the things that you want them to notice most, including the value you’ll bring to their life or business. **Things you’ll want them to focus on include:**

*   _Compelling headlines_
*   _Their deeply resonating “why”_
*   _Visuals that provide context or convey a feeling_
*   _Your offer and value-added bonuses_

Additionally, making your website scrollable on both desktop and mobile devices is key to a great user experience and potentially higher conversions. [Google reports](https://www.thinkwithgoogle.com/marketing-strategies/app-and-mobile/mobile-web-traffic-statistics/)
 that an average of 50% of traffic to a website is from mobile devices. If your sales page is too long, making it difficult to scroll on mobile devices, your visitors could miss important information or simply lose interest and leave.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/understanding-the-psychology-of-selling#connect-with-the-audience-to-convert)

Connect with the audience to convert
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Creating an effective sales page is about much more than design aesthetics; it’s about connecting with your audience on a psychological level. By focusing on the “why” behind their purchase decisions and addressing their core needs—whether it’s alleviating pain, generating profit, or gaining popularity—you can create a more meaningful connection. At the same time, understanding the limitations of attention spans in our digital age means you must communicate your value swiftly and clearly. By ensuring your sales page is digestible, mobile-friendly, and strategically focused on the key elements that matter most to your audience, you’ll be well on your way to converting visitors into loyal customers.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/understanding-the-psychology-of-selling#about-the-author)

About the author
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Afton is a Digital Strategist and has over a decade of hands-on experience with some of the biggest thought leaders online. Her gifts in design and strategy have helped her clients and students to grow profitable and influential businesses online. She believes everyone has something amazing to teach the world and is capable of becoming a thought leader in their own right - and she would love to show you how. You can learn more about Hero Afton Negrea on her website, [https://www.aftonnegrea.com/](https://www.aftonnegrea.com/)
. ![Afton Negrea Headshot](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/N_ou1KPM051i95tz/articles/images/b940c3c0_28970238773787.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=N_ou1KPM051i95tz&q=85&s=222543e6901ea506305bd985b93be5ef) This content was provided by Kajabi Expert Afton Negrea and is offered for informational and educational purposes only and not as expert advice. [​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-categorize-your-blog-posts#step-1-add-tags-to-blog-posts)

Step 1. Add tags to blog posts
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Tagging your blog posts is a great way to keep them organized. After adding the tags and saving your changes, the tags will be displayed as categories on your blog homepage.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-categorize-your-blog-posts#add-tags-to-a-blog-post)

Add tags to a blog post

1.  Open the **Website** tab from your Dashboard.

3.  There, select an existing Blog Post or [create a new one](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-create-a-blog-post)
    .
4.  On the right side of the page, enter your tag title to search or create a new tag in the **Organization** section of the Blog Post Editor.
5.  Select your existing tag or click **tab/enter** after entering your new tag to apply.
6.  Then, click **Save**:

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-categorize-your-blog-posts#step-2-display-categories-on-the-blog-homepage)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-categorize-your-blog-posts#add-a-categories-section-to-the-blog-sidebar)

Add a categories section to the blog sidebar

1.  Open the **Website** tab from your Dashboard.
2.  Select the **Pages** tab.
3.  Click the **Customize** icon next to Blog.
4.  Under Sections, select **Blog Listings**.
5.  Scroll down to the **Sidebar** section and check **Show Sidebar on Desktop**.
6.  Click **Add Content** to begin building your blog sidebar.
7.  Select **Categories**.
8.  Customize the text displaying the Heading and All Categories Language.
9.  Click **Save** to keep your changes:

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-categorize-your-blog-posts#delete-categories)

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

2.  Click **Blog**.
3.  Select an existing Blog Post.
4.  In the **Organization** section on the right-hand side, click the **x** icon on the tag you wish to delete.
5.  Press **Save** to save your changes:

Overview
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

You can embed video content from external sources like YouTube directly into your blog posts using embed code. This allows you to include additional video content beyond the single video upload option in the media card.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-embed-a-video-to-a-blog-post#embed-a-video-in-a-blog-post)

Embed a video in a blog post
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Looking to upload your video to your blog post? [Learn to upload media to blog posts](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-add-media-to-your-blog-posts)
 to learn how to upload media to your blog posts. First, copy the embed code for the video you would like to use.

1.  If you are embedding a video from YouTube, click **Share** under the video player:

![YouTube Share button](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/0dktLU6n0E_nSYxP/articles/images/88953749_AFB12B9D-C312-4BD0-8F17-5137B42D1E43.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=0dktLU6n0E_nSYxP&q=85&s=0741e1a49a39921faf67f20bdc136b9f)

2.  Then, click **Embed**.

![YouTube Embed option](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/4xb7Z9X_ecGbjk3p/articles/images/5b667012_E4E8D041-B792-4938-8AE1-ABFBED96F643.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=4xb7Z9X_ecGbjk3p&q=85&s=eeae83a2c57bff62c30ad4ecf290b251)

3.  From there, copy the Embed Code:

![YouTube Embed Code](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/km6s0kSe4aDFzY4R/articles/images/a4cb2dd8_C1AAF44E-1A40-4197-8F72-FED22D3BB6E1.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=km6s0kSe4aDFzY4R&q=85&s=0eb494c4a029e4c238dfd0888f424af6) Next, you will need to paste the Embed Code into the Source Code of your blog post:

1.  Open the **Website** tab from the Dashboard.
2.  Then, click **Blog**.
3.  Edit an existing **Blog Post** or [create a new one](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-create-a-blog-post)
    .
4.  Open the source code of the Content section on the **Blog Post** (click the `<>` symbol in the top of the toolbar).
5.  Paste the embed code and click **Ok**.
6.  Click **Save** to update your post.

# Add a call to action to a blog post - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-add-a-call-to-action-to-an-individual-blog-post#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-add-a-call-to-action-to-an-individual-blog-post#overview)

Overview
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A Call to Action (CTA) is typically used to provoke a response from your visitors by encouraging them to click on something. You can use an image or a link as a call to action in your blog posts to encourage your visitors to visit one of your landing pages, a checkout page, an opt-in page, or any other web page with a URL link.

**Note:** Looking to add or remove the call to action block on every blog post? [Learn to design blog posts](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-design-your-blog-posts)
.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-add-a-call-to-action-to-an-individual-blog-post#use-an-image-as-a-call-to-action)

Use an image as a call to action
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

With Kajabi you can use an image to act as a button, allowing you to use your design and brand for your call to action. To use an image as a call to action in your blog post, upload your image and configure it as your call to action.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-add-a-call-to-action-to-an-individual-blog-post#step-1-upload-the-image)

Step 1. Upload the image

1.  Select the **Website** tab from the Dashboard.
2.  Click **Blog**.
3.  Select or create a Blog Post.
4.  Locate the **Post Details** section.
5.  Enter call to action text to let the reader know to click the image.
6.  Select **Upload image**.
7.  Choose the file and click **Open**:

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-add-a-call-to-action-to-an-individual-blog-post#step-2-insert-link)

Step 2. Insert link

1.  Select the uploaded image with the cursor.
2.  Click the **Insert/edit link** button in the Content Editor.
3.  Enter the **URL** of the page you want the call to action to lead to.
4.  Select **New window** from the **Target** dropdown menu.
5.  Click **Ok**.
6.  Click **Save**.
7.  Click **Preview** to test the call to action:

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-add-a-call-to-action-to-an-individual-blog-post#use-a-link-as-a-call-to-action)

Use a link as a call to action
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Communicate a call to action with a simple link when building a blog post.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-add-a-call-to-action-to-an-individual-blog-post#add-a-link-call-to-action)

Add a link call to action

1.  Select the **Website** tab from the Dashboard.
2.  Click **Blog**.
3.  Select or create a Blog Post.
4.  Locate the **Post Details** section.
5.  Click the **Insert/edit link** button in the Content Editor.
6.  Enter the **URL** of the page you want the call to action to lead to.
7.  Enter the Text to display for the link.
8.  Select **New window** from the **Target** dropdown menu.
9.  Click **Ok**.
10.  Click **Save**.
11.  Click **Preview** to test the call to action:

# Create a blog post - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-create-a-blog-post#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-create-a-blog-post#overview)

Overview
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

All of your blog posts (both published and unpublished) can be found by navigating to the Blog tab nested under the Website tab of your Kajabi Dashboard. You can create, edit, schedule, and organize your posts all from one place.

Looking to design your blog posts? [Learn to design blog posts](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-design-your-blog-posts)
 to learn more.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-create-a-blog-post#add-a-post-to-your-blog)

Add a post to your blog
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

To add a new post to your blog:

1.  Open the **Website** tab from your Dashboard.
2.  Then, select the Blog tab.
3.  In the top right corner, click **\+ New Post**:

[Learn to add media to your blog posts](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-add-media-to-your-blog-posts)
.

**Note:** The slug “search” is reserved and cannot be used as a blog post URL slug. Blog post images are resized to 1280 x 720 pixels and have a maximum upload size of 5 MB.

**Tip:** After saving your new blog post, click the Preview icon that appears just below your post title in the editor to view a preview of your post.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-create-a-blog-post#set-a-publishing-date)

Set a publishing date
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Do you like to work ahead on your blog? With Kajabi you can schedule a blog post to be published at a future date. This is also a great tool to use if you need to migrate your blog posts over to Kajabi from another platform like WordPress. You’ll be able to keep your publication dates consistent with your former blog dates, and schedule future posts with ease.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-create-a-blog-post#set-a-specific-publishing-date)

Set a specific publishing date

1.  Open the **Website** tab from your Dashboard.
2.  Then, click **Blog**.
3.  Choose an existing **Blog Post** or create a new one.
4.  Click **Set a specific publishing date**.
5.  Select a date when your blog post will be published and click **Apply**:

![Set a Specific Publishing Date](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/T7HThu_bu5xEvH2P/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-16-set-a-blog-publishing-date-1785428363550.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=T7HThu_bu5xEvH2P&q=85&s=76538916eccf2abd034cec2b742b3dbe)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-create-a-blog-post#add-tags-to-posts)

Add tags to posts
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Tagging your **Blog Posts** with category tags is a great way to keep them organized and easy to find. After adding your tags and saving your changes, the tags will be displayed as categories on your blog homepage.

**Note:** Worried about reaching your Kajabi tag limit of 100 tags? Don’t be. Tags in your blog posts are only used for organization and are separate from the tags used in your Contacts tab. Your tag limit will only apply to the tags created for your Contacts.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-create-a-blog-post#add-tags-to-blog-posts)

Add tags to blog posts

1.  Open the **Website** tab from your Dashboard.
2.  Then, click **Blog**.
3.  Select an existing Blog Post or create a new one.
4.  Locate the **Organization** card in the right sidebar.
5.  Click into the **Tags** field.
6.  Select an existing tag from the dropdown or type the name of a new tag and press Enter.
7.  Then, click **Save**:

# Add Facebook comments with the legacy template - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-add-facebook-comments-to-your-blog-posts-with-the-legacy-template#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-add-facebook-comments-to-your-blog-posts-with-the-legacy-template#overview)

Overview
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This article covers how to add Facebook comments to blog posts built with the Premier legacy template. If you are using Kajabi Pages or Website Builder, please refer to the [updated guide](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-add-facebook-comments-to-your-page)
.

**Note:** To add Facebook comments, you will need to be on a Kajabi Pro account to access the code editor. Learn about the different plans [here](https://kajabi.com/pricing/)
.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-add-facebook-comments-to-your-blog-posts-with-the-legacy-template#step-1-get-the-facebook-comments-code)

Step 1. Get the Facebook Comments code
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

To add Facebook comments to a blog post, log into your Facebook account and follow [this link](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/plugins/comments)
 to configure and generate HTML snippets for the Facebook Comments plugin:

1.  Copy and paste the blog page URL into the Comments Plugin Code Generator URL field.
2.  Enter the number of posts (or comments) to display on the page.
3.  Click **GET CODE**:

**Tip:** Keep two tabs open in your browser for your Kajabi Blog and the Facebook Comments Plugin Code Generator to easily switch back and forth during the process of adding Facebook Comments to your page.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-add-facebook-comments-to-your-blog-posts-with-the-legacy-template#step-2-open-the-code-editor-in-kajabi)

Step 2. Open the Code Editor in Kajabi
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Once the code snippets are generated, head back to Kajabi and enter the Blog Post code editor:

1.  Open the **Website** tab from the Dashboard.
2.  Select **Pages**.
3.  Locate the **Blog Post** page template.
4.  Click `…` on the far right and choose **Modify code**:

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-add-facebook-comments-to-your-blog-posts-with-the-legacy-template#step-3-paste-the-first-code-snippet-into-kajabi)

Step 3. Paste the first code snippet into Kajabi
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Open the `Layouts` folder in the code editor:

1.  Click on the `theme.liquid` file.
2.  Scroll down to the `<body>` tag (usually around line 70 of a freshly installed template).
3.  Copy the first code snippet from the Comments Plugin Generator.
4.  Paste the code snippet one line below the `<body>` tag.
5.  Click **Save**:

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-add-facebook-comments-to-your-blog-posts-with-the-legacy-template#step-4-paste-the-second-code-snippet)

Step 4. Paste the second code snippet
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Open the `Templates` folder in the code editor:

1.  Click on the `blog_post.liquid` file.
2.  Locate the `{% section "blog_post_body" %}` tag (usually around line 5 of a freshly installed template).
3.  Copy the second code snippet from the Comments Plugin Generator.
4.  Paste the second code snippet one line below the `{% section "blog_post_body" %}`:

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-add-facebook-comments-to-your-blog-posts-with-the-legacy-template#step-5-configure-the-second-code-snippet)

Step 5. Configure the second code snippet
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Finally, to get your Facebook Comments to fully function on all of your blog posts:

1.  Replace the site URL within the quotations in the second code snippet with this exact text: `#####{{canonical_url}}`

For example, if the second code snippet began like this: `<div class="fb-comments" data-href="https://help.kajabi.com/blog/getting-to-know-the-how-tos"data-numposts="3" data-width=""></div>` It would be changed to look like this: `<div class="fb-comments" data-href="#####{{canonical_url}}" data-numposts="3" data-width=""></div>` Click **Save** and preview your blog posts to see Facebook Comments near the bottom of the page.

YesNo

# Configure SEO and sharing settings for a blog - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-configure-seo-and-sharing-settings-for-your-blog#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-configure-seo-and-sharing-settings-for-your-blog#overview)

Overview
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The SEO and sharing settings for your blog display information about your blog on search engines and social media websites, and may be displayed when your blog is shared by text or email. Properly configuring these settings helps increase your blog’s visibility and traffic.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-configure-seo-and-sharing-settings-for-your-blog#seo-and-sharing-settings-for-the-blog-page)

SEO and sharing settings for the blog page
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The SEO and sharing settings for your blog will display information about your blog on search engines and social media websites and may be displayed when your blog is shared by text or email. With this in mind, it is important to understand that if you do not complete your blog SEO and sharing settings, the results will default to the [SEO settings in your Site Details](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/seo-and-sharing#h_916d67e7-770b-4b3e-97ab-6571a5e1c57e)
.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-configure-seo-and-sharing-settings-for-your-blog#blog-page-settings)

Blog page settings

*   Customize the Page Title for your blog
*   Provide a description for your blog
*   Upload an image for your blog

![SEO and Sharing Settings for Blog](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/-IEuur07Sv6pI5G7/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-14-seo-and-sharing-settings-1785429879458.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=-IEuur07Sv6pI5G7&q=85&s=dd215bcb3a3bdde993802481d811136f) [Learn to optimize your Page Title and Description](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/get-started-with-seo)
.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-configure-seo-and-sharing-settings-for-your-blog#seo-and-sharing-settings-for-each-blog-post)

SEO and sharing settings for each blog post
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The SEO and sharing settings for your blog posts will display information about your post on search engines and social media websites and may be displayed when your post is shared by text or email. With this in mind, it is important to understand that if you do not complete your SEO and sharing settings for each blog post, the results will default to the [SEO settings in your Site Details](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/seo-and-sharing#h_916d67e7-770b-4b3e-97ab-6571a5e1c57e)
.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-configure-seo-and-sharing-settings-for-your-blog#blog-post-settings)

Blog post settings

*   Customize the backend of the Blog Post URL address
*   Enter the Page Title for the blog post
*   Provide a page description for your blog post
*   Upload an image for your blog post SEO

![SEO and Sharing Settings for Post](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/-IEuur07Sv6pI5G7/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-19-blog-seo-and-sharing-settings-1785429879918.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=-IEuur07Sv6pI5G7&q=85&s=76d52fd0a4fbd22f7ee0be5f393ef2fe) [Learn to optimize your Page Title and Description](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/business-guides/get-started-with-seo)
.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-configure-seo-and-sharing-settings-for-your-blog#customize-blog-page-seo-and-sharing-settings)

Customize blog page SEO and sharing settings
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-configure-seo-and-sharing-settings-for-your-blog#customize-blog-page-settings)

Customize blog page settings

1.  Open the **Website** from your Dashboard.
2.  Then, click **Blog**.
3.  From there, click **Settings**:

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-configure-seo-and-sharing-settings-for-your-blog#configure-individual-blog-post-settings)

Configure individual blog post settings

1.  Open the **Website** from your Dashboard.
2.  Then, click **Blog**.
3.  There, select the Blog Post you want to edit.
4.  Scroll down to the bottom of the page to **SEO and Sharing**:

**Tip:** To ensure that each blog post has SEO and sharing set up, fill out each blog post’s SEO and Sharing section when creating the blog post.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-configure-seo-and-sharing-settings-for-your-blog#edit-your-blog-post-url)

Edit your blog post URL
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The blog post URL is based on the title of the post by default. You can edit the URL to your preference:

**Note:** All blog URLs will have /blog/ before the blog title.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-configure-seo-and-sharing-settings-for-your-blog#rss-feed)

RSS feed
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Yes, all Kajabi sites will have an RSS feed for the blog automatically generated. You can find your blog’s RSS feed by starting with your domain or subdomain, adding /blog.rss, and then entering it into your browser. For example: `https://your-site-name.mykajabi.com/blog.rss`

**Note:** If you have connected a custom domain to your site, use your custom domain for your RSS feed.

# Customize the blog sidebar - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/customizing-your-blog-sidebar#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/customizing-your-blog-sidebar#overview)

Overview
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Your blog sidebar is a powerful tool for redirecting visitors to additional content with images, links, and opt-ins. You can use it to showcase recent blog posts, communicate author information, and include an All Categories link to view all of your blog categories.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/customizing-your-blog-sidebar#customize-the-blog-sidebar)

Customize the blog sidebar
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/customizing-your-blog-sidebar#set-up-the-sidebar)

Set up the sidebar

1.  Open the **Website** tab from the Dashboard.
2.  Click the **Pages** tab.
3.  Select the **Blog** page from the list of Website pages.
4.  Under Sections, select **Blog Listings**.
5.  Check **Show Sidebar**.
6.  Click **Add Content** and begin building the blog sidebar:

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/customizing-your-blog-sidebar#sidebar-blocks)

Sidebar blocks
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

You can add the following blocks to your blog sidebar:

*   Author
*   Call to Action
*   Categories
*   Custom Block
*   Image
*   Recent Posts
*   Sidebar Search
*   Social Links

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/customizing-your-blog-sidebar#author)

Author

Add your information as the author and customize the text displayed including Name, Title, Bio, and Image. ![Author block](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/lKMXoaEC38-vIpmO/articles/images/077f4e1e_360096148894.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=lKMXoaEC38-vIpmO&q=85&s=9df9df4a911a5bc557ddc0d8592901ba)

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/customizing-your-blog-sidebar#call-to-action)

Call to Action

Use a Call to Action to encourage an immediate response from your visitors to:

*   Lead a visitor to a custom **Landing Page**
*   Lead to a sale by going to a **Checkout Page**
*   Encourage your audience to **download a file**
*   Lead to any website page with a **URL link**
*   Open a **Two-Step Optin Popup**
*   Act as a link to **lead to a section of the page**

![Call to Action block](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/vZwjLDvOZJMn-nsK/articles/images/2d893f61_360098444333.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=vZwjLDvOZJMn-nsK&q=85&s=a504e5afa76fedfe91c0d4e1f9e74869)

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/customizing-your-blog-sidebar#categories)

Categories

Use Categories to easily filter through your blog posts when visitors view your blog. Read [How to Categorize your Blog Posts](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-categorize-your-blog-posts)
 for details. ![Categories block](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/X2fl5c4w8CoiMUSm/articles/images/990abc32_360096149374.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=X2fl5c4w8CoiMUSm&q=85&s=318108ea3112f47fc2139ea92126ee4d)

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/customizing-your-blog-sidebar#custom-block)

Custom Block

Create custom blocks in your blog sidebar to include images, a Call to Action (CTA), and additional text content. ![Custom Block](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/EFdfkzsgcSmbPght/articles/images/c7e54c68_360096149474.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=EFdfkzsgcSmbPght&q=85&s=172200294c4cf8294a7d07d49cde56c0)

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/customizing-your-blog-sidebar#image)

Image

Add an image to your sidebar to enhance the visual experience of your blog homepage and act as an optional button by configuring the Image Action. ![Image block](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/nb-ZvvvD8AMIw1RF/articles/images/e3464a84_360096149814.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=nb-ZvvvD8AMIw1RF&q=85&s=8ba75f620e1755aec02f3e112f2329a6)

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/customizing-your-blog-sidebar#recent-posts)

Recent Posts

List your most recent posts for your blog visitors to easily access. ![Recent Posts block](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/So_4WToHMfn76-m1/articles/images/6b7b19b0_360098445013.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=So_4WToHMfn76-m1&q=85&s=c7f91f453232e2a847c1b3e8914aab77)

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/customizing-your-blog-sidebar#sidebar-search)

Sidebar Search

Add a search bar to the homepage of your blog for your visitors to easily search your blog posts. ![Sidebar Search block](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/WdSx_69sPJcy_iHX/articles/images/9371335f_360098445073.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=WdSx_69sPJcy_iHX&q=85&s=4761267101d016f2c632d0cf56af4ce9)

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/customizing-your-blog-sidebar#social-links)

Social Links

Include Social Links to connect your blog visitors to your social networking pages. Simply copy and paste your social networking page URL to its corresponding text box in the Sidebar Editor. ![Social Links block](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/ig0P6X_YYqhSgRa-/articles/images/225fb3e1_360098445133.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=ig0P6X_YYqhSgRa-&q=85&s=aedbe7b4b7624dc7661d117f03b45bd5)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/customizing-your-blog-sidebar#rearrange-sidebar-blocks)

Rearrange sidebar blocks
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  In the sidebar editor, click **Blog Listings**.
2.  Navigate to the **Sidebar** section.
3.  Hover your mouse over the `=` and drag the sidebar blocks to the desired location.
4.  Click **Save** to keep the changes:

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/customizing-your-blog-sidebar#sidebar-containers)

Sidebar containers
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Separate your sidebar by putting it in a Container. # Upload a file to blog posts - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-upload-a-file-to-your-blog-posts#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-upload-a-file-to-your-blog-posts#overview)

Overview
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Deliver supplemental resources to your blog post visitors including PDFs, images, graphics, and more. To add a downloadable file, you will need a standalone landing page, your downloadable file, and a call to action button.

With Kajabi’s many features, you can upload your downloadable file onto a landing page and design a landing page specific to your file. Then, when your blog post visitors click your call to action button in your blog post, they will be redirected to your landing page encouraging them to download your file.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-upload-a-file-to-your-blog-posts#step-1-create-a-landing-page)

Step 1. Create a landing page
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

To give access to your downloadable file from your blog post, you will need to create a separate landing page on Kajabi to hold your file. In order for your blog post visitors to access your file, they will need to click a button to be redirected to your custom landing page containing your file. First, you will need to create and customize your landing page to showcase your file.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-upload-a-file-to-your-blog-posts#create-a-landing-page-with-a-downloadable-file)

Create a landing page with a downloadable file

1.  Open the **Website** tab from your Dashboard.
2.  Click **Pages**.
3.  Then, open your **Landing pages** folder.
4.  Click **\+ New Landing Page**.
5.  Select the template that fits your design and brand.
6.  Enter your page title.
7.  Click **Create**:

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-upload-a-file-to-your-blog-posts#add-a-call-to-action-section-for-the-downloadable-file)

Add a Call to Action section for the downloadable file

1.  Click into the Section you wish to add your Call to Action (CTA) to.
2.  Click **Add Content**.
3.  Select **Call to Action**.
4.  Open the **Call to Action** Block Setting from the sidebar panel.
5.  Enter the text you wish to display on your button in the **Text** field.
6.  Select **Download a file** from the Button Action dropdown menu.
7.  Click **Pick file** to upload your file onto the page.
8.  Customize your Call to Action button with the remaining Call to Action settings. [Learn more](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-use-a-call-to-action)
    
9.  Click **Save** to keep and apply your changes:

After configuring your Call to Action section, customize your page to highlight your Call to Action to easily direct your visitors to the file.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-upload-a-file-to-your-blog-posts#step-2-link-the-landing-page-to-the-blog-post)

Step 2. Link the landing page to the blog post
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Now that you have prepared your landing page, it is time to add your landing page link to your blog post.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-upload-a-file-to-your-blog-posts#add-the-landing-page-link-to-the-blog-post)

Add the landing page link to the blog post

1.  Navigate back to your Kajabi Dashboard.
2.  Copy the link to your newly created landing page. [Learn more](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-copy-your-page-link)
    
3.  Then, open the Website tab and select **Blog**.
4.  [Create a new Blog Post](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-create-a-blog-post)
     or select an existing Blog Post to edit.
5.  Enter the text for your link and select it with your cursor.
6.  Click the **Insert/Edit Link** button in your Blog Post Text Editor.
7.  Paste your Landing Page link in the URL box.
8.  Select a **Target**:
    *   **None** – Open the link in the current window
    *   **New Window** – Open in a different window
9.  Click **Ok**.
10.  Then, click **Save** to keep and apply your changes:

After completing this final step, your blog visitors will be redirected to your custom-created landing page when they click the link to download your file from your blog post. Preview your blog post to test your visitor’s experience.

# Add a two-step opt-in to a blog - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-add-a-two-step-optin-to-your-blog#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-add-a-two-step-optin-to-your-blog#overview)

Overview
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A two-step opt-in is a popup that appears when a button or call to action is clicked on your page. This feature leverages human psychology to encourage opt-ins—by committing to the initial small step of clicking a call to action, your site visitor is more likely to commit to the next step of opting in.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-add-a-two-step-optin-to-your-blog#what-is-a-two-step-opt-in)

What is a two-step opt-in?
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**The two steps in the two-step opt-in:**

1.  Click a button
2.  Opt-in

With this simple feature, you can improve your rate of opt-ins with a customized, branded popup. Kajabi’s two-step opt-in is an easy-to-use alternative to traditional opt-in popups. **Plus, it’s flexible.** In your blog, you can use it to display a message, an image, or a Progress Bar—all to grow your list.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-add-a-two-step-optin-to-your-blog#set-up-a-two-step-opt-in)

Set up a two-step opt-in
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-add-a-two-step-optin-to-your-blog#step-1-create-and-customize-your-two-step-opt-in-popup)

Step 1. Create and customize your two-step opt-in popup

1.  Open the **Website** tab from the Dashboard.
2.  Click **Pages**.
3.  Select the **Blog** or **Blog Post** page from the list of Website Pages. Create a two-step opt-in popup for the main blog homepage or for every blog post.
4.  In the sidebar, click **Two-Step Optin**.
5.  Select **Show Popup** to view changes while you edit.
6.  Customize the two-step opt-in popup to display the form and any additional blocks.
7.  Uncheck **Show Popup** and click **Save** to apply the changes:

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-add-a-two-step-optin-to-your-blog#step-2-create-a-call-to-action-button-to-trigger-the-two-step-opt-in-popup)

Step 2. Create a call to action button to trigger the two-step opt-in popup

To enable your two-step opt-in, set up a button or call to action to open the two-step opt-in when clicked. Keep in mind, although you can create multiple call to action buttons in your blog homepage or blog posts to trigger your two-step opt-in, you can only create and customize one two-step opt-in popup for your blog homepage and one popup to appear across all blog posts. For the purpose of this guide, you will create a call to action in the **Blog Sidebar** to enable the two-step opt-in popup when clicked.

#### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-add-a-two-step-optin-to-your-blog#create-a-call-to-action-in-the-blog-sidebar)

Create a call to action in the blog sidebar

1.  Navigate back to the sidebar editor.
2.  Open the **Blog Listings** section.
3.  Click **Add Content** under the Sidebar section.
4.  Select **Call to Action**.
5.  Locate **Button Action** in the sidebar control panel.
6.  Select **Open two-step opt-in popup**.
7.  Customize the button message and button appearance from the sidebar control panel.
8.  Click **Save** to apply and keep the changes:

[Learn more about customizing your blog sidebar](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/customizing-your-blog-sidebar)
.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-add-a-two-step-optin-to-your-blog#customize-the-two-step-opt-in)

Customize the two-step opt-in
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-add-a-two-step-optin-to-your-blog#edit-two-step-popup)

Edit two-step popup

Enable this setting to show the popup in the editor. Be sure to uncheck this before you finish editing.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-add-a-two-step-optin-to-your-blog#edit-the-image-block)

Edit the image block

If you choose to display an image in your popup, be sure to select **Show Image** on to display your uploaded image.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-add-a-two-step-optin-to-your-blog#edit-the-form-block)

Edit the form block

1.  Click into the **Form** block in the sidebar editor.
2.  Select a form from the dropdown menu labeled **Form**.

To select a form from the dropdown, you must first [create a Form](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/marketing/forms/create-and-build-your-form)
 in your Marketing tab.

#### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-add-a-two-step-optin-to-your-blog#select-a-thank-you-page)

Select a thank you page

Set up the action triggered after the form is submitted from the page:

*   Go to a Landing Page
*   Go to a Checkout Page
*   Download a File
*   Go to a URL (Be sure to use the full URL. For example, [https://kajabi.com/](https://kajabi.com/)
    )

**Note:** Leave blank to send your form submitters to the default Thank You page located under the Website Design tab or to the specified Thank You page set up in the [After Submissions settings](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/marketing/forms/how-to-use-the-after-submission-settings-in-forms)
 of the Form editor. Selecting the Thank You page from this dropdown will override the default Thank You page and the After Submission Form settings Thank You page.

#### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-add-a-two-step-optin-to-your-blog#button-text)

Button text

Customize your message displayed on the button to submit the form.

#### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-add-a-two-step-optin-to-your-blog#form-style)

Form style

Customize the appearance of the form displayed in your popup:

*   **Input Label** – change the appearance of the labels for the form fields
*   **Button Style** – create a solid color button or an outlined button
*   **Button Width** – choose to take up the full width of the form or the Auto size based on the button text
*   **Button Color** – brand your button with your colors
*   **Button Text Color** – brand your button text for solid buttons (selected in Button Style)

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-add-a-two-step-optin-to-your-blog#section-appearance)

Section appearance

Customize the Background Color and Text Color of your two-step opt-in popup.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/how-to-add-a-two-step-optin-to-your-blog#add-content)

Add content

Include additional content to your popup:

*   Images
*   Text
*   A Progress Bar to encourage urgency

# The 4 foundational habits of all successful bloggers - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/the-4-foundational-habits-of-all-successful-bloggers#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/the-4-foundational-habits-of-all-successful-bloggers#overview)

Overview
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The most successful bloggers spend 90-95% of their week in just four key areas. By focusing your efforts on these habits, you can build a sustainable and profitable blogging practice.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/blog/the-4-foundational-habits-of-all-successful-bloggers#the-4-habits-of-successful-bloggers)

The 4 habits of successful bloggers
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The most successful bloggers spend 90-95% of their week in just four key areas:

*   **Create habit** – Successful bloggers publish content on their blog regularly. They are effectively using text, audio, or video to get their message out to the masses. Have a goal of producing one helpful piece of content each week, if possible. Over time, you’ll have a vast depository of useful content to share with your audience.
*   **Capture habit** – Successful bloggers are also religious about building and nurturing an email list. They are always looking for ways and opportunities to add more subscribers to their list. Two great places to create your list is in the right sidebar of your blog or at the end of your post. Kajabi simplifies this habit with the built-in features of your blog page.
*   **Compile habit** – This habit alone separates the “hobby” bloggers from the full-time bloggers. Each week they are working on creating products and services that they plan to sell on their blog and to their email list. Two effective paid products to create are online courses and membership sites. Kajabi has your back here—you can easily create an online course, then sell it to your list or on your blog. Want recurring income month after month? Create a membership site on Kajabi and get monthly paying members in no time.
*   **Connect habit** – The connect habit is all about getting traffic. Go to where your audience resides online and attract them to your blog. Having blog content makes the process so much easier. Share your blog posts on social media and drive traffic back to your site.

When planning out your week, spend time in each of these four critical areas, and you’ll see your blogging efforts grow. **Related Article**: [How to Build Your Online Business with the Hourglass Funnel](https://bloggingyourpassion.com/build-your-online-business/)

# Add JavaScript tracking code to Checkout pages - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/checkout/how-to-add-a-javascript-tracking-code-to-your-checkout-pages#content-area)

**Tracking code** from services like Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, or other analytics platforms can help you understand how customers interact with Checkout pages. Add tracking code to monitor conversions, retarget visitors, and measure the effectiveness of marketing campaigns. This code will be placed at the end of the `<body>` of each checkout page.

**Warning:** Custom JavaScript code runs on Checkout pages and has access to page content. Only add tracking code from trusted sources. Malicious code could compromise checkout security or customer data.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/checkout/how-to-add-a-javascript-tracking-code-to-your-checkout-pages#add-edit-or-remove-tracking-code)

Add, edit, or remove tracking code
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Tracking code for Checkout pages is managed separately from the Header Page Script field used for other pages.

1.  From the Dashboard, click **Settings.**
2.  Under **Payment settings**, click **Checkout**.
3.  In the **Checkout Tracking Code** section, click to add or edit **Header tracking code** or **Footer tracking code**: ![Checkout 07 21 2026 05 52 PM](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/6hTs5Qo9y1l7mIuC/images/Checkout-07-21-2026_05_52_PM.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=6hTs5Qo9y1l7mIuC&q=85&s=49e4d738a25ab340686921e71784c86d)
4.  Paste in new JavaScript code, update current code, or remove all code from each field.
5.  Click **Save.**

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/checkout/how-to-add-a-javascript-tracking-code-to-your-checkout-pages#disable-tracking-code-on-a-specific-offer%E2%80%99s-enhanced-checkout-page)

Disable tracking code on a specific Offer’s Enhanced Checkout page
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Tracking code added under Checkout Tracking Code applies to all Checkout pages across your site. To disable tracking on a specific Offer’s Enhanced Checkout page:

1.  From the Dashboard, click **Sales**, then **Pricing**.
2.  Click an **Offer Title**.
3.  Click **Edit checkout** at the top of the page.
4.  Click the section title **Checkout**.
5.  Toggle off **Include header tracking code** and/or **Include footer tracking code**.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/checkout/how-to-add-a-javascript-tracking-code-to-your-checkout-pages#google-analytics-and-meta-pixel-purchase-events)

Google Analytics and Meta Pixel purchase events
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

If your Kajabi account is connected to Google Analytics or Meta Pixel, you do not need to add manual tracking code to capture purchases. Enhanced Checkout automatically triggers a purchase event for both integrations when a transaction is completed.

**Tip:** Learn how to connect [Google Analytics](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/api-integrations/analytics-integrations/connect-google-analytics-with-kajabi)
 and [Meta Pixel](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/api-integrations/analytics-integrations/meta-pixel-with-kajabi)
 with Kajabi.

With Kajabi’s latest updates to the website builder, you can create custom website pages and build out your standard website pages. # Landing Page slug improvements - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/landing-page-slug-improvements#content-area)

On January 15, 2019, Kajabi released an updated URL structure for every website on the Kajabi platform. Previously, landing page URLs were structured like this: `https://domain.com/p/landing-page` After the update, you are no longer required to nest landing pages underneath the `/p` directory and can now use the landing page URL straight off the root of your website: `https://domain.com/landing-page`

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/landing-page-slug-improvements#how-will-this-affect-me)

How will this affect me?
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   This change affects every site and requires no action on your part to use the feature.
*   Existing backlinks to the `/p` pages will still work as they did previously. For example, the page `camjabi.com/p/dogs` will be automatically switched to `camjabi.com/dogs` and will load without any issues.
*   Landing page references inside Kajabi will be updated to use the updated URL structure.
*   You may need to update pages that now conflict with reserved keywords on your website. For example, if you had a landing page with the URL `camjabi.com/p/library` that page URL will be automatically changed to `camjabi.com/library` and would therefore redirect to your library page in Kajabi rather than the landing page it was originally associated with. If you have landing pages ending with `/p/library`, `/p/blog`, `/p/store`, `/p/search`, or `/p/404` you will need to change these URLs to a different name in order to connect your page URL to the correct page.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/landing-page-slug-improvements#url-slug-limitations)

URL slug limitations
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Landing Page URL slugs have the following restrictions:

*   Each slug must be unique across your site (no two pages can share the same URL)
*   Slugs cannot contain the following characters: `" < > % { } | \ ^ [ ]`
*   The following words are reserved and cannot be used as slugs: `new`, `edit`, `session`, `logout`, `users`, `admin`, `stylesheets`, `assets`, `javascripts`, `images`
*   Landing Page titles have a maximum length of 70 characters
*   If a title matches a reserved word, you will see the error: “Title is a reserved word in our system. Try a different title.”

# Static pages - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/static-pages#content-area)

Static Pages are simple pages that you can add to your website. Unlike website or landing pages, static pages have limited customization options. They can be useful for pages that are mainly text, such as a terms of service or privacy policy.

**Note:** Static Pages are a legacy feature and not available for all accounts. You can [add pages to your website](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-add-pages-to-your-website)
 instead.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/static-pages#create-a-static-page)

Create a static page
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Go to Settings > **[Static pages](https://app.kajabi.com/admin/last_site/pages)
    **.
2.  Click **New page**.
3.  Add a title and content.
4.  Static pages are always nested under /pages/ on your website. Enter what you want the URL to be.
5.  Optionally, you can choose a navigation menu for this static page to be added to. Otherwise, choose **None - Do not add**.
6.  Optionally, enter a page title, description, and a social image for the static page.
7.  Click **Save**.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/static-pages#edit-a-static-page)

Edit a static page
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Go to Settings > **[Static pages](https://app.kajabi.com/admin/last_site/pages)
    **.
2.  Click the edit button next to a static page.
3.  Edit the page details or settings.
4.  Click **Save**.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/static-pages#preview-a-static-page)

Preview a static page
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Go to Settings > **[Static pages](https://app.kajabi.com/admin/last_site/pages)
    **.
2.  Click the preview button next to a static page.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/static-pages#delete-a-static-page)

Delete a static page
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Go to Settings > **[Static pages](https://app.kajabi.com/admin/last_site/pages)
    **.
2.  Click the edit button next to a static page.
3.  Click **Delete Page**.
4.  On the confirmation prompt, click **Delete**.

# Speed up a Kajabi site: Boost desktop and mobile load times - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-speed-up-your-kajabi-site-boost-desktop-and-mobile-load-times#content-area)

Experiencing slow load times on your Kajabi site can be frustrating for both you and your visitors. Slow websites can negatively impact user experience and SEO rankings, especially on mobile devices where users expect quick access. Fortunately, there are steps you can take to improve your site’s performance. Follow these easy steps to enhance your Kajabi site’s load speed on both desktop and mobile platforms.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-speed-up-your-kajabi-site-boost-desktop-and-mobile-load-times#step-1-compress-your-images)

Step 1: Compress your images
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Large image files can significantly slow down your website. Compressing these images can reduce their file size without losing quality, leading to faster load times.

*   **Use Image Compression Tools:** Tools like ImageOptim (for Mac users) or TinyPNG (for all platforms) can drastically reduce image sizes.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-speed-up-your-kajabi-site-boost-desktop-and-mobile-load-times#step-2-optimize-page-content)

Step 2: Optimize page content
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The amount and type of content on your page can affect its load time. Optimizing your content can help speed up your site.

*   **Evaluate Your Content:** Look through your pages to identify any content causing slowdowns. This could include large video files, unnecessary scripts, or excessive high-resolution images.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-speed-up-your-kajabi-site-boost-desktop-and-mobile-load-times#step-3-limit-the-use-of-external-scripts)

Step 3: Limit the use of external scripts
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

External scripts, such as those for analytics, social media buttons, or chatbots, can slow down your page load times.

*   **Review and Remove Unnecessary Scripts:** Check your site for any scripts that are not essential and remove them. For the scripts you need, ensure they are loaded asynchronously to minimize impact on performance.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-speed-up-your-kajabi-site-boost-desktop-and-mobile-load-times#step-4-test-your-site-speed)

Step 4: Test your site speed
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

After making these changes, it’s important to test your site’s speed to see the improvements.

*   **Use Speed Testing Tools:** Tools like Google PageSpeed Insights or GTmetrix can give you insights into your site’s performance before and after making these changes.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-speed-up-your-kajabi-site-boost-desktop-and-mobile-load-times#additional-tips)

Additional tips
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **Regularly Update Your Site:** Keep your Kajabi site and any integrations up to date to ensure you’re using the most efficient versions.
*   **Monitor Your Site’s Performance:** Regularly check your site’s load times and make adjustments as needed to maintain optimal speed.

# Upload a PDF onto a page - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-upload-a-pdf-onto-a-page#content-area)

PDF files can be used to give an existing or potential customer supplemental or additional content. Learn how to upload a PDF file onto a page.

* * *

This guide refers to the latest page template available with the Website Builder and Kajabi Pages. If you are using the Premier Legacy Templates, please refer to the guide [here](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-upload-a-pdf-onto-your-page-with-premier)
.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-upload-a-pdf-onto-a-page#uploading-a-downloadable-pdf-file-to-your-page)

Uploading a downloadable PDF file to your page
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Include a downloadable PDF file on your page by using a Call to Action to trigger the file. With the Call to Action Block, upload your downloadable file. [Learn more about the Call to Action](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-use-a-call-to-action)
. After setting up your downloadable PDF with a Call to Action, your page visitors will be able to click the button to launch your file to download onto their device.

**Note:** The downloadable file URL cannot be edited unless you host your file using a third-party file storage platform (e.g., Dropbox, Google Drive, etc.). Keep in mind, your chosen file storage platform may have their own specific URL conventions.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-upload-a-pdf-onto-a-page#step-1-create-a-call-to-action)

Step 1. Create a Call to Action
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   Open the **Website** tab from the Dashboard.
*   Select either **Website Pages** or **Landing Pages**.
*   Open the page editor for your Page. [Learn more](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-get-to-the-page-editor)
    
*   Click the Section you want to edit or [create a Section](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/add-sections-to-your-pages)
     to add a Call to Action (CTA).

Learn to [create a Call to Action (CTA)](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/add-a-basic-content-section-to-your-page#call-to-action)
 for details.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-upload-a-pdf-onto-a-page#step-2-set-up-your-button-action)

Step 2. Set up your button action
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   After creating a CTA, navigate to the sidebar.
*   Scroll to Button Action and select **Download a file** from the dropdown.
*   Click **Pick File** and upload your PDF file.
*   When the file has finished uploading, click **Save**:

[Preview](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/preview-your-page)
 and test your Call to Action (CTA) Button. When the Call to Action Button is clicked, a tab will be created with the PDF document.

**Tip:** Uploading a downloadable file such as a PDF can be done with a _Call to Action Button_ and with the _Image Action_ and _Action drop-down menus_ located in various Sections. This is a great way to add branded imagery to identify your downloadable files!

What is the Page Editor?

.

# Why do I have two login buttons in my page header? - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/why-do-i-have-two-login-buttons-in-my-page-header#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/why-do-i-have-two-login-buttons-in-my-page-header#why-does-this-happen)

Why does this happen?
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The User Menu Block in your page header will display the “Log In” text if your page visitor has not logged in to your site. [Learn about the User Menu Block](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-add-a-user-menu-to-your-page-header)
. If you have included a link to your [login page](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-build-your-login-page)
 in a custom navigation menu, your page will display two “Log In” buttons: ![Two login buttons example](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/ulOk3PjSKir43Xg0/articles/images/122a0e58_7FEB6351-6495-4922-AC2D-FCD9D03AF8FC.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=ulOk3PjSKir43Xg0&q=85&s=b709e59b87ffb58eb269e2b650790aa9)

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/why-do-i-have-two-login-buttons-in-my-page-header#i-want-one-login-button)

I want one login button
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

If you wish to include a login button in your page header, be sure to include the [User Menu Block](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-add-a-user-menu-to-your-page-header)
. The User Menu Block will display the “Log In” text when a page visitor has not logged in to your site and will change to the customer’s avatar when the customer has logged in. Just be sure to remove the link to your login page from your navigation menu. [Learn to edit your navigation menu](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/navigation/build-navigation-menus#h_9805cfa2-98b5-492f-a408-4cc0e6bf1f07)
.

By removing the login link from your navigation menu and including the User Menu Block in your page header, your header will contain a single login button: ![Single login button example](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/PGtO8PCuc_NzdaFE/articles/images/da53c2fd_E10B9946-F1C1-43C2-8B0E-10EF13677597.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=PGtO8PCuc_NzdaFE&q=85&s=1888803c7cb5be7a163297b4981be2f8)

# View a sitemap - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/view-your-sitemap#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/view-your-sitemap#overview)

Overview
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Internet search engines use your website **sitemap** to understand how your site is structured, easily find each page, and index your **Pages** appropriately, so they display relevant Pages in search results.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/view-your-sitemap#what-is-a-sitemap)

What is a sitemap?
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

![sitemap example](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/zWdoUKm3XPeQD8ud/articles/images/1ce74bcc_sitemapkajabi.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=zWdoUKm3XPeQD8ud&q=85&s=18a957522ffbd207c36cd083666d84db) A sitemap, specifically an [XML](https://www.w3.org/standards/xml/core)
 sitemap, directs search engines like Google to your important pages so they display appropriately in search results. Given the importance of organic traffic to your website from Internet searches, it’s best to do everything you can to help search engines understand your site. A sitemap maximizes the chance search engines will see everything you want them to find. For your convenience, Kajabi creates a sitemap using your published Pages.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/view-your-sitemap#what-pages-are-included-in-my-sitemap)

What pages are included in my sitemap?

Your sitemap includes published content across your Kajabi site:

*   **Landing Pages** (published, with **Show page in search results** enabled)
*   **Website Pages** (published custom pages, excluding system pages such as 404, Login, Library, and Blog)
*   **Blog homepage, Blog Posts, and Blog category tag pages**
*   **Sales Pages** (published)
*   **Store page**
*   **Podcast pages** (public podcasts and their published episodes)
*   **Newsletter pages** (unarchived newsletters and their published web-visible posts)
*   **Your site homepage**

Pages with **Show page in search results** disabled, unpublished pages, and private podcasts are excluded from the sitemap. [Learn how to customize your Page details](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/customize-your-page-details)
. [Learn more about sitemaps](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/advanced/sitemaps/overview)
.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/view-your-sitemap#view-your-website%E2%80%99s-sitemap)

View your website’s sitemap
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  To view your sitemap, type your website’s **URL** in a web browser, followed by `/sitemap.xml`. For example, to see Kajabi.com’s sitemap, you should enter `kajabi.com/sitemap.xml`.
2.  Search engines, like Google, eventually find your sitemap on their own. To speed up this process, you may add your sitemap to the [Google Sitemaps report/Google Search Console](https://search.google.com/search-console/about)
     whenever you make significant changes to your website. However, this step is not required.

Example of a cross-selling experience:

![44E2354D-CDBB-487E-82E7-C9267EC0C1F4.png](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/zWdoUKm3XPeQD8ud/articles/images/1727b770_44E2354D-CDBB-487E-82E7-C9267EC0C1F4.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=zWdoUKm3XPeQD8ud&q=85&s=b691acf2ee90818ec4c84966607f25a7)

*   Click **Add Section** from the sidebar editor.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-customize-the-block-width#adjusting-the-block-width)

Adjusting the block width
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Each Section of your Page is divided into a 12-column grid. Adding content (with Blocks) places your Blocks within the Section’s 12-column grid. When customizing your Block, you can adjust the amount of space your Block takes up in a Section to change the overall appearance of your content in the Section. Be mindful of the effect a block’s width may have on other blocks in the section.

*   Select the **Section** containing the Block you wish to edit.
*   Then, click into the **Block**.
*   At the top of the block, select the **Column Number** to change the Block Width.
*   Click **Save** to keep your changes:
