# Hide a page from search engines - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-hide-your-page-from-search-engines#content-area)

Control whether your landing pages appear in search engine results using the SEO and Sharing settings.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-hide-your-page-from-search-engines#overview)

Overview
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

You can hide your landing pages from search indexes using the SEO and Sharing settings available in your landing page editor. This is useful when you want to keep certain pages private or exclusive to specific audiences.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-hide-your-page-from-search-engines#hide-your-landing-pages-from-search-indexes)

Hide your landing pages from search indexes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Note:** Hiding a page from indexing will also cause any links or downloads found on that page to be hidden from web searches as well. This means those downloadable files or links will no longer be found via web search.

1.  Open the **Website** tab from your Dashboard.
2.  Click **Pages** and then select the Landing pages tab.
3.  Locate the landing page you wish to hide from search engines.
4.  Click the `…` icon.
5.  Select **Edit Details** from the dropdown menu.
6.  Navigate to the SEO and social sharing settings.
7.  Click to toggle off the **Show page in search results** setting.
8.  Click **Save** to keep your changes.

**Note:** This setting is only available in your standalone Landing Pages and cannot be applied to your standard website pages.

When you disable **Show page in search results**, Kajabi adds a `noindex, nofollow` meta tag to the page. This tells search engines not to index the page or follow any links on it. The page will also be excluded from your [sitemap](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/view-your-sitemap)
.

# Why aren't my changes saving? - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/why-arent-my-changes-saving#content-area)

If you are using multiple browser tabs to customize your site, your changes may not save. Avoid using multiple tabs to ensure that your customizations are properly saved.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/why-arent-my-changes-saving#why-aren%E2%80%99t-my-changes-saving)

Why aren’t my changes saving?
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

If you are customizing your site with multiple browser tabs, your changes in one tab may not save properly in the other tab. For example, you may be customizing the same landing page or editing the same Course Product within two different browser tabs. This can result in various problems, from edits getting saved over to accidentally deleting content because when you are working on the same area in multiple tabs each tab needs to be reloaded before it shows the most recent changes. Even if a “Save” button is clicked in one tab, it cannot force a second tab to reload, so that second tab would not reflect the changes until it is refreshed manually. This can open you up to losing your edits if you are making changes with multiple browser tabs.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/why-arent-my-changes-saving#the-solution)

The solution
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Stick to one tab on one web browser. By customizing your site on one browser tab, you can avoid losing your edits and design your site exactly as you envision.

YesNo

# Link to a section of a different page - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/linking-to-a-section-of-a-different-page#content-area)

Linking to specific sections of a page is a valuable tool to help your site visitors navigate your page. Learn to link to a section of a page by using anchor tags. If you are using the Premier Legacy Templates, please refer to the guide [here](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-set-anchor-links-in-your-page-with-premier)
.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/linking-to-a-section-of-a-different-page#adding-an-anchor-tag-to-a-section-of-your-page)

Adding an anchor tag to a section of your page
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

With an anchor tag, you can link to any section of your page containing your added anchor tag. This allows you to “anchor” a section of your page to use for your hyperlink.

*   Click into the **Text Block** you want to lead to, click `<>` in the Text Editor.
*   Then, insert the following code with your desired Anchor Tag.

We recommend creating an Anchor Tag that is relevant to the section. Keep in mind, the URL linking to the Anchor Tag will be visible to the visitors clicking the link.

    <a name="anchor_tag_here"></a>
    

*   Add #AnchorTag to the end of your URL to send your audience to your anchor link.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/linking-to-a-section-of-a-different-page#in-the-example-below)

In the example below

    <a name="virtualclass"></a>
    

The URL to the Anchor is: **[https://help.kajabi.com/#virtualclass](https://help.kajabi.com/#virtualclass)
**

**Note:** The Anchor Tag is case sensitive.For example, if your Anchor Tag is `<a name="VirtualClass"></a>` then your URL must have #**V**irtual**C**lass and not #**v**irtual**c**lass. Notice the difference in the first letter of each word. Be sure to match your URL to your Anchor Tag including any applicable lowercase or uppercase letters.

# Pages explained - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/pages-explained#content-area)

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/pages-explained#why-use-kajabi-pages)

Why use Kajabi Pages?
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

With Kajabi Pages you have the flexibility to build exactly the page you want. But it doesn’t stop there. Here at Kajabi, we asked ourselves, “**What is going to make our customers more successful?**” That’s why Kajabi Pages are built to streamline the process of creating beautiful pages in a way that is simple and painless, to help you showcase your content and get your site up and running in no time. With Kajabi Pages you can:

*   Encourage [Opt-ins](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-add-a-form-to-your-page)
     to grow your list.
*   Display [Video Players](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-create-a-section-with-videos-in-your-page)
    .
*   Create [Sales Pages](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/add-an-offer-to-a-page)
     for your digital products.
*   Custom create an Online Store for [digital](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-add-offers-pricing-sections)
     and [physical products](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-sell-physical-products-on-kajabi-with-shopify-buy-buttons)
    .

And more. To sum it up, Kajabi Pages give you the ability to build and design custom landing pages to help you accomplish your unique vision for your business.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/pages-explained#selecting-your-page-template)

Selecting your page template
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Get started designing your page by first selecting a template that best fits your vision. Kajabi Pages provides you with basic streamlined pages and premium-designed pages to get you up and running:

Read [How to Add Pages to Your Website](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-add-pages-to-your-website)
 to begin building custom landing pages.

**Tip:** Interested in a fast and easy way to start collecting email addresses to build your email list? Use the Lead Generation Page Creator to help you build a Lead Generation Landing Page in just a few simple steps. [Learn how to create a Lead Gen Page](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/create-a-lead-generation-landing-page)
.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/pages-explained#customizing-your-page-settings)

Customizing your page settings
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

After selecting your template, customize your Page Settings before diving into the design of your custom landing page. This will help set up your page to begin designing and adding your content.

*   **[Favicon](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-upload-a-favicon-to-a-page)
    ** is the image displayed in the tab of your web browser to create a more polished look.
*   **[Style Guide](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/customize-your-page-font-and-style-with-the-style-guide)
    ** is used to configure your page colors, fonts, font colors, and font sizes.
*   **[Design Tools](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/build-your-page-with-design-tools)
    ** turn on the grid overlay while designing a page. This shows you a 12-column grid, to help you design your layout.
*   **[Custom Code](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/add-custom-code-to-pages)
    ** allows you to insert custom HTML, CSS or JavaScript into your page. If you are not familiar with CSS or JavaScript, we advise that you either avoid using this section or reach out to our support team to guide you through its functionality.
*   **[Exit Popups](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/add-an-exit-popup-to-a-page)
    ** will appear when your visitor attempts to leave your page.
*   **[Two Step Optin](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-use-the-two-step-optin-popup)
    ** launches an Opt-in Form popup when a button is clicked.

Kajabi Pages are made up of:

*   **[Blocks](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/add-blocks-to-your-page)
    **
*   **[Sections](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/add-sections-to-your-pages)
    **

Each Section of your page is made up of multiple Blocks. For example, the [Text & Image](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-create-a-section-with-images#text-image)
 section includes a Text Block and an Image Block: ![Text & Image section example](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/m6ttm4IwHXcY_OW_/articles/images/70d4a4ac_16607141491739.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=m6ttm4IwHXcY_OW_&q=85&s=fa6be18526087d78d0780a061699b0f1) Kajabi provides you with [preset Sections](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/add-sections-to-your-pages)
 containing specific Blocks to streamline the process of designing your page. Each section is customizable, and regardless of the Section you choose, you can always remove, add, and edit the Blocks within your chosen Section according to your design vision.

**Note:** Although any Section can be replicated by adding or removing Block types, the appearance of your Section may vary due to the optimized design Kajabi has built for you with each preset Section.

Now that you are an expert on Kajabi Pages, we recommend customizing your [Header](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/customizing-your-header)
 and [Footer](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/customizing-your-footer)
 to officially begin designing your page to showcase your brand and business.

# Align blocks in a section - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-align-blocks-in-a-section#content-area)

Learn to vertically align your Blocks in a Section when customizing your pages.

**Tip:** [Enable the grid overlay](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/build-your-page-with-design-tools)
 while designing your page. Enabling the grid tool can help you align your layout to look great every time.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-align-blocks-in-a-section#aligning-blocks-with-equal-height-blocks)

Aligning blocks with equal height blocks
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Enable **Equal Height Blocks** to change the vertical length of each Block in the row to equal the height of the tallest Block in the row:

*   Open the **Website** tab from the Dashboard.
*   Select either **Website Pages** or **Landing Pages**.
*   Open the page editor for your Page. [Learn more](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-get-to-the-page-editor)
    
*   Navigate to the left sidebar panel and select the Section you wish to edit.
*   Scroll to **Section Settings**.
*   Click **Desktop Layout**.
*   Check **Equal Height Blocks** to align all Blocks to the tallest Block in the row (if you have multiple rows in a Section as shown below, repeat for the rows you wish to align).
*   Click **Save** to keep your changes:

**Note:** Enabling **Equal Height Blocks** will not change the height of your uploaded images in order to retain the original image ratio. Instead, your images will vertically align to the top of the tallest Block in the row. For best results with Text Blocks, use an equal number of text lines in each Block.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-align-blocks-in-a-section#aligning-blocks-with-vertical-alignment)

Aligning blocks with vertical alignment
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Vertically align all Blocks in a Section to the top, bottom, or center of the tallest Block in the row by adjusting the Desktop Layout Vertical Alignment setting:

*   Open the **Website** tab from the Dashboard.
*   Select either **Website Pages** or **Landing Pages**.
*   Open the page editor for your Page. [Learn more](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-get-to-the-page-editor)
    
*   Navigate to the left sidebar panel and select the Section you wish to edit.
*   Scroll to **Section Settings**.
*   Click **Desktop Layout**.
*   Open the Vertical Alignment dropdown menu.
*   Select **Top** to align all Blocks to the tallest Block in the row (if you have multiple rows in a Section as shown below, repeat for the rows you wish to align).
*   Click **Save** to keep your changes:

**Note:** Vertical alignment is only available in the Section Settings and is not available in Block Settings. For best results with Text Blocks, use an equal number of text lines in each Block.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-create-a-new-page-with-premier#overview)

Overview
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Build your landing pages with the legacy template, Premier.

**Important:** Creating your landing page with the legacy template, Premier, will not include the newest features available with Kajabi Pages. A page built with Premier cannot be transferred to Kajabi Pages to access the newest features. If you wish to use the Kajabi Pages Templates, please refer to the updated guide [here](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-add-pages-to-your-website)
.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-create-a-new-page-with-premier#creating-a-page-with-premier)

Creating a page with Premier
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

To create a landing page with the legacy template, Premier:

*   Open the **Website** tab from the Dashboard.
*   Click **Pages**.
*   Select the **Landing** page tab.
*   In the top right corner of the page, click **\+ New Landing Page**.
*   Scroll to the very bottom of the page.
*   Click **Kajabi Legacy Templates**.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-build-your-about-page#content-area)

Learn to build a strong brand and share your story with the About page.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-build-your-about-page#what-is-the-about-page)

What is the about page?
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The About page provides a space on your website to:

*   inspire your site visitors,
*   showcase your accomplishments,
*   and personalize your visitors experience with you and your brand.

With the [Website Builder](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/customizing-your-website-pages-with-the-website-builder)
, build and design your About page to share who you are and what you do.

**Note:** The About page is included as a standard website page with the Website Builder. If you have not [made the switch to the Website Builder](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-make-the-switch-to-the-new-website-builder)
, you can create a custom About page with a standalone landing page. [Learn more](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-add-pages-to-your-website)

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-build-your-about-page#how-to-customize-your-about-page)

How to customize your about page
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The About page is not just a space to share who you are, but it is a point of contact for creating a relationship with future customers. With the Website Builder, design an About page that is uniquely yours with the same powerful editing capabilities you have experienced with Kajabi Pages. [Learn to customize your page with the website builder](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/customizing-your-website-pages-with-the-website-builder)
. To begin customizing your About page:

*   Open the **Website** tab from the Dashboard.
*   Click **Pages**.
*   Select **About** from your list of website pages to begin customizing:

With the Website Builder, customize the appearance of your About Page:

*   **Header**: Choose to hide or display your Header and customize the Menu links, your logo, and include hello bar banners to share any announcements directly from your About page. [Learn more](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/customizing-your-header)
    
*   **Add Sections & Blocks** to design a unique page experience that best fits your brand and business. [Learn more about Sections](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/add-sections-to-your-pages)
     & [Learn about Blocks](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/add-blocks-to-your-page)
    
*   **Footer**: Choose to hide or display your Footer and customize its visual appearance to change the copyright, add your own social media links, and adjust the color of the Footer background. [Learn more](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/customizing-your-footer)
    
*   **Exit Popup**: Include an exit popup to display a message upon your customers attempt to exit the page. [Learn more about exit popups](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-use-the-exit-popup-in-your-page-with-premier)
    

**Tip:** Want to add your About page to your navigation menu? Copy your About page link and add it to your desired navigation menu. [Click here to learn more](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-copy-your-page-link)
.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-delete-a-landing-page#overview)

Overview
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Permanently remove a custom website page or a landing page when you no longer need it.

**Important:** Deleting a page cannot be undone and the content within your page once deleted cannot be retrieved. Please be sure to confirm the page you wish to delete before permanently removing it.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-delete-a-landing-page#deleting-a-page)

Deleting a page
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Permanently remove a standalone page or a custom website page from your Pages tab by deleting the page.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-delete-a-landing-page#to-delete-your-page)

To delete your page

*   Open the **Website** tab from your Dashboard.
*   Click **Pages**.
*   Locate the Page you wish to permanently remove.
*   Click `…` next to the page title you want to remove.
*   Check that you are deleting the correct page and click **Delete**.
*   Then, confirm again by selecting **Delete** in the prompt:

**Note:** System pages (such as 404, Login, Library, Blog, Blog Post, Blog Search, Home, Store, Thank You, and Customer Directory) cannot be deleted. Only custom website pages and Landing Pages can be removed.

# Create a telephone link - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-create-a-telephone-link#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-create-a-telephone-link#overview)

Overview
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Add a telephone link to your page with a Call to Action (CTA) button to make it easy for visitors to contact you.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-create-a-telephone-link#what-is-a-telephone-link)

What is a telephone link?
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A telephone link is a click-to-call button used to automatically open the default phone app on a visitor’s device when clicked:

Telephone links can be used to encourage your page visitors to reach out to you with an easy-to-click button. To create a telephone link, include the link `tel:` followed by the phone number you wish to automatically populate in the default phone app of your visitor’s device. For example, the link could be `tel:555-555-5555` to open the phone app with the phone number pre-populated. This helps your user easily contact you via a phone call. Want to add an email link to encourage your page visitors to send an email? [Learn to add a Mailto link with a CTA](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-add-a-mailto-link-with-a-cta)
.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-create-a-telephone-link#how-to-add-a-telephone-link)

How to add a telephone link
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-create-a-telephone-link#step-1-create-a-call-to-action-cta-button)

Step 1. Create a Call to Action (CTA) button

Use a CTA to insert your telephone link in your Pages, Email Campaigns, and Products with a button. We recommend using a Call to Action to link your phone number. Want to learn more about the Call to Action? [Learn to use a Call to Action](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-use-a-call-to-action)
. For the purpose of this guide, we will create a Call to Action (CTA) in a landing page:

*   Open the **Website** tab from the Dashboard.
*   Select the **Pages** tab.
*   Open the page editor for your Page. [Learn more](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-get-to-the-page-editor)
    
*   Navigate to the sidebar panel.
*   Click **Add Section**.
*   Select **Call to Action**.
*   Click **Add**. Your newly created Section will generate at the bottom of your page:

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-create-a-telephone-link#step-2-insert-your-telephone-link)

Step 2. Insert your telephone link

Open the CTA to insert your telephone link:

*   In the sidebar, open the **Text** block.
*   Navigate to Block Settings and click **Call To Action**.
*   Under Button Action, select **Go to a URL**.
*   In the empty field below Button Action, enter your telephone link (e.g., `tel:555-555-5555`).
*   Click **Save** to apply your changes:

**Tip:** [Test your page](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/preview-your-page#h_c1dae47b-74d9-4b05-9bbd-7e59dd06662a)
 with your Call to Action to ensure that everything looks the way you intend.

# Duplicate a website to landing pages - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-duplicate-your-website-to-landing-pages#content-area)

Retain your customization and branding from your website to your landing pages by duplicating any website page (excluding System pages) into a landing page.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-duplicate-your-website-to-landing-pages#overview)

Overview
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

With the website builder you can duplicate any website page (excluding System pages) into a landing page. This allows you to retain your customization and branding from your website to your landing pages.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-duplicate-your-website-to-landing-pages#how-to-duplicate-your-website-page-into-a-landing-page)

How to duplicate your website page into a landing page
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

To add your page to Landing:

1.  Open the **Website** tab from your Dashboard.
2.  Click the **Pages** tab.
3.  Then, locate the custom website page you wish to add to Landing.
4.  Click the `…` menu icon.
5.  Select **\+ Add page to Landing**.
6.  Read the prompt and click **Add page**:

Your duplicated page will display in Landing with the original title and a **Draft** status. You must publish it separately once you are ready. To easily identify your duplicated page, the title will include a copy number suffix. For example, your duplicated page title may state, “Baking Bash Copy 2”: ![Duplicated Page Example](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/uG5M_9Irmb-dLu49/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-8-how-to-duplicate-your-website-to-landing-pages-kajabi-help-center17278028435681727806360257-1756080394373-1759912602587-1768530397720-1769338598618-1770546998803-1775382383107-1780240299047.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=uG5M_9Irmb-dLu49&q=85&s=c19bb9cb5f3de3844ff6153c171a22f7)

**Note:** System pages (such as 404, Login, Library, Blog, Store, and Thank You) cannot be duplicated to Landing Pages. Only custom website pages support this action. If you have reached your plan’s Landing Page limit, the duplication will not proceed.

# Export a landing page - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-export-a-landing-page#content-area)

Export your landing pages to import them onto another Kajabi site or share them as templates with other Heroes.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-export-a-landing-page#overview)

Overview
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Kajabi allows you to export your landing pages so you can reuse them across different sites or share your designs with others. After exporting, you’ll receive an email with a download link for your exported page.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-export-a-landing-page#export-your-page)

Export your page
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Open the **Website** tab from the Dashboard.
2.  Click **Pages**.
3.  Select the **Landing** page folder.
4.  Locate the Landing Page you wish to export.
5.  Open the `…` menu for the page you wish to export.
6.  Select **Export**.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-export-a-landing-page#download-your-exported-page)

Download your exported page
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

After your page has finished exporting, check your email inbox associated with your account for an email from Kajabi Support to download the zip file of your exported page. With your exported file, [import your page](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-duplicate-your-page-to-another-kajabi-site)
 onto a different site on Kajabi or share your page with a friend. ![Exported page email](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/KcN1Ave2wqokJV1G/articles/images/68bb2f4c_8C46C579-9A78-489B-8EF8-3104A4267233.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=KcN1Ave2wqokJV1G&q=85&s=4f0fe5e5e87491a630b0c3256179b7c5)

**Note:** For security purposes, the link provided in the email will expire in 7 days from the date of export. If the link expires before you have the chance to download the zip file, repeat the steps to export to receive a new link.

Embedding allows you to take a video from a video playing platform such as YouTube, Vimeo, or Wistia and post it on your page. People can watch the video directly on your page without leaving your site.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-embed-a-video-to-your-page-with-premier#overview)

Overview
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This guide shows you how to add video embeds to pages built with the Premier legacy templates. You’ll learn how to add a Video Embed Section and paste your video embed code.

**Note:** This article refers to the Premier Legacy Templates, which may be outdated. If you are using the Kajabi Pages Templates, refer to the updated guide [here](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-add-a-video-embed-block)
.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-embed-a-video-to-your-page-with-premier#add-a-video-embed-section)

Add a Video Embed Section
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

To embed video onto your page built with the Premier legacy templates:

1.  Open the **Website** tab from the Dashboard.
2.  Click **Pages**.
3.  Locate the page you wish to customize or [create a new page](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-create-a-new-page-with-premier)
    .
4.  Open the page editor for your page. [Learn more](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-get-to-the-page-editor)

6.  Select **Video Embed**.

8.  Click **Save** to keep your changes.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Step 1. Copy your video embed code

Copy the Embed Code for the video you want to embed on your page. In this example, we are copying the Video Embed Code for a video hosted on YouTube:

1.  Open the video you want to embed.
2.  Click **Share**.
3.  Click **Embed**.
4.  Click **Copy**.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-embed-a-video-to-your-page-with-premier#step-2-paste-your-video-embed-code)

Step 2. Paste your video embed code

Navigate to your Kajabi admin account to paste your copied Embed Code:

1.  Click your Video Embed Section to open the editor.
2.  In the sidebar, paste the Embed Code into the Embed Code field.
3.  Click **Save** to keep your changes.

# Publish and draft a page - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-publish-and-draft-your-page#content-area)

Creating a page will automatically set it to draft. Update your Page Visibility Settings to keep your page hidden as you customize and publish when you’re ready.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-publish-and-draft-your-page#overview)

Overview
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Page visibility settings allow you to control whether your page is live and accessible to visitors or hidden as a draft while you work on it. You can quickly toggle between Published and Draft status using a shortcut or through the Edit Page Details menu.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-publish-and-draft-your-page#default-visibility-for-a-page)

Default visibility for a page
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Creating a page will automatically set your page to draft. Update your Page Visibility Settings to keep your page hidden as you customize your page and publish when you’re ready.

**Note:** A page in draft mode will redirect to your [Standard Website 404 Page](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-build-your-404-page)
. Be sure to customize the 404 Page located in the Design section of your Website tab to match your branding and language if your users attempt to view a Drafted Page.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-publish-and-draft-your-page#change-your-page-visibility-the-shortcut)

Change your page visibility: the shortcut
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Open the **Website** tab from your Dashboard.
2.  Click **Landing Pages**.
3.  Locate the Landing Page you wish to Publish or Draft.
4.  Select the **Visibility Setting (Published or Draft)** to the right of your Page Title.
5.  Select your desired **Visibility Setting (Published or Draft)** from the dropdown menu:

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-publish-and-draft-your-page#change-your-page-visibility-edit-page-details)

Change your page visibility: Edit Page Details
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Open the **Website** tab from your Dashboard.
2.  Click **Landing Pages**.
3.  Click the `…` menu to the right of the Landing Page you wish to Publish or Draft.
4.  Select **Edit Details**.
5.  Navigate to the Page visibility section and select Publish or Draft.
6.  Click **Save** in the lower right corner to apply your changes:

# Upload a favicon and logo used on templates - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-upload-your-favicon-and-logo-used-on-new-templates#content-area)

The Branding section in Site Details will allow you to upload your default logo and favicon that will be used on all newly created Website and Page templates.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-upload-your-favicon-and-logo-used-on-new-templates#what-is-a-favicon)

What is a favicon?
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A favicon is a small icon on a website’s tab or window in your browser. You are probably familiar with the favicon for the sites you frequent, such as the blue Kajabi favicon for this very page: ![Kajabi - The All-In-One Online Business Platform](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/ErhhF8cXbpvObQwR/articles/images/f2d76a0f_Kajabi_-_The_All-In-One_Online_Business_Platform.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=ErhhF8cXbpvObQwR&q=85&s=fc4e05aa87533396dcf30ea482234b6a) While adding a favicon is simple, it is one more way to signal your business’s professionalism and reinforce your brand. Keep in mind, the ideal image file size for favicons is a 32x32 PNG. However, if you upload a bigger image Kajabi will help you resize it.

**Note:** If you have created landing pages before setting your favicon in your Site Settings, you will need to manually add your favicon to each page created prior to setting up your favicon. Pages created after setting your favicon will automatically include your favicon set up in your Site Settings.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-upload-your-favicon-and-logo-used-on-new-templates#upload-your-favicon-and-logo)

Upload your favicon and logo
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   Open the **Settings** tab from your Dashboard.
*   Select **Site Details**.
*   Scroll down to the **Branding** section.
*   Click **Choose a social image** and follow the prompts to upload your image.
*   Click **Save** to keep your changes:

**Tip:** You can still edit the favicon and logo on individual pages in the template editor for a Website or Page. The **Branding** setting will only set the default favicon.

# View page analytics - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-view-your-page-analytics#content-area)

Tracking statistics for individual pages can help you understand the impact an individual page has on your conversion rates. With Kajabi Pages you are able to see the views, opt-ins, and conversions. Learn about your individual page stats.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-view-your-page-analytics#defining-your-page-analytics)

Defining your page analytics
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

![Defining Your Page Analytics](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/Fky1o1xAW1UyWbKo/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-19-page-analytics-1785428660356.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=Fky1o1xAW1UyWbKo&q=85&s=e7ef17fac70df7f7d1cd953a8e27355f) **Views** are the number of Page Views.

*   Use the time frame dropdown located in the top right corner of the **Views and Opt-ins Card** to bring focus to your stats.

**Opt-ins** display the number of Opt-in Forms submitted from the Page.

*   Use the time frame dropdown located in the top right corner of the **Views and Opt-ins Card** to bring focus to your stats.

**Conversion Rate** is the percentage of Opt-ins (Form Submissions) per number of Page Views.

*   Use the time frame dropdown located in the top right corner of the **Conversion Rate Card** to view your conversion rate within a specific period of time.

**Recent Opt-ins** provide insight into the recent activity of your page. View the contacts that submitted a specific Form on the page and view the date the Form was submitted.

**Note:** If your page does not include a Form or a Form has not been submitted the Recent Opt-ins card will not display in your Page Dashboard.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-view-your-page-analytics#view-your-website-page-analytics)

View your Website page analytics
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

View your website page analytics to track the performance of your website pages:

*   Open the **Website** tab from your Dashboard.
*   Click **Pages**.
*   Locate the title of the Website Page you wish to view.
*   Open the three dots menu.
*   Select **View Analytics**.
*   Scroll down the Page Dashboard to view your Page Analytics:

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-view-your-page-analytics#view-your-landing-page-analytics)

View your Landing page analytics
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

View your individual landing page analytics to track the performance of specific pages:

*   Open the **Website** tab from your Dashboard.
*   Open your **Landing** page tab.
*   Locate the title of the Page you wish to view.
*   Open the three dots menu.
*   Select **View Analytics**.
*   Scroll down the Page Dashboard to view your Page Analytics:

Looking for additional Page View information? [Click here to learn more about your unique page views](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/analytics/report-page-views)
.

**Note:** Page stats cannot be reset. Instead, duplicate your page and edit the URL to reflect the original page to begin tracking stats. Learn to [duplicate your page](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/duplicate-a-page)
 and [edit your page details](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/customize-your-page-details)
.

> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/what-is-the-difference-between-premier-and-encore#content-area)

Your Kajabi site consists of [**Website Pages**](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/pages-overview#website-pages)
, [**Landing Pages**](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/pages-overview#landing-pages)
, and [**Funnel Pages**](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/pages-overview#funnel-pages)
 . Each of these page types has its own **Page Editor**, which has tools and features to help you customize them. There are three versions available: [Nova](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/nova-theme-overview)
, an AI-first Page Editor and theme; **Encore**, which includes advanced customization options; and **Premier**, the legacy editor.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/what-is-the-difference-between-premier-and-encore#access-a-page-editor)

Access a Page Editor

1.  From the dashboard, open the **Website** tab.
2.  Click **Website Pages** or **Landing Pages**, or **Funnels** tab.
3.  Locate the page you wish to edit.
4.  Select one of three ways to open the editor:
    *   Click its **Page Title**
    *   Click the **(cookie) Customize icon**
    *   Click the **more options (…) icon** and select **Edit design**

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/what-is-the-difference-between-premier-and-encore#nova)

Nova
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Nova** is a Page Editor and theme designed from the ground up for building with AI. Instead of filling in a fixed template, you describe the page you want and the [**MCP**](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/api-integrations/connect-kajabi-to-claude-or-chatgpt)
 composes it for you, which produces modern, distinctive layouts rather than the same template with different words. Nova works as the foundation for AI-generated pages. Kajabi’s existing Encore and Premier themes still work as designed. Nova is an additional option, not a replacement. 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/what-is-the-difference-between-premier-and-encore#encore)

Encore
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The **Encore** Page Editor is continually updated with features, and is alternatively referred to as the **Website Builder**. Encore includes advanced customization options. Read how to switch from Premier to the Website Builder in this [article](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-make-the-switch-to-the-new-website-builder)
.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/what-is-the-difference-between-premier-and-encore#premier)

Premier
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Premier** is the legacy Page Editor. Premier offers a streamlined approach to website and page design, while Encore offers more customization options. Premier Website and Landing Page themes are referred to as “Legacy Themes”. You will need to choose a Legacy Theme if you wish to build a website or [Landing Page](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-create-a-new-page-with-premier)
 in Premier. [Learn more about Legacy Themes](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/website-templates-overview)
.

| **Sections** | **Descriptions** |
| --- | --- |
| [**Accordion**](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-add-an-accordion-section-to-your-premier-page) | Compile a list of FAQ’s or general information to share with users. |
| [**Assessment**](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-add-an-assessment-to-your-page-with-premier) | Collect information from users or test their knowledge using an Assessment. |
| [**Blog Posts**](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-add-blog-posts-to-your-page-with-premier) | Show recent posts from your Blog in reverse chronological order. |
| [**Countdown Timer**](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-add-a-countdown-to-your-page-with-premier) | Use this section to show when an event is going to begin or to countdown to an Offer expiration date. |
| [**Call To Action**](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-use-a-call-to-action-in-your-page-with-premier) | A response button that can redirect the user to a page, Offer checkout, trigger a download, open a two step opt-in, or lead to any URL. |
| [**Custom Code**](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-embed-custom-code-to-your-page-with-premier) | Embed custom code in a page. |

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/what-is-the-difference-between-premier-and-encore#premier-vs-encore)

Premier vs. Encore
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

While both Premier and Encore offer great customization options and include all you need to set up Website and Landing Pages, there are some key differences between the two. The table below shows the features offered by each.

| **Features** | **Encore** | **Premier** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Accordion](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-add-an-accordion-section-to-your-premier-page)<br> vs [FAQ](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-add-an-faq-section) | Both | Accordion |
| [Block Width Adjustment](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-customize-the-block-width) | Yes | No  |
| Desktop/Mobile Layout Option | Yes | No  |
| Categorized + Add Section Feature | Yes | No  |
| Search Bar in Edit Page | Yes | No  |
| [Facebook Comment Section](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-add-facebook-comments-to-your-page) | No  | Yes |
| [Animations](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/customizing-block-animations) | Yes | No  |
| Mobile/Desktop Layout Options | Yes | No  |

# Embed a third-party audio player to a page - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-embed-a-third-party-audio-player-to-a-page#content-area)

Whether you want to showcase a podcast, music, or a voice message, audio can be a great way to grab your viewer’s attention.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-embed-a-third-party-audio-player-to-a-page#overview)

Overview
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Kajabi allows you to embed third-party audio players on your pages using the Custom Code block. This gives you the flexibility to use popular audio platforms like Spotify, SoundCloud, JW Player, or Apple Music to share audio content with your audience.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-embed-a-third-party-audio-player-to-a-page#step-1-find-the-perfect-audio-player)

Step 1. Find the perfect audio player
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The first step is finding which audio player will be best for you and your brand. There are many free audio players to choose from, so deciding which one is best may require a bit of research. Popular choices include:

*   [JW Player](https://www.jwplayer.com/)
    
*   [SoundCloud](https://soundcloud.com/)
    
*   [Spotify](https://www.spotify.com/)
    
*   [Apple Music](https://www.apple.com/apple-music/)
    

Once your content has been uploaded to a player, the next step is to create a Custom Code Block to embed the code on your site.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-embed-a-third-party-audio-player-to-a-page#step-2-add-a-custom-code-block)

Step 2. Add a custom code block
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Open the **Website** tab from the Dashboard.
2.  Select the **Pages** tab.
3.  Open the page editor for your page. [Learn more](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-get-to-the-page-editor)
    
4.  In the sidebar panel, click the Section you want to edit or [create a new Section](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/add-sections-to-your-pages)
    .
5.  From the list, select **Custom Code**.
6.  Your newly created Custom Code Block will generate at the bottom of the Section.
7.  Click **Save** to keep your changes.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-embed-a-third-party-audio-player-to-a-page#step-3-enter-the-embed-code-for-the-third-party-player)

Step 3. Enter the embed code for the third party player
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Important:** Introducing custom code to your site can open you up to vulnerabilities and potential malware attacks. We recommend using vulnerability tools like [VirusTotal](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/home/url)
 or [Snyk](https://snyk.io/)
 to scan any custom code that you intend to use and apply certain [best practices](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/code-based-customizations)
 to help reduce potential impact.

1.  In your page, hover over the existing Custom Code Block you want to edit and click **Edit**.
2.  In the Code field, paste a copied embed code or enter your custom code. For this tutorial, we used Spotify’s player embed code, but the process should remain the same for all other player embed codes.
3.  Click **Save** to keep your changes.

# Edit the text editor color picker for pages - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-edit-the-text-editor-color-picker-for-your-pages#content-area)

Create a simple, standout design with colors that match your brand using the text editor color picker.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-edit-the-text-editor-color-picker-for-your-pages#overview)

Overview
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Kajabi helps you design smart pages by automatically adjusting text color based on the brightness of your selected background. For example, if you choose a dark background, the text color changes to stand out. If you select a light background, the text takes on a darker tone. You can also override these dynamic colors and define your own branded text and background colors using the site brand settings.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-edit-the-text-editor-color-picker-for-your-pages#customizing-your-color-palette)

Customizing your color palette
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

By default, Kajabi adjusts text color based on your background brightness:

To determine your own branded text and background colors, select your desired colors for both text and background to override the dynamically adjusting text colors. When changing text color in the text editor, select from your site brand colors to streamline the build and design of your pages.

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-edit-the-text-editor-color-picker-for-your-pages#change-your-site-brand-colors)

Change your site brand colors
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Open the **Settings** tab from your Dashboard.
2.  Click **Site Details**.
3.  Scroll to **Colors**.
4.  Click each color you wish to change to create your desired custom color.
5.  Click **Save** to keep and apply your changes.

[Learn more about your Site Brand Settings](https://help.kajabi.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037850453)

* * *

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-edit-the-text-editor-color-picker-for-your-pages#create-a-custom-color)

Create a custom color
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

To create your custom color palette, click the color you wish to change and enter your RGB color code in the bottom right field or use the sliders to select your color:

*   Use the **vertical bar** to select the hue
*   Use the **square box** to adjust the saturation and brightness of your color
*   Use the **horizontal bar** to adjust opacity of your color
*   Use the **color code box** to insert a pre-designed custom code

**Note:** You can find hundreds of pre-customized codes online or by using [this site](https://htmlcolorcodes.com/color-names/)
.

![Site Settings Color Picker](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/EFdfkzsgcSmbPght/articles/images/c82be3f6_41917702664475.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=EFdfkzsgcSmbPght&q=85&s=8f422285b4625fc69565d1b5c2902f94)

# Add and remove Upsells and Downsells - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-add-and-remove-upsells-and-downsells#content-area)

Maximize your profit by adding **Upsells and Downsells** to your order flow. Your customers can choose to purchase additional product(s) after completing their initial purchase.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-add-and-remove-upsells-and-downsells#upsells-and-downsells)

Upsells and Downsells
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-add-and-remove-upsells-and-downsells#what-is-an-upsell)

What is an Upsell?

An Upsell is used as a way to advertise another Offer after the initial Offer has been purchased. A user will complete a purchase and the Upsell will appear as a separate page after checking out and before the account creation page: ![Upsell page](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/uG5M_9Irmb-dLu49/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-6-upsell-preview-page-1756080390967-1768530399322-1769338597512-1775382383088-1780240402726.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=uG5M_9Irmb-dLu49&q=85&s=a78b23a368e39135aa886238e9ce5d9d)

**Note:** Add up to 10 upsells and downsells to your Offer checkout process. Standard business practice is to use between 3 - 4 upsells and downsells to avoid overwhelming your customers.

The upsell page will ask your customer to make an additional purchase. Your customer can then choose to purchase the Upsell or decline the Upsell. Afterward, they will be redirected to the account creation page to set up their account details. [Learn more about what happens when a customer purchases an Offer](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/what-happens-when-a-customer-purchases-my-offer)
.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-add-and-remove-upsells-and-downsells#what-is-a-downsell)

What is a Downsell?

A Downsell is another Offer presented to customers that decline to purchase the Upsell. This gives you a second chance to make an additional sale if your customer declines the original Upsell. Downsells are typically lower-priced Offers, a discount on the same Product, or an Offer for a completely new Product. [Learn more about adding and editing Downsells](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-add-and-edit-a-downsell)
.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-add-and-remove-upsells-and-downsells#add-an-upsell)

Add an Upsell
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-add-and-remove-upsells-and-downsells#add-an-upsell-to-a-paid-offer)

Add an Upsell to a paid Offer

1.  First, [create an Offer](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/create-an-offer)
     to use as an **Upsell**
2.  Then, return to your Offers Dashboard and select the Offer you wish to attach your Upsell to
3.  Navigate to the Cross-selling tab and click **Get Started**
4.  In the dropdown menu, select the **Offer** you want to use as the Upsell
5.  Add a **Title** and **Description** for your Upsell, and optionally upload a Video and customize the Purchase and Cancel button text
6.  Click **Add Upsell** to apply your changes
7.  Finally, toggle your Upsell to **Active** to ensure your customers will see it when checking out

**Tip:** Add up to 10 upsells to your Offer checkout process. Standard business practice is to use between 3 - 4 upsells and downsells to avoid overwhelming your customers.

**Note:** Upsells can only be added to paid offers. This means that Users with a 100% off coupon for an Offer with an Upsell will not be given the Upsell because it is no longer a paid offer with their coupon applied. [Learn more about troubleshooting your Upsell](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/can-upsells-be-used-with-a-free-offer)
.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-add-and-remove-upsells-and-downsells#preview-your-upsell)

Preview your upsell
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

View your upsell purchase experience by clicking `...` to the right of your Upsell status and selecting **Preview**: ![Preview upsell](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/AIdS_N2hx9dBLwx9/articles/images/37af67da_image.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=AIdS_N2hx9dBLwx9&q=85&s=90fe3aae1bca58e53e155910790f028a) If you want to test your customer experience with multiple Upsells or Downsells in your Offer, decline to purchase each Upsell or Downsell in order to see each page when previewing.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-add-and-remove-upsells-and-downsells#remove-an-upsell)

Remove an Upsell
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-add-and-remove-upsells-and-downsells#remove-an-upsell-from-an-offer)

Remove an Upsell from an Offer

1.  Open the **Sales** tab from the Dashboard
2.  Click **Offers**
3.  Select the Offer from which you’d like to remove the Upsell
4.  Navigate to the **Cross-selling** tab on the Offer page
5.  On the Cross-selling page, click the `…` menu next to the Upsell Offer
6.  Click **Remove** to delete it

**Note:** If you’ve added a Downsell to your Upsell, you must delete it first prior to deleting the top-level Upsell.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/how-to-make-a-translation-request#overview)

Overview
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

We do our best to catch grammatical errors or inaccurate wording in our app, but we can’t catch everything — especially in languages other than English. Currently, there is no option for you to make changes directly. To submit a formal request to change any particular wording, reach out to our support team.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/how-to-make-a-translation-request#information-to-provide)

Information to provide
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Include the following information when you submit your request:

*   The URL
*   A screenshot of the translation error/request
*   The word or phrase you would like changed
*   The word or phrase you would like us to use instead

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/how-to-make-a-translation-request#requests-that-are-typically-approved)

Requests that are typically approved
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   Grammatical errors
*   Typos

**Note:**Info/warning/error messages still appear in English and cannot be changed at this time.

# Kajabi Hero Community (KHC) - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabi-hero-community-khc#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabi-hero-community-khc#overview)

Overview
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The **Kajabi Hero Community** exists to empower, educate, and connect Heroes with each other and with Kajabi employees — so you can build and grow with confidence. This is a trusted space for accurate Kajabi info, product updates, best practices, and Hero wins that help others see what’s possible. The community is a positive, supportive, and focused environment where Heroes can connect, learn, and grow together. Community guidelines reflect our core values and goals to ensure the best experience for everyone.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabi-hero-community-khc#key-benefits)

Key benefits

*   A space designed around the Hero journey, not algorithms or outside agendas
*   Purposeful channels based on where you are in your business journey and what you are building
*   A clutter-free environment that respects your time, energy, and attention
*   A community rooted in Kajabi itself, with the same clarity and care we put into the product
*   A faster-improving product, because we use the Community right alongside you — every friction point becomes a fix, and the whole experience evolves faster for everyone

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabi-hero-community-khc#access-the-khc)

Access the KHC
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Log in to your Kajabi account.
2.  From your **Dashboard**, click your name in the upper right corner.
3.  Select **Kajabi Community**.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabi-hero-community-khc#khc-channels)

KHC Channels
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

In the **Community sidebar**, you will find several Channels listed that you may post in, each with a unique purpose. ![KHC Sidebar](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/jr10YKvFYk7-UzP1/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-9-kajabi-hero-community-1782636378411-1784126776587-1784151916690.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=jr10YKvFYk7-UzP1&q=85&s=b7a329bc26ddb1e69a2907ab01782f12) General posts about Kajabi products or topics belong in the **Discussions** channel. Feel free to introduce yourself — what are you building and where are you in your journey? Share celebrations and Kajabi milestones in the **Wins** channel, find answers and inspiration in the **Resources** channel, and share your product feedback, ideas, and bug reports through the [Kajabi Ideas Portal](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/how-to-submit-product-feedback-and-ideas)
. Post often — questions, roadblocks, and victories are welcome, but discuss only Kajabi product-related topics within KHC channels. This ensures the community remains a valuable resource and prevents the group from becoming overwhelmed with unrelated content.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabi-hero-community-khc#product-updates-channel)

Product Updates Channel

This Channel contains posts written by Kajabi staff and is the source for feature announcements, performance improvements, and tips on getting the most out of releases.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabi-hero-community-khc#submit-feedback-and-ideas-through-the-kajabi-ideas-portal)

Submit feedback and ideas through the Kajabi Ideas Portal

To share product feedback/ideas or to report a functionality issue, select either **Feedback Portal** or **Bug Reports** in the **KHC sidebar**.

**Note:** Clicking either **Feedback Portal** or **Bug Reports** opens the portal in a separate window.

The [Kajabi Ideas Portal](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/how-to-submit-product-feedback-and-ideas)
 gives Heroes the power to influence feature ideas and product roadmaps. Keeping everything in one place helps our teams understand your ideas, prioritize improvements, and communicate updates more effectively. By posting in the portal, you automatically receive email notifications as updates occur on posts you have created, voted for, or commented on. Directing feedback to the portal ensures your suggestions and concerns are properly reviewed and considered by the right product team. [Learn more about the Portal](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/how-to-submit-product-feedback-and-ideas)
.

# Resolve login issues across platforms - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/resolving-login-issues-on-kajabi-across-platforms#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/resolving-login-issues-on-kajabi-across-platforms#overview)

Overview
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Login issues can differ between desktop, mobile app, and web browser environments. This article walks you through common challenges and how to resolve them.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/resolving-login-issues-on-kajabi-across-platforms#understand-roles-admin-login-vs-member-login)

Understand roles: admin login vs. member login
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Kajabi has two distinct roles, and knowing which one applies to you is essential for logging in correctly:

*   **Site Owners/Admins**: Use the general Kajabi login portal at [app.kajabi.com](https://app.kajabi.com/)
    . Admins manage site settings and content and cannot access courses through standard member login portals.
*   **Members/Customers**: Access courses exclusively through the specific site of the Hero whose content you purchased. For web login, always use the specific URL provided by the course creator (e.g., \[SITE\].mykajabi.com). Avoid using the admin portal.

**Note:**Using the admin login URL for member or course access will not work and may display an error like _account blocked_. Always confirm you are entering credentials on the correct platform.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/resolving-login-issues-on-kajabi-across-platforms#common-login-problems-and-resolutions)

Common login problems and resolutions
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/resolving-login-issues-on-kajabi-across-platforms#log-in-from-a-web-browser)

Log in from a web browser

#### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/resolving-login-issues-on-kajabi-across-platforms#issue)

Issue

You cannot log in from a desktop browser even though you are successfully logged in on the Kajabi app.

#### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/resolving-login-issues-on-kajabi-across-platforms#solutions)

Solutions

*   Visit the specific course provider’s website and log in using your member credentials.
*   If you have forgotten the password, use the **Forgot Password** link on the course site, complete the email-based password reset process, and log in.
*   Avoid using the admin portal ([app.kajabi.com](https://app.kajabi.com/)
    ) for member logins.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/resolving-login-issues-on-kajabi-across-platforms#log-in-from-the-kajabi-mobile-app)

Log in from the Kajabi mobile app

#### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/resolving-login-issues-on-kajabi-across-platforms#issue-2)

Issue

You cannot log in to the Kajabi mobile app even though you are successfully logged in on the web.

#### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/resolving-login-issues-on-kajabi-across-platforms#solutions-2)

Solutions

*   Confirm you are using the correct login credentials for the specific course provider’s site.
*   If you have forgotten the password, reset it through the course provider’s website before attempting to log in again on the mobile app.
*   Make sure the app is updated to the latest version.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/resolving-login-issues-on-kajabi-across-platforms#troubleshooting)

Troubleshooting
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **Clear browser cache and cookies**: Stored data can sometimes cause login issues
*   **Try a different browser**: If one browser is not working, try another
*   **Check your internet connection**: A weak connection can prevent successful logins
*   **Disable browser extensions**: Some extensions may interfere with the login process
