# Design logos and graphics with Canva - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/how-to-design-logos-and-graphics-with-canva#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/how-to-design-logos-and-graphics-with-canva#overview)

Overview
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Canva is a great, nearly free tool that allows you to create all the images, logos, and graphics you need for a consistent look across your Kajabi courses and business.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/how-to-design-logos-and-graphics-with-canva#create-a-canva-account)

Create a Canva account
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Set up an account at [Canva.com](http://www.canva.com/)
 using Facebook, Email, or other social media accounts. If you choose not to use your social media account, you will need to wait for and click on a verification email.

1.  Once you have created your account you will see this header:

![Canva Header](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/ErhhF8cXbpvObQwR/articles/images/f115068e_canva_1.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=ErhhF8cXbpvObQwR&q=85&s=dd9428224d7edc5892c50e9673cfe712)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/how-to-design-logos-and-graphics-with-canva#choose-a-template-for-a-graphic-or-logo)

Choose a template for a graphic or logo
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Choose what type of graphic you are going to create, whether it is a logo for your business or courses, a poster for a live event, or a header for your Facebook account. Canva has templates for every occasion. If you cannot find a template that fits your idea, create a custom dimension by clicking on the box in the upper right corner: ![Canva Templates](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/VkTxgCuL_efk5MYH/articles/images/02d996eb_canva_2.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=VkTxgCuL_efk5MYH&q=85&s=a25856875a5c0b5263c0aab44e40b029)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/how-to-design-logos-and-graphics-with-canva#design-a-logo)

Design a logo
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Once you select a logo from the business section of templates, you will see a variety of layouts, elements, and options: ![Canva Logo Designer](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/dM5M-GS8a4ZpE9E0/articles/images/92ce837f_canva_3.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=dM5M-GS8a4ZpE9E0&q=85&s=1acf60040ac33ec303a50c6b5e4a82d4)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/how-to-design-logos-and-graphics-with-canva#customize-a-logo-or-graphic)

Customize a logo or graphic
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Select a template and click **UPLOADS** to add your own photos such as a headshot or any other images you may want to include on the logo:

![Canva Uploads](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/PGtO8PCuc_NzdaFE/articles/images/cfa4608c_DL4.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=PGtO8PCuc_NzdaFE&q=85&s=6ad7090e337dd014a0110ffc08b3b944)

2.  Add elements such as grids, charts, and icons by clicking the **ELEMENTS** tab:

![Canva Elements](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/qzToDq-sR9DK0LoF/articles/images/6dad26f1_DL5.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=qzToDq-sR9DK0LoF&q=85&s=8948d2b4e695342fd346285e699b5764)

3.  Canva also offers stock images and illustrations that you can buy for $1 when you search for a term in the search bar:

![Canva Stock Images](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/N3VXT8aMWFKAgK0L/articles/images/c58d8fd9_Social_Media_____Untitled_Design.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=N3VXT8aMWFKAgK0L&q=85&s=9460ef0bce5999f730c2f17e63e2cc6e)

4.  Once you have experimented with different layouts and elements, added your own text including your brand name, and set the background to your desired color, save and download your logo.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/how-to-design-logos-and-graphics-with-canva#download-and-share-a-logo)

Download and share a logo
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Save your logo by clicking **File** then **Save**. While Canva does auto-save every few minutes, make sure you save your work each time you exit the program or after making changes. To download your logo:

1.  Click **Download** in the top right corner.
2.  Select your preferred file format (PNG recommended for logos).
3.  Click **Download** to save the file to your computer.

You can then upload your logo to Kajabi for use on your website, courses, and marketing materials.

# Submit product feedback and ideas - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/how-to-submit-product-feedback-and-ideas#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/how-to-submit-product-feedback-and-ideas#overview)

Overview
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The Kajabi Ideas Portal allows Heroes to submit feature requests, vote on ideas, and track product roadmap updates. Keeping everything in one place helps our teams understand your ideas, prioritize improvements, and communicate updates more effectively. You automatically receive email notifications as updates occur on posts you have created, voted for, or commented on.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/how-to-submit-product-feedback-and-ideas#access-the-kajabi-ideas-portal)

Access the Kajabi Ideas Portal
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The Kajabi Ideas Portal can be accessed by visiting **[feedback.kajabi.com](https://feedback.kajabi.com/)
.**

1.  Click the **Log in** button in the upper right corner.
2.  Enter your Kajabi credentials.

![Screenshot 2026 05 14 At 1 01 32 PM](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/LfizvcVjxLrKBo9s/images/Screenshot-2026-05-14-at-1.01.32-PM.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=LfizvcVjxLrKBo9s&q=85&s=5c2df222ca946c8e964716cb3af5f8af)

3.  Once logged in, you will see the product roadmap, which provides a transparent view of where each idea is in the development process.

![Screenshot 2026 05 14 At 1 03 22 PM](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/LfizvcVjxLrKBo9s/images/Screenshot-2026-05-14-at-1.03.22-PM.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=LfizvcVjxLrKBo9s&q=85&s=e1ef496fa72e0b5d8de7a2821d6e631b)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/how-to-submit-product-feedback-and-ideas#submit-ideas-and-feedback)

Submit ideas and feedback
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The Kajabi Ideas Portal is designed to make sharing ideas and feedback fast and easy.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/how-to-submit-product-feedback-and-ideas#choose-which-board-to-submit-to)

Choose which board to submit to

*   **Feature Request**: Something you wish Kajabi could do. If there is a capability or tool you wish existed inside Kajabi, add it here. Tell us what outcome you are trying to create.
*   **Unclear Design**: Something that exists today but feels confusing, slow, or harder than it should be. Share the exact moment where the workflow breaks, feels clunky, or makes you hesitate. This helps us remove friction and simplify the experience.
*   **Lack of Guidance**: Something you are trying to do but feel stuck, unsure, or unclear about. If you are not sure which step to take, how to structure something, or what best practice to follow, tell us. This feeds improvements to coaching, onboarding, and product guidance.
*   **Bug Reports**: If you are experiencing a bug that is not critical to your business, share it here. If a bug is blocking you from critical actions (such as your checkout not working), contact us through [support@kajabi.com](mailto:support@kajabi.com)
     or the conversation widget in your account.

![Screenshot 2026 05 14 At 1 03 41 PM](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/T7HThu_bu5xEvH2P/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-1-kajabi-ideas-portal-boards-1785428325841.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=T7HThu_bu5xEvH2P&q=85&s=0a54bc66d08f21e9d7c754f7a0454bfa)

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/how-to-submit-product-feedback-and-ideas#submit-an-idea)

Submit an idea

1.  Start typing your idea in the **Details** section. If there is already a similar post, other posts will automatically be recommended for you.
2.  If you see your idea already listed, **upvote** that post instead.
3.  If not, continue creating your post by selecting the **Category** and **Impact on Business**.
4.  If you have a current workaround for the requested feature, include it in the **current workaround** field.
5.  Click **Submit Idea** once you are satisfied with your request.

![Screenshot 2026 05 14 At 1 04 30 PM](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/LfizvcVjxLrKBo9s/images/Screenshot-2026-05-14-at-1.04.30-PM.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=LfizvcVjxLrKBo9s&q=85&s=a932f2ec0b78afe48afb5b5a55877bcd)

**Note:**If your feedback is similar to an existing post, it may be merged to keep related ideas together.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/how-to-submit-product-feedback-and-ideas#vote-on-a-post)

Vote on a post
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

To support an existing idea by upvoting:

1.  Click the **upvote arrow** found to the right of any post to add your vote.
2.  Click the same arrow again to remove your vote if you change your mind.

![Screenshot 2026 05 14 At 1 04 07 PM](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/T7HThu_bu5xEvH2P/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-1-vote-on-a-post-1785428326637.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=T7HThu_bu5xEvH2P&q=85&s=51cf3c0028f0811e25f255d316584e6f)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/how-to-submit-product-feedback-and-ideas#comment-on-a-post)

Comment on a post
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Add comments to share more details, context, or examples to strengthen your feedback.

1.  Click into the post you wish to comment on.
2.  Enter your comment, then click **SUBMIT** to post your comment.

![Screenshot 2026 05 14 At 1 09 04 PM](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/T7HThu_bu5xEvH2P/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-1-comment-on-a-post-1785428327184.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=T7HThu_bu5xEvH2P&q=85&s=0df3b6b5debff1d8ee15dbc672d7239c)

# Kajabi sales calls and demos - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/does-kajabi-offer-sales-calls-or-demos#content-area)

Kajabi does not currently offer sales calls. However, you can learn the [ABCs of Kajabi from our Demo page.](https://www.kajabi.com/demo)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/does-kajabi-offer-sales-calls-or-demos#start-a-free-trial)

# Kajabi swag shipment changes - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabi-swag-shipment-changes#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabi-swag-shipment-changes#overview)

Overview
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The European Union implemented changes to value-added tax (VAT) rules that affect how Kajabi swag shipments are handled for EU recipients.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabi-swag-shipment-changes#eu-vat-rule-changes)

EU VAT rule changes
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

As of July 1st, 2021, the European Union requires VAT on all orders, regardless of value.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabi-swag-shipment-changes#impact-on-swag-shipments)

Impact on swag shipments
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

VAT is collected after import and prior to delivery by the shipment carrier (i.e. your local postal service). If you qualify for Kajabi swag, you are responsible for paying these VAT fees to receive your swag box. The fees are based on the value of the item(s) being shipped and are roughly 21% of the total item value.

**Warning:**If the fees are not processed and successfully paid for by the recipient, the shipment will be returned to the sender.

# Kajabi's Data Protection Addendum and Standard Contractual Clauses - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabis-updated-data-protection-addendum-for-the-new-standard-contractual-clauses#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabis-updated-data-protection-addendum-for-the-new-standard-contractual-clauses#overview)

Overview
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Have questions about Kajabi’s Data Protection Addendum (DPA)? This article covers frequently asked questions to help you understand the changes.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabis-updated-data-protection-addendum-for-the-new-standard-contractual-clauses#faqs)

FAQs
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabis-updated-data-protection-addendum-for-the-new-standard-contractual-clauses#why-has-kajabi-updated-the-data-protection-addendum-dpa-)

Why has Kajabi updated the Data Protection Addendum (DPA)?

We revised our [Terms of Service Agreement](https://kajabi.com/policies/terms)
 and Data Protection Addendum (DPA) to include the Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) as published by the European Commission on June 4th, 2021.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabis-updated-data-protection-addendum-for-the-new-standard-contractual-clauses#how-does-this-change-impact-me)

How does this change impact me?

The updates to the DPA are only applicable if you use Kajabi to process European Economic Area (EEA) data or data within the [jurisdictions outlined](https://assets.website-files.com/5db0d55a083f4b7cd59d2e42/61524b42156de002fe9cdfb9_Kajabi-%20DPA%20September%202021.pdf)
 in the agreement.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabis-updated-data-protection-addendum-for-the-new-standard-contractual-clauses#what-do-i-need-to-do)

What do I need to do?

If you are subject to our DPA, no additional action is required. The DPA automatically becomes part of your agreement with us effective September 27th, 2021.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabis-updated-data-protection-addendum-for-the-new-standard-contractual-clauses#when-is-the-dpa-effective)

When is the DPA effective?

The DPA was automatically effective on September 27th, 2021 for all Heroes who have agreed to our Terms of Service Agreement. All contracts made after September 27th, 2021 must use the SCCs. Pre-existing contracts automatically transitioned to the SCCs starting December 22nd, 2022, where applicable.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabis-updated-data-protection-addendum-for-the-new-standard-contractual-clauses#will-there-be-any-other-changes-to-the-dpa)

Will there be any other changes to the DPA?

We have made changes to the DPA for the benefit of our global Heroes. We work to consistently stay abreast of all domestic and global regulations relating to data protection and make updates as deemed necessary.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabis-updated-data-protection-addendum-for-the-new-standard-contractual-clauses#what-changes-do-the-eu%E2%80%99s-sccs-contain)

What changes do the EU’s SCCs contain?

The European Commission updated the SCCs to address additional structures of processing activities that exist in today’s world, including the GDPR and the Schrems II decision. These requirements apply additional transparency and notification controls. The SCCs are modular, enabling them to be tailored to the specific type of transfer. The clauses have been expanded to include controller-to-controller, controller-to-processor, processor-to-processor, and processor-to-controller transfer, which align better to transfer paradigms in use globally today.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabis-updated-data-protection-addendum-for-the-new-standard-contractual-clauses#how-are-the-sccs-applicable-to-me)

How are the SCCs applicable to me?

If you are using Kajabi to transfer personal data originating from the EEA, the UK, and/or Switzerland, then the SCCs are the valid transfer mechanism to make these transfers. If you have a global membership, these updates allow for better alignment to your responsibilities of compliance under GDPR and other data protection regulations globally.

# Kajabi Glossary - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabi-glossary#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabi-glossary#overview)

Overview
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This glossary covers the different features, Kajabi terminology, and how they are used in Kajabi.

**Tip:**Search for terms by holding **CMD**+**F** on a Mac or **CTRL**+**F** on Windows. Enter the term you are searching for and click **Enter** until you locate it.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabi-glossary#dashboard-terms)

Dashboard terms
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Dashboard** is your home base. This is the screen you see each time you log into your Kajabi account. Read [Navigate the Dashboard](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/account-settings/my-kajabi/dashboard-explained)
 for details.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabi-glossary#stat-cards)

Stat cards

**Opt-Ins** are the number of people that have opted into a form over the last 30 days. This indicator allows you to see at a glance how many subscribers have been added to your list. **Sales** reflect, as a whole, how much money you have made on Kajabi in the past 30 days. Read [Analytics overview](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/analytics/analytics-overview)
 for more details. **Comments** allow you to see how many comments you have received on all products and on all lessons. Read [Manage Course comments](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/courses/how-to-manage-course-comments)
 for details. **Customers** reflect the number of people who have been granted or have purchased an offer over the past 30 days. Read [Differentiate between customers and contacts](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/contacts/manage-your-contacts/what-is-the-difference-between-a-customer-contact-and-a-subscriber)
 for details.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabi-glossary#product-terms)

Product terms
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabi-glossary#products)

Products

**Products** are a digital service that can be delivered online. A product is most commonly a course, a membership, a community, a resource center, or a webinar replay. Read [Create a Product](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/courses/courses-overview)
 for details. **Membership** is a Product where you can add content on a pre-agreed basis where customers pay you a recurring fee in exchange for access to your membership content. Read [Create a Product](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/courses/courses-overview)
 for details. **Community** is where your customers can virtually connect and discuss mediated and unmediated topics. A Kajabi **Community**, like a Facebook group, allows you to add customers to interact with one another. As the administrator, you can build an interactive and engaging space with your customers. Create topics, organize groups of people, and assign access to your Community members. [Learn more about Kajabi Communities](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/community/build-kajabi-communities)
. **Template** is a pre-built template with a product outline already created as a guide. While templates are pre-built, you can edit them in any way you see fit. You can add modules, lessons, and assessments as needed. The template acts as a guide. Read [Create a Product](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/courses/courses-overview)
 for details on different Product Templates, creating your Product, and Memberships and Communities in Kajabi. **Product Outline** is where you can organize and add content to your Product. Read [View a Product Outline](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/courses/how-to-view-your-course-outline)
 for details. **Module** is a way to break up your content so your customers can easily see the different topics available to them in your Product. Read [Create a Module](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/courses/course-modules)
 for details. **Lesson** is the home for each individual piece of your content. A lesson is where you can add your videos, text, downloadable files, automations, and an image. The lessons are the individual sections within a certain module. Read [Create a Product Lesson](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/courses/create-a-lesson)
 for details. **Quiz** allows you to test your Course customers’ learning at any point in your Course using a variety of different question types. Learn more about [Quizzes in Kajabi](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/courses/course-quizzes)
. **Assessment** is a test or a survey that allows you to gather information from your customers before, during, or after the course is complete. Learn more about [Assessments in Kajabi](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/contacts/create-manage-and-share-assessments/create-and-customize-assessments)
. **Product Preview** is the view of your Product your customers will see. Read [Preview a Product](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/courses/how-to-preview-your-product)
 for details. **Drip** allows you to release modules of content X number of days after your customer has purchased your Offer. When adding in Drip days, add onto the original number. For example, 7, 14, 21 days for dripped modules. Read [Use Drip content to release Product Lessons over time](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/courses/schedule-and-drip-content-in-courses)
 for details. **Lock** is a release option that allows your content to be released after your customer has completed your specified lesson. Read [Lock content from a Course Outline](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/courses/lock-content-in-your-course-product)
 for details. **Draft** is a release feature that allows you to hide your content from your customers as you build the lesson in your Product. Read [Create a Product Lesson](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/products/courses/create-a-lesson)
 for details on lesson states and visibility.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabi-glossary#offers)

Offers

**Offer** is the price tag and the vehicle for delivering your Product. This means having the ability to provide your customers with different payment options for services and products you provide. Read [Create an Offer](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/create-an-offer)
 for details. **Upsell** is a feature to encourage an additional sale. An Upsell presents an additional purchase opportunity after checkout. Upsell pages are built using the same Builder as your site and checkout pages and can be reused across multiple Offers. If they choose to purchase the Upsell Offer, it is processed as a separate transaction from the original Offer purchase. Read [Add and edit an Upsell](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/upsells-overview)
 for details. **Order Bump** can be used as a way to advertise another offer directly from the checkout page. A customer goes through the checkout sequence and sees a simple option to add another Offer to their checkout right below the payment information. If you wish to include an Order Bump, when writing the description, keep in mind that it should refer to the Offer getting bumped. Read [Add an Order Bump](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/checkout/how-to-add-an-order-bump-to-your-offer)
 for details. **Single Use Coupon** is a single coupon that can be used for launches or special deals. This is where you can create a code like `BLACKFRIDAY` and every time this code is entered there is a percent off (example: 20% off) discount applied. Read [Create a Coupon](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/how-to-create-a-coupon)
 for details. **Bulk Coupon Code** is for when you want to provide a limited amount of coupons with unique links and upload them to a site like Groupon. Read [Generate Coupon Codes in bulk](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/creating-coupon-codes-in-bulk)
 for details. **Product Access** allows the customers that purchase your Offer to gain access to the Product(s) included with the Offer on your specified day within the Product Access option. Read [Give access to a Product on a specific date](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-give-access-to-your-product-on-a-specific-date)
 for details. **Restrict Access** removes your customer from the Product(s) after your specified number of days. This means your customer no longer has access to the Product(s) of your Offer from their Library. Read [Restrict Product access to a specific number of days](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-restrict-product-access-to-a-specific-amount-of-days)
 for details.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabi-glossary#website-terms)

Website terms
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabi-glossary#design)

Design

**Design** is a section of the Website tab where you can design your Library, Store, Login, Static, Thank You, and Blog Pages along with your Pages containing your Blog Posts and Blog Search bar. **Template Home** is the homepage that your settings are defaulted to when you create your Kajabi account. When visitors enter your URL in their browser, this is the page that appears if you have not changed your settings in your Site Details. Read [Build a Homepage](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-build-your-custom-homepage)
 for details. **Navigation** is where you add specific links that you want your visitors to access in the header of your site. The links in this navigation can include links on Kajabi and from other site pages. It can be any link you can copy and paste into your Navigation menu. Keep in mind, most of the time when creating your navigation menu, select **link** as the option. Read [Add a menu to your page header](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-add-a-menu-to-your-page-header)
 for details. **Manage Templates** allows you to select from a variety of different templates that carry through your Design tab Pages. Read [Customize a Website Template](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-upload-a-new-website-template)
 for details.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabi-glossary#page-builder)

Page Builder

**Pages** allow you to build individual landing pages to direct traffic. Your Pages can be used as opt-in pages, homepages, video players, and more. The various templates allow you to create different pages for different purposes with ease. Read [Create a Page](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-add-pages-to-your-website)
 for details. **Standalone Pages** are not attached to any marketing funnel flows. **Funnel Pages** in the Pages tab are folders containing all of the Pages that exist in your funnel(s).

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabi-glossary#blog)

Blog

**Blog Posts** are articles or videos that make up the content on your blog. Read [Customize a Blog](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-design-your-blog-homepage)
 to edit and customize all of your blog pages and blog post layouts.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabi-glossary#marketing-terms)

Marketing terms
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabi-glossary#funnels)

Funnels

**Funnels** bring marketing and sales together through the power of Automations. A funnel drives traffic to your opt-in page to capture lead information and send follow-up information to ultimately convert leads into paying customers. **Legacy Funnels** are used more for the purpose of offer conversion, rather than lead generation and offer conversion.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabi-glossary#email-campaigns)

Email Campaigns

**Email Broadcast** is one email sent out. This is most commonly used as an announcement or newsletter email. Read about [Email Broadcasts](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/marketing/email-campaigns/email-campaigns-overview#email-broadcast)
 in Kajabi to learn more. **Email Sequence** is an email or a list of emails that can be sent out after a trigger has been completed on your site. Read about [Email Sequences](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/marketing/email-campaigns/email-campaigns-overview#email-sequence)
 in Kajabi to learn more. **Email Stat: Bounced** is when an email to a recipient fails, usually due to the recipient’s email not existing. **Email Stat: Clicked** is when your email recipient clicks any of the links included in your email. **Email Stat: Opened** emails occur when an email campaign has been delivered and viewed by the recipient. Read [Email Metrics overview](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/marketing/email-campaigns/email-metrics-overview)
 for more details.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabi-glossary#types-of-emails)

Types of emails

**Marketing Emails** are emails sent to your email list subscribers. These emails include Email Broadcasts, Email Sequences, and Event Emails. If they are not subscribed and have not approved to be sent marketing emails, they will not receive these types of emails. Read the [Email Campaigns overview](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/marketing/email-campaigns/email-campaigns-overview)
 to learn more. **System Generated Emails** are emails sent regardless of whether or not your users are subscribed to marketing emails, as they alert them that an action has occurred within the app such as a purchase confirmed, Product access granted, and more. Read [Edit the automated emails sent by a site](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/account-settings/notifications/edit-automated-email-notifications)
 for details. **Event Emails** have the same permissions as Marketing emails. Event emails are sent on a time-specific schedule before, during, and after your event. Read [Create an Event](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/marketing/events/how-to-create-an-event)
 for details. Read [Understanding the difference between Marketing and Transactional emails](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/marketing/email-campaigns/what-are-marketing-and-transactional-emails)
 for further detail.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabi-glossary#automations)

Automations

**“When” Trigger** is the signal that fires off an action when triggered. **“Then” Trigger** is the action that occurs after the “When” trigger has fired. **Condition** is an additional “only if” condition in the Automations infrastructure to allow you to filter your automation. For instance, say you want to add a tag to all users who have submitted a specific Form, but only if they answered a specific question on that Form with a specific answer. Read about [Automations](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/marketing/automations/automations-overview)
 in Kajabi to learn more.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabi-glossary#events)

Events

**Events** in Kajabi represent a date and time that can be surrounded by emails and automated actions. People can be registered to an Event by completing a Form, purchasing a Product, and many other Automations. This feature gives you the option to create marketing campaigns based on a time instead of explicitly creating marketing campaigns based on sign-up or purchase dates. Read [Create an Event](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/marketing/events/how-to-create-an-event)
 for details.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabi-glossary#forms)

Forms

**Double Opt-In** is a feature for your Forms. The Double Opt-In automatically sends a confirmation email to the address inputted on the Form. This email prompts your subscriber to confirm that they would like to be added to your list and receive your marketing emails. By using a Double Opt-In, you can improve the quality of leads you are receiving. When a lead confirms they want to remain a contact on your list, it shows they are interested in your business and have a higher likelihood of becoming a customer. Making a Double Opt-In a requirement also reduces the chances of your marketing emails being flagged as spam. Read [Set up a Form with a Double Opt-In](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/marketing/forms/how-to-set-up-a-form-with-double-opt-in)
 for details.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabi-glossary#contacts-terms)

Contacts terms
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabi-glossary#all-contacts)

All Contacts

**Subscriber** is a contact (name and email) who has signed up to receive marketing emails. This can be done by agreeing to receive marketing emails when purchasing an Offer or by submitting a Form to be subscribed to your list. **Customers** are anyone who has purchased or has been granted access to an Offer. Customers have a blue checkmark icon on their avatar when scrolling through the All Contacts tab. **Tags** allow you to separate your list to easily target specific groups of contacts and perform a variety of actions such as setting up Automations with a Tag and sending Emails to specific contacts with your specified Tag(s). **Lifecycle** shows the amount of time a contact has been added as well as the transactions and interactions that have taken place since the contact joined your list or purchased an Offer. **Grant Offer** is an option to provide access to a Product and bypass needing payment. Read [Grant an Offer](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-grant-an-offer)
 for more details. Granting an Offer sends a system-generated email, the Offer Grant Email. Read [Edit the automated emails sent by a site](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/account-settings/notifications/edit-automated-email-notifications)
 for details on editing your system-generated email.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabi-glossary#assessments)

Assessments

**Assessment** is a test or a survey that allows you to gather information from your customers before, during, or after the course is complete. Read [Assessments in Kajabi](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/contacts/create-manage-and-share-assessments/create-and-customize-assessments)
 for details.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabi-glossary#affiliates)

Affiliates

**Affiliates** consist of people selling/marketing your course on your behalf while receiving a commission from you in the process. This is a scalable way to maximize revenue. Read the [Affiliate overview](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/affiliates/affiliates-overview)
 for details.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabi-glossary#settings-terms)

Settings terms
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Payment Integrations** are where you can connect Stripe and/or PayPal to your site. Read [Connect Stripe to Kajabi](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/api-integrations/payment-integrations/connect-stripe-to-kajabi)
 and [Connect PayPal to Kajabi](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/api-integrations/payment-integrations/connect-paypal-to-kajabi)
 for details. **Email Templates** are system-generated emails that get sent out when something happens within your Kajabi account. Review these templates and make any changes you wish to fit your brand and language. Read [Edit the automated emails sent by a site](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/account-settings/notifications/edit-automated-email-notifications)
 for details. **Domain** is the address for your website such as `example.com`. Domains can be registered from domain registrars such as GoDaddy or Google Domains and connected to your Kajabi site to replace the default Kajabi subdomain given to you. Learn to [purchase a domain](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/domains/how-to-purchase-a-domain-name)
 for more details. Want to connect your custom domain? Learn to [connect a custom domain](https://help.kajabi.com/hc/en-us/articles/360036668374)
 to Kajabi. **Subdomain** is the beginning portion of your website address such as [www.example.com](http://www.example.com/)
 or courses.example.com (“www” and “courses” are the subdomains). Kajabi provides you with a default Kajabi subdomain for your site to help you get started. **Account Users** come with different permissions depending on their Admin Roles. Read [Add Admin Users for a site](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/account-settings/users/account-users)
 for details.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/resources/kajabi-glossary#kajabi-extras)

Kajabi extras
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Hero**: A [Kajabi Hero](https://pages.kajabi.com/heroes)
 is a person who is committed to the path of turning their passion into profit and has taken the leap to begin their online business with Kajabi. From the day you sign up, you are on your way to making your first 1,000,then1,000, then 1,000,then100,000 and eventually $1 million, all of which are accomplishments worth celebrating. No matter how big or small, each step is important and potentially life-changing. With Kajabi, you are the hero of your own story. **Partner**: A Kajabi Partner refers Kajabi to their audience or clients and earns commission on active referrals. Tier-based commission rates and one-time bounty options are described in the [Partner Program overview](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/partner-program-overview)
. Read [Become a Kajabi Partner](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-become-a-kajabi-partner)

# Add and edit a Downsell - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-add-and-edit-a-downsell#content-area)

A **Downsell** is another Offer presented to customers that decline to purchase an Upsell. This gives you a second chance to make an additional sale if your customer declines your Upsell. Your Downsell is typically a lower-priced Offer, a discount on the Upsell Product, or you can choose to offer a completely new Product.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-add-and-edit-a-downsell#add-a-downsell)

Add a Downsell
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  First, [create an Offer](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/create-an-offer)
     to use as a Downsell.
2.  Return to your Offers Dashboard and select the Offer you wish to attach your Downsell to.
3.  Select the **Upsells** tab.
4.  Add a new Upsell or navigate to an existing Upsell Offer.
5.  Click **Add downsell** on your Upsell offer card.
6.  Complete the Downsell prompt:
    *   Select your Downsell offer
    *   Enter a Downsell title
    *   Enter a Downsell description
    *   Upload a video for your Downsell (optional)
    *   Update the purchase button text (optional)
7.  Click **Add Downsell** to apply your changes.

Be sure to activate both your Downsell and Upsell to initiate the upsell and downsell flow during checkout!

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-add-and-edit-a-downsell#edit-a-downsell)

Edit a Downsell
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

After you have added a Downsell to your Offer, you have the ability to edit specific details of the Downsell further.

1.  Open the **Sales** tab from your Dashboard.
2.  Select the Offer containing the Downsell you wish to edit.
3.  Select the **Upsells** tab.
4.  Click the **Downsell** attached to your Upsell Offer.
5.  In the Downsell editor popup, edit the title, description, CTA text, or add a video.
6.  Click **Save** to keep and apply your changes.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-add-and-edit-a-downsell#remove-a-downsell)

Remove a Downsell
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Open the **Sales** tab from your Dashboard.
2.  Click **Offers**.
3.  Select the Offer from which you’d like to remove the Downsell.
4.  Select the **Upsells** tab.
5.  On the Upsell page, click the `…` menu next to the Downsell Offer.
6.  Click **Remove** to delete it.

# Can Upsells be used with a free Offer? - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/can-upsells-be-used-with-a-free-offer#content-area)

**Upsells** can be used with paid Offers only. An Upsell cannot be used with a Free Offer.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/can-upsells-be-used-with-a-free-offer#what-is-an-upsell)

What is an Upsell?
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Upsells are a great way to maximize your profit by encouraging an additional sale during the checkout process. [Learn more about using Upsells in your paid Offers](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-add-and-remove-upsells-and-downsells)
.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/can-upsells-be-used-with-a-free-offer#troubleshooting)

Troubleshooting
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/can-upsells-be-used-with-a-free-offer#i-added-an-upsell-to-my-free-offer-but-it-doesn%E2%80%99t-appear-during-checkout)

I added an Upsell to my Free Offer, but it doesn’t appear during Checkout

Upsells cannot be used with a Free Offer. Although you can add an Upsell to a Free Offer in the Offer Editor, your customers will not be given the option to purchase the Upsell during checkout. [Learn to customize the pricing of an Offer](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/how-to-create-a-pricing-plan-for-your-offer)
 for more details.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/can-upsells-be-used-with-a-free-offer#the-upsell-doesn%E2%80%99t-appear-during-checkout-when-my-customer-applies-their-coupon)

The Upsell doesn’t appear during Checkout when my customer applies their coupon

Customers with a 100% off coupon for an Offer with an Upsell will not be given the option to purchase the Upsell. 100% Off coupons turn a paid Offer into a Free Offer when applied.

**Note:** If you are trying to [test purchase](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/creating-a-test-purchase-in-kajabi)
 your offer with a 100% coupon, or the offer is free, the upsell will not be offered for purchase.

[Learn more about creating coupons](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/coupons/how-to-create-a-coupon)
 in Kajabi.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/sales/offers/can-upsells-be-used-with-a-free-offer#i-successfully-tested-the-upsell-before-but-now-i-can%E2%80%99t-perform-another-test-purchase)

I successfully tested the Upsell before, but now I can’t perform another test purchase

If you are using the same email address in your second test, Kajabi will recognize that your initial test email address previously purchased the Upsell. Be sure to use a different email address if you wish to perform multiple tests.

# Partner Program overview - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/partner-program-overview#content-area)

The **Kajabi Partner Program** gives content creators, freelancers, and agencies the tools and support to grow their businesses through referrals and commissions. Whether you’re recommending Kajabi through your content or building client sites directly, you can customize how you share Kajabi based on your audience, services, or business goals.

**Note:** Looking to connect with vetted third-party Kajabi service providers to help you with your Kajabi site, email campaigns, and more? Check out [Kajabi Experts](https://contra.com/kajabi?view=people)
.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/partner-program-overview#what-kind-of-partner-are-you)

What kind of partner are you?
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Kajabi supports two types of partners: **Affiliates** and **Agencies/Freelancers**. Here’s how they differ:

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/partner-program-overview#affiliates)

Affiliates

Affiliates share Kajabi with their audiences through content, courses, or social channels. This is a great fit if you’re a creator, educator, or influencer who wants to generate passive income by recommending a tool you believe in.

#### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/partner-program-overview#best-for)

**Best for:**

*   YouTubers, podcasters, and bloggers
*   Coaches, educators, and course creators
*   Influencers with engaged digital communities

#### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/partner-program-overview#how-you-earn)

**How you earn:**

*   Share Kajabi using your referral link
*   Earn recurring commissions when someone you refer becomes a paying Kajabi Hero

#### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/partner-program-overview#what-you-get)

**What you get:**

*   Partner Dashboard to track referrals and commissions
*   Promo assets and branded Kajabi campaigns
*   Ongoing commission as long as you and your referral remain active

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/partner-program-overview#service-providers-agencies-and-freelancers)

Service Providers - Agencies and Freelancers

Agencies and freelancers work hands-on with clients to build, launch, and grow their Kajabi sites. This track is ideal if you offer services like web development, digital marketing, funnel strategy, or business coaching. **Best for:**

*   Web developers, funnel builders, brand strategists
*   Consultants, instructional designers, and SEO specialists
*   Agencies managing multiple Kajabi clients

**How you earn:**

*   Refer clients to Kajabi using your unique link
*   Earn recurring commissions as clients stay active
*   Offer your own paid services (e.g. site builds, coaching, marketing)

**What you get:**

*   Partner Dashboard to manage projects and track commissions
*   Developer accounts to build and hand off client sites

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/partner-program-overview#partner-commission)

Partner commission
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The Kajabi Partner Program offers a scalable commission structure based on your impact and engagement. As your referrals grow, so does your earning potential.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/partner-program-overview#commission-tiers)

Commission tiers

| Tier | \# of Active Referred Heroes | Earnings type | Commission rate | Applies to |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Starter Partner** | 1-4 | One-time bounty per referral | 100% of the referral’s first month of subscription payment | Each new active referred Hero |
| **Builder Partner** | 5-24 | Recurring commission | 10% of each subscription payment | All active referred Heroes |
| **Accelerator Partner** | 25-49 | Recurring commission | 15% of each subscription payment | All active referred Heroes |
| **Premium Partner** | 50+ | Recurring commission | 20% of each subscription payment | All active referred Heroes |

**Note:** The Starter Partner bounty equals 100% of the referral’s first month of subscription payment. For referrals on an annual plan, the bounty equals one month of that annual plan’s value, not 100% of the full annual subscription. Once a referral has earned a bounty or commission, that referral is not eligible for the other payout type.

#### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/partner-program-overview#bounty-payments-starter-tier)

Bounty payments (Starter tier)

If you’re in the Starter Partner tier, you earn a **one-time bounty payment** for each referral who becomes an active Kajabi Hero. The bounty equals 100% of the referral’s first month of subscription payment. If the referral is on an annual plan, the bounty equals one month of that annual plan’s value, not the full annual amount. For full program terms, see the [Partner Program Agreement](https://kajabi.com/policies/partner-program-terms)
.

#### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/partner-program-overview#recurring-commission-builder-tier-and-beyond)

Recurring commission (Builder tier and beyond)

Once you reach the Builder tier and beyond, you’ll earn a **percentage of every subscription payment** your referred Hero makes, at the rate listed in the table above, for as long as the referral and your partner account remain active.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/partner-program-overview#key-partner-benefits)

Key Partner Benefits
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The Kajabi Partner Program is designed to help you thrive. As a partner, you’ll have access to exclusive tools, resources, and opportunities tailored to your unique business model.

*   Recurring commission on every active referral
*   Partner Dashboard to manage referrals, earnings, and client projects
*   Developer accounts to build and transfer Kajabi sites seamlessly
*   Ready-to-use marketing campaigns and branded assets to make promotion easy
*   Ongoing support and recognition from Kajabi as a key player in the ecosystem

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/partner-program-overview#join-the-partner-program)

Join the Partner Program
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Whether you’re sharing Kajabi with your audience or building digital businesses for clients, the Kajabi Partner Program is designed to help you grow and earn. Sign up today to get access to your Partner Dashboard, marketing tools, and everything you need to start referring, managing, and earning. # FTC guidelines - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/ftc-guidelines#content-area)

Kajabi welcomes recommendations and endorsements from Heroes. **FTC disclosure rules** apply when you participate in this kind of marketing as a Kajabi Partner or paid endorser, and you must follow them to stay compliant.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/ftc-guidelines#what-is-the-ftc)

What is the FTC?
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The Federal Trade Commission, or FTC, is an independent agency of the United States government whose mission is to protect consumers from anticompetitive, misleading, deceptive, and unfair business practices. The FTC wants to make sure that consumers are able to differentiate between ad content and organic content. This has become an increasing focus of the FTC especially given the rise of the use of endorsements in social media marketing. Over the past few years, the FTC has expressed growing concern over the lack of transparency in endorsements and partner content. According to the FTC, the increased use of endorsements in social media has led to widespread and pervasive deceptive advertising. According to the FTC’s rules, paid influencers, endorsers, and partners must disclose the nature of their relationships with the brands within their content. Your audience needs to understand whether what they’re seeing is an ad or a genuine endorsement, with no monetary gain in it for you. When you are paid or receive free or discounted products or services from Kajabi (for example as a paid partner or endorser) these rules apply to you, and even if you’re not from the United States, they may still apply. Violating the FTC’s rules can result in penalties, fines, and even legal fees. Unfortunately, just claiming that you didn’t know the rules or you had no intent to violate the rules, is not an argument to avoid these penalties.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/ftc-guidelines#key-requirements)

Key requirements
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Reading and understanding the FTC’s guidelines can be complicated, which is why we’ve provided a summary of the key requirements you must meet as a Kajabi partner or paid endorser.

**Note:** This summary is based on our understanding of the FTC rules and is not legal advice. Contact your legal counsel if you have questions or concerns.

*   Disclosure language must be placed **before** your link in any and all placements, regardless of the format of the content. It’s best practice to place your disclosure above your links at the beginning of your content or as close to the links as possible. Disclosure language must not be avoidable or hard to miss.
*   Disclosures need to be **clear and apparent** to the reader. In other words, you shouldn’t have to search or click on a link in order to see it. For example, although placing your disclosure in your website footer meets the requirement of having one, it may be hard to find and thus will not meet the requirement of being displayed clearly and conspicuously.
*   If you include your endorsement and/or link in any social media posts, **you must include the FTC disclosure**. You can use hashtags to disclose your relationship like #KajabiPartner or #Ad.
*   If you are reposting a video, you must make sure the subsequent videos also include the required disclosures.
*   If using video, the disclosure should be present in **both audio and written form**, and not just in the text description.
*   Disclosures should **always** be added, even in cases where space is limited.
*   Disclosures should be in the **same language** as the endorsement.
*   If posting from outside the United States, U.S. law applies if it’s reasonably foreseeable that the post will affect U.S. consumers. Foreign laws might also apply, please consult counsel in your local jurisdiction.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/ftc-guidelines#ftc-disclosure-examples)

FTC disclosure examples
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

If you’re not sure what to put as your disclosure, here are some examples you can use:

*   “I partner with Kajabi and may receive a commission if you sign up through my link.”
*   “This post contains affiliate links.”
*   “Paid partnership with Kajabi.”

Here are a few “Do’s” and “Don’ts” from the FTC:

*   Do clearly disclose when you have a financial or family relationship with a brand.
*   Do ensure your sponsorship is hard to miss.
*   Do treat sponsored tags, including tags in pictures, like any other endorsement.
*   On image-only platforms like Snapchat, do superimpose disclosures over the images.
*   Don’t assume followers know about all your brand relationships.
*   Don’t assume disclosure built into social media platforms is sufficient.
*   Don’t use ambiguous disclosures like “Thanks,” #collab, #sp, #spon, #affiliate or #ambassador.
*   Don’t rely on disclosures that people will see only when they click “more”.

When in doubt, visit the following links or reach out to the FTC directly:

*   [FTC Endorsement Guidelines](https://www.ecfr.gov/cgi-bin/text-idx?SID=701066299822530421fece37367c91d3&mc=true&node=pt16.1.255&rgn=div5)
    
*   [The FTC’s Endorsement Guides: What People Are Asking](https://www.ftc.gov/business-guidance/resources/ftcs-endorsement-guides-what-people-are-asking#social)
    
*   [Disclosures 101 for Social Media Influencers](https://www.ftc.gov/business-guidance/resources/disclosures-101-social-media-influencers)

# Access managed sites in the Partner Dashboard - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-access-managed-sites-in-your-partner-dashboard#content-area)

The **Managed Sites** section gives you a centralized view of all the Kajabi sites you actively manage as a service provider. Whether you support clients with web design, development, marketing, or platform setup, this section helps you stay organized and quickly access your clients’ sites.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-access-managed-sites-in-your-partner-dashboard#access-managed-sites)

Access managed sites
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  From your Kajabi Dashboard, click your account icon in the top right corner.
2.  Select **Partner Program** to open your Kajabi Partner Dashboard.
3.  Select **Sites** from the navigation side menu.
4.  Here, you’ll be defaulted into the **Managed Sites** tab.
5.  This is where all sites will be listed where you’ve been added as a **Collaborator.**

![Managed Partner Sites](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/bM79MDdFmJHkNuiQ/articles/images/cb04967a_Managed_Partner_Sites.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=bM79MDdFmJHkNuiQ&q=85&s=7b2ab9399ef5e469e4e8b30cd6c47a24) This section is updated automatically as you gain or lose access to client sites.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-access-managed-sites-in-your-partner-dashboard#what-you%E2%80%99ll-find-in-managed-sites)

What you’ll find in managed sites
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The **Managed Sites** section is designed to streamline how you view and access client projects within Kajabi. Here’s what you’ll find:

*   **Site Name**: The name of each Kajabi site you’re managing.
*   **Site Owner**: The client who owns the site.
*   **Role**: Your assigned role (Collaborator).
*   **Status**:
    *   **Active**: 90 days remaining
    *   **Pending**
    *   **Deactivated**
    *   **Archived**
*   **Log In**: Use this button to instantly log into your client’s site.
*   **Request access or build site**: Use this button to request access to a client’s site.
*   You can filter your list of client sites via Active, Pending, Deactivated & Archived.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-access-managed-sites-in-your-partner-dashboard#faqs)

FAQs
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-access-managed-sites-in-your-partner-dashboard#how-do-i-get-a-site-to-show-up-in-this-section)

How do I get a site to show up in this section?

You must be added as an Administrator on the client’s Kajabi site. Click the **Request access** or **build site** button. Input the email address associated with your client’s Kajabi account and personalize the message.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-access-managed-sites-in-your-partner-dashboard#can-i-remove-a-site-from-this-list)

Can I remove a site from this list?

If you no longer manage a site, you can use the ”…” to remove access. Once removed, it will no longer appear here.

# Track Partner referrals - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-track-your-partner-referrals#content-area)

The **Partner Referral** page shows all the creators you have referred to Kajabi and their current status. Use this page to track your referrals and monitor their progress from trial to active status.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-track-your-partner-referrals#access-the-partner-referral-page)

Access the Partner Referral page
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The Partner Referral page is the best place for you to view your referred creators and check their current status. To navigate to the Partner Referral page:

1.  From the Kajabi Dashboard, click your **account icon** in the top right corner.
2.  Select **Partner Program** to open your Kajabi Partner Dashboard.
    *   If you do not have a Kajabi account, login [here](https://kajabi.com/partnerprogram)
        
3.  In the Partner Dashboard, click **See Referrals** to view your referrals and their statuses:

![Partner Referrals](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/p8xUcPoEbYtv-GgI/articles/images/b1f2fc9a_how-to-track-your-partner-referrals-google-docs.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=p8xUcPoEbYtv-GgI&q=85&s=eec4e9606234f551f46dcceab407d1ad)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-track-your-partner-referrals#referral-page)

Referral page
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

On the Referral page, you can view all your referrals along with their current status:

*   **Trialing** – The referral is currently in their Kajabi trial period.
*   **Active** – The referral has completed their trial and is now an active Kajabi user.
*   **Cancelled** – The referral has cancelled their Kajabi subscription and is no longer active.

You can also customize your view on the Referral page by applying filters. Available filter options include:

*   Referral Signup Date
*   Campaign
*   Earnings
*   GMV Tier
*   Current Plan
*   Products Created

![Referral Filters](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/Fn77vao1ddNujGxX/articles/images/41423844_how-to-track-your-partner-referrals-google-docs_1.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=Fn77vao1ddNujGxX&q=85&s=c15cac57efa71eac0430eb3538f1b66f)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-track-your-partner-referrals#view-referral-details)

View referral details
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

To view more information about a specific referral:

1.  Search for a specific referral by name using the search bar, or select the referral from the **Referral** page.
2.  Click the **More Actions** button (**…**) next to their name.

You’ll be able to see the following details:

*   **Name** – The referral’s full name.
*   **Referral Date** – The date they signed up through your referral link.
*   **Campaign** – The specific campaign they came from, if applicable.
*   **Earnings** – The total amount you’ve earned from this referral.
*   **Creator Earnings** – The referral’s GMV (Gross Merchandise Value).
*   **Current Plan** – The Kajabi subscription plan that the referral is currently on.
*   **Status** – The referral’s current status: _Trialing_, _Active_, or _Cancelled_:

![Referral Details](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/3LRg1R0Ebo6WLo67/articles/images/c238c8a1_how-to-track-your-partner-referrals-google-docs_2.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=3LRg1R0Ebo6WLo67&q=85&s=a174e062a142238291f729d275413df6)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-track-your-partner-referrals#refer-someone)

Refer someone
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

To refer someone to Kajabi right from the Partner Referral Page:

1.  Click the **Refer Someone** button.
2.  A pop-up menu will appear with everything you need to share your referral link.

In the pop-up, you can:

*   Select the **Campaign** you want to use.
*   View the **unique link** associated with that campaign.
*   Easily **copy** the referral link to share with others:

![Refer Someone](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/ldffj5KR1_5A4Y2H/articles/images/67bfd82f_how-to-track-your-partner-referrals-google-docs_3.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=ldffj5KR1_5A4Y2H&q=85&s=7ad42801652f8d2cb1df853ba83f414f)
