# Kajabi Partner Program FAQs - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/kajabi-partner-program-faq#content-area)

Tier rules, commission rates, payout timing, and eligibility for the Kajabi Partner Program are explained below. For full program terms, see the [Partner Program Agreement](https://kajabi.com/policies/partner-program-terms)
.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/kajabi-partner-program-faq#general)

General
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/kajabi-partner-program-faq#what-is-a-kajabi-partner)

What is a Kajabi Partner?

As a Kajabi Partner, you refer clients to Kajabi and provide them with the tools they need for their online business. The Kajabi Partner Program offers a scalable commission structure based on your impact and engagement. As your referrals grow, so does your earning potential.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/kajabi-partner-program-faq#do-i-need-to-be-a-kajabi-customer-to-become-a-partner)

Do I need to be a Kajabi customer to become a partner?

Yes. At this time, the partner program application is only open to Kajabi Heroes.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/kajabi-partner-program-faq#what-if-i-believe-i%E2%80%99ve-been-incorrectly-deactivated-or-underpaid)

What if I believe I’ve been incorrectly deactivated or underpaid?

Please contact [partners@kajabi.com](mailto:partners@kajabi.com)
. We’ll review your account and help resolve any issues.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/kajabi-partner-program-faq#tiers-&-commissions)

Tiers & commissions
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/kajabi-partner-program-faq#what-are-the-different-partner-tiers)

What are the different partner tiers?

Partners can earn increasing commissions as they move up tiers based on the number of active referrals. [See the tier breakdown here](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/partner-program-overview)
.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/kajabi-partner-program-faq#how-is-my-tier-determined)

How is my tier determined?

Your tier is based on how many active referrals you have. An active referral is a Hero who:

*   Completed their trial
*   Has an active, paid subscription
*   Is not on a parked plan or experiencing payment issues

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/kajabi-partner-program-faq#do-tiers-change-automatically)

Do tiers change automatically?

Yes. Your tier will automatically update as referrals activate or churn. When it’s time for payouts, we look at the tier you were in _during the month the transaction occurred_, not your current tier. For example, payouts in June are based on your tier from April.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/kajabi-partner-program-faq#inactivity-cliff)

Inactivity cliff
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/kajabi-partner-program-faq#what-is-the-%E2%80%9Ccliff%E2%80%9D)

What is the “cliff”?

If you go 12 months without generating 1 _new_ referral (not reactivation), you’ll hit the inactivity cliff.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/kajabi-partner-program-faq#what-happens-when-i-hit-the-cliff)

What happens when I hit the cliff?

You’ll lose eligibility to earn commissions. If you’re a grandfathered partner, you’ll also lose your 30% legacy commission rate and move into the tiered structure.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/kajabi-partner-program-faq#can-i-reactivate-my-partner-status-after-hitting-the-cliff)

Can I reactivate my partner status after hitting the cliff?

Yes. To reactivate, you must refer a _new_ Hero—someone who has never been referred to Kajabi before. This does not include Heroes who were previously referred and later reactivated, or who moved from a parked to an active subscription. Once reactivated, your tier will be based on your current count of active referrals.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/kajabi-partner-program-faq#grandfathered-partners)

Grandfathered partners
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/kajabi-partner-program-faq#what-happens-if-i-cancel-my-kajabi-subscription-but-still-want-to-be-a-partner)

What happens if I cancel my Kajabi subscription but still want to be a partner?

You’ll need to email [partners@kajabi.com](mailto:partners@kajabi.com)
 to switch to the standalone partner program.

**Note:** You will no longer receive the 30% grandfathered commission, and this change is not retroactive. You won’t receive 30% on past or future transactions once the switch is made, even if they occurred while you were still eligible.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/kajabi-partner-program-faq#payouts)

Payouts
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/kajabi-partner-program-faq#when-are-payouts-made)

When are payouts made?

Payouts are reviewed between the 19th–23rd of each month and are typically issued by the 25th. They cover transactions from roughly 60 days prior. For example, you’ll receive your April payout around April 25th for transactions that occurred in February.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/kajabi-partner-program-faq#what-do-partners-earn-commission-on)

What do partners earn commission on?

Only on active base plan subscriptions. Add-ons, Kajabi Payments, or Feature Limit Increases (FLIs) are excluded. Parked is not considered an _active_ base plan and, therefore excluded from payouts.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/kajabi-partner-program-faq#what-if-my-tier-changes-before-a-payout)

What if my tier changes before a payout?

You’ll be paid based on the tier you were in during the referral month, not the payout month. If your active referral count drops halfway through the month, we will default to the higher tier for that month to ensure you’re paid fairly.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/kajabi-partner-program-faq#what-happens-if-i-referred-someone-in-the-past-who-reactivated-their-subscription)

What happens if I referred someone in the past who reactivated their subscription?

You won’t be reactivated unless you refer someone _new_. Renewals of old referrals don’t count for reactivation or cliff extensions.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/kajabi-partner-program-faq#what-if-my-paypal-email-is-incorrect)

What if my PayPal email is incorrect?

You’ll need to correct this ASAP. If we can’t pay you within 90 days, your payout will be forfeited to prevent long-term liability. Learn how to [update your PayPal email here](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/updating-your-partner-paypal-email)
.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/kajabi-partner-program-faq#my-referral-forgot-to-use-my-partner-link-when-they-signed-up-how-do-i-get-credit-for-them)

My referral forgot to use my Partner link when they signed up, how do I get credit for them?

You can advise them to send an email to [partners@kajabi.com](mailto:partners@kajabi.com)
 requesting that you receive credit for their account. The Partner team will then be able to look into manually associating them with your account.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/kajabi-partner-program-faq#does-my-commission-change-if-my-referral-upgrades-their-kajabi-subscription-from-monthly-to-annual)

Does my commission change if my referral upgrades their Kajabi Subscription from monthly to annual?

Your commission rate stays the same. It’s still your tier’s percentage (10%, 15%, or 20%), applied to each subscription payment your referral makes. Switching between monthly and annual only changes how often that commission is paid out:

*   **Annual plan:** When your referral pays for an annual plan, you receive your tier’s percentage of that single payment, paid out once per year.
*   **Monthly plan:** When your referral pays monthly, you receive your tier’s percentage of each monthly payment, paid out each month.

You do not receive the full annual subscription amount. You receive your tier’s percentage of it. If you’re a Starter Partner earning a bounty (rather than recurring commission), the bounty equals 100% of the referral’s first month of subscription payment. For an annual referral, the bounty equals one month of that annual plan’s value, not the full annual amount.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/kajabi-partner-program-faq#will-kajabi-send-me-tax-forms-for-my-partner-payouts)

Will Kajabi send me tax forms for my Partner payouts?

No, Kajabi does not provide tax forms for your Partner payouts. Since Kajabi uses PayPal to send Partner payouts, questions regarding tax forms should be directed to PayPal. Visit [PayPal’s Help Center](https://www.paypal.com/us/smarthelp/home)
 for more information.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/kajabi-partner-program-faq#will-kajabi-send-me-receipts-or-invoices-for-partner-payments)

Will Kajabi send me receipts or invoices for Partner Payments?

No, Kajabi does not send receipts or invoices for Partner payouts. Depending on your account settings in PayPal, you may receive emails or notifications when you receive payments from Kajabi. Visit [PayPal’s Help Center](https://www.paypal.com/us/smarthelp/home)
 for more information.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/kajabi-partner-program-faq#bounty-vs-commission)

Bounty vs. commission
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/kajabi-partner-program-faq#what-is-a-%E2%80%9Cbounty%E2%80%9D)

What is a “bounty”?

A bounty is a one-time payment for a qualifying new referral when the partner is in the Starter tier and not yet earning ongoing commissions. The bounty equals **100% of the referral’s first month of subscription payment**. If the referral is on an annual plan, the bounty equals one month of that annual plan’s value, not the full annual subscription amount.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/kajabi-partner-program-faq#can-i-earn-a-bounty-and-commission-on-the-same-referral)

Can I earn a bounty _and_ commission on the same referral?

No. Once a bounty or commission has been paid for a referral, that referral is no longer eligible for another payout type.

# View the Partner Dashboard - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-view-your-partner-dashboard#content-area)

The **Partner Dashboard** is your central hub for managing your Partner Program activities. Here you can track referrals, view earnings, manage campaigns, and monitor your partner tier status.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-view-your-partner-dashboard#access-the-partner-dashboard)

Access the Partner Dashboard
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   Open your **User Menu** by clicking the account name located in the top right corner of your Kajabi Dashboard.
    *   If you do not have a Kajabi account, log in at [kajabi.com/partnerprogram](https://kajabi.com/partnerprogram)
        .
*   Select **Partner Program**.

**Note:** The Partner site has a refreshed look. For any questions about the previous version, contact [partners@kajabi.com](mailto:partners@kajabi.com)
.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-view-your-partner-dashboard#partner-tier)

Partner Tier
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The first card welcoming you to your Partner Dashboard, next to the Leaderboard, will indicate your Partner Tier within the commission structure. This card will display your current **Partner Tier** and how many more users you need to refer until you reach your next tier. You will also see your cliff date: ![Partner Tier Card](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/ldffj5KR1_5A4Y2H/articles/images/664827bc_how-to-view-your-partner-dashboard-google-docs_1.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=ldffj5KR1_5A4Y2H&q=85&s=3f90769cfe02b88074b8878ece88e763)

**Note:** A cliff is the inactivity threshold for partners. You must have at least 1 referral within a rolling 12 months of the cliff date to remain eligible for payouts.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-view-your-partner-dashboard#referral-stats)

Referral stats
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

![Referral Stats](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/p8xUcPoEbYtv-GgI/articles/images/a937e773_how-to-view-your-partner-dashboard-google-docs.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=p8xUcPoEbYtv-GgI&q=85&s=a5b40250192861da4f39ccf1faa4f43d)

*   **Total Clicks:** The number of visits that have been generated through your partner link.
*   **Trialing Referrals:** Any user who is currently trialing and is NOT paying for their Kajabi subscription.
*   **Active Referrals:** Any user who has completed their trial and is paying for their Kajabi subscription.
*   **Churned Referrals:** Any user who has cancelled their Kajabi subscription and no longer has an active account.

Learn more about your [Referrals](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-track-your-partner-referrals)
.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-view-your-partner-dashboard#earnings)

Earnings
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

![Your Earnings](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/Fn77vao1ddNujGxX/articles/images/3da0a517_how-to-view-your-partner-dashboard-google-docs_2.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=Fn77vao1ddNujGxX&q=85&s=19770a4552ea0ce0ae45364835938bb0)

*   **This month so far** – The sum of your earnings for \[current month\] that are yet to be finalized. Earnings are paid out 2 months in arrears.
*   **Last month** – The sum of your earnings from \[month\] that are yet to be finalized. Earnings are paid out 2 months in arrears.
*   **Next payout** – Your next payout will be on \[Month\] 25th for transactions from \[Month\]. Payouts are paid 2 months in arrears. See terms for more details.
*   **Lifetime earnings** - The total amount of earnings you have been paid out by Kajabi.

Learn more about [Payouts](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/partner-payout-report-partner-transaction-report)
.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-view-your-partner-dashboard#most-recent-campaigns)

Most recent campaigns
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

![Most Recent Campaigns](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/Uf21CoHlc2fuCkZI/articles/images/b56c7e4c_how-to-view-your-partner-dashboard-google-docs_3.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=Uf21CoHlc2fuCkZI&q=85&s=74ab941c50f898d0065dc2ca0c01143c) Drive traffic to Kajabi with **Campaigns** and start gaining active referrals in your Partner Dashboard. From your dashboard, you can see the data and results of your most recent campaigns. You can quickly grab referral links for your most recent campaigns or grab a general referral link from the top right corner of your Partner Dashboard: ![Referral Link](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/WDcixStsKF83F9nW/articles/images/5043d5be_how-to-view-your-partner-dashboard-google-docs_4.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=WDcixStsKF83F9nW&q=85&s=e58cd314c0fd9ebb6694aab0570e10f5) Each campaign will come with a **Campaign Brief** which will contain:

*   Commission breakdown
*   Benefits for joining the campaign
*   Sample email copy
*   Creative assets to use for ads and other promotional pieces
*   Kajabi Style Guide

Learn to [create your Campaign Link](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-create-share-partner-campaign-links)
 to begin sharing with the world.

# Create a referral signup email - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-create-a-referral-signup-email#content-area)

The **Referral Sign up Email** is automatically sent to someone who creates a new Kajabi account using your Partner referral link. Use it to welcome your new Kajabi referral and deliver any promised bonuses, such as a downloadable file, Offer access, or a webinar link. This email is sent on your behalf and is separate from any emails you send to your own customers or contacts. Add a personalized welcome message and a link to your bonus content. The system sends the email automatically on your behalf.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-create-a-referral-signup-email#create-a-referral-signup-email)

Create a referral signup email
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Welcome and deliver your promised bonuses to your Kajabi referrals by creating your referral signup email.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-create-a-referral-signup-email#navigate-to-the-partner-dashboard)

Navigate to the Partner Dashboard

1.  Open your User Menu by clicking the account icon located in the top right corner of your Kajabi Dashboard.
    *   If you do not have a Kajabi account, log in [here](https://kajabi.com/partnerprogram)
        .
2.  Select **Partner Program**.

![Partner program menu](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/O5ZsKXCFiDIup7FH/articles/images/bf5f68e9_how-to-create-a-referral-signup-email-google-docs.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=O5ZsKXCFiDIup7FH&q=85&s=1c125d1551b96a4f1496367a6f699203)

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-create-a-referral-signup-email#create-the-referral-signup-email)

Create the referral signup email

1.  Navigate to **Campaigns** from the left sidebar
2.  Select a Campaign to edit or [create a new Campaign](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-create-share-partner-campaign-links)
    .
3.  Locate **Sign up Emails** towards the top of the page under the Campaign title
4.  Click **New Sign up Email**.
5.  Select your **Campaign Link** to connect your signup email to a specific [campaign](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-create-share-partner-campaign-links)
    .
6.  Enter your email **Subject** line.
7.  Enter your message into the **Body** of your email.
8.  Enter **CTA text** and **CTA link** if you would like a button to be included:

![Sign up email form](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/KcN1Ave2wqokJV1G/articles/images/6498b6f2_how-to-create-a-referral-signup-email-google-docs.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=KcN1Ave2wqokJV1G&q=85&s=e011770a8d2a3230435e04ad4e325b5f) ![Sign up email preview](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/29uSBG1YPVOIMIfF/articles/images/fd3ea065_how-to-create-a-referral-signup-email-google-docs_1.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=29uSBG1YPVOIMIfF&q=85&s=bb347db358bae754a66add0db5e68668) After creating your Referral Signup Email, referrals from your campaign will receive your signup email automatically.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-create-a-referral-signup-email#delete-a-referral-signup-email)

Delete a referral signup email
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Open your **Partner Dashboard**.
2.  Navigate to **Campaigns** from the left sidebar
3.  Select the **Campaign** with the email you wish to edit
4.  Locate **Referral Sign up Emails** towards the top of the page under the Campaign title
5.  Click the (…) next to the **email** you wish to remove.
6.  Click **Delete email.**
7.  Confirm the permanent deletion.

# Create and share Partner Campaign links - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-create-share-partner-campaign-links#content-area)

**Partner Campaigns** drive traffic to gain and track active referrals in your Partner Dashboard. This article covers how to create campaign links, personalize your campaigns, and track campaign performance.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-create-share-partner-campaign-links#partner-campaigns)

Partner Campaigns
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The Campaigns tab in the Partner Dashboard provides a clear and organized way to track your performance as a Kajabi Partner. At the top, it highlights key metrics that summarize your overall progress, including total clicks, trial sign-ups, active referrals, and total earnings. These give you a quick snapshot of how your promotional efforts are performing. Beneath that, there’s a searchable and sortable list of all your individual campaigns. Each campaign is displayed with:

*   **Campaign title & preview image** – making it easy to identify at a glance.
*   **Performance columns** – showing clicks, trials, activations, and earnings per campaign.
*   **Links count** – indicating how many links are associated with each campaign.
*   **Status badge** – marking whether a campaign is currently active or not.

You also have the option to filter campaigns by status (Active, Closed, or All), and there’s a button to create a new campaign whenever you’re ready to launch something new. This layout makes it easy to manage multiple campaigns and quickly understand what’s working and where improvement is needed.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-create-share-partner-campaign-links#create-partner-campaigns)

Create Partner Campaigns
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

To start sharing your Partner link for a specific campaign:

1.  Open the Partner Dashboard and click **Campaigns** from the left sidebar.
2.  Choose a Campaign that fits your audience best and click **Create Campaign** (Partners always have access to an extended 30-day trial).
3.  Title your Campaign and click **Save**
4.  Create a **bonus sign-up email**
5.  Click **Copy Link** to grab your unique tracking URL.
6.  Share your link in content, emails, or onboarding docs!

**Note:** A campaign is subject to close or change at any time at the discretion of the Kajabi team.

**Tip:** Use campaign-specific links to track where your referrals are coming from.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-create-share-partner-campaign-links#personalize-partner-program-campaigns)

Personalize Partner Program campaigns
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The **Personalization Funnel** lets you customize your referral campaigns to highlight your story, achievements, and expertise. This builds trust with your audience and helps increase conversion rates and sign-ups.

**Note:** We reserve the right to remove anything deemed offensive or discriminatory per our [Acceptable Use Policy](https://legal.kajabi.com/policies/aup)
 and [Partner Program Agreement](https://legal.kajabi.com/policies/partner-program-terms)
.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-create-share-partner-campaign-links#access-the-personalization-funnel)

Access the Personalization Funnel
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Log in to your **Partner Program site**.
2.  In the left-hand navigation menu, click **Campaigns**.
3.  Select the **Personalization Funnel** tab.
4.  Toggle ON **Enable Personalization Funnel.**
5.  Begin uploading and creating content that highlights you in your referral funnel:

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-create-share-partner-campaign-links#customizable-pages)

Customizable pages
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-create-share-partner-campaign-links#landing-page)

Landing page

A top banner will be displayed at the top of your landing page, which can be customized. On the landing page, you can:

*   Upload a profile image or avatar
*   Add your name
*   Include your title
*   Add a testimonial or quote.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-create-share-partner-campaign-links#checkout-page)

Checkout page

The right side section on the checkout page can be designed for your personalized content, such as:

*   Up to three **Success Tips** (bullet points) can be added.
*   All landing page personalization options are also available:

All fields are mandatory before saving. This ensures a complete, polished experience for your audience. Currently, you may customize two campaigns:

*   **Free 30-Day Trial**
*   **Kajabi Homepage**

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-create-share-partner-campaign-links#what-your-audience-will-see)

What your audience will see
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Your personalized content will appear:

*   At the top of your landing page banner
*   In the right section of the checkout page

This creates a cohesive, branded experience for your referrals.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-create-share-partner-campaign-links#campaign-stats)

Campaign stats
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

When you click into a campaign, for example, “Kajabi Homepage”, you will be taken to a detailed view that breaks down the performance of each individual campaign link associated with it. At the top, you’ll see the same summary-style metrics as the main dashboard, specific to that campaign:

*   Total Clicks
*   Trialing Referrals
*   Active Referrals
*   Lifetime Earnings

This gives you a glance at how well that campaign is doing overall. ![Campaign Stats Overview](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/KcN1Ave2wqokJV1G/articles/images/6279aa9d_how-to-create-share-partner-campaign-links-google-docs.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=KcN1Ave2wqokJV1G&q=85&s=ce0753f7e235ab0426f3a2344112f627) Below that, there’s a breakdown of all the custom links created under this campaign. Each row includes:

*   **Link Title:** what you named the link (e.g., “Facebook group” or “Instagram post”).
*   **Clicks:** how many times that specific link has been clicked.
*   **Trials:** how many trial sign-ups it generated.
*   **Activated:** the number of users who became active referrals.
*   **Link Icon:** for quickly accessing or copying the URL.
*   **(⋯):** an option to edit the title of a link.

![Campaign Links Breakdown](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/s8LUOsnVLY_yN3xs/articles/images/e505bc46_how-to-create-share-partner-campaign-links-google-docs_1.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=s8LUOsnVLY_yN3xs&q=85&s=aa170f53d265617be8242c5bd2178d66) You can export the data of a specific campaign by clicking on **Export** in the top right corner: ![Export Campaign Data](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/WDcixStsKF83F9nW/articles/images/490f976d_how-to-create-share-partner-campaign-links-google-docs_2.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=WDcixStsKF83F9nW&q=85&s=6ec3b1c016ef9d1ae274338b0fdc71d2)

# Partner Payout Report and Partner Transaction Report - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/partner-payout-report-partner-transaction-report#content-area)

The **Partner Payout Report** and **Partner Transaction Report** give you complete transparency into your Partner earnings. Use them to review monthly payout summaries and drill down into the details of individual transactions.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/partner-payout-report-partner-transaction-report#payout-report-overview)

Payout Report overview
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

There are 2 reports related to your Partner payout information:

1.  **Payout Report:** Provides a summary of monthly earnings, including payout dates and the status of each month’s earnings.
2.  **Transaction Report:** Offers a detailed view of all successful transactions for a specific month.

These reports are designed to help you track your progress, understand the status of each payout, and build confidence in the payout process.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/partner-payout-report-partner-transaction-report#access-the-payout-reports)

Access the Payout Reports
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Log in to your Kajabi Partner account.
2.  If you do not have a Kajabi account, log in [here](https://kajabi.com/partnerprogram)
    
3.  Select **Payouts** from the main navigation menu.

Within the Payouts section, you’ll find:

*   The **Payout Report** with summary tiles and a monthly summary table.
*   By clicking into a specific month you will see the **Transaction Report**.

Each report is designed for ease-of-use, with tooltips providing additional context for each statistic (e.g., “Next Payout” explains that payouts are issued on the 25th of each month for transactions from two months prior).

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/partner-payout-report-partner-transaction-report#payout-report)

Payout Report
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The Partner Payout Report summarizes your monthly earnings and payout statuses in an easy-to-read format.

**Note:** The Payouts tab only shows reports from February 2025 onward.

![Payout Report](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/ulOk3PjSKir43Xg0/articles/images/0b1b0064_hc-article-draft-partner-payout-report-partner-transaction-report-google-docs.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=ulOk3PjSKir43Xg0&q=85&s=4534ac9b91475a1fc897bc9bd51611ec)

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/partner-payout-report-partner-transaction-report#what-it-shows)

What it shows

The summary tiles include:

*   **Next payout** – Your next payout will be on \[Month\] 25th for transactions from \[Month\]. Payouts are paid 2 months in arrears. See terms for more details.
*   **This month so far** – The sum of your earnings for \[current month\] that are yet to be finalized. Earnings are paid out 2 months in arrears.
*   **Last month** – The sum of your earnings from \[month\] that are yet to be finalized. Earnings are paid out 2 months in arrears.
*   **Lifetime earnings** – The total amount of earnings you have been paid out for by Kajabi.

Each month’s summary includes:

*   **Transaction Month:** The month during which the transactions occurred.
*   **Payout Date:** The scheduled date when payouts are processed (typically the 25th of the month).
*   **Total Transactions:** The number of qualifying transactions for that month.
*   **Tier & Commission:** Your current tier and the total commission earned.
*   **Status:** The payout status for the month.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/partner-payout-report-partner-transaction-report#status-definitions)

Status definitions

The status of each month’s earnings can be one of the following:

*   **Pending:** Transactions are still in the mandatory waiting period and have not finalized.
*   **Holding Period:** Your Partner tier is locked, but the transaction waiting period hasn’t yet elapsed.
*   **Pending Payout:** The waiting period has cleared, and the payout is finalized but awaiting processing.
*   **Paid:** The payout has been successfully processed and sent.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/partner-payout-report-partner-transaction-report#transaction-report)

Transaction Report
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/partner-payout-report-partner-transaction-report#what-it-shows-2)

What it shows

For each transaction in a selected month, the report displays:

*   **Referral Name:** The name of the person who made the purchase.
*   **Transaction Date:** When the transaction occurred.
*   **Subscription Cost:** The cost of the referral’s subscription.
*   **Commission %:** Your commission percentage.
    *   Note that the commission percent is tied to your partner tier for the month that the transaction occurred.
*   **Commission Amount:** The dollar amount earned for that transaction.
*   **Status:** The current status of the transaction, which may be:
    *   **Pending:** The transaction is still within the mandatory waiting period.
    *   **Approved:** The waiting period has passed and the commission is confirmed.
    *   **Refunded:** The referral has received a full or partial refund.

**Note:** The report only includes successful, paid transactions from referrals who were active during that month. It does not display parked transactions or purchase amounts of Add-ons or Feature Limit Increases.

# Partner Terms and Services FAQs - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/updated-partner-terms-services-faqs#content-area)

The **Kajabi Partner Program Terms and Services** outline rules for commissions, advertising, and account status. Below are answers to common questions about how these terms affect you and your business.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/updated-partner-terms-services-faqs#faqs)

FAQs
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/updated-partner-terms-services-faqs#what-will-happen-to-my-existing-commissions-under-this-agreement)

What will happen to my existing commissions under this agreement?

You’ll still receive the commission through PayPal after the 60-day hold.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/updated-partner-terms-services-faqs#is-all-paid-advertising-now-off-limits-to-me-as-a-partner)

Is all paid advertising now off-limits to me as a partner?

No, you can still run paid ads under the agreement. But there are restrictions: You can’t link directly to any Kajabi-owned site. You also can’t run ads that include your direct partner link or use any Kajabi keywords. Here’s an example of a paid media campaign you could run: Sending paid traffic to your own page titled “How to choose the right online course platform for you” and including your Kajabi partner link inside that page.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/updated-partner-terms-services-faqs#so-if-i-have-a-blog-with-my-partner-link-on-it-can-i-still-run-ads-to-it)

So if I have a blog with my Partner link on it, can I still run ads to it?

Yes, as long as you’re not using Kajabi in the keywords and the page you’re running ads to is your own.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/updated-partner-terms-services-faqs#if-i-cancel-my-own-kajabi-account-can-i-still-get-commissions-as-a-partner-what-happens-if-i-cancel-and-reactivate)

If I cancel my own Kajabi account, can I still get commissions as a Partner? What happens if I cancel and reactivate?

No, you must maintain an active Kajabi account to make referrals and get commissions as a partner. If you cancel your account, you forfeit any further commissions. If you re-activate later, you’ll be starting from scratch as a Partner.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/updated-partner-terms-services-faqs#what-happens-if-one-of-my-active-referrals-cancels-their-account-and-then-signs-up-again-later)

What happens if one of my active referrals cancels their account and then signs up again later?

It depends on how they sign up. If your referral cancels and reactivates their existing account, you will get a commission. However, if your referral cancels and signs up with a new account you will not get the commission. To receive the commission for a referral that cancels and signs up with a new account, your referral will need to sign up with one of your Partner links again.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/updated-partner-terms-services-faqs#what-happens-if-one-of-my-active-referrals-is-past-due-on-their-kajabi-subscription-payments)

What happens if one of my active referrals is past due on their Kajabi subscription payments?

If there is a delay in a referral’s Kajabi subscription payment, there will also be a delay in the Partner commission.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/updated-partner-terms-services-faqs#what-are-the-specific-%E2%80%9Ckajabi-keywords%E2%80%9D-that-i-cannot-use-in-an-ad-campaign)

What are the specific “Kajabi Keywords” that I cannot use in an ad campaign?

You cannot use the word Kajabi when bidding for keywords. For example: “Kajabi courses” would not be allowed but “online course builder” would be.

# Create custom campaign links - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/creating-custom-campaign-links-as-a-kajabi-partner#content-area)

**Custom campaign links** drive traffic to any content you’ve created on your own website or any content Kajabi has published, from blog posts to webinars. You receive credit for any referrals who click your link and sign up for Kajabi within a 30-day period.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/creating-custom-campaign-links-as-a-kajabi-partner#how-do-custom-campaign-links-work)

How do custom campaign links work?
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Kajabi Partner Links (including custom campaign links) place a 30-day tracking cookie on the link clicker’s browser. This means that when someone clicks on your Partner link and signs up for Kajabi within 30 days of clicking the link, you will receive credit for the referral. Once the referral becomes a paying Hero, they are considered an “active referral.” As a Kajabi Partner, you will begin earning commissions for your Active Referrals.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/creating-custom-campaign-links-as-a-kajabi-partner#create-a-custom-campaign-link)

Create a custom campaign link
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/creating-custom-campaign-links-as-a-kajabi-partner#navigate-to-the-kajabi-partner-dashboard)

Navigate to the Kajabi Partner Dashboard

1.  From the Kajabi Dashboard, click your account icon in the top right corner.
2.  Select **Partner Program** to open the Kajabi Partner Dashboard.
    *   If you do not have a Kajabi account, log in [here](https://kajabi.com/partnerprogram)
        
3.  In your Partner Dashboard, navigate to **Campaigns** in the left side bar.
4.  Click the **Create a campaign** button.
5.  Locate the **Custom Campaign** card.
6.  Click **Create Campaign**.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/creating-custom-campaign-links-as-a-kajabi-partner#create-the-custom-campaign-link)

Create the custom campaign link

To create a custom campaign link:

*   Give it a title. A great title to use for a Custom Campaign would be the URL’s Page Name. For example, if you were to generate a Custom Campaign from a blog post URL, use the title of the blog post.
*   Copy and paste the URL you’d like to use for your Custom Campaign.
*   Next, title the link you’re generating for your Custom Campaign. You can re-use this campaign’s title, or if you plan on promoting the link in different places or channels, we suggest adding the channel’s name to the link’s title. That way, you can create additional links for each channel under this campaign and see which channel is converting best.

![Creating custom campaign links](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/4xb7Z9X_ecGbjk3p/articles/images/5e2c80d6_creating-custom-campaign-links-as-a-kajabi-partner-google-docs.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=4xb7Z9X_ecGbjk3p&q=85&s=9fee9479637416708eaad965aad31a86) Once you’ve completed the Custom Campaign Link form, Kajabi will take the URL you inputted and generate a URL that has your 30-day tracking cookie attached for you to go out and share. A custom campaign link might look like this:

    https://app.kajabi.com/r/abcD3FGHi/t/jklmnopq
    

**Note:** Although your custom campaign link may be formatted to look similar to the link above, it will still direct your visitors to the URL you input. Test your custom campaign link by copying and pasting it into your browser to confirm that it leads to the correct page.

# Create a development site in the Partner Dashboard - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-create-a-development-site-in-your-partner-dashboard#content-area)

**Development sites** give Kajabi Partners a free space to experiment with features, build templates, and demo potential client solutions, all without affecting a live site. Sites remain in development until transferred to the Hero who will own them. Use development sites to:

*   **Build Client Prototypes**: Create mockups or templates to share with leads.
*   **Test New Features**: Try out platform updates before using them on client sites.
*   **Develop Efficient Workflows**: Build and refine your internal processes.

**Note:** You will not be able to collect contacts or emails, access the branded app, analytics, or creator studio, or sell products from a development site. You will also not be able to access certain settings.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-create-a-development-site-in-your-partner-dashboard#access-development-sites)

Access development sites
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Log in to your Kajabi Partner account.
2.  Select **Sites** from the navigation side menu.
3.  Click **Development** to view your Development sites.
4.  Click **Create** to create a development site.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-create-a-development-site-in-your-partner-dashboard#key-details)

Key details
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   **Free Access**: Development Sites are free for Partners and do not expire.
*   **No Selling**: These sites are for demo and development purposes only—selling products or collecting payments is not allowed.
*   **Status**:
    *   In Development: Currently building a site
    *   Pending: Sites that are waiting for the client to accept the site transfer. Once transferred, the site cannot be returned again.
    *   Transferred: Sites that have been successfully transferred to a client.
*   **Edit**: Use this button to instantly log into your development site. You will know it’s in development by a blue banner at the top.
*   **Request access or build site**: Use this button to build a site.
*   You can filter your list of client sites via In Development, Pending & Transferred.
*   You can also search by development site title as well.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-create-a-development-site-in-your-partner-dashboard#faqs)

FAQs
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-create-a-development-site-in-your-partner-dashboard#can-i-upgrade-a-development-site-to-a-full-kajabi-plan)

Can I upgrade a Development Site to a full Kajabi plan?

As a Kajabi Partner/Agency, you can transfer ownership to:

*   Clients who do not have a Kajabi account, however, they will have to create an account before they can accept the site transfer
*   Clients with a Kajabi account, but they will need to be within their plan limits

When a site transfer is initiated by a Kajabi Partner, the future owner of the site (aka your client) will receive an email with instructions to accept the transfer.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-partner-program/how-to-create-a-development-site-in-your-partner-dashboard#can-i-use-these-sites-to-run-my-own-business-or-sell-products)

Can I use these sites to run my own business or sell products?

No, Development Sites are strictly for demo and development purposes. Selling products is not permitted on those sites. Development sites can be/are built to be sold and transferred to clients.

Template Store
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The templates available in the Template Store are created and designed by Kajabi Experts to give you beautiful designs to engage your site visitors and customers. Every template in the Template Store is vetted and approved by Kajabi to ensure compatibility and safety on your site. Every template comes with an accompanying PDF with the resources needed and the template vendor’s contact information for your convenience.

To access the Template Store:

4.  Double-click the zip file to enter your download. This will populate another folder.
5.  Click into that folder to find the zip file you will upload into the customize section of your product on Kajabi:

Overview
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Have questions about the Template Store? Here are answers to frequently asked questions if you are purchasing a template.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-templates/template-customer-faqs#faqs)

FAQs
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-templates/template-customer-faqs#how-do-i-upload-my-template)

How do I upload my template?

[Learn to navigate the Template Store and upload your template](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-templates/how-to-use-kajabis-template-store-upload-your-template)
.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-templates/template-customer-faqs#do-i-need-to-know-how-to-code-to-install-a-template)

Do I need to know how to code to install a template?

No, you do not need to know any coding. Simply upload the .zip file and make any edits as you would on a normal Kajabi page or product.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-templates/template-customer-faqs#how-will-i-get-the-template-to-upload-to-my-kajabi-site)

How will I get the template to upload to my Kajabi site?

When you purchase the template, you will be emailed with instructions on how to download the template.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-templates/template-customer-faqs#how-many-templates-can-i-purchase-for-my-kajabi-site)

How many templates can I purchase for my Kajabi site?

You can purchase as many templates as you wish to accomplish the look and feel of your desired Kajabi landing page, website, or product.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-templates/template-customer-faqs#who-do-i-contact-if-i-need-support-on-my-template)

Who do I contact if I need support on my template?

You can message the template developer from whom you purchased the template for additional support: ![Screenshot_2023-12-05_at_3_53_26 PM_png.png](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/kyPjiIL9ED6HYU81/images/launchbrightly/desktop-light-version-8-template-get-support-1781158541588.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=kyPjiIL9ED6HYU81&q=85&s=4d5da3d8517746d0c0db0711932ac5df)

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-templates/template-customer-faqs#will-there-be-additional-template-categories-released-in-the-future)

Will there be additional template categories released in the future?

Yes, as the Template Store continues to build its offerings, additional categories, such as funnels, bundles, and more, will be available.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-templates/template-customer-faqs#what-if-the-template-i-purchased-has-a-bug-or-needs-updating)

What if the template I purchased has a bug or needs updating?

You can message the template developer from whom you purchased the template for additional support.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-templates/template-customer-faqs#can-i-get-a-refund-on-a-website-template-i-purchased)

Can I get a refund on a website template I purchased?

No. Due to the digital nature of website templates, **all sales are final**. Once the template files have been delivered, refunds, exchanges, or cancellations cannot be offered.

# Create standout Template Store templates - Kajabi

> Documentation Index
> -------------------
> 
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: [/llms.txt](https://help.kajabi.com/llms.txt)
> 
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

[Skip to main content](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-templates/template-tips-for-template-developers#content-area)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-templates/template-tips-for-template-developers#overview)

Overview
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Providing templates in the Template Store? These tips help you create templates that stand out, meet approval criteria, and deliver real value to the Heroes who use them.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-templates/template-tips-for-template-developers#understand-what-heroes-look-for)

Understand what Heroes look for
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Heroes purchasing templates want a simple solution to their tough design challenges. Many know how they want their brands to look but cannot achieve it with their current level of design skills. This is where you come in.

**Note:** As a template provider, you are responsible for answering customer questions and fixing any bugs that may arise.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-templates/template-tips-for-template-developers#template-criteria)

Template criteria
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

When a template is submitted, the Approval team looks for the following requirements:

*   Template is uploadable
*   **Documentation link** - Include documentation within the template upload if your template needs extra instructions
*   Ability for video/audio upload
*   **Editor buttons** - Undo, redo, save, preview
*   Global settings
*   Image upload
*   Video/audio upload
*   Section/block reordering and cloning

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-templates/template-tips-for-template-developers#update-template-settings-information)

Update template settings information

1.  Open the Code Editor for your template type (e.g., Website, Landing, or Product Page). [Learn to access the Code Editor](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-access-the-code-editor)
    .
2.  Open the **Config** folder.
3.  Locate the **Theme Name**, **Author information**, **Documentation link**, and **Support URL** to update:

![template-tips-google-docs.png](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/qzToDq-sR9DK0LoF/articles/images/6c4f5582_upload_7870144513647227053.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=qzToDq-sR9DK0LoF&q=85&s=37709e77cefbaf5db2dfa035ef1359a4)

4.  Click **Save** to keep and apply your changes.

If you have additional materials, provide documentation to support the customer during the install of your template.

**Note:** Make sure that all images are royalty-free and you have the rights to use them within your template.

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-templates/template-tips-for-template-developers#template-type-requirements)

Template type requirements
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-templates/template-tips-for-template-developers#website)

Website

If you are providing a Website template, ensure that your template includes the following:

*   Ability to add website pages
*   Page navigation
*   Pages that show as System or Draft/Published

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-templates/template-tips-for-template-developers#product)

Product

If you are providing a Product template, ensure that your template includes the following:

*   Page navigation
*   Library navigation
*   User settings navigation

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-templates/template-tips-for-template-developers#third-party-theme-upgrade-via-zip)

Third-party theme upgrade via zip
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Note:** This feature is currently in beta and is being tested by a select group of Heroes. If you have questions or concerns about this feature, reach out to [support@kajabi.com](mailto:support@kajabi.com)
.

This feature allows Heroes who have purchased third-party themes to update their themes with .zip files you provide, without reinstalling or copying over settings via the Code Editor. The following guidelines outline how this feature works:

*   Any custom code installed through the [Kajabi Code Editor](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/website/pages/how-to-access-the-code-editor)
     will not be copied over
*   Any custom code installed through the Kajabi Builder will be copied over
*   Any settings in .json, such as fonts, style guides, etc. will be copied over
*   Any previous changes to sections and blocks will be copied over
*   Ensure you upload the same theme file, or your file may be corrupted. For example, upload the same website theme, landing page theme, etc. for updates. Do not mix and match these files.

**Note:** If you are currently using the standard theme update process to let customers who purchased your themes update them, you do not need to change your workflow.

Follow the naming convention best practices below to enable Heroes who have purchased your theme to update their themes.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-templates/template-tips-for-template-developers#configure-your-theme-file-for-update-from-zip)

Configure your theme file for update from zip

To trigger the Update from Zip feature, use the guidelines below for two key elements stored in the settings\_schema.json portion of your theme file. The combination of correct “theme\_name” and “theme\_version” triggers the update from zip UI for your customers.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-templates/template-tips-for-template-developers#theme_name)

theme\_name

If you want to trigger an upload from zip UI, do not use the following names in your “theme\_name” in the settings\_schema.json file of the theme. **Website:**

*   Encore
*   Premier

**Product:**

*   Momentum
*   Premier
*   Lagunita
*   Warren
*   Taylor
*   Mist
*   Classic
*   Dive
*   Derby
*   Primo
*   Slate
*   Next

**Landing Page:**

*   Encore
*   Premier

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-templates/template-tips-for-template-developers#theme_version)

theme\_version

If you want to trigger an upload from zip UI, use the following naming rules for “theme\_version”:

*   **Landing Pages** - Text + Your Version Number (do not use version numbers listed below)
*   **Web** - Text + Your Version Number (do not use version numbers listed below)
*   **Product** - Text + Your Version Number (do not use version numbers listed below)

These are the rules as they relate to “theme\_version” that are used for showing the internal theme update flow. If you want your theme to show the update from zip flow, make sure your theme _does not_ satisfy these rules: **Website:**

*   Encore - “0.4.0”, “0.4.1”, “1.0.0”, “1.0.0-gm”, “1.0.1”, “1.1.0”, “1.1.1”, “1.1.2”,“1.1.3”, “1.2.0”, “1.2.1”,“1.3.0”, “1.3.1”,“1.3.2”,“1.3.3”, “1.4.0”,“1.4.2”, “1.4.3”,“1.0.0-GM”,“1.5.0”,“1.5.1”,“1.5.3”, “1.5.4”, “1.5.5”, “1.5.6”, “1.6.0”, “1.7.0”
*   Premier - “6.1.4”, “6.2.0”

**Product:**

*   Momentum - “6.1.1”, “6.1.2”, “6.1.3”, “6.1.4”, “6.2.0”, “6.3.0”, “6.4.0”, “6.5.0”, “6.5.1”, “6.5.2”, “6.6.0”, “6.6.1”
*   Premier - “7.0.0”, “7.1.0”, “7.2.0”, “7.3.0”, “7.4.0”, “7.4.1”, “7.5.0”

**Landing Page:**

*   Premier - “6.1.3”, “6.2.0”
*   Encore - “1.2.4”, “2.0.0”, “2.0.1”, “2.0.2”, “2.0.3”, “2.1.0”, “2.3.0”, “2.3.1”, “2.3.2”, “2.3.3”, “2.4.0”, “2.4.2”, “2.4.3”, “2.5.3”, “2.5.5”, “2.6.0”, “2.7.0”

If your current theme\_versions do not include any text, that is ok. Just make sure that your theme version does not fall within the range of version numbers outlined above.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-templates/template-tips-for-template-developers#examples-of-theme_name-and-theme_version-combinations)

Examples of theme\_name and theme\_version combinations

**Example 1 Web: Triggers Update from Zip**

*   Theme\_name: Custom Theme
*   Version\_number: 2.1.1

Why: The theme\_name does not match an existing canonical **Example 2 Web: Triggers Update from Zip**

*   Theme\_name: Encore
*   Version\_number: Custom Name 1.7.0

Why: The theme\_version does not match an expected version number based on theme\_name **Example 3 Web: Triggers Standard Update Flow**

*   Theme\_name: Encore
*   Version\_number: 1.7.0

Why: The theme\_version and theme\_name matches an expected version number and theme\_name for this theme type (web). **Example 4 Web: Triggers Update from Zip**

*   Theme\_name: Momentum
*   Version\_number: 1.7.0

Why: The theme\_name does not match an expected theme\_name for this theme type. Momentum is an expected Product theme, not a web theme.

### 

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-templates/template-tips-for-template-developers#user-experience-and-entry-points)

User experience and entry points

If a theme is named correctly using the above naming rules, the following UI will show: If a theme is not named correctly and includes a Kajabi internal “theme\_name” and a recognized “version\_number”, the standard upgrade flow will be shown. Using Kajabi internal “theme name” for theme upgrades is not recommended unless you are only selling presets of existing Kajabi themes without any additional code or enhancements. ![3p-theme-upgrade-via-zip-google-docs.png](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/i8Bc_j6-cGyNbKX6/articles/images/cc874e18_31053773844379.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=i8Bc_j6-cGyNbKX6&q=85&s=5b8e4c6bc3c123c5470b9b5e210e0738) The entry points that your customers use to access this feature are the same as before; however, the logic outlined above dictates which of the two update UIs are shown. **Landing Pages:** ![3p-theme-upgrade-via-zip-landing.png](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/vZwjLDvOZJMn-nsK/articles/images/2eb32fa4_31053798593435.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=vZwjLDvOZJMn-nsK&q=85&s=07128b91149baea7f0ac7baa7a26664a) **Website:** ![3p-theme-upgrade-via-zip-website.png](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/qeZsMFDNFsOwklNU/articles/images/8ac72a0e_31053773847835.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=qeZsMFDNFsOwklNU&q=85&s=f6a3d65da5b40b1a65378e3c3b08dfd2) **Product:** ![3p-theme-upgrade-via-zip-product.png](https://mintcdn.com/kajabi-support/3C7Vui-NnfT9lLL-/articles/images/d1b8909f_31053773850395.png?w=2500&fit=max&auto=format&n=3C7Vui-NnfT9lLL-&q=85&s=14b6359135f8f3b961982352b87c8ac9)

[​](https://help.kajabi.com/articles/resources/kajabi-templates/template-tips-for-template-developers#tips-to-make-templates-stand-out)

Tips to make templates stand out
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Create based on the customer’s aesthetic:

*   Feminine
*   Fitness
*   Masculine
*   Business
*   Real Estate
*   Memberships

Create specific pages:

*   Link in bio pages
*   Sales pages for specific sales goals/events
*   Community pages
*   Coming Soon pages
*   Media pages
